liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 9

sūta uvāca
ālasyaṃ prathamaṃ paścādvyādhipīḍā prajāyate  |
pramādaḥ saṃśayasthāne cittasyehānavasthitiḥ  || 1,9.1 ||
aśraddhādarśanaṃ bhrāntirduḥkhaṃ ca trividhaṃ tataḥ  |
daurmanasyamayogyeṣu viṣayeṣu ca yogyatā  || 1,9.2 ||
daśadhābhiprajāyante muneryogāntarāyakāḥ  |
ālasyaṃ cāpravṛttiśca gurutvātkāyacittayoḥ  || 1,9.3 ||
vyādhayo dhātuvaiṣamyātkarmajā doṣajāstathā  |
pramādastu samādhestu sādhanānāmabhāvanam  || 1,9.4 ||
idaṃ vetyubhayaspṛktaṃ vijñānaṃ sthānasaṃśayaḥ  |
anavasthitacittatvamapratiṣṭhā hi yoginaḥ  || 1,9.5 ||
labdhāyāmapi bhūmau ca cittasya bhavabandhanāt |
aśraddhābhāvarahitā vṛttirvai sādhaneṣu ca  || 1,9.6 ||
sādhye cittasya hi gurau jñānācāraśivādiṣu  |
viparyayajñānamiti bhrāntidarśanamucyate  || 1,9.7 ||
anātmanyātmavijñānamajñānāttasya saṃnidhau  |
duḥkhamādhyātmikaṃ proktaṃ tathā caivādhibhautikam  || 1,9.8 ||
ādhidaivikamityuktaṃ trividhaṃ sahajaṃ punaḥ  |
icchāvighātātsaṃkṣobhaścetasastadudāhṛtam  || 1,9.9 ||
daurmanasyaṃ niroddhavyaṃ vairāgyeṇa pareṇa tu  |
tamasā rajasā caiva saṃspṛṣṭaṃ durmanaḥ smṛtam  || 1,9.10 ||
tadā manasi saṃjātaṃ daurmanasyamiti smṛtam  |
haṭhātsvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yogyāyogyavivekataḥ  || 1,9.11 ||
viṣayeṣu vicitreṣu jantorviṣayalolatā  |
antarāyā iti khyātā yogasyaite hi yoginām  || 1,9.12 ||
atyantotsāhayuktasya naśyanti na ca saṃśayaḥ  |
pranaṣṭeṣvantarāyeṣu dvijāḥ paścāddhi yoginaḥ  || 1,9.13 ||
upasargāḥ pravartante sarve te'siddhisūcakāḥ  |
pratibhā prathamā siddhirdvitīyā śravaṇā smṛtā  || 1,9.14 ||
vārttā tṛtīyā viprendrāsturīyā ceha darśanā  |
āsvādā pañcamī proktā vedanā ṣaṣṭhikā smṛtā  || 1,9.15 ||
svalpaṣaṭsiddhisaṃtyāgātsiddhidāḥ siddhayo muneḥ  |
pratibhā pratibhāvṛtiḥ pratibhāva iti sthitiḥ  || 1,9.16 ||
buddhirvivecanā vedyaṃ budhyate buddhirucyate  |
sūkṣme vyavahite'tīte viprakṛṣṭe tvanāgate  || 1,9.17 ||
sarvatra sarvadā jñānaṃ pratibhānukrameṇa tu  |
śravaṇātsarvaśabdānāmaprayatnena yoginaḥ  || 1,9.18 ||
hrasvadīrghaplutādīnāṃ guhyānāṃ śravaṇādapi  |
sparśasyādhigamo yastu vedanā tūpapāditā  || 1,9.19 ||
darśanāddivyarūpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāprayatnataḥ  |
saṃviddivyarase tasminnāsvādo hyaprayatnataḥ  || 1,9.20 ||
vārttā ca divyagandhānāṃ tanmātrā buddhisaṃvidā  |
vindante yoginastasmādābrahmabhuvanaṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,9.21 ||
jagatyasmin hi dehasthaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ samam  |
aupasargikameteṣu guṇeṣu guṇitaṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,9.22 ||
saṃtyājyaṃ sarvathā sarvamaupasargikamātmanaḥ  |
paiśāce pārthivaṃ cāpyaṃ rākṣasānāṃ pure dvijāḥ  || 1,9.23 ||
yākṣe tu taijasaṃ proktaṃ gāndharve śvasanātmakam  |
aindre vyomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ saumye caiva tu mānasam  || 1,9.24 ||
prājāpatye tvahaṅkāraṃ brāhme bodhamanuttamam  |
ādye cāṣṭau dvitīye ca tathā ṣoḍaśarūpakam  || 1,9.25 ||
caturviṃśattṛtīye tu dvātriṃśacca caturthake  |
catvāriṃśatpañcame tu bhūtamātrātmakaṃ smṛtam  || 1,9.26 ||
gandho rasastathā rūpaṃ śabdaḥ sparśastathaiva ca  |
pratyekamaṣṭadhā siddhaṃ pañcame tacchatakratoḥ  || 1,9.27 ||
tathāṣṭacatvāriṃśacca ṣaṭpañcāśattathaiva ca  |
catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ brāhmaṃ labhate dvijasattamāḥ  || 1,9.28 ||
aupasargikamā brahma bhuvaneṣu parityajet |
lokeṣvālokya yogena yogavitparamaṃ sukham  || 1,9.29 ||
sthūlatā hrasvatā bālyaṃ vārdhakyaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā  |
nānājātisvarūpaṃ ca caturbhirdehadhāraṇam  || 1,9.30 ||
pārthivāṃśaṃ vinā nityaṃ surabhirgandhasaṃyutaḥ  |
etadaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktamaiśvaryaṃ pārthivaṃ mahat || 1,9.31 ||
jale nivasanaṃ yadvadbhūmyāmiva vinirgamaḥ  |
icchecchaktaḥ svayaṃ pātuṃ samudramapi nāturaḥ  || 1,9.32 ||
yatrecchati jagatyasmiṃstatrāsya jaladarśanam  |
yadyadvastu samādāya bhoktumicchati kāmataḥ  || 1,9.33 ||
tattadrasānvitaṃ tasya trayāṇāṃ dehadhāraṇam  |
bhāṇḍaṃ vinātha hastena jalapiṇḍasya dhāraṇam  || 1,9.34 ||
avraṇatvaṃ śarīrasya pārthivena samanvitam  |
etatṣoḍaśakaṃ proktamāpyamaiśvaryamuttamam  || 1,9.35 ||
dehādagnivinirmāṇaṃ tattāpabhayavarjitam  |
lokaṃ dagdhamapīhānyadadagdhaṃ svavidhānataḥ  || 1,9.36 ||
jalamadhye hutavahaṃ cādhāya parirakṣaṇam  |
agninigrahaṇaṃ haste smṛtimātreṇa cāgamaḥ  || 1,9.37 ||
bhasmībhūtavinirmāṇaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ sakāmataḥ  |
dvābhyāṃ rūpaviniṣpattirvinā taistribhirātmanaḥ  || 1,9.38 ||
caturviṃśātmakaṃ hyetattaijasaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  |
manogatitvaṃ bhūtānāmantarnivasanaṃ tathā  || 1,9.39 ||
parvatādimahābhāra skandhenodvahanaṃ punaḥ  |
laghutvaṃ ca gurutvaṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ vāyudhāraṇam  || 1,9.40 ||
aṅgulyagranighātena bhūmeḥ sarvatra kaṃpanam  |
ekena dehaniṣpattirvātaiśvaryaṃ smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ  || 1,9.41 ||
chāyāvihīnaniṣpattirindriyāṇāṃ ca darśanam  |
ākāśagamanaṃ nityamindriyārthaiḥ samanvitam  || 1,9.42 ||
dūre ca śabdagrahaṇaṃ sarvaśabdāvagāhanam  |
tanmātraliṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvaprāṇinidarśanam  || 1,9.43 ||
aindramaiśvaryamityuktametairuktaḥ purātanaḥ  |
yathākāmopalabdhiśca yathākāmavinirgamaḥ  || 1,9.44 ||
sarvatrābhibhavaścaiva sarvaguhyanidarśanam  |
kāmānurūpanirmāṇaṃ vaśitvaṃ priyadarśanam  || 1,9.45 ||
saṃsāradarśanaṃ caiva mānasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam  |
chedanaṃ tāḍanaṃ bandhaṃ saṃsāraparivartanam  || 1,9.46 ||
sarvabhūtaprasādaśca mṛtyukālajayastathā  |
prājāpatyamidaṃ proktamāhaṅkārikamuttamam  || 1,9.47 ||
akāraṇajagatsṛṣṭistathānugraha eva ca  |
pralayaścādhikāraśca lokavṛttapravartanam  || 1,9.48 ||
asādṛśyamidaṃ vyaktaṃ nirmāṇaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak |
saṃsārasya ca kartṛtvaṃ brāhmametadanuttamam  || 1,9.49 ||
etāvattattvamityuktaṃ prādhānyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam  |
brahmaṇā tadguṇaṃ śakyaṃ vettumanyairna śakyate  || 1,9.50 ||
vidyate tatparaṃ śaivaṃ viṣṇunā nāvagamyate  |
asaṃkhyeyaguṇaṃ śuddhaṃ ko jānīyācchivātmakam  || 1,9.51 ||
vyutthāne siddhayaścaitā hyupasargāśca kīrtitāḥ  |
niroddhavyāḥ prayatnena vairāgyeṇa pareṇa tu  || 1,9.52 ||
nāśātiśayatāṃ jñātvā viṣayeṣu bhayeṣu ca  |
aśraddhayā tyajetsarvaṃ virakta iti kīrtitaḥ  || 1,9.53 ||
vaitṛṣṇyaṃ puruṣe khyātaṃ guṇavaitṛṣṇyamucyate  |
vairāgyeṇaiva saṃtyājyāḥ siddhayaścaupasargikāḥ  || 1,9.54 ||
aupasargikamā brahma bhuvaneṣu parityajet |
nirudhyaiva tyajetsarvaṃ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ  || 1,9.55 ||
prasanne vimalā muktirvairāgyeṇa pareṇa vai  |
athavānugrahārthaṃ ca līlārthaṃ vā tadā muniḥ  || 1,9.56 ||
anirudhya viceṣṭedyaḥ so'pyevaṃ hi sukhī bhavet |
kvacidbhūmiṃ parityajya hyākāśe krīḍate śriyā  || 1,9.57 ||
udgirecca kvacidvedān sūkṣmānarthān samāsataḥ  |
kvacicchrute tadarthena ślokabandhaṃ karoti saḥ  || 1,9.58 ||
kvaciddaṇḍakabandhaṃ tu kuryādbandhaṃ sahasraśaḥ  |
mṛgapakṣisamūhasya rutajñānaṃ ca vindati  || 1,9.59 ||
brahmādyaṃ sthāvarāntaṃ ca hastāmalakavadbhavet |
bahunātra kimuktena vijñānāni sahasraśaḥ  || 1,9.60 ||
utpadyante muniśreṣṭhā munestasya mahātmanaḥ  |
abhyāsenaiva vijñānaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca sthiraṃ bhavet || 1,9.61 ||
tejorūpāṇi sarvāṇi sarvaṃ paśyati yogavit |
devabimbānyanekāni vimānāni sahasraśaḥ  || 1,9.62 ||
paśyati brahmaviṣṇvindra yamāgnivaruṇādikān  |
grahanakṣatratārāśca bhuvanāni sahasraśaḥ  || 1,9.63 ||
pātālatalasaṃsthāśca samādhisthaḥ sa paśyati  |
ātmavidyāpradīpena svasthenācalanena tu  || 1,9.64 ||
prasādāmṛtapūrṇena sattvapātrasthitena tu  |
tamo nihatya puruṣaḥ paśyati hyātmanīśvaram  || 1,9.65 ||
tasya prasādāddharmaśca aiśvaryaṃ jñānameva ca  |
vairāgyamapavargaśca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,9.66 ||
na śakyo vistaro vaktuṃ varṣāṇāmayutairapi  |
yoge pāśupate niṣṭhā sthātavyaṃ ca munīśvarāḥ  || 1,9.67 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 10

sūta uvāca
satāṃ jitātmanāṃ sākṣāddvijātīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
dharmajñānāṃ ca sādhūnāmācāryāṇāṃ śivātmanām  || 1,10.1 ||
dayāvatāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāstathā caiva tapasvinām  |
saṃnyāsināṃ viraktānāṃ jñānināṃ vaśagātmanām  || 1,10.2 ||
dānināṃ caiva dāntānāṃ trayāṇāṃ satyavādinām  |
alubdhānāṃ sayogānāṃ śrutismṛtividāṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,10.3 ||
śrautasmārtāviruddhānāṃ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ  |
saditi brahmaṇaḥ śabdastadante ye labhantyuta  || 1,10.4 ||
sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo yāti tena santaḥ pracakṣate  |
daśātmake ye viṣaye sādhane cāṣṭalakṣaṇe  || 1,10.5 ||
na krudhyanti na hṛṣyanti jitātmānastu te smṛtāḥ  |
sāmānyeṣu ca dravyeṣu tathā vaiśeṣikeṣu ca  || 1,10.6 ||
brahmakṣatraviśo yasmādyuktāstasmāddvijātayaḥ  |
varṇāśrameṣu yuktasya svargādisukhakāriṇaḥ  || 1,10.7 ||
śrautasmārtasya dharmasya jñānāddharmajña ucyate  |
vidyāyāḥ sādhanātsādhu brahmacārī gurorhitaḥ  || 1,10.8 ||
kriyāṇāṃ sādhanāccaiva gṛhasthaḥ sādhurucyate  |
sādhanāttapaso'raṇye sādhurvaikhānasaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,10.9 ||
yatamāno yatiḥ sādhuḥ smṛto yogasya sādhanāt |
evamāśramadharmāṇāṃ sādhanātsādhavaḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,10.10 ||
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho yatistathā  |
dharmādharmāviha proktau śabdāvetau kriyātmakau  || 1,10.11 ||
kuśalākuśalaṃ karma dharmādharmāviti smṛtau  |
dhāraṇārthe mahān hyeṣa dharmaśabdaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  || 1,10.12 ||
adhāraṇe mahattve ca adharma iti cocyate  |
atreṣṭaprāpako dharma ācāryairupadiśyate  || 1,10.13 ||
adharmaścāniṣṭaphalo hyācāryairupadiśyate  |
vṛddhāścālolupāścaiva ātmavanto hyadāmbhikāḥ  || 1,10.14 ||
samyagvinītā ṛjavastānācāryān pracakṣate  |
svayamācarate yasmādācāre sthāpayatyapi  || 1,10.15 ||
ācinoti ca śāstrārthānācāryastena cocyate  |
vijñeyaṃ śravaṇācchrautaṃ smaraṇātsmārtamucyate  || 1,10.16 ||
ijyā vedātmakaṃ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ varṇāśramātmakam  |
dṛṣṭvānurūpamarthaṃ yaḥ pṛṣṭo naivāpi gūhati  || 1,10.17 ||
yathādṛṣṭapravādastu satyaṃ laiṅge'tra paṭhyate  |
brahmacaryaṃ tathā maunaṃ nirāhāratvameva ca  || 1,10.18 ||
ahiṃsā sarvataḥ śāntistapa ityabhidhīyate  |
ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu yo hitāyāhitāya ca  || 1,10.19 ||
vartate tvasakṛdvṛttiḥ kṛtsnā hyeṣā dayā smṛtā  |
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ dravyaṃ nyāyenaivāgataṃ kramāt || 1,10.20 ||
tattadguṇavate deyaṃ dātustaddānalakṣaṇam  |
dānaṃ trividhamityetatkaniṣṭhajyeṣṭhamadhyamam  || 1,10.21 ||
kāruṇyātsarvabhūtebhyaḥ saṃvibhāgastu madhyamaḥ  |
śrutismṛtibhyāṃ vihito dharmo varṇāśramātmakaḥ  || 1,10.22 ||
śiṣṭācārāviruddhaśca sa dharmaḥ sādhurucyate  |
māyākarmaphalatyāgī śivātmā parikīrtitaḥ  || 1,10.23 ||
nivṛttaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo yukto yogī prakīrtitaḥ  |
asakto bhayato yastu viṣayeṣu vicārya ca  || 1,10.24 ||
alubdhaḥ saṃyamī proktaḥ prārthito'pi samantataḥ  |
ātmārthaṃ vā parārthaṃ vā indriyāṇīha yasya vai  || 1,10.25 ||
na mithyā sampravartante śamasyaiva tu lakṣaṇam  |
anudvigno hyaniṣṭeṣu tatheṣṭānnābhinandati  || 1,10.26 ||
prītitāpaviṣādebhyo vinivṛttirviraktatā  |
saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaḥ kṛtānāmakṛtaiḥ saha  || 1,10.27 ||
kuśalākuśalānāṃ tu prahāṇaṃ nyāsa ucyate  |
avyaktādyaviśeṣānte vikāre'sminnacetane  || 1,10.28 ||
cetanācetanānyatva vijñānaṃ jñānamucyate  |
evaṃ tu jñānayuktasya śraddhāyuktasya śaṅkaraḥ  || 1,10.29 ||
prasīdati na saṃdeho dharmaścāyaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
kiṃ tu guhyatamaṃ vakṣye sarvatra parameśvare  || 1,10.30 ||
bhave bhaktirna saṃdehastayā yukto vimucyate  |
ayogyasyāpi bhagavān bhaktasya parameśvaraḥ  || 1,10.31 ||
prasīdati na saṃdeho nigṛhya vividhaṃ tamaḥ  |
jñānamadhyāpanaṃ homo dhyānaṃ yajñastapaḥ śrutam  || 1,10.32 ||
dānamadhyayanaṃ sarvaṃ bhavabhaktyai na saṃśayaḥ  |
cāndrāyaṇasahasraiśca prājāpatyaśataistathā  || 1,10.33 ||
māsopavāsaiścānyairvā bhaktirmunivarottamāḥ  |
abhaktā bhagavatyasmiṃlloke giriguhāśaye  || 1,10.34 ||
patanti cātmabhogārthaṃ bhakto bhāvena mucyate  |
bhaktānāṃ darśanādeva nṛṇāṃ svargādayo dvijāḥ  || 1,10.35 ||
na durlabhā na sandeho bhaktānāṃ kiṃ punastathā  |
brahmaviṣṇusurendrāṇāṃ tathānyeṣāmapi sthitiḥ  || 1,10.36 ||
bhaktyā eva munīnāṃ ca balasaubhāgyameva ca  |
bhavena ca tathā proktaṃ samprekṣyomāṃ pinākinā  || 1,10.37 ||
devyai devena madhuraṃ vārāṇasyāṃ purā dvijāḥ  |
avimukte samāsīnā rudreṇa paramātmanā  || 1,10.38 ||
rudrāṇī rudramāhedaṃ labdhvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm  |

śrīdevyuvāca
kena vaśyo mahādeva pūjyo dṛśyastvamīśvaraḥ  || 1,10.39 ||
tapasā vidyayā vāpi yogeneha vada prabho  |

sūta uvāca
niśamya vacanaṃ tasyāstathā hyālokya pārvatīm  || 1,10.40 ||
āha bālendutilakaḥ pūrṇenduvadanāṃ hasan  |
smṛtvātha menayā patnyā girergāṃ kathitāṃ purā  || 1,10.41 ||
cirakālasthitiṃ prekṣya girau devyā mahātmanaḥ  |
devi labdhā purī ramyā tvayā yatpraṣṭumarhasi  || 1,10.42 ||
sthānārthaṃ kathitaṃ mātrā vismṛteha vilāsini  |
purā pitāmahenāpi pṛṣṭaḥ praśnavatāṃ vare  || 1,10.43 ||
yathā tvayādya vai pṛṣṭo draṣṭuṃ brahmātmakaṃ tvaham  |
śvete śvetena varṇena dṛṣṭvā kalpe tu māṃ śubhe  || 1,10.44 ||
sadyojātaṃ tathā rakte raktaṃ vāmaṃ pitāmahaḥ  |
pīte tatpuruṣaṃ pītamaghore kṛṣṇamīśvaram  || 1,10.45 ||
īśānaṃ viśvarūpākhyo viśvarūpaṃ tadāha mām  || 1,10.46 ||

pitāmaha uvāca
vāma tatpuruṣāghora sadyojāta maheśvara  |
dṛṣṭo mayā tvaṃ gāyatryā devadeva maheśvara  |
kena vaśyo mahādeva dhyeyaḥ kutra ghṛṇānidhe  || 1,10.47 ||
dṛśyaḥ pūjyastathā devyā vaktumarhasi śaṅkara  |

śrībhagavānuvāca
avocaṃ śraddhayaiveti vaśyo vārijasaṃbhava  || 1,10.48 ||
dhyeyo liṅge tvayā dṛṣṭe viṣṇunā payasāṃ nidhau  |
pūjyaḥ pañcāsyarūpeṇa pavitraiḥ pañcabhirdvijaiḥ  || 1,10.49 ||
bhava bhaktyādya dṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayāṇḍaja jagadguro  |
so'pi māmāha bhāvārthaṃ dattaṃ tasmai mayā purā  || 1,10.50 ||
bhāvaṃ bhāvena deveśi dṛṣṭavānmāṃ hṛdīśvaram  |
tasmāttu śraddhayā vaśyo dṛśyaḥ śreṣṭhagireḥ sute  || 1,10.51 ||
pūjyo liṅge na saṃdehaḥ sarvadā śraddhayā dvijaiḥ  |
śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā jñānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ  || 1,10.52 ||
śraddhā svargaśca mokṣaśca dṛśyo'haṃ śraddhayā sadā  || 1,10.53 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 11

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ vai dṛṣṭavānbrahmā sadyojātaṃ maheśvaram  |
vāmadevaṃ mahātmānaṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam  || 1,11.1 ||
aghoraṃ ca tatheśānaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi  |

sūta uvāca
ekonatriṃśakaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ  || 1,11.2 ||
tasmiṃstatparamaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyāyato brahmaṇastadā  |
utpannastu śikhāyuktaḥ kumāraḥ śvetalohitaḥ  || 1,11.3 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaṃ śrīmān brahmā vai viśvatomukhaḥ  |
hṛdi kṛtvā mahātmānaṃ brahmarūpiṇamīśvaram  || 1,11.4 ||
sadyojātaṃ tato brahmā dhyānayogaparo'bhavat |
dhyānayogātparaṃ jñātvā vavande devamīśvaram  || 1,11.5 ||
sadyojātaṃ tato brahma brahma vai samacintayat |
tato'sya pārśvataḥ śvetāḥ prādurbhūtā mahāyaśāḥ  || 1,11.6 ||
sunando nandanaścaiva viśvanandopanandanau  |
śiṣyāste vai mahātmāno yaistadbrahma sadāvṛtam  || 1,11.7 ||
tasyāgre śvetavarṇābhaḥ śveto nāma mahāmuniḥ  |
vijajñe'tha mahātejāstasmājjajñe harastvasau  || 1,11.8 ||
tatra te munayaḥ sarve sadyojātaṃ maheśvaram  |
prapannāḥ parayā bhaktyā gṛṇanto brahma śāśvatam  || 1,11.9 ||
tasmādviśveśvaraṃ devaṃ ye prapadyanti vai dvijāḥ  |
prāṇāyāmaparā bhūtvā brahmatatparamānasāḥ  || 1,11.10 ||
te sarve pāpanirmuktā vimalā brahmavarcasaḥ  |
viṣṇulokamatikramya rudralokaṃ vrajanti te  || 1,11.11 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 12

sūta uvāca
tatastriṃśattamaḥ kalpo rakto nāma prakīrtitaḥ  |
brahmā yatra mahātejā raktavarṇamadhārayat || 1,12.1 ||
dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
prādurbhūto mahātejāḥ kumāro raktabhūṣaṇaḥ  || 1,12.2 ||
raktamālyāmbaradharo raktanetraḥ pratāpavān  |
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kumāraṃ raktavāsasam  || 1,12.3 ||
paraṃ dhyānaṃ samāśritya bubudhe devamīśvaram  |
sa taṃ praṇamya bhagavān brahmā paramayantritaḥ  || 1,12.4 ||
vāmadevaṃ tato brahmā brahma vai samacintayat |
tathā stuto mahādevo brahmaṇā parameśvaraḥ  || 1,12.5 ||
pratītahṛdayaḥ sarva idamāha pitāmaham  |
dhyāyatā putrakāmena yasmātte'haṃ pitāmaha  || 1,12.6 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ paramayā bhaktyā stutaśca brahmapūrvakam  |
tasmāddhyānabalaṃ prāpya kalpe kalpe prayatnataḥ  || 1,12.7 ||
vetsyase māṃ prasaṃkhyātaṃ lokadhātāramīśvaram  |
tatastasya mahātmānaścatvāraste kumārakāḥ  || 1,12.8 ||
saṃbabhūvurmahātmāno viśuddhā brahmavarcasaḥ  |
virajāśca vibāhuśca viśoko viśvabhāvanaḥ  || 1,12.9 ||
brahmaṇyā brahmaṇastulyā vīrā adhyavasāyinaḥ  |
raktāṃbaradharāḥ sarve raktamālyānulepanāḥ  || 1,12.10 ||
raktakuṅkumaliptāṅgā raktabhasmānulepanāḥ  |
tato varṣasahasrānte brahmatve'dhyavasāyinaḥ  || 1,12.11 ||
gṛṇantaśca mahātmāno brahma tadvāmadaivikam  |
anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 1,12.12 ||
dharmopadeśamakhilaṃ kṛtvā te brahmaṇaḥ priyāḥ  |
punareva mahādevaṃ praviṣṭā rudramavyayam  || 1,12.13 ||
ye'pi cānye dvijaśreṣṭhā yuñjānā vāmamīśvaram  |
prapaśyanti mahādevaṃ tadbhaktāstatparāyaṇāḥ  || 1,12.14 ||
te sarve pāpanirmuktā vimalā brahmacāriṇaḥ  |
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  || 1,12.15 ||



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 13

sūta uvāca
ekatriṃśattamaḥ kalpaḥ pītavāsā iti smṛtaḥ  |
brahmā yatra mahābhāgaḥ pītavāsā babhūva ha  || 1,13.1 ||
dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
prādurbhūto mahātejāḥ kumāraḥ pītavastradhṛk || 1,13.2 ||
pītagandhānuliptāṅgaḥ pītamālyāṃbaro yuvā  |
hemayajñopavītaśca pītoṣṇīṣo mahābhujaḥ  || 1,13.3 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhyānasaṃyukto brahmā lokamaheśvaram  |
manasā lokadhātāraṃ prapede śaraṇaṃ vibhum  || 1,13.4 ||
tato dhyānagatastatra brahmā māheśvarīṃ varām  |
gāṃ viśvarūpāṃ dadṛśe maheśvaramukhāccyutām  || 1,13.5 ||
catuṣpadāṃ caturvaktrāṃ caturhastāṃ catuḥstanīm  |
caturnetrāṃ catuḥśṛṅgīṃ caturdaṃṣṭrāṃ caturmukhīm  || 1,13.6 ||
dvātriṃśadguṇasaṃyuktāmīśvarīṃ sarvatomukhīm  |
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātejā mahādevīṃ maheśvarīm  || 1,13.7 ||
punarāha mahādevaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ  |
matiḥ smṛtirbuddhiriti gāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ  || 1,13.8 ||
ehyehīti mahādevi sātiṣṭhatprāñjalirvibhum  |
viśvamāvṛtya yogena jagatsarvaṃ vaśīkuru  || 1,13.9 ||
atha tāmāha deveśo rudrāṇī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi  |
brāhmaṇānāṃ hitārthāya paramārthā bhaviṣyasi  || 1,13.10 ||
tathaināṃ putrakāmasya dhyāyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
pradadau devadeveśaḥ catuṣpādāṃ jagadguruḥ  || 1,13.11 ||
tatastāṃ dhyānayogena viditvā parameśvarīm  |
brahmā lokaguroḥ so'tha pratipede maheśvarīm  || 1,13.12 ||
gāyatrīṃ tu tato raudrīṃ dhyātvā brahmānuyantritaḥ  |
ityetāṃ vaidikīṃ vidyāṃ raudrīṃ gāyatrīmīritām  || 1,13.13 ||
japitvā tu mahādevīṃ brahmā lokanamaskṛtām  |
prapannastu mahādevaṃ dhyānayuktena cetasā  || 1,13.14 ||
tatastasya mahādevo divyayogaṃ bahuśrutam  |
aiśvaryaṃ jñānasaṃpattiṃ vairāgyaṃ ca dadau prabhuḥ  || 1,13.15 ||
tato'sya pārśvato divyāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ kumārakāḥ  |
pītamālyāṃbaradharāḥ pītasraganulepanāḥ  || 1,13.16 ||
pītābhoṣṇīṣaśirasaḥ pītāsyāḥ pītamūrdhajāḥ  |
tato varṣasahasrānta uṣitvā vimalaujasaḥ  || 1,13.17 ||
yogātmānastapohlādāḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitaiṣiṇaḥ  |
dharmayogabalopetā munīnāṃ dīrghasattriṇām  || 1,13.18 ||
upadiśya mahāyogaṃ praviṣṭāste maheśvaram  |
evametena vidhinā ye prapannā maheśvaram  || 1,13.19 ||
anye'pi niyatātmāno dhyānayuktā jitendriyāḥ  |
te sarve pāpamutsṛjya vimalā brahmavarcasaḥ  || 1,13.20 ||
praviśanti mahādevaṃ rudraṃ te tvapunarbhavāḥ  || 1,13.21 ||


_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 14

sūta uvāca
tatastasmingate kalpe pītavarṇe svayaṃbhuvaḥ  |
punaranyaḥ pravṛttastu kalpo nāmnāsitastu saḥ  || 1,14.1 ||
ekārṇave tadā vṛtte divye varṣasahasrake  |
sraṣṭukāmaḥ prajā brahmā cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ  || 1,14.2 ||
tasya cintayamānasya putrakāmasya vai prabhoḥ  |
kṛṣṇaḥ samabhavadvarṇo dhyāyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,14.3 ||
athāpaśyanmahātejāḥ prādurbhūtaṃ kumārakam  |
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahāvīryaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā  || 1,14.4 ||
kṛṣṇāṃbaradharoṣṇīṣaṃ kṛṣṇayajñopavītinam  |
kṛṣṇena maulinā yuktaṃ kṛṣṇasraganulepanam  || 1,14.5 ||
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānamaghoraṃ ghoravikramam  |
vavande devadeveśamadbhutaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam  || 1,14.6 ||
prāṇāyāmaparaḥ śrīmān hṛdi kṛtvā maheśvaram  |
manasā dhyānuyuktena prapannastu tamīśvaram  || 1,14.7 ||
aghoraṃ tu tato brahmā brahmarūpaṃ vyacintayat |
tathā vai dhyāyamānasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,14.8 ||
pradadau darśanaṃ devo hyaghoro ghoravikramaḥ  |
athāsya pārśvataḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kṛṣṇasraganulepanāḥ  || 1,14.9 ||
catvārastu mahātmānaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ kumārakāḥ  |
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaśikhaścaiva kṛṣṇāsyaḥ kṛṣṇavastradhṛk || 1,14.10 ||
tato varṣasahasraṃ tu yogataḥ parameśvaram  |
upāsitvā mahāyogaṃ śiṣyebhyaḥ pradaduḥ punaḥ  || 1,14.11 ||
yogena yogasampannāḥ praviśya manasā śivam  |
amalaṃ nirguṇaṃ sthānaṃ praviṣṭā viśvamīśvaram  || 1,14.12 ||
evametena yogena ye'pi cānye manīṣiṇaḥ  |
cintayanti mahādevaṃ gantāro rudramavyayam  || 1,14.13 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 15

sūta uvāca
tatastasmin gate kalpe kṛṣṇavarṇe bhayānake  |
tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ brahmā taṃ brahmarūpiṇam  || 1,15.1 ||
anugṛhya tatastuṣṭo brahmāṇamavadaddharaḥ  |
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa saṃharāmi na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,15.2 ||
brahmahatyādikān ghorāṃstathānyānapi pātakān  |
hīnāṃścaiva mahābhāga tathaiva vividhānyapi  || 1,15.3 ||
upapātakamapyevaṃ tathā pāpāni suvrata  |
mānasāni sutīkṣṇāni vācikāni pitāmaha  || 1,15.4 ||
kāyikāni sumiśrāṇi tathā prāsaṃgikāni ca  |
buddhipūrvaṃ kṛtānyeva sahajāgantukāni ca  || 1,15.5 ||
mātṛdehotthitānyevaṃ pitṛdehe ca pātakam  |
saṃharāmi na saṃdehaḥ sarvaṃ pātakajaṃ vibho  || 1,15.6 ||
lakṣaṃ japtvā hyaghorebhyo brahmahā mucyate prabho  |
tadardhaṃ vācike vatsa tadardhaṃ mānase punaḥ  || 1,15.7 ||
caturguṇaṃ buddhipūrve krodhādaṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam  |
vīrahā lakṣamātreṇa bhrūṇahā koṭimabhyaset || 1,15.8 ||
mātṛhā niyutaṃ japtvā śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca strīghnaḥ pāpayuto naraḥ  || 1,15.9 ||
ayutāghoramabhyasya mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
surāpo lakṣamātreṇa buddhyābuddhyāpi vai prabho  || 1,15.10 ||
mucyate nātra saṃdehastadardhena ca vāruṇīm  |
asnātāśī sahasreṇa ajapī ca tathā dvijaḥ  || 1,15.11 ||
ahutāśī sahasreṇa adātā ca viśudhyati  |
brāhmaṇasvāpahartā ca svarṇasteyī narādhamaḥ  || 1,15.12 ||
niyutaṃ mānasaṃ japtvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
gurutalparato vāpi mātṛghno vā narādhamaḥ  || 1,15.13 ||
brahmaghnaśca japedevaṃ mānasaṃ vai pitāmaha  |
saṃparkātpāpināṃ pāpaṃ tatsamaṃ paribhāṣitam  || 1,15.14 ||
tathāpyayutamātreṇa pātakādvai pramucyate  |
saṃsargātpātakī lakṣaṃ japedvai mānasaṃ dhiyā  || 1,15.15 ||
upāṃśu yaccaturdhā vai vācikaṃ cāṣṭadhā japet |
pātakādardhameva syādupapātakināṃ smṛtam  || 1,15.16 ||
tadardhaṃ kevale pāpe nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ suvarṇasteyameva ca  || 1,15.17 ||
kṛtvā ca gurutalpaṃ ca pāpakṛdbrāhmaṇo yadi  |
rudragāyatriyā grāhyaṃ gomūtraṃ kāpilaṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,15.18 ||
gandhadvāreti tasyā vai gomayaṃ svasthamāharet |
tejo'si śuktamityājyaṃ kāpilaṃ saṃharedbudhaḥ  || 1,15.19 ||
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti cāharet |
gavyaṃ dadhi navaṃ sākṣātkāpilaṃ vai pitāmaha  || 1,15.20 ||
devasya tveti mantreṇa saṃgrahedvai kuśodakam  |
ekasthaṃ hemapātre vā kṛtvāghoreṇa rājate  || 1,15.21 ||
tāmre vā padmapātre vā pālāśe vā dale śubhe  |
sakūrcaṃ sarvaratnāḍhyaṃ kṣiptvā tatraiva kāñcanam  || 1,15.22 ||
japellakṣamaghorākhyaṃ hutvā caiva ghṛtādibhiḥ  |
ghṛtena caruṇā caiva samidbhiśca tilaistathā  || 1,15.23 ||
yavaiśca vrīhibhiścaiva juhuyādvai pṛthakpṛthak |
pratyekaṃ saptavāraṃ tu dravyālābhe ghṛtena tu  || 1,15.24 ||
hutvāghoreṇa deveśaṃ snātvāghoreṇa vai dvijāḥ  |
aṣṭadroṇaghṛtenaiva snāpya paścādviśodhya ca  || 1,15.25 ||
ahorātroṣitaḥ snātaḥ pibetkūrcaṃ śivāgrataḥ  |
brāhmaṃ brahmajapaṃ kuryādācamya ca yathāvidhi  || 1,15.26 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaghno'pi brahmahā bhrūṇahā tathā  |
vīrahā gurughātī ca mitraviśvāsaghātakaḥ  || 1,15.27 ||
steyī suvarṇasteyī ca gurutalparataḥ sadā  |
madyapo vṛṣalīsaktaḥ paradāravidharṣakaḥ  || 1,15.28 ||
brahmasvahā tathā goghno mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā  |
devapracyāvakaścaiva liṅgapradhvaṃsakastathā  || 1,15.29 ||
tathānyāni ca pāpāni mānasāni dvijo yadi  |
vācikāni tathānyāni kāyikāni sahasraśaḥ  || 1,15.30 ||
kṛtvā vimucyate sadyo janmāntaraśatairapi  |
etadrahasyaṃ kathitamaghoreśaprasaṃgataḥ  || 1,15.31 ||
tasmājjapeddvijo nityaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye  || 1,15.32 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 16

sūta uvāca
athānyo brahmaṇaḥ kalpo vartate munipuṅgavāḥ  |
viśvarūpa iti khyāto nāmataḥ paramādbhutaḥ  || 1,16.1 ||
vinivṛtte tu saṃhāre punaḥ sṛṣṭe carācare  |
brahmaṇaḥ putrakāmasya dhyāyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,16.2 ||
prādurbhūtā mahānādā viśvarūpā sarasvatī  |
viśvamālyāṃbaradharā viśvayajñopavītinī  || 1,16.3 ||
viśvoṣṇīṣā viśvagandhā viśvamātā mahoṣṭhikā  |
tathāvidhaṃ sa bhagavānīśānaṃ parameśvaram  || 1,16.4 ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam  |
atha taṃ manasā dhyātvā yuktātmā vai pitāmahaḥ  || 1,16.5 ||
vavande devamīśānaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvagaṃ prabhum  |
omīśāna namaste'stu mahādeva namo'stu te  || 1,16.6 ||
namo'stu sarvavidyānāmīśāna parameśvara  |
namo'stu sarvabhūtānāmīśāna vṛṣavāhana  || 1,16.7 ||
brahmaṇo'dhipate tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe brahmarūpiṇe  |
namo brahmādhipataye śivaṃ me'stu sadāśiva  || 1,16.8 ||
oṅkāramūrte deveśa sadyojāta namonamaḥ  |
prapadye tvāṃ prapanno'smi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ  || 1,16.9 ||
abhave ca bhave tubhyaṃ tathā nātibhave namaḥ  |
bhavodbhava bhaveśāna māṃ bhajasva mahādyute  || 1,16.10 ||
vāmadeva namastubhyaṃ jyeṣṭhāya varadāya ca  |
namo rudrāya kālāya kalanāya namo namaḥ  || 1,16.11 ||
namo vikaraṇāyaiva kālavarṇāya varṇine  |
balāya balināṃ nityaṃ sadā vikaraṇāya te  || 1,16.12 ||
balapramathanāyaiva baline brahmarūpiṇe  |
sarvabhūteśvareśāya bhūtānāṃ damanāya ca  || 1,16.13 ||
manonmanāya devāya namastubhyaṃ mahādyute  |
vāmadevāya vāmāya namastubhyaṃ mahātmane  || 1,16.14 ||
jyeṣṭhāya caiva śreṣṭhāya rudrāya varadāya ca  |
kālahantre namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ mahātmane  || 1,16.15 ||
iti stavena deveśaṃ nanāma vṛṣabhadhvajam  |
yaḥ paṭhetsakṛdeveha brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati  || 1,16.16 ||
śrāvayedvā dvijān śrāddhe sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  |
evaṃ dhyānagataṃ tatra praṇamantaṃ pitāmaham  || 1,16.17 ||
uvāca bhagavānīśaḥ prīto'haṃ te kimicchasi  |
tatastu praṇato bhūtvā vāgviśuddhaṃ maheśvaram  || 1,16.18 ||
uvāca bhagavān rudraṃ prītaṃ prītena cetasā  |
yadidaṃ viśvarūpaṃ te viśvagauḥ śreyasīśvarī  || 1,16.19 ||
etadveditumicchāmi yatheyaṃ parameśvara  |
kaiṣā bhagavatī devī catuṣpādā caturmukhī  || 1,16.20 ||
catuḥśṛṅgī caturvaktrā caturdaṃṣṭrā catuḥstanī  |
caturhastā caturnetrā viśvarūpā kathaṃ smṛtā  || 1,16.21 ||
kiṃnāmagotrā kasyeyaṃ kiṃvīryā cāpi karmataḥ  |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ  || 1,16.22 ||
prāha devavṛṣaṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ cātmasaṃbhavam  |
rahasyaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ pāvanaṃ puṣṭivardhanam  || 1,16.23 ||
śṛṇuṣvaitatparaṃ guhyamādisarge yathā tathā  |
evaṃ yo vartate kalpo viśvarūpastvasau mataḥ  || 1,16.24 ||
brahmasthānamidaṃ cāpi yatra prāptaṃ tvayā prabho  |
tvattaḥ parataraṃ deva viṣṇunā tatpadaṃ śubham  || 1,16.25 ||
vaikuṇṭhena viśuddhena mama vāmāṅgajena vā  |
tadāprabhṛti kalpaśca trayastriṃśattamo hyayam  || 1,16.26 ||
śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāmatītā ye svayaṃbhuvaḥ  |
purastāttava deveśa tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate  || 1,16.27 ||
ānandastu sa vijñeya ānandatve vyavasthitaḥ  |
māṇḍavyagotrastapasā mama putratvamāgataḥ  || 1,16.28 ||
tvayi yogaṃ ca sāṃkhyaṃ ca tapovidyāvidhikriyāḥ  |
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ dayā brahma ahiṃsā sanmatiḥ kṣamā  || 1,16.29 ||
dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ damaḥ śāntirvidyāvidyā matirdhṛtiḥ  |
kāntirnītiḥ prathā medhā lajjā dṛṣṭiḥ sarasvatī  || 1,16.30 ||
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kriyā caiva prasādaśca pratiṣṭhitāḥ  |
dvātriṃśatsuguṇā hyeṣā dvātriṃśākṣarasaṃjñayā  || 1,16.31 ||
prakṛtirvihitā brahmaṃstvatprasūtirmaheśvarī  |
viṣṇorbhagavataścāpi tathānyeṣāmapi prabho  || 1,16.32 ||
saiṣā bhagavatī devī matprasūtiḥ pratiṣṭhitā  |
caturmukhī jagadyoniḥ prakṛtirgauḥ pratiṣṭhitā  || 1,16.33 ||
gaurī māyā ca vidyā ca kṛṣṇā haimavatīti ca  |
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiścaiva yāmāhustattvacintakāḥ  || 1,16.34 ||
ajāmekāṃ lohitāṃ śuklakṛṣṇāṃ viśvaprajāṃ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpām  |
ajo'haṃ māṃ viddhi tāṃ viśvarūpaṃ gāyatrīṃ gāṃ viśvarūpāṃ hi buddhyā  || 1,16.35 ||
evamuktvā mahādevaḥ sasarja parameśvaraḥ  |
tataśca pārśvagā devyāḥ sarvarūpakumārakāḥ  || 1,16.36 ||
jaṭī muṇḍī śikhaṇḍī ca ardhamuṇḍaśca jajñire  |
tatastena yathoktena yogena sumahaujasaḥ  || 1,16.37 ||
divyavarṣasahasrānte upāsitvā maheśvaram  |
dharmopadeśamakhilaṃ kṛtvā yogamayaṃ dṛḍham  || 1,16.38 ||
śiṣṭāśca niyatātmānaḥ praviṣṭā rudramīśvaram  || 1,16.39 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 17

sūta uvāca
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaḥ sahyādīnāṃ samudbhavaḥ  |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā dvijottamān  || 1,17.1 ||
sa yāti brahmasāyujyaṃ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ  |

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ liṅgamabhūlliṅge samabhyarcyaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ  || 1,17.2 ||
kiṃ liṅgaṃ kastathā liṅgī sūta vaktumihārhasi  |

romaharṣaṇa uvāca
evaṃ devāśca ṛṣayaḥ praṇipatya pitāmaham  || 1,17.3 ||
apṛcchan bhagavaṃlliṅgaṃ kathamāsīditi svayam  |
liṅge maheśvaro rudraḥ samabhyarcyaḥ kathaṃ tviti  || 1,17.4 ||
kiṃ liṅgaṃ kastathā liṅgī so'pyāha ca pitāmahaḥ  |

pitāmaha uvāca
pradhānaṃ liṅgamākhyātaṃ liṅgī ca parameśvaraḥ  || 1,17.5 ||
rakṣārthamaṃbudhau mahyaṃ viṣṇostvāsītsurottamāḥ  |
vaimānike gate sarge janalokaṃ saharṣibhiḥ  || 1,17.6 ||
sthitikāle tadā pūrṇe tataḥ pratyāhṛte tathā  |
caturyugasahasrānte satyalokaṃ gate surāḥ  || 1,17.7 ||
vinādhipatyaṃ samatāṃ gate'nte brahmaṇo mama  |
śuṣke ca sthāvare sarve tvanāvṛṣṭyā ca sarvaśaḥ  || 1,17.8 ||
paśavo mānuṣā vṛkṣāḥ piśācāḥ piśitāśanāḥ  |
gandharvādyāḥ krameṇaiva nirdagdhā bhānubhānubhiḥ  || 1,17.9 ||
ekārṇave mahāghore tamobhūte samantataḥ  |
suṣvāpāṃbhasi yogātmā nirmalo nirupaplavaḥ  || 1,17.10 ||
sahasraśīrṣā viśvātmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadevabhavodbhavaḥ  || 1,17.11 ||
hiraṇyagarbho rajasā tamasā śaṅkaraḥ svayam  |
sattvena sarvago viṣṇuḥ sarvātmatve maheśvaraḥ  || 1,17.12 ||
kālātmā kālanābhastu śuklaḥ kṛṣṇastu nirguṇaḥ  |
nārāyaṇo mahābāhuḥ sarvātmā sadasanmayaḥ  || 1,17.13 ||
tathābhūtamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ paṅkajekṣaṇam  |
māyayā mohitastasya tamavocamamarṣitaḥ  || 1,17.14 ||
kastvaṃ vadeti hastena samutthāpya sanātanam  |
tadā hastaprahāreṇa tīvreṇa sa dṛḍhena tu  || 1,17.15 ||
prabuddho'hīyaśayanātsamāsīnaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vaśī  |
dadarśa nidrāviklinna nīrajāmalalocanaḥ  || 1,17.16 ||
māmagre saṃsthitaṃ bhāsā dhyāsito bhagavān hariḥ  |
āha cotthāya bhagavān hasanmāṃ madhuraṃ sakṛt || 1,17.17 ||
svāgataṃsvāgataṃ vatsa pitāmaha mahādyute  |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā smitapūrvaṃ surarṣabhāḥ  || 1,17.18 ||
rajasā baddhavairaśca tamavocaṃ janārdanam  |
bhāṣase vatsa vatseti sargasaṃhārakāraṇam  || 1,17.19 ||
māmihāntaḥsmitaṃ kṛtvā guruḥ śiṣyamivānagha  |
kartāraṃ jagatāṃ sākṣātprakṛteśca pravartakam  || 1,17.20 ||
sanātanamajaṃ viṣṇuṃ viriñciṃ viśvasaṃbhavam  |
viśvātmānaṃ vidhātāraṃ dhātāraṃ paṅkajekṣaṇam  || 1,17.21 ||
kimarthaṃ bhāṣase mohādvaktumarhasi satvaram  |
so'pi māmāha jagatāṃ kartāhamiti lokaya  || 1,17.22 ||
bhartā hartā bhavānaṅgādavatīrṇo mamāvyayāt |
vismṛto'si jagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam  || 1,17.23 ||
puruṣaṃ paramātmānaṃ puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam  |
viṣṇumacyutamīśānaṃ viśvasya prabhavodbhavam  || 1,17.24 ||
tavāparādho nāstyatra mama māyākṛtaṃ tvidam  |
śṛṇu satyaṃ caturvaktra sarvadeveśvaro hyayam  || 1,17.25 ||
kartā netā ca hartā ca na mayāsti samo vibhuḥ  |
ahameva paraṃ brahma paraṃ tattvaṃ pitāmaha  || 1,17.26 ||
ahameva paraṃ jyotiḥ paramātmā tvahaṃ vibhuḥ  |
yadyaddṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ jagatyasmiṃścarācaram  || 1,17.27 ||
tattadviddhi caturvaktra sarvaṃ manmayamityatha  |
mayā sṛṣṭaṃ purāvyaktaṃ caturviṃśatikaṃ svayam  || 1,17.28 ||
nityāntā hyaṇavo baddhāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ krodhodbhavādayaḥ  |
prasādāddhi bhavānaṇḍānyanekānīha līlayā  || 1,17.29 ||
sṛṣṭā buddhirmayā tasyāmahaṅkārastridhā tataḥ  |
tanmātrāpañcakaṃ tasmānmanaḥ ṣaṣṭhendriyāṇi ca  || 1,17.30 ||
ākāśādīni bhūtāni bhautikāni ca līlayā  |
ityuktavati tasmiṃśca mayi cāpi vacastathā  || 1,17.31 ||
āvayoścābhavadyuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam  |
pralayārṇavamadhye tu rajasā baddhavairayoḥ  || 1,17.32 ||
etasminnantare liṅgamabhavaccāvayoḥ puraḥ  |
vivādaśamanārthaṃ hi prabodhārthaṃ ca bhāsvaram  || 1,17.33 ||
jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam  |
kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktamādimadhyāntavarjitam  || 1,17.34 ||
anaupamyamanirdeśyamavyaktaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam  |
tasya jvālāsahasreṇa mohito bhagavān hariḥ  || 1,17.35 ||
mohitaṃ prāha māmatra parīkṣāvo'gnisaṃbhavam  |
adhogamiṣyāmyanala staṃbhasyānupamasya ca  || 1,17.36 ||
bhavānūrdhvaṃ prayatnena gantumarhasi satvaram  |
evaṃ vyāhṛtya viśvātmā svarūpamakarottadā  || 1,17.37 ||
vārāhamahamapyāśu haṃsatvaṃ prāptavānsurāḥ  |
tadāprabhṛti māmāhurhaṃsaṃ haṃso virāḍiti  || 1,17.38 ||
haṃsahaṃseti yo brūyānmāṃ haṃsaḥ sa bhaviṣyati  |
suśveto hyanalākṣaśca viśvataḥ pakṣasaṃyutaḥ  || 1,17.39 ||
mano'nilajavo bhūtvā gato'haṃ cordhvataḥ surāḥ  |
nārāyaṇo'pi viśvātmā nīlāñjanacayopamam  || 1,17.40 ||
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanamāyatam  |
meruparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ gauratīkṣṇāgradaṃṣṭriṇam  || 1,17.41 ||
kālādityasamābhāsaṃ dīrghaghoṇaṃ mahāsvaram  |
hrasvapādaṃ vicitrāṅgaṃ jaitraṃ dṛḍhamanaupamam  || 1,17.42 ||
vārāhamasitaṃ rūpamāsthāya gatavānadhaḥ  |
evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tvaranviṣṇuradhogataḥ  || 1,17.43 ||
nāpaśyadalpamapyasya mūlaṃ liṅgasya sūkaraḥ  |
tāvatkālaṃ gato hyūrdhvamahamapyarisūdanaḥ  || 1,17.44 ||
satvaraṃ sarvayatnena tasyāntaṃ jñātumicchayā  |
śrānto hyadṛṣṭvā tasyāntamahaṅkārādadhogataḥ  || 1,17.45 ||
tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāntaḥ saṃtrastalocanaḥ  |
sarvadevabhavastūrṇamutthitaḥ saḥ mahāvapuḥ  || 1,17.46 ||
samāgato mayā sārdhaṃ praṇipatya mahāmanāḥ  |
māyayā mohitaḥ śaṃbhostasthau saṃvignamānasaḥ  || 1,17.47 ||
pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvataścaiva cāgrataḥ parameśvaram  |
praṇipatya mayā sārdhaṃ sasmāra kimidaṃ tviti  || 1,17.48 ||
tadā samabhavattatra nādo vai śabdalakṣaṇaḥ  |
omomiti suraśreṣṭhāḥ suvyaktaḥ plutalakṣaṇaḥ  || 1,17.49 ||
kimidaṃ tviti saṃcintya mayā tiṣṭhanmahāsvanam  |
liṅgasya dakṣiṇe bhāge tadāpaśyatsanātanam  || 1,17.50 ||
ādyavarṇamakāraṃ tu ukāraṃ cottare tataḥ  |
makāraṃ madhyataścaiva nādāntaṃ tasya caumiti  || 1,17.51 ||
sūryamaṇḍalavaddṛṣṭvā varṇamādyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe  |
uttare pāvakaprakhyamukāraṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ  || 1,17.52 ||
śītāṃśumaṇḍalaprakhyaṃ makāraṃ madhyamaṃ tathā  |
tasyopari tadāpaśyacchuddhasphaṭikavatprabhum  || 1,17.53 ||
turīyātītamamṛtaṃ niṣkalaṃ nirupaplavam  |
nirdvandvaṃ kevalaṃ śūnyaṃ bāhyābhyantaravarjitam  || 1,17.54 ||
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ caiva sabāhyābhyantarasthitam  |
ādimadhyāntarahitamānandasyāpi kāraṇam  || 1,17.55 ||
mātrāstisrastvardhamātraṃ nādākhyaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam  |
ṛgyajuḥsāmavedā vai mātrārūpeṇa mādhavaḥ  || 1,17.56 ||
vedaśabdebhya eveśaṃ viśvātmānamacintayat |
tadābhavadṛṣirveda ṛṣeḥ sāratamaṃ śubham  || 1,17.57 ||
tenaiva ṛṣiṇā viṣṇurjñātavān parameśvaram  |

deva uvāca
cintayā rahito rudro vāco yanmanasā saha  || 1,17.58 ||
aprāpya taṃ nivartante vācyastvekākṣareṇa saḥ  |
ekākṣareṇa tadvācyamṛtaṃ paramakāraṇam  || 1,17.59 ||
satyamānandamamṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma parātparam  |
ekākṣarādakārākhyo bhagavānkanakāṇḍajaḥ  || 1,17.60 ||
ekākṣarādukārākhyo hariḥ paramakāraṇam  |
ekākṣarānmakārākhyo bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ  || 1,17.61 ||
sargakartā tvakārākhyo hyukārākhyastu mohakaḥ  |
makārākhyastayornityamanugrahakaro'bhavat || 1,17.62 ||
makārākhyo vibhurbījī hyakāro bījamucyate  |
ukārākhyo hariryoniḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ  || 1,17.63 ||
bījī ca bījaṃ tadyonirnādākhyaśca maheśvaraḥ  |
bījī vibhajya cātmānaṃ svecchayā tu vyavasthitaḥ  || 1,17.64 ||
asya liṅgādabhūdbījamakāro bījinaḥ prabhoḥ  |
ukārayonau nikṣiptamavardhata samantataḥ  || 1,17.65 ||
sauvarṇamabhavaccāṇḍamāveṣṭyādyaṃ tadakṣaram  |
anekābdaṃ tathā cāpsu divyamaṇḍaṃ vyavasthitam  || 1,17.66 ||
tato varṣasahasrānte dvidhā kṛtamajodbhavam  |
aṇḍamapsu sthitaṃ sākṣādādyākhyeneśvareṇa tu  || 1,17.67 ||
tasyāṇḍasya śubhaṃ haimaṃ kapālaṃ cordhvasaṃsthitam  |
jajñe yaddyaustadaparaṃ pṛthivī pañcalakṣaṇā  || 1,17.68 ||
tasmādaṇḍodbhavo jajñe tvakārākhyaścaturmukhaḥ  |
sa sraṣṭā sarvalokānāṃ sa eva trividhaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,17.69 ||
evamomomiti proktamityāhuryajuṣāṃ varāḥ  |
yajuṣāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā ṛcaḥ sāmāni sādaram  || 1,17.70 ||
evameva hare brahmannityāhuḥ śrutayastadā  |
tato vijñāya deveśaṃ yathāvacchrutisaṃbhavaiḥ  || 1,17.71 ||
mantrairmaheśvaraṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva sumahodayam  |
āvayoḥ stutisaṃtuṣṭo liṅge tasminnirañjanaḥ  || 1,17.72 ||
divyaṃ śabdamayaṃ rūpamāsthāya prahasan sthitaḥ  |
akārastasya mūrdhā tu lalāṭaṃ dīrghamucyate  || 1,17.73 ||
ikāro dakṣiṇaṃ netramīkāro vāmalocanam  |
ukāro dakṣiṇaṃ śrotramūkāro vāmamucyate  || 1,17.74 ||
ṛkāro dakṣiṇaṃ tasya kapolaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
vāmaṃ kapolam ṝkāro ḻa ḹ nāsāpuṭe ubhe  || 1,17.75 ||
ekāramoṣṭhamūrddhvaśca aikārastvadharo vibhoḥ  |
okāraśca tathaukāro dantapaṅktidvayaṃ kramāt || 1,17.76 ||
amastu tālunī tasya devadevasya dhīmataḥ  |
kādipañcākṣarāṇyasya pañca hastāni dakṣiṇe  || 1,17.77 ||
cādipañcākṣarāṇyevaṃ pañca hastāni vāmataḥ  |
ṭādipañcākṣaraṃ pādastādipañcākṣaraṃ tathā  || 1,17.78 ||
pakāramudaraṃ tasya phakāraḥ pārśvamucyate  |
bakāro vāmapārśvaṃ vai bhakāraṃ skandhamasya tat || 1,17.79 ||
makāraṃ hṛdayaṃ śaṃbhormahādevasya yoginaḥ  |
yakārādisakārāntaṃ vibhorvai sapta dhātavaḥ  || 1,17.80 ||
hakāra ātmarūpaṃ vai kṣakāraḥ krodha ucyate  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā umayā sārdhaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaram  || 1,17.81 ||
praṇamya bhagavān viṣṇuḥ punaścāpaśyadūrddhvataḥ  |
oṅkāraprabhavaṃ mantraṃ kalāpañcakasaṃyutam  || 1,17.82 ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ subhāṣṭatriṃśadakṣaram  |
medhākaramabhūdbhūyaḥ sarvadharmārthasādhakam  || 1,17.83 ||
gāyatrīprabhavaṃ mantraṃ haritaṃ vaśyakārakam  |
caturviṃśativarṇāḍhyaṃ catuṣkalamanuttamam  || 1,17.84 ||
atharvamasitaṃ mantraṃ kalāṣṭakasamāyutam  |
abhicārikamatyarthaṃ trayastriṃśacchubhākṣaram  || 1,17.85 ||
yajurvedasamāyuktaṃ pañcatriṃśacchubhākṣaram  |
kalāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ suśvetaṃ śāntikaṃ tathā  || 1,17.86 ||
trayodaśakalāyuktaṃ bālādyaiḥ saha lohitam  |
sāmodbhavaṃ jagatyādyaṃ vṛddhisaṃhārakāraṇam  || 1,17.87 ||
varṇāḥ ṣaḍadhikāḥ ṣaṣṭirasya mantravarasya tu  |
pañca mantrāṃstathā labdhvā jajāpa bhagavān hariḥ  || 1,17.88 ||
atha dṛṣṭvā kalāvarṇamṛgyajuḥsāmarūpiṇam  |
īśānamīśamukuṭaṃ puruṣāsyaṃ purātanam  || 1,17.89 ||
aghorahṛdayaṃ hṛdyaṃ vāmaguhyaṃ sadāśivam  |
sadyaḥ pādaṃ mahādevaṃ mahābhogīndrabhūṣaṇam  || 1,17.90 ||
viśvataḥ pādavadanaṃ viśvato'kṣikaraṃ śivam  |
brahmaṇo'dhipatiṃ sarga sthitisaṃhārakāraṇam  || 1,17.91 ||
tuṣṭāva punariṣṭābhirvāgbhirvaradamīśvaram  || 1,17.92 ||



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 18

viṣṇuruvāca
ekākṣarāya rudrāya akārāyātmarūpiṇe  |
ukārāyādidevāya vidyādehāya vai namaḥ  || 1,18.1 ||
tṛtīyāya makārāya śivāya paramātmane  |
sūryāgnisomavarṇāya yajamānāya vai namaḥ  || 1,18.2 ||
agnaye rudrarūpāya rudrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
śivāya śivamantrāya sadyojātāya vedhase  || 1,18.3 ||
vāmāya vāmadevāya varadāyāmṛtāya te  |
aghorāyātighorāya sadyojātāya raṃhase  || 1,18.4 ||
īśānāya śmaśānāya ativegāya vegine  |
namo'stu śrutipādāya ūrdhvaliṅgāya liṅgine  || 1,18.5 ||
hemaliṅgāya hemāya vāriliṅgāya cāṃbhase  |
śivāya śivaliṅgāya vyāpine vyomavyāpine  || 1,18.6 ||
vāyave vāyuvegāya namaste vāyuvyāpine  |
tejase tejasāṃ bhartre namastejo'dhivyāpine  || 1,18.7 ||
jalāya jalabhūtāya namaste jalavyāpine  |
pṛthivyai cāntarikṣāya pṛthivīvyāpine namaḥ  || 1,18.8 ||
śabdasparśasvarūpāya rasagandhāya gandhine  |
gaṇādhipataye tubhyaṃ guhyādguhyatamāya te  || 1,18.9 ||
anantāya virūpāya anantānāmayāya ca  |
śāśvatāya variṣṭhāya vārigarbhāya yogine  || 1,18.10 ||
saṃsthitāyāmbhasāṃ madhye āvayormadhyavarcase  |
goptre hartre sadā kartre nidhanāyeśvarāya ca  || 1,18.11 ||
acetanāya cintyāya cetanāyāsahāriṇe  |
arūpāya surūpāya anaṅgāyāṅgahāriṇe  || 1,18.12 ||
bhasmadigdhaśarīrāya bhānusomāgnihetave  |
śvetāya śvetavarṇāya tuhinādricarāya ca  || 1,18.13 ||
suśvetāya suvaktrāya namaḥ śvetaśikhāya ca  |
śvetāsyāya mahāsyāya namaste śvetalohita  || 1,18.14 ||
sutārāya viśiṣṭāya namo dundubhine hara  |
śatarūpavirūpāya namaḥ ketumate sadā  || 1,18.15 ||
ṛddhiśokaviśokāya pinākāya kapardine  |
vipāśāya supāśāya namaste pāśanāśine  || 1,18.16 ||
suhotrāya haviṣyāya subrahmaṇyāya sūriṇe  |
sumukhāya suvaktrāya durdamāya damāya ca  || 1,18.17 ||
kaṅkāya kaṅkarūpāya kaṅkaṇīkṛtapannaga  |
sanakāya namastubhyaṃ sanātana sanandana  || 1,18.18 ||
sanatkumārasāraṅgamāraṇāya mahātmane  |
lokākṣiṇe tridhāmāya namo virajase sadā  || 1,18.19 ||
śaṅkhapālāya śaṅkhāya rajase tamase namaḥ  |
sārasvatāya meghāya meghavāhana te namaḥ  || 1,18.20 ||
suvāhāya vivāhāya vivādavaradāya ca  |
namaḥ śivāya rudrāya pradhānāya namonamaḥ  || 1,18.21 ||
triguṇāya namastubhyaṃ caturvyūhātmane namaḥ  |
saṃsārāya namastubhyaṃ namaḥ saṃsārahetave  || 1,18.22 ||
mokṣāya mokṣarūpāya mokṣakartre namonamaḥ  |
ātmane ṛṣaye tubhyaṃ svāmine viṣṇave namaḥ  || 1,18.23 ||
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ nāgānāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
oṅkārāya namastubhyaṃ sarvajñāya namo namaḥ  || 1,18.24 ||
sarvāya ca namastubhyaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca  |
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya ādidevāya te namaḥ  || 1,18.25 ||
namo'stvajāya pataye prajānāṃ vyūhahetave  |
mahādevāya devānāmīśvarāya namo namaḥ  || 1,18.26 ||
śarvāya ca namastubhyaṃ satyāya śamanāya ca  |
brahmaṇe caiva bhūtānāṃ sarvajñāya namo namaḥ  || 1,18.27 ||
mahātmane namastubhyaṃ prajñārūpāya vai namaḥ  |
citaye citirūpāya smṛtirūpāya vai namaḥ  || 1,18.28 ||
jñānāya jñānagamyāya namaste saṃvide sadā  |
śikharāya namastubhyaṃ nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ  || 1,18.29 ||
ardhanārīśarīrāya avyaktāya namonamaḥ  |
ekādaśavibhedāya sthāṇave te namaḥ sadā  || 1,18.30 ||
namaḥ somāya sūryāya bhavāya bhavahāriṇe  |
yaśaskarāya devāya śaṅkarāyeśvarāya ca  || 1,18.31 ||
namo'ṃbikādhipataye umāyāḥ pataye namaḥ  |
hiraṇyabāhave tubhyaṃ namaste hemaretase  || 1,18.32 ||
nīlakeśāya vittāya śitikaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ  |
kapardine namastubhyaṃ nāgāṅgābharaṇāya ca  || 1,18.33 ||
vṛṣārūḍhāya sarvasya hartre kartre namonamaḥ  |
vīrarāmātirāmāya rāmanāthāya te vibho  || 1,18.34 ||
namo rājādhirājāya rājñāmadhigatāya te  |
namaḥ pālādhipataye pālāśākṛntate namaḥ  || 1,18.35 ||
namaḥ keyūrabhūṣāya gopate te namonamaḥ  |
namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya namo likucapāṇaye  || 1,18.36 ||
bhuvaneśāya devāya vedaśāstra namo'stu te  |
sāraṅgāya namastubhyaṃ rājahaṃsāya te namaḥ  || 1,18.37 ||
kanakāṅgadahārāya namaḥ sarpopavītine  |
sarpakuṇḍalamālāya kaṭisūtrīkṛtāhine  || 1,18.38 ||
vedagarbhāya garbhāya viśvagarbhāya te śiva  |

brahmovāca
virarāmeti saṃstutvā brahmaṇā sahito hariḥ  || 1,18.39 ||
etatstotravaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayedvāpi brāhmaṇān vedapāragān  || 1,18.40 ||
sa yāti brahmaṇo loke pāpakarmarato'pi vai  |
tasmājjapetpaṭhennityaṃ śrāvayedbrāhmaṇāñchubhān  || 1,18.41 ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ viṣṇunā paribhāṣitam  || 1,18.42 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 19

sūta uvāca
athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto'haṃ surasattamau  |
paśyatāṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ vimucyatām  || 1,19.1 ||
yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrābhyāṃ mama pūrvaṃ mahābalau  |
ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ  || 1,19.2 ||
vāme pārśve ca me viṣṇurviśvātmā hṛdayodbhavaḥ  |
prīto'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyagvaraṃ dadmi yathepsitam  || 1,19.3 ||
evamuktvā tu taṃ viṣṇuṃ karābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ  |
pasparśa subhagābhyāṃ tu kṛpayā tu kṛpānidhiḥ  || 1,19.4 ||
tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasā praṇipatya maheśvaram  |
prāha nārāyaṇo nāthaṃ liṅgasthaṃ liṅgavarjitam  || 1,19.5 ||
yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau  |
bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi cāvyabhicāriṇī  || 1,19.6 ||
devaḥ pradattavān devāḥ svātmanyavyabhicāriṇīm  |
brahmaṇe viṣṇave caiva śraddhāṃ śītāṃśubhūṣaṇaḥ  || 1,19.7 ||
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā punarnārāyaṇaḥ svayam  |
praṇipatya ca viśveśaṃ prāha mandataraṃ vaśī  || 1,19.8 ||
āvayordevadeveśa vivādamatiśobhanam  |
ihāgato bhavān yasmādvivādaśamanāya nau  || 1,19.9 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā punaḥ prāha haro harim  |
praṇipatya sthitaṃ mūrdhnā kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ smayan  || 1,19.10 ||

śrīmahādeva uvāca
pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartā tvaṃ dharaṇīpate  |
vatsa vatsa hare viṣṇo pālayaitaccarācaram  || 1,19.11 ||
tridhā bhinno hyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇubhavākhyayā  |
sargarakṣālayaguṇairniṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,19.12 ||
saṃmohaṃ tyaja bho viṣṇo pālayainaṃ pitāmaham  |
pādme bhaviṣyati sutaḥ kalpe tava pitāmahaḥ  || 1,19.13 ||
tadā drakṣyasi māṃ caivaṃ so'pi drakṣyati padmajaḥ  |
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata  || 1,19.14 ||
tadāprabhṛti lokeṣu liṅgārcā supratiṣṭhitā  |
liṅgavedī mahādevī liṅgaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ  || 1,19.15 ||
layanālliṅgamityuktaṃ tatraiva nikhilaṃ surāḥ  |
yastu laiṅgaṃ paṭhennityamākhyānaṃ liṅgasannidhau  || 1,19.16 ||
sa yāti śivatāṃ vipro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,19.17 ||

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 20

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ pādme purā kalpe brahmā padmodbhavo'bhavat |
bhavaṃ ca dṛṣṭavāṃstena brahmaṇā puruṣottamaḥ  || 1,20.1 ||
etatsarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa sāṃprataṃ vaktumarhasi  |

sūta uvāca
āsīdekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam  || 1,20.2 ||
madhye caikārṇave tasmin śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |
jīmūtābho'mbujākṣaśca kirīṭī śrīpatirhariḥ  || 1,20.3 ||
nārāyaṇamukhodgīrṇa sarvātmā puruṣottamaḥ  |
aṣṭabāhurmahāvakṣā lokānāṃ yonirucyate  || 1,20.4 ||
kimapyacintyaṃ yogātmā yogamāsthāya yogavit |
phaṇāsahasrakalitaṃ tamapratimavarcasam  || 1,20.5 ||
mahābhogapaterbhogaṃ sādhvāstīrya mahocchrayam  |
tasminmahati paryaṅke śete caikārṇave prabhuḥ  || 1,20.6 ||
evaṃ tatra śayānena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā  |
ātmārāmeṇa krīḍārthaṃ līlayākliṣṭakarmaṇā  || 1,20.7 ||
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ taruṇādityasannibham  |
vajradaṇḍaṃ mahotsedhaṃ nābhyāṃ sṛṣṭaṃ tu puṣkaram  || 1,20.8 ||
tasyaivaṃ krīḍamānasya samīpaṃ devamīḍhuṣaḥ  |
hemagarbhāṇḍajo brahmā rukmavarṇo hyatīndriyaḥ  || 1,20.9 ||
caturvaktro viśālākṣaḥ samāgamya yadṛcchayā  |
śriyā yuktena divyena suśubhena sugandhinā  || 1,20.10 ||
krīḍamānaṃ ca padmena dṛṣṭvā brahmā śubhekṣaṇam  |
savismayamathāgamya saumyasampannayā girā  || 1,20.11 ||
provāca ko bhavāñchete hyāśrito madhyamambhasām  |
atha tasyācyutaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇastu śubhaṃ vacaḥ  || 1,20.12 ||
udatiṣṭhata paryaṅkādvismayotphullalocanaḥ  |
pratyuvācottaraṃ caiva kalpe kalpe pratiśrayaḥ  || 1,20.13 ||
kartavyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ caiva kriyate yacca kiṃcana  |
dyaurantarikṣaṃ bhūścaiva paraṃ padamahaṃ bhuvaḥ  || 1,20.14 ||
tamevamuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ punarathābravīt |
kastvaṃ khalu samāyātaḥ samīpaṃ bhagavānkutaḥ  || 1,20.15 ||
kva vā bhūyaśca gantavyaṃ kaśca vā te pratiśrayaḥ  |
ko bhavān viśvamūrtirvai kartavyaṃ kiṃ ca te mayā  || 1,20.16 ||
evaṃ bruvantaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ  |
māyayā mohitaḥ śaṃbhoravijñāya janārdanam  || 1,20.17 ||
māyayā mohitaṃ devamavijñātaṃ mahātmanaḥ  |
yathā bhavāṃstathaivāhamādikartā prajāpatiḥ  || 1,20.18 ||
savismayaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ  |
anujñātaśca te nātha vaikuṇṭho viśvasaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,20.19 ||
kautūhalānmahāyogī praviṣṭo brahmaṇo mukham  |
imānaṣṭādaśa dvīpān sasamudrān saparvatān  || 1,20.20 ||
praviśya sumahātejāścāturvarṇyasamākulān  |
brahmaṇastambhaparyantaṃ saptalokān sanātanān  || 1,20.21 ||
brahmaṇastūdare dṛṣṭvā sarvānviṣṇurmahābhujaḥ  |
aho'sya tapaso vīryamityuktvā ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 1,20.22 ||
aṭitvā vividhāṃllokān viṣṇurnānāvidhāśrayān  |
tato varṣasahasrānte nāntaṃ hi dadṛśe yadā  || 1,20.23 ||
tadāsya vaktrānniṣkramya pannagendraniketanaḥ  |
nārāyaṇo jagaddhātā pitāmahamathābravīt || 1,20.24 ||
bhagavānādiraṅkaśca madhyaṃ kālo diśo nabhaḥ  |
nāhamantaṃ prapaśyāmi udarasya tavānagha  || 1,20.25 ||
evamuktvābravīdbhūyaḥ pitāmahamidaṃ hariḥ  |
bhagavānevamevāhaṃ śāśvataṃ hi mamodaram  || 1,20.26 ||
praviśya lokān paśyaitānanaupamyānsurottama  |
tataḥ prāhlādinīṃ vāṇīṃ śrutvā tasyābhinandya ca  || 1,20.27 ||
śrīpaterudaraṃ bhūyaḥ praviveśa pitāmahaḥ  |
tāneva lokān garbhasthānapaśyatsatyavikramaḥ  || 1,20.28 ||
paryaṭitvā tu devasya dadṛśe'ntaṃ na vai hareḥ  |
jñātvā gatiṃ tasya pitāmahasya dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pidhāya viṣṇuḥ  |
vibhurmanaḥ kartumiyeṣa cāśu sukhaṃ prasupto'hamiti pracintya  || 1,20.29 ||
tato dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pihitāni samīkṣya vai  |
sūkṣmaṃ kṛtvātmano rūpaṃ nābhyāṃ dvāramavindata  || 1,20.30 ||
padmasūtrānusāreṇa cānvapaśyatpitāmahaḥ  |
ujjahārātmano rūpaṃ puṣkarāccaturānanaḥ  || 1,20.31 ||
virarājāravindasthaḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ  |
brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavāñjagadyoniḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 1,20.32 ||
etasminnantare tābhyāmekaikasya tu kṛtsnaśaḥ  |
vartamāne tu saṃgharṣe madhye tasyārṇavasya tu  || 1,20.33 ||
kuto'pyaparimeyātmā bhūtānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ  |
śūlapāṇirmahādevo hemavīrāṃbaracchadaḥ  || 1,20.34 ||
agacchadyatra so'nanto nāgabhogapatirhariḥ  |
śīghraṃ vikramatastasya padbhyāmākrāntapīḍitāḥ  || 1,20.35 ||
udbhūtāstūrṇamākāśe pṛthulāstoyabindavaḥ  |
atyuṣṇaścātiśītaśca vāyustatra vavau punaḥ  || 1,20.36 ||
taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ brahmā viṣṇumabhāṣata  |
abbindavaśca śītoṣṇāḥ kampayantyaṃbujaṃ bhṛśam  || 1,20.37 ||
etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi kiṃ vā tvanyaccikīrṣasi  |
etadevaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ pitāmahamukhodgatam  || 1,20.38 ||
śrutvāpratimakarmā hi bhagavānasurāntakṛt |
kiṃ nu khalvatra me nābhyāṃ bhūtamanyatkṛtālayam  || 1,20.39 ||
vadati priyamatyarthaṃ manyuścāsya mayā kṛtaḥ  |
ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā pratyuvācedamuttaram  || 1,20.40 ||
kimatra bhagavānadya puṣkare jātasaṃbhramaḥ  |
kiṃ mayā ca kṛtaṃ deva yanmāṃ priyamanuttamam  || 1,20.41 ||
bhāṣase puruṣaśreṣṭha kimarthaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ  |
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ deveśaṃ lokayātrānugaṃ tataḥ  || 1,20.42 ||
pratyuvācāmbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā vedanidhiḥ prabhuḥ  |
yo'sau tavodaraṃ pūrvaṃ praviṣṭo'haṃ tvadicchayā  || 1,20.43 ||
yathā mamodare lokāḥ sarve dṛṣṭāstvayā prabho  |
tathaiva dṛṣṭāḥ kārtsnyena mayā lokāstavodare  || 1,20.44 ||
tato varṣasahasrāttu upāvṛttasya me'nagha  |
tvayā matsarabhāvena māṃ vaśīkartumicchatā  || 1,20.45 ||
āśu dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pihitāni samantataḥ  |
tato mayā mahābhāga saṃcintya svena tejasā  || 1,20.46 ||
labdho nābhipradeśena padmasūtrādvinirgamaḥ  |
mā bhūtte manaso'lpo'pi vyāghāto'yaṃ kathaṃcana  || 1,20.47 ||
ityeṣānugatirviṣṇo kāryāṇāmaupasarpiṇī  |
yanmayānantaraṃ kāryaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇyaham  || 1,20.48 ||
tataḥ paramameyātmā hiraṇyakaśipo ripuḥ  |
anavadyāṃ priyāmiṣṭāṃ śivāṃ vāṇīṃ pitāmahāt || 1,20.49 ||
śrutvā vigatamātsaryaṃ vākyamasmai dadau hariḥ  |
na hyevamīdṛśaṃ kāryaṃ mayādhyavasitaṃ tava  || 1,20.50 ||
tvāṃ bodhayitukāmena krīḍāpūrvaṃ yadṛcchayā  |
āśu dvārāṇi sarvāṇi ghāṭitāni mayātmanaḥ  || 1,20.51 ||
na te'nyathāvagantavyaṃ mānyaḥ pūjyaśca me bhavān  |
sarvaṃ marṣaya kalyāṇa yanmayāpakṛtaṃ tava  || 1,20.52 ||
asmānmayohyamānastvaṃ padmādavatara prabho  |
nāhaṃ bhavantaṃ śaknomi soḍhuṃ tejomayaṃ gurum  || 1,20.53 ||
sa hovāca varaṃ brūhi padmādavatara prabho  |
putro bhava mamārighna mudaṃ prāpsyasi śobhanām  || 1,20.54 ||
sadbhāvavacanaṃ brūhi padmādavatara prabho  |
sa tvaṃ ca no mahāyogī tvamīḍyaḥ praṇavātmakaḥ  || 1,20.55 ||
adyaprabhṛti sarveśaḥ śvetoṣṇīṣavibhūṣitaḥ  |
padmayoniriti hyevaṃ khyāto nāmnā bhaviṣyasi  || 1,20.56 ||
putro me tvaṃ bhava brahman saptalokādhipaḥ prabho  |
tataḥ sa bhagavāndevo varaṃ dattvā kirīṭine  || 1,20.57 ||
evaṃ bhavatu cetyuktvā prītātmā gatamatsaraḥ  |
pratyāsannamathāyāntaṃ bālārkābhaṃ mahānanam  || 1,20.58 ||
bhavamatyadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇamathābravīt |
aprameyo mahāvaktro daṃṣṭrī dhvastaśiroruhaḥ  || 1,20.59 ||
daśabāhustriśūlāṅko nayanairviśvataḥ sthitaḥ  |
lokaprabhuḥ svayaṃ sākṣādvikṛto muñjamekhalī  || 1,20.60 ||
meṇḍhreṇordhvena mahatā nardamāno'tibhairavam  |
kaḥ khalveṣa pumān viṣṇo tejorāśirmahādyutiḥ  || 1,20.61 ||
vyāpya sarvā diśo dyāṃ ca ita evābhivartate  |
tenaivamukto bhagavān viṣṇurbrahmāṇamabravīt || 1,20.62 ||
padbhyāṃ talanipātena yasya vikramato'rṇave  |
vegena mahatākāśe'pyutthitāśca jalaśayāḥ  || 1,20.63 ||
sthūlādbhirviśvato'tyarthaṃ sicyase padmasaṃbhava  |
ghrāṇajena ca vātena kampyamānaṃ tvayā saha  || 1,20.64 ||
dodhūyate mahāpadmaṃ svacchandaṃ mama nābhijam  |
samāgato bhavānīśo hyanādiścāntakṛtprabhuḥ  || 1,20.65 ||
bhavānahaṃ ca stotreṇa upatiṣṭhāva godhvajam  |
tataḥ kruddho'mbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā provāca keśavam  || 1,20.66 ||
bhavānna nūnamātmānaṃ vetti lokaprabhuṃ vibhum  |
brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāraṃ māṃ na vetsi sanātanam  || 1,20.67 ||
ko hyasau śaṅkaro nāma āvayorvyatiricyate  |
tasya tatkrodhajaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā harirabhāṣata  || 1,20.68 ||
mā maivaṃ vada kalyāṇa parivādaṃ mahātmanaḥ  |
mahāyogendhano dharmo durādharṣo varapradaḥ  || 1,20.69 ||
heturasyātha jagataḥ purāṇapuruṣo'vyayaḥ  |
bījī khalveṣa bījānāṃ jyotirekaḥ prakāśate  || 1,20.70 ||
bālakrīḍanakairdevaḥ krīḍate śaṅkaraḥ svayam  |
pradhānamavyayo yoniravyaktaṃ prakṛtistamaḥ  || 1,20.71 ||
mama caitāni nāmāni nityaṃ prasavadharmiṇaḥ  |
yaḥ kaḥ sa iti duḥkhārtairdṛśyate yatibhiḥ śivaḥ  || 1,20.72 ||
eṣa bījī bhavānbījamahaṃ yoniḥ sanātanaḥ  |
sa evamukto viśvātmā brahmā viṣṇumapṛcchata  || 1,20.73 ||
bhavān yonirahaṃ bījaṃ kathaṃ bījī maheśvaraḥ  |
etanme sūkṣmamavyaktaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi  || 1,20.74 ||
jñātvā ca vividhotpattiṃ brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ  |
imaṃ paramasādṛśyaṃ praśnamabhyavadaddhariḥ  || 1,20.75 ||
asmānmahattaraṃ bhūtaṃ guhyamanyanna vidyate  |
mahataḥ paramaṃ dhāma śivamadhyātmināṃ padam  || 1,20.76 ||
dvividhaṃ caivamātmānaṃ pravibhajya vyavasthitaḥ  |
niṣkalastatra yo'vyaktaḥ sakalaśca maheśvaraḥ  || 1,20.77 ||
yasya māyāvidhijñasya agamyagahanasya ca  |
purā liṅgodbhavaṃ bījaṃ prathamaṃ tvādisargikam  || 1,20.78 ||
mama yonau samāyuktaṃ tadbījaṃ kālaparyayāt |
hiraṇmayamakūpāre yonyāmaṇḍamajāyata  || 1,20.79 ||
śatāni daśa varṣāṇāmaṇḍamapsu pratiṣṭhitam  |
ante varṣasahasrasya vāyunā taddvidhā kṛtam  || 1,20.80 ||
kapālamekaṃ dyaurjajñe kapālamaparaṃ kṣitiḥ  |
ulbaṃ tasya mahotsedho yo'sau kanakaparvataḥ  || 1,20.81 ||
tataśca pratisaṃdhyātmā devadevo varaḥ prabhuḥ  |
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāṃstvabhijajñe caturmukhaḥ  || 1,20.82 ||
ā tārārkendunakṣatraṃ śūnyaṃ lokamavekṣya ca  |
ko'hamityapi ca dhyāte kumārāste'bhavaṃstadā  || 1,20.83 ||
priyadarśanāstu yatayo yatīnāṃ pūrvajāstava  |
bhūyo varṣasahasrānte tata evātmajāstava  || 1,20.84 ||
bhuvanānalasaṃkāśāḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ  |
śrīmānsanatkumāraśca ṛbhuścaivordhvaretasau  || 1,20.85 ||
sanakaḥ sanātanaścaiva tathaiva ca sanandanaḥ  |
utpannāḥ samakālaṃ te buddhyātīndriyadarśanāḥ  || 1,20.86 ||
utpannāḥ pratibhātmāno jagatāṃ sthitihetavaḥ  |
nārapsyante ca karmāṇi tāpatrayavivarjitāḥ  || 1,20.87 ||
alpasaukhyaṃ bahukleśaṃ jarāśokasamanvitam  |
jīvanaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva saṃbhavaśca punaḥ punaḥ  || 1,20.88 ||
alpabhūtaṃ sukhaṃ svarge duḥkhāni narake tathā  |
viditvā cāgamaṃ sarvamavaśyaṃ bhavitavyatām  || 1,20.89 ||
ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tava vaśe sthitau  |
trayastu trīn guṇān hitvā cātmajāḥ sanakādayaḥ  || 1,20.90 ||
vavartena tu jñānena pravṛttāste mahaujasaḥ  |
tatasteṣu pravṛtteṣu sanakādiṣu vai triṣu  || 1,20.91 ||
bhaviṣyasi vimūḍhastvaṃ māyayā śaṅkarasya tu  |
evaṃ kalpe tu vaivṛtte saṃjñā naśyati te'nagha  || 1,20.92 ||
kalpe śeṣāṇi bhūtāni sūkṣmāṇi pārthivāni ca  |
sarveṣāṃ hyaiśvarī māyā jāgṛtiḥ samudāhṛtā  || 1,20.93 ||
yathaiṣa parvato merurdevaloko hyudāhṛtaḥ  |
tasya cedaṃ hi māhātmyaṃ viddhi devavarasya ha  || 1,20.94 ||
jñātvā ceśvarasadbhāvaṃ jñātvā māmaṃbujekṣaṇam  |
mahādevaṃ mahābhūtaṃ bhūtānāṃ varadaṃ prabhum  || 1,20.95 ||
praṇavenātha sāmnā tu namaskṛtya jagadgurum  |
tvāṃ ca māṃ caiva saṃkruddho niḥśvāsānnirdahedayam  || 1,20.96 ||
evaṃ jñātvā mahāyogamabhyuttiṣṭhanmahābalam  |
ahaṃ tvāmagrataḥ kṛtvā stoṣyāmyanalasaprabham  || 1,20.97 ||

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 21

sūta uvāca
brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ sa garuḍadhvajaḥ  |
atītaiśca bhaviṣyaiśca vartamānaistathaiva ca  || 1,21.1 ||
nāmabhiśchāndasaiścaiva idaṃ stotramudīrayat |

viṣṇuruvāca
namastubhyaṃ bhagavate suvratānantatejase  || 1,21.2 ||
namaḥ kṣetrādhipataye bījine śūline namaḥ  |
sumeḍhrāyārcyameḍhrāya daṇḍine rūkṣaretase  || 1,21.3 ||
namo jyeṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāya pūrvāya prathamāya ca  |
namo mānyāya pūjyāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.4 ||
gahvarāya ghaṭeśāya vyomacīrāṃbarāya ca  |
namaste hyasmadādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.5 ||
vedānāṃ prabhave caiva smṛtīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
prabhave karmadānānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.6 ||
namo yogasya prabhave sāṃkhyasya prabhave namaḥ  |
namo dhruvanibaddhānāmṛṣīṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.7 ||
ṛkṣāṇāṃ prabhave tubhyaṃ grahāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
vaidyutāśanimeghānāṃ garjitaprabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.8 ||
mahodadhīnāṃ prabhave dvīpānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
adrīṇāṃ prabhave caiva varṣāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.9 ||
namo nadīnāṃ prabhave nadānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
mahauṣadhīnāṃ prabhave vṛkṣāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.10 ||
dharmavṛkṣāya dharmāya sthitīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
prabhave ca parārdhasya parasya prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.11 ||
namo rasānāṃ prabhave ratnānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
kṣaṇānāṃ prabhave caiva lavānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.12 ||
ahorātrārdhamāsānāṃ māsānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
ṛtūnāṃ prabhave tubhyaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.13 ||
prabhave cāparārdhasya parārdhaprabhave namaḥ  |
namaḥ purāṇaprabhave sargāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.14 ||
manvantarāṇāṃ prabhave yogasya prabhave namaḥ  |
caturvidhasya sargasya prabhave'nantacakṣuṣe  || 1,21.15 ||
kalpodayanibandhānāṃ vātānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  |
namo viśvasya prabhave brahmādhipataye namaḥ  || 1,21.16 ||
vidyānāṃ prabhave caiva vidyādhipataye namaḥ  |
namo vratādhipataye vratānāṃ prabhave namaḥ  || 1,21.17 ||
mantrāṇāṃ prabhave tubhyaṃ mantrādhipataye namaḥ  |
pitṝṇāṃ pataye caiva paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,21.18 ||
vāgvṛṣāya namastubhyaṃ purāṇavṛṣabhāya ca  |
namaḥ paśūnāṃ pataye govṛṣendradhvajāya ca  || 1,21.19 ||
prajāpatīnāṃ pataye siddhīnāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
daityadānavasaṃghānāṃ rakṣasāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,21.20 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ ca pataye yakṣāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
garuḍoragasarpāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,21.21 ||
sarvaguhyapiśācānāṃ guhyādhipataye namaḥ  |
gokarṇāya ca goptre ca śaṅkukarṇāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.22 ||
varāhāyāprameyāya ṛkṣāya virajāya ca  |
namaḥ surāṇāṃ pataye gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,21.23 ||
aṃbhasāṃ pataye caiva ojasāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
namo'stu lakṣmīpataye śrīpāya kṣitipāya ca  || 1,21.24 ||
balābalasamūhāya akṣobhyakṣobhaṇāya ca  |
dīptaśṛṅgaikaśṛṅgāya vṛṣabhāya kakudmine  || 1,21.25 ||
namaḥ sthairyāya vapuṣe tejasānuvratāya ca  |
atītāya bhaviṣyāya vartamānāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.26 ||
suvarcase ca vīryāya śūrāya hyajitāya ca  |
varadāya vareṇyāya puruṣāya mahātmane  || 1,21.27 ||
namo bhūtāya bhavyāya mahate prabhavāya ca  |
janāya ca namastubhyaṃ tapase varadāya ca  || 1,21.28 ||
aṇave mahate caiva namaḥ sarvagatāya ca  |
namo bandhāya mokṣāya svargāya narakāya ca  || 1,21.29 ||
namo bhavāya devāya ijyāya yājakāya ca  |
pratyudīrṇāya dīptāya tattvāyātiguṇāya ca  || 1,21.30 ||
namaḥ pāśāya śastrāya namastvābharaṇāya ca  |
hutāya upahūtāya prahutaprāśitāya ca  || 1,21.31 ||
namo'stviṣṭāya pūrtāya agniṣṭomadvijāya ca  |
sadasyāya namaścaiva dakṣiṇāvabhṛthāya ca  || 1,21.32 ||
ahiṃsāyāpralobhāya paśumantrauṣadhāya ca  |
namaḥ puṣṭipradānāya suśīlāya suśīline  || 1,21.33 ||
atītāya bhaviṣyāya vartamānāya te namaḥ  |
suvarcase ca vīryāya śūrāya hyajitāya ca  || 1,21.34 ||
varadāya vareṇyāya puruṣāya mahātmane  |
namo bhūtāya bhavyāya mahate cābhayāya ca  || 1,21.35 ||
jarāsiddha namastubhyamayase varadāya ca  |
adhare mahate caiva namaḥ sastupatāya ca  || 1,21.36 ||
namaścendriyapatrāṇāṃ lelihānāya sragviṇe  |
viśvāya viśvarūpāya viśvataḥ śirase namaḥ  || 1,21.37 ||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāya rudrāyāpratimāya ca  |
namo havyāya kavyāya havyavāhāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.38 ||
namaḥ siddhāya medhyāya iṣṭāyejyāparāya ca  |
suvīrāya sughorāya akṣobhyakṣobhaṇāya ca  || 1,21.39 ||
suprajāya sumedhāya dīptāya bhāskarāya ca  |
namo buddhāya śuddhāya vistṛtāya matāya ca  || 1,21.40 ||
namaḥ sthūlāya sūkṣmāya dṛśyādṛśyāya sarvaśaḥ  |
varṣate jvalate caiva vāyave śiśirāya ca  || 1,21.41 ||
namaste vakrakeśāya ūruvakṣaḥśikhāya ca  |
namo namaḥ suvarṇāya tapanīyanibhāya ca  || 1,21.42 ||
virūpākṣāya liṅgāya piṅgalāya mahaujase  |
vṛṣṭighnāya namaścaiva namaḥ saumyekṣaṇāya ca  || 1,21.43 ||
namo dhūmrāya śvetāya kṛṣṇāya lohitāya ca  |
piśitāya piśaṅgāya pītāya ca niṣaṅgiṇe  || 1,21.44 ||
namaste saviśeṣāya nirviśeṣāya vai namaḥ  |
nama ījyāya pūjyāya upajīvyāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.45 ||
namaḥ kṣemyāya vṛddhāya vatsalāya namonamaḥ  |
namo bhūtāya satyāya satyāsatyāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.46 ||
namo vai padmavarṇāya mṛtyughnāya ca mṛtyave  |
namo gaurāya śyāmāya kadrave lohitāya ca  || 1,21.47 ||
mahāsaṃdhyābhravarṇāya cārudīptāya dīkṣiṇe  |
namaḥ kamalahastāya digvāsāya kapardine  || 1,21.48 ||
apramāṇāya sarvāya avyayāyāmarāya ca  |
namo rūpāya gandhāya śāśvatāyākṣatāya ca  || 1,21.49 ||
purastādbṛṃhate caiva vibhrāntāya kṛtāya ca  |
durgamāya maheśāya krodhāya kapilāya ca  || 1,21.50 ||
tarkyātarkyaśarīrāya baline raṃhasāya ca  |
sikatyāya pravāhyāya sthitāya prasṛtāya ca  || 1,21.51 ||
sumedhase kulālāya namaste śaśikhaṇḍine  |
citrāya citraveṣāya citravarṇāya medhase  || 1,21.52 ||
cekitānāya tuṣṭāya namaste nihitāya ca  |
namaḥ kṣāntāya dāntāya vajrasaṃhananāya ca  || 1,21.53 ||
rakṣoghnāya viṣaghnāya śitikaṇṭhordhvamanyave  || 1,21.54 ||
lelihāya kṛtāntāya tigmāyudhadharāya ca  || 1,21.55 ||
pramodāya saṃmodāya yativedyāya te namaḥ  |
anāmayāya sarvāya mahākālāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.56 ||
praṇavapraṇaveśāya bhaganetrāntakāya ca  |
mṛgavyādhāya dakṣāya dakṣayajñāntakāya ca  || 1,21.57 ||
sarvabhūtātmabhūtāya sarveśātiśayāya ca  |
puraghnāya suśastrāya dhanvine'tha paraśvadhe  || 1,21.58 ||
pūṣadantavināśāya bhaganetrāntakāya ca  |
kāmadāya variṣṭhāya kāmāṅgadahanāya ca  || 1,21.59 ||
raṅge karālavaktrāya nāgendravadanāya ca  |
daityānāmantakeśāya daityākrandakarāya ca  || 1,21.60 ||
himaghnāya ca tīkṣṇāya ārdracarmadharāya ca  |
śmaśānaratinityāya namo'stūlmukadhāriṇe  || 1,21.61 ||
namaste prāṇapālāya muṇḍamālādharāya ca  |
prahīṇaśokairvividhairbhūtaiḥ parivṛtāya ca  || 1,21.62 ||
naranārīśarīrāya devyāḥ priyakarāya ca  |
jaṭine muṇḍine caiva vyālayajñopavītine  || 1,21.63 ||
namo'stu nṛtyaśīlāya upanṛtyapriyāya ca  |
manyave gītaśīlāya munibhirgāyate namaḥ  || 1,21.64 ||
kaṭakaṭāya tigmāya apriyāya priyāya ca  |
vibhīṣaṇāya bhīṣmāya bhagapramathanāya ca  || 1,21.65 ||
siddhasaṃghānugītāya mahābhāgāya vai namaḥ  |
namo muktāṭṭahāsāya kṣveḍitāsphoṭitāya ca  || 1,21.66 ||
nardate kūrdate caiva namaḥ pramuditātmane  |
namo mṛḍāya śvasate dhāvate'dhiṣṭhite namaḥ  || 1,21.67 ||
dhyāyate jṛmbhate caiva rudate dravate namaḥ  |
valgate krīḍate caiva lambodaraśarīriṇe  || 1,21.68 ||
namo'kṛtyāya kṛtyāya muṇḍāya kīkaṭāya ca  |
nama unmattadehāya kiṅkiṇīkāya vai namaḥ  || 1,21.69 ||
namo vikṛtaveṣāya krūrāyāmarṣaṇāya ca  |
aprameyāya goptre ca dīptāyānirguṇāya ca  || 1,21.70 ||
vāmapriyāya vāmāya cūḍāmaṇidharāya ca  |
namastokāya tanave guṇairapramitāya ca  || 1,21.71 ||
namo guṇyāya guhyāya agamyagamanāya ca  |
lokadhātrī tviyaṃ bhūmiḥ pādau sajjanasevitau  || 1,21.72 ||
sarveṣāṃ siddhiyogānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ tavodaram  |
madhye'ntarikṣaṃ vistīrṇaṃ tārāgaṇavibhūṣitam  || 1,21.73 ||
svāteḥ patha ivābhāti śrīmān hārastavorasi  |
diśo daśabhujāstubhyaṃ keyūrāṅgadabhūṣitāḥ  || 1,21.74 ||
vistīrṇapariṇāhaśca nīlāñjanacayopamaḥ  |
kaṇṭhaste śobhate śrīmān hemasūtravibhūṣitaḥ  || 1,21.75 ||
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣamanaupamyaṃ mukhaṃ tathā  |
padmamālākṛtoṣṇīṣaṃ śiro dyauḥ śobhate'dhikam  || 1,21.76 ||
dīptiḥ sūrye vapuścandre sthairyaṃ śaile'nile balam  |
auṣṇyamagnau tathā śaityamapsu śabdo'mbare tathā  || 1,21.77 ||
akṣarāntaraniṣpandādguṇānetānvidurbudhāḥ  |
japo japyo mahādevo mahāyogomaheśvaraḥ  || 1,21.78 ||
pureśayo guhāvāsī khecaro rajanīcaraḥ  |
taponidhirguhagururnandano nandavardhanaḥ  || 1,21.79 ||
hayaśīrṣā payodhātā vidhātā bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
boddhavyo bodhitā netā durdharṣo duṣprakampanaḥ  || 1,21.80 ||
bṛhadratho bhīmakarmā bṛhatkīrtirdhanañjayaḥ  |
ghaṇṭāpriyo dhvajī chattrī pinākī dhvajinīpatiḥ  || 1,21.81 ||
kavacī paṭṭiśī khaḍgī dhanurhastaḥ paraśvadhī  |
aghasmaro'naghaḥ śūro devarājo'rimardanaḥ  || 1,21.82 ||
tvāṃ prasādya purāsmābhirdviṣanto nihatā yudhi  |
agniḥ sadārṇavāṃbhastvaṃ pibannapi na tṛpyase  || 1,21.83 ||
krodhākāraḥ prasannātmā kāmadaḥ kāmagaḥ priyaḥ  |
brahmacāri cāgādhaśca brahmaṇyaḥ śiṣṭapūjitaḥ  || 1,21.84 ||
devānāmakṣayaḥ kośastvayā yajñaḥ prakalpitaḥ  |
havyaṃ tavedaṃ vahati vedoktaṃ havyavāhanaḥ  |
prīte tvayi mahādeva vayaṃ prītā bhavāmahe  || 1,21.85 ||
bhavānīśo'nādimāṃstvaṃ ca sarvalokānāṃ tvaṃ brahmakartādisargaḥ  |
sāṃkhyāḥ prakṛteḥ paramaṃ tvāṃ viditvā kṣīṇadhyānāstvāmamṛtyuṃ viśanti  || 1,21.86 ||
yogāśca tvāṃ dhyāyino nityasiddhaṃ jñātvā yogān saṃtyajante punastān  |
ye cāpyanye tvāṃ prasannā viśuddhāḥ svakarmabhiste divyabhogā bhavanti  || 1,21.87 ||
aprasaṃkhyeyatattvasya yathā vidmaḥ svaśaktitaḥ  |
kīrtitaṃ tava māhātmyamapārasya mahātmanaḥ  || 1,21.88 ||
śivo no bhava sarvatra yo'si so'si namo'stu te  |

sūta uvāca
ya idaṃ kīrtayedbhaktyā brahmanārāyaṇastavam  || 1,21.89 ||
śrāvayedvā dvijān vidvān śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ  |
aśvamedhāyutaṃ kṛtvā yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt || 1,21.90 ||
pāpācāro'pi yo martyaḥ śṛṇuyācchivasannidhau  |
japedvāpi vinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 1,21.91 ||
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye yajñe vāvabhṛthāntike  |
kīrtayedvā satāṃ madhye sa yāti brahmaṇo'ntikam  || 1,21.92 ||

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 22

sūta uvāca
atyantāvanatau dṛṣṭvā madhupiṅgāyatekṣaṇaḥ  |
prahṛṣṭavadano'tyarthamabhavatsatyakīrtanāt || 1,22.1 ||
umāpatirvirūpākṣo dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ  |
pinākī khaṇḍaparaśuḥ suprītastu trilocanaḥ  || 1,22.2 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavāndevaḥ śrutvā vāgamṛtaṃ tayoḥ  |
jānannapi mahādevaḥ krīḍāpūrvamathābravīt || 1,22.3 ||
kau bhavantau mahātmānau parasparahitaiṣiṇau  |
sametāvaṃbujābhakṣāvasmin ghore mahāplave  || 1,22.4 ||
tāvūcaturmahātmānau saṃnirīkṣya parasparam  |
bhagavān kiṃ tu yatte'dya na vijñānaṃ tvayā vibho  || 1,22.5 ||
vibho rudra mahāmāya icchayā vāṃ kṛtau tvayā  |
tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā abhinandyābhimānya ca  || 1,22.6 ||
uvāca bhagavāndevo madhuraṃ ślakṣṇayā girā  |
bho bho hiraṇyagarbha tvāṃ tvāṃ ca kṛṣṇa bravīmyaham  || 1,22.7 ||
prīto'hamanayā bhaktyā śāśvatākṣarayuktayā  |
bhavantau hṛdayasyāsya mama hṛdyatarāvubhau  || 1,22.8 ||
yuvābhyāṃ kiṃ dadāmyadya varāṇāṃ varamīpsitam  |
athovāca mahābhāgo viṣṇurbhavamidaṃ vacaḥ  || 1,22.9 ||
sarvaṃ mama kṛtaṃ deva parituṣṭo'si me yadi  |
tvayi me supratiṣṭhā tu bhaktirbhavatu śaṅkaraḥ  || 1,22.10 ||
evamuktastu vijñāya saṃbhāvayata keśavam  |
pradadau ca mahādevo bhaktiṃ nijapadāṃbuje  || 1,22.11 ||
bhavānsarvasya lokasya kartā tvamadhidaivatam  |
tadevaṃ svasti te vatsa gamiṣyāmyaṃbujekṣaṇa  || 1,22.12 ||
evamuktvā tu bhagavān brahmāṇaṃ cāpi śaṅkaraḥ  |
anugṛhyāspṛśaddevo brahmāṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,22.13 ||
karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca prāha hṛṣṭataraḥ svayam  |
matsamastvaṃ na saṃdeho vatsa bhaktaśca me bhavān  || 1,22.14 ||
svastyastu te gamiṣyāmi saṃjñā bhavatu suvrata  |
evamuktvā tu bhagavāṃstato'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ  || 1,22.15 ||
gatavān gaṇapo devaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ  |
avāpya saṃjñāṃ govindātpadmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 1,22.16 ||
prajāḥ sraṣṭumanāścakre tapa ugraṃ pitāmahaḥ  |
tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiṃcitsamavartata  || 1,22.17 ||
tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥkhātkrodho hyajāyata  |
krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ  || 1,22.18 ||
tatastebhyo'śrubindubhyo vātapittakaphātmakāḥ  |
mahābhāgā mahāsattvāḥ svastikairapyalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 1,22.19 ||
prakīrṇakeśāḥ sarpāste prādurbhūtā mahāviṣāḥ  |
sarpāṃstānagrajāndṛṣṭvā brahmātmānamanindayat || 1,22.20 ||
aho dhiktapaso mahyaṃ phalamīdṛśakaṃ yadi  |
lokavaināśikī jajñe ādāveva prajā mama  || 1,22.21 ||
tasya tīvrābhavanmūrcchā krodhāmarṣasamudbhavā  |
mūrcchābhiparitāpena jahau prāṇānprajāpatiḥ  || 1,22.22 ||
tasyāpratimavīryasya dehātkāruṇyapūrvakam  |
athaikādaśa te rudrā rudanto'bhyakramaṃstathā  || 1,22.23 ||
rodanātkhalu rudratvaṃ teṣu vai samajāyata  |
ye rudrāste khalu prāṇā ye prāṇāste tadātmakāḥ  || 1,22.24 ||
prāṇāḥ prāṇavatāṃ jñeyāḥ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitāḥ  |
atyugrasya mahattvasya sādhurācaritasya ca  || 1,22.25 ||
prāṇāṃstasya dadau bhūyastriśūlī nīlalohitaḥ  |
labdhvāsūn bhagavānbrahma devadevamumāpatim  || 1,22.26 ||
praṇamya saṃsthito'paśyadgāyatryā viśvamīśvaram  |
sarvalokamayaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā stutvā pitāmahaḥ  || 1,22.27 ||
tato vismayamāpannaḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ  |
uvāca vacanaṃ śarvaṃ sadyāditvaṃ kathaṃ vibho  || 1,22.28 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 23
sūta uvāca
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇo bhagavān bhavaḥ  |
brahmarūpī prabodhārthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prāha sasmitam  || 1,23.1 ||
śvetakalpo yadā hyāsīdahameva tadābhavam  |
śvetoṣṇīṣaḥ śvetamālyaḥ śvetāṃbaradharaḥ sitaḥ  || 1,23.2 ||
śvetāsthiḥ śvetaromā ca śvetāsṛkśvetalohitaḥ  |
tena nāmnā ca vikhyātaḥ śvetakalpastadā hyasau  || 1,23.3 ||
matprasūtā ca deveśī śvetāṅgā śvetalohitā  |
śvetavarṇā tadā hyāsīdgāyatrī brahmasaṃjñitā  || 1,23.4 ||
tasmādahaṃ ca deveśa tvayā guhyena vai punaḥ  |
vijñātaḥ svena tapasā sadyojātatvamāgataḥ  || 1,23.5 ||
sadyojāteti brahmaitadguhyaṃ caitatprakīrtitam  |
tasmādguhyatvamāpannaṃ ye vetsyanti dvijātayaḥ  || 1,23.6 ||
matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
yadā caiva punastvāsīllohito nāma nāmataḥ  || 1,23.7 ||
matkṛtena ca varṇena kalpo vai lohitaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
tadā lohitamāṃsāsthi lohitakṣīrasaṃbhavā  || 1,23.8 ||
lohitākṣī stanavatī gāyatrī gauḥ prakīrtitā  |
tato'syā lohitatvena varṇasya ca viparyayāt || 1,23.9 ||
vāmatvāccaiva devasya vāmadevatvamāgataḥ  |
tatrāpi ca mahāsattva tvayāhaṃ niyatātmanā  || 1,23.10 ||
vijñātaḥ svena yogena tasminvarṇāntare sthitaḥ  |
tataśca vāmadeveti khyātiṃ yāto'smi bhūtale  || 1,23.11 ||
ye cāpi vāmadeva tvāṃ jñāsyantīha dvijātayaḥ  |
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  || 1,23.12 ||
yadāhaṃ punareveha pītavarṇo yugakramāt |
matkṛtena ca nāmnā vai pītakalpo'bhavattadā  || 1,23.13 ||
matprasūtā ca deveśī pītāṅgī pītalohitā  |
pītavarṇā tadā hyāsīdgāyatrī brahmasaṃjñitā  || 1,23.14 ||
tatrāpi ca mahāsattva yogayuktena cetasā  |
yasmādahaṃ tairvijñāto yogatatparamānasaiḥ  || 1,23.15 ||
tatra tatpuruṣatvena vijñāto'haṃ tvayā punaḥ  |
tasmāttatpuruṣatvaṃ vai mamaitatkanakāṇḍaja  || 1,23.16 ||
ye māṃ rudraṃ ca rudrāṇīṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram  |
vetsyanti tapasā yuktā vimalā brahmasaṃgatāḥ  || 1,23.17 ||
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
yadāhaṃ punarevāsaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇo bhayānakaḥ  || 1,23.18 ||
matkṛtena ca varṇena saṃkalpaḥ kṛṣṇa ucyate  |
tatrāhaṃ kālasaṃkāśaḥ kālo lokaprakālakaḥ  || 1,23.19 ||
vijñāto'haṃ tvayā brahman ghoro ghoraparākramaḥ  |
matprasūtā ca gāyatrī kṛṣṇāṅgī kṛṣṇalohitā  || 1,23.20 ||
kṛṣṇarūpā ca deveśa tadāsīdbrahmasaṃjñitā  |
tasmādghoratvamāpannaṃ ye māṃ vetsyanti bhūtale  || 1,23.21 ||
teṣāmaghoraḥ śāntaśca bhaviṣyāmyahamavyayaḥ  |
punaśca viśvarūpatvaṃ yadā brahmanmamābhavat || 1,23.22 ||
tadāpyahaṃ tvayā jñātaḥ parameṇa samādhinā  |
viśvarūpā ca saṃvṛttā gāyatrī lokadhāriṇī  || 1,23.23 ||
tasmin viśvatvamāpannaṃ ye māṃ vetsyanti bhūtale  |
teṣāṃ śivaśca saumyaśca bhaviṣyāmi sadaiva hi  || 1,23.24 ||
yasmācca viśvarūpo vai kalpo'yaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ  |
viśvarūpā tathā ceyaṃ sāvitrī samudāhṛtā  || 1,23.25 ||
sarvarūpā tathā ceme saṃvṛttā mama putrakāḥ  |
catvāraste mayā khyātāḥ putra vai lokasaṃmatāḥ  || 1,23.26 ||
yasmācca sarvavarṇatvaṃ prajānāṃ ca bhaviṣyati  |
sarvabhakṣā ca medhyā ca varṇataśca bhaviṣyati  || 1,23.27 ||
mokṣo dharmastathārthaśca kāmaśceti catuṣṭayam  |
yasmādvedāśca vedyaṃ ca caturdhā vai bhaviṣyati  || 1,23.28 ||
bhūtagrāmāśca catvāra āśramāśca tathaiva ca  |
dharmasya pādāścatvāraścatvāro mama putrakāḥ  || 1,23.29 ||
tasmāccaturyugāvasthaṃ jagadvai sacarācaram  |
caturdhāvasthitaścaiva catuṣpādo bhaviṣyati  || 1,23.30 ||
bhūrloko'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarlokaśca mahastathā  |
janastapaśca satyaṃ ca viṣṇulokastataḥ param  || 1,23.31 ||
aṣṭākṣarasthito lokaḥ sthāne sthāne tadakṣaram  |
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahaścaiva pādāścatvāra eva ca  || 1,23.32 ||
bhūrlokaḥ prathamaḥ pādo bhuvarlokastataḥ param  |
svarloko vai tṛtīyaśca caturthastu mahastathā  || 1,23.33 ||
pañcamastu janastatra ṣaṣṭhaśca tapa ucyate  |
satyaṃ tu saptamo loko hyapunarbhavagāminām  || 1,23.34 ||
viṣṇulokaḥ smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
skāndamaumaṃ tathā sthānaṃ sarvasiddhisamanvitam  || 1,23.35 ||
rudralokaḥ smṛtastasmātpadaṃ tadyogināṃ śubham  |
nirmamā nirahaṅkārāḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ  || 1,23.36 ||
drakṣyanti taddvijā yuktā dhyānatatparamānasāḥ  |
yasmāccatuṣpadā hyeṣā tvayā dṛṣṭā sarasvatī  || 1,23.37 ||
pādāntaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ vai kaumāraṃ śāntamuttamam  |
aumaṃ māheśvaraṃ caiva tasmāddṛṣṭā catuṣpadā  || 1,23.38 ||
tasmāttu paśavaḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti catuṣpadāḥ  |
tataścaiṣāṃ bhaviṣyanti catvāraste payodharāḥ  || 1,23.39 ||
somaśca mantrasaṃyukto yasmānmama mukhāccyutaḥ  |
jīvaḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ brahman punaḥ pītastanāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,23.40 ||
tasmātsomamayaṃ caiva amṛtaṃ jīvasaṃjñitam  |
catuṣpādā bhaviṣyanti śvetatvaṃ cāsya tena tat || 1,23.41 ||
yasmāccaiva kriyā bhūtvā dvipadā ca maheśvarī  |
dṛṣṭā punastathaivaiṣā sāvitrī lokabhāvinī  || 1,23.42 ||
tasmācca dvipadāḥ sarve dvistanāśca narāḥ śubhāḥ  |
tasmācceyamajā bhūtvā sarvavarṇā maheśvarī  || 1,23.43 ||
yā vai dṛṣṭā mahāsattvā sarvabhūtadharā tvayā  |
tasmācca viśvarūpatvaṃ prajānāṃ vai bhaviṣyati  || 1,23.44 ||
ajaścaiva mahātejā viśvarūpo bhaviṣyati  |
amogharetāḥ sarvatra mukhe cāsya hutāśanaḥ  || 1,23.45 ||
tasmātsarvagato medhyaḥ paśurūpī hutāśanaḥ  |
tapasā bhāvitātmāno ye māṃ drakṣyanti vai dvijāḥ  || 1,23.46 ||
īśitve ca vaśitve ca sarvagaṃ sarvataḥ sthitam  |
rajastamobhyāṃ nirmuktāstyaktvā mānuṣyakaṃ vapuḥ  || 1,23.47 ||
matsamīpamupeṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
ityevamukto bhagavān brahmā rudreṇa vai dvijāḥ  || 1,23.48 ||
praṇamya prayato bhūtvā punarāha pitāmahaḥ  |
ya evaṃ bhagavān vidvān gāyatryā vai maheśvaram  || 1,23.49 ||
viśvātmānaṃ hi sarvaṃ tvāṃ gāyatryāstava ceśvara  |
tasya dehi paraṃ sthānaṃ tathāstviti ca so'bravīt || 1,23.50 ||
tasmādvidvān hi viśvatvamasyāścāsya mahātmanaḥ  |
sa yāti brahmasāyujyaṃ vacanādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,23.51 ||
