liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 24
sūta uvāca
śrutvaivamakhilaṃ brahmā rudreṇa paribhāṣitam  |
punaḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ rudramāha prajāpatiḥ  || 1,24.1 ||
bhagavandevadeveśa viśvarūpaṃ maheśvara  |
umādhava mahādeva namo lokābhivandita  || 1,24.2 ||
viśvarūpa mahābhāga kasminkāle maheśvara  |
yā imāste mahādeva tanavo lokavanditāḥ  || 1,24.3 ||
kasyāṃ vā yugasaṃbhūtyāṃ drakṣyantīha dvijātayaḥ  |
kena vā tapasā deva dhyānayogena kena vā  || 1,24.4 ||
namaste vai mahādeva śakyo draṣṭuṃ dvijātibhiḥ  |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śarvaḥ samprekṣya taṃ puraḥ  || 1,24.5 ||
smayanprāha mahādeva ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃbhavaḥ  |

śrībhagavānuvāca
tapasā naiva vṛttena dānadharmaphalena ca  || 1,24.6 ||
na tīrthaphalayogena kratubhirvāptadakṣiṇaiḥ  |
na vedādhyayanairvāpi na vittena na vedanaiḥ  || 1,24.7 ||
na śakyaṃ mānavairdraṣṭumṛte dhyānādahaṃ tviha  |
saptame caiva vārāhe tatastasminpitāmaha  || 1,24.8 ||
kalpeśvaro'tha bhagavān sarvalokaprakāśanaḥ  |
manurvaivasvataścaiva tava pautro bhaviṣyati  || 1,24.9 ||
tadā caturyugāvasthe tasminkalpe yugāntike  |
anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca  || 1,24.10 ||
utpatsyāmi tadā brahman punarasmin yugāntike  |
yugapravṛttyā ca tadā tasmiṃśca prathame yuge  || 1,24.11 ||
dvāpare prathame brahman yadā vyāsaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ  |
tadāhaṃ brāhmaṇārthāya kalau tasmin yugāntike  || 1,24.12 ||
bhaviṣyāmi śikhāyuktaḥ śveto nāma mahāmuniḥ  |
himavacchikhare ramye chāgale parvatottame  || 1,24.13 ||
tatra śiṣyāḥ śikhāyuktā bhaviṣyanti tadā mama  |
śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāsyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ  || 1,24.14 ||
catvārastu mahātmāno brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ  |
tataste brahmabhūyiṣṭhā dṛṣṭvā brahmagatiṃ parām  || 1,24.15 ||
matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyanti dhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ  |
tataḥ punaryadā brahman dvitīye dvāpare prabhuḥ  || 1,24.16 ||
prajāpatiryadā vyāsaḥ sadyo nāma bhaviṣyati  |
tadā lokahitārthāya sutāro nāma nāmataḥ  || 1,24.17 ||
bhaviṣyāmi kalau tasmin śiṣyānugrahakāmyayā  |
tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā nāmataḥ parikīrtitāḥ  || 1,24.18 ||
dundubhiḥ śatarūpaśca ṛcīkaḥ ketumāṃstadā  |
prāpya yogaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ sthāpya brahma ca bhūtale  || 1,24.19 ||
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti sahacāritvameva ca  |
tṛtīye dvāpare caiva yadā vyāsastu bhārgavaḥ  || 1,24.20 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi damanastu yugāntike  |
tatrāpi ca bhaviṣyanti catvāro mama putrakāḥ  || 1,24.21 ||
vikośaśca vikeśaśca vipāśaḥ śāpanāśanaḥ  |
te'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa yogoktena mahaujasaḥ  || 1,24.22 ||
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
caturthe dvāpare caiva yadā vyāso'ṅgirāḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,24.23 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi suhotro nāma nāmataḥ  |
tatrāpi mama te putrāścatvāro'pi tapodhanāḥ  || 1,24.24 ||
dvijaśreṣṭhā bhaviṣyanti yogātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ  |
sumukho durmukhaścaiva durdaro duratikramaḥ  || 1,24.25 ||
prāpya yogagatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ vimalā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ  |
te'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa yogayuktā mahaujasaḥ  || 1,24.26 ||
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
pañcame dvāpare caiva vyāsastu savitā yadā  || 1,24.27 ||
tadā cāpi bhaviṣyāmi kaṅko nāma mahātapāḥ  |
anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ yogātmaikakalāgatiḥ  || 1,24.28 ||
catvārastu mahābhāgā vimalāḥ śuddhayonayaḥ  |
śiṣyā mama bhaviṣyanti yogātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ  || 1,24.29 ||
sanakaḥ sanandanaścaiva prabhuryaśca sanātanaḥ  |
vibhuḥ sanatkumāraśca nirmamā nirahaṃkṛtāḥ  || 1,24.30 ||
matsamīpamupeṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
parīvarte punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe mṛtyurvyāso yadā vibhuḥ  || 1,24.31 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi logākṣīrnāma nāmataḥ  |
tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā yogātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ  || 1,24.32 ||
bhaviṣyanti mahābhāgāścatvāro lokasaṃmatāḥ  |
sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhapādraja eva ca  || 1,24.33 ||
yogātmāno mahātmānaḥ sarve vai dagdhakilbiṣāḥ  |
te'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa dhyānayogasamanvitāḥ  || 1,24.34 ||
matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
saptame parivarte tu yadā vyāsaḥ śatakratuḥ  || 1,24.35 ||
vibhunāmā mahātejāḥ prathitaḥ pūrvajanmani  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi kalau tasmin yugāntike  || 1,24.36 ||
jaigīṣavyo vibhuḥ khyātaḥ sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ varaḥ  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti yuge tathā  || 1,24.37 ||
sārasvataśca meghaśca meghḥḥṃ yogaṃ rudralokaṃ gatā hi te  || 1,24.58 ||
trayodaśe punaḥ prāpte parivarte krameṇa tu  |
dharmo nārāyaṇo nāma vyāsastu bhavitā yadā  || 1,24.59 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi vālirnāma mahāmuniḥ  |
vālakhilyāśrame puṇye parvate gandhamādane  || 1,24.60 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti tapodhanāḥ  |
sudhāmā kāśyapaścaiva vāsiṣṭho virajāstathā  || 1,24.61 ||
mahāyogabalopetā vimalā ūrdhvaretasaḥ  |
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokaṃ gatā hi te  || 1,24.62 ||
yadā vyāsastarakṣustu paryāye tu caturdaśe  |
tatrāpi punarevāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi yugāntike  || 1,24.63 ||
vaṃśe tvaṅgirasāṃ śreṣṭhe gautamo nāma nāmataḥ  |
bhaviṣyati mahāpuṇyaṃ gautamaṃ nāma tadvanam  || 1,24.64 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti kalau tadā  |
atrirdevasadaścaiva śravaṇo'tha śraviṣṭhakaḥ  || 1,24.65 ||
yogātmāno mahātmānaḥ sarve yogasamanvitāḥ  |
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya te gatāḥ  || 1,24.66 ||
tataḥ pañcadaśe prāpte parivarte kramāgate  |
traiyyāruṇiryadā vyāso dvāpare samapadyata  || 1,24.67 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi nāmnā vedaśirā dvijaḥ  |
tatra vedaśiro nāma astraṃ tatpārameśvaram  || 1,24.68 ||
bhaviṣyati mahāvīryaṃ vedaśīrṣaśca parvataḥ  |
himavatpṛṣṭhamāsādya sarasvatyāṃ nagottame  || 1,24.69 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti tapodhanāḥ  |
kuṇiśca kuṇibāhuśca kuśarīraḥ kunetrakaḥ  || 1,24.70 ||
yogātmāno mahātmānaḥ sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ  |
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya te gatāḥ  || 1,24.71 ||
vyāso yuge ṣoḍaśe tu yadā devo bhaviṣyati  |
tatra yogapradānāya bhaktānāṃ ca yatātmanām  || 1,24.72 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi gokarṇo nāma nāmataḥ  |
bhaviṣyati supuṇyaṃ ca gokarṇaṃ nāma tadvanam  || 1,24.73 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti ca yoginaḥ  |
kāśyapo hyuśanāścaiva cyavano'tha bṛhaspatiḥ  || 1,24.74 ||
te'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa dhyānayogasamanvitāḥ  |
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ gantāro rudrameva hi  || 1,24.75 ||
tataḥ saptadaśe caiva parivarte kramāgate  |
yadā bhaviṣyati vyāso nāmnā devakṛtañjayaḥ  || 1,24.76 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi guhāvāsīti nāmataḥ  |
himavacchikhare ramye mahottuṅge mahālaye  || 1,24.77 ||
siddhakṣetraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati mahālayam  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā yogajñā brahmavādinaḥ  || 1,24.78 ||
bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno nirmamā nirahaṃkṛtāḥ  |
utathyo vāmadevaśca mahāyogo mahābalaḥ  || 1,24.79 ||
teṣāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu śiṣyāṇāṃ dhyānayoginām  |
bhaviṣyanti tadā kāle sarve te dhyānayuñjakāḥ  || 1,24.80 ||
yogābhyāsaratāścaiva hṛdi kṛtvā maheśvaram  |
mahālaye padaṃ nyastaṃ dṛṣṭvā yānti śivaṃ padam  || 1,24.81 ||
ye cānye'pi mahātmānaḥ kalau tasmin yugāntike  |
dhyāne manaḥ samādhāya vimalāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ  || 1,24.82 ||
mama prasādādyāsyanti rudralokaṃ gatajvarāḥ  |
gatvā mahālayaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā māheśvaraṃ padam  || 1,24.83 ||
tīrṇastārayate janturdaśa pūrvāndaśottarān  |
ātmānamekaviṃśaṃ tu tārayitvā mahālaye  || 1,24.84 ||
mama prasādādyāsyanti rudralokaṃ gatajvarāḥ  |
tato'ṣṭādaśame caiva parivarte yadā vibho  || 1,24.85 ||
tadā ṛtañjayo nāma vyāsastu bhavitā muniḥ  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi śikhaṇḍī nāma nāmataḥ  || 1,24.86 ||
siddhakṣetre mahāpuṇye devadānavapūjite  |
himavacchikhare ramye śikhaṇḍī nāma parvataḥ  || 1,24.87 ||
śikhaṇḍino vanaṃ cāpi yatra siddhaniṣevitam  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti tapodhanāḥ  || 1,24.88 ||
vācaśravā ṛcīkaśca śyāvāśvaśca yatīśvaraḥ  |
yogātmāno mahātmānaḥ sarve te vedapāragāḥ  || 1,24.89 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya saṃvṛtāḥ  |
atha ekonaviṃśe tu parivarte kramāgate  || 1,24.90 ||
vyāsastu bhavitā nāmnā bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi jaṭāmālī ca nāmataḥ  || 1,24.91 ||
himavacchikhare ramye jaṭāyuryatra parvataḥ  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti mahaujasaḥ  || 1,24.92 ||
hiraṇyanābhaḥ kauśalyo lokākṣī kuthumistathā  |
īśvarā yogadharmāṇaḥ sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ  || 1,24.93 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya saṃsthitāḥ  |
tato viṃśatimaścaiva parivarto yadā tadā  || 1,24.94 ||
gautamastu tadā vyāso bhaviṣyati mahāmuniḥ  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi aṭṭahāsastu nāmataḥ  || 1,24.95 ||
aṭṭahāsapriyāścaiva bhaviṣyanti tadā narāḥ  |
tatraiva himavatpṛṣṭhe aṭṭahāso mahāgiriḥ  || 1,24.96 ||
devadānavayakṣendra siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti mahaujasaḥ  || 1,24.97 ||
yogātmāno mahātmāno dhyāyino niyatavratāḥ  |
sumanturbarbarī vidvān kabandhaḥ kuśikaṃdharaḥ  || 1,24.98 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya te gatāḥ  |
ekaviṃśe punaḥ prāpte parivarte kramāgate  || 1,24.99 ||
vācaśravāḥ smṛto vyāso yadā sa ṛṣisattamaḥ  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi dāruko nāma nāmataḥ  || 1,24.100 ||
tasmādbhaviṣyate puṇyaṃ devadāruvanaṃ śubham  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti mahaujasaḥ  || 1,24.101 ||
plakṣo dārbhāyaṇiścaiva ketumān gautamastathā  |
yogātmāno mahātmāno niyatā ūrdhvaretasaḥ  || 1,24.102 ||
naiṣṭhikaṃ vratamāsthāya rudralokāya te gatāḥ  |
dvāviṃśe parivarte tu vyāsaḥ śuṣmāyaṇo yadā  || 1,24.103 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi vārāṇasyāṃ mahāmuniḥ  |
nāmnā vai lāṅgalī bhīmo yatra devāḥ savāsavāḥ  || 1,24.104 ||
drakṣyanti māṃ kalau tasmin bhavaṃ caiva halāyudham  |
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti sudhārmikāḥ  || 1,24.105 ||
bhallavī madhupiṅgaśca śvetaketuḥ kuśastathā  |
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ te'pi dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ  || 1,24.106 ||
vimalā brahmabhūyiṣṭhā rudralokāya saṃsthitāḥ  |
parivarte trayoviṃśe tṛṇabinduryadā muniḥ  || 1,24.107 ||
vyāso hi bhavitā brahmaṃstadāhaṃ bhavitā punaḥ  |
śveto nāma mahākāyo muniputrastu dhārmikaḥ  || 1,24.108 ||
tatra kālaṃ jariṣyāmi tadā girivarottame  |
tena kālañjaro nāma bhaviṣyati sa parvataḥ  || 1,24.109 ||
tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā bhaviṣyanti tapasvinaḥ  |
uśiko bṛhadaśvaśca devalaḥ kavireva ca  || 1,24.110 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya te gataḥ  |
parivarte caturviṃśe vyāsa ṛkṣo yadā vibho  || 1,24.111 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi kalau tasmin yugāntike  |
śūlī nāma mahāyogī naimiṣe devavandite  || 1,24.112 ||
tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā bhaviṣyanti tapodhanāḥ  |
śālihotro'gniveśaśca yuvanāśvaḥ śaradvasuḥ  || 1,24.113 ||
te'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa rudralokāya saṃsthitāḥ  |
pañcaviṃśe punaḥ prāpte parivarte kramāgate  || 1,24.114 ||
vāsiṣṭhastu yadā vyāsaḥ śaktirnāmnā bhaviṣyati  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi daṇḍī muṇḍīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,24.115 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti tapodhanāḥ  |
chagalaḥ kuṇḍakarṇaśca kubhāṇḍaśca pravāhakaḥ  || 1,24.116 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogamamṛtatvāya te gatāḥ  |
ṣaḍviṃśe parivarte tu yadā vyāsaḥ parāśaraḥ  || 1,24.117 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi sahiṣṇurnāma nāmataḥ  |
puraṃ bhadravaṭaṃ prāpya kalau tasmin yugāntike  || 1,24.118 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti sudhārmikāḥ  |
ulūko vidyutaścaiva śaṃbūko hyāśvalāyanaḥ  || 1,24.119 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya te gatāḥ  |
saptaviṃśe punaḥ prāpte parivarte kramāgate  || 1,24.120 ||
jātūkarṇyo yadā vyāso bhaviṣyati tapodhanaḥ  |
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi somaśarmā dvijottamaḥ  || 1,24.121 ||
prabhāsatīrthamāsādya yogātmā yogaviśrutaḥ  |
tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā bhaviṣyanti tapodhanāḥ  || 1,24.122 ||
akṣapādaḥ kumāraśca ulūko vatsa eva ca  |
yogātmāno mahātmāno vimalāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ  || 1,24.123 ||
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ rudralokaṃ tato gatāḥ  |
aṣṭāviṃśe punaḥ prāpte parivarte kramāgate  || 1,24.124 ||
parāśarasutaḥ śrīmān viṣṇurlokapitāmahaḥ  |
yadā bhaviṣyati vyāso nāmnā dvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,24.125 ||
tadā ṣaṣṭhena cāṃśena kṛṣṇaḥ puruṣasattamaḥ  |
vasudevādyaduśreṣṭho vāsudevo bhaviṣyati  || 1,24.126 ||
tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi yogātmā yogamāyayā  |
lokavismayanārthāya brahmacāriśarīrakaḥ  || 1,24.127 ||
śmaśāne mṛtamutsṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāyamanāthakam  |
brāhmaṇānāṃ hitārthāya praviṣṭo yogamāyayā  || 1,24.128 ||
divyāṃ meruguhāṃ puṇyāṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ ca viṣṇunā  |
bhaviṣyāmi tadā brahmaṃllakulī nāma nāmataḥ  || 1,24.129 ||
kāyāvatāra ityevaṃ siddhakṣetraṃ ca vai tadā  |
bhaviṣyati suvikhyātaṃ yāvadbhūmirdhariṣyati  || 1,24.130 ||
tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti tapasvinaḥ  |
kuśikaścaiva gargaśca mitraḥ kauruṣya eva ca  || 1,24.131 ||
yogātmāno mahātmāno brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ  |
prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ vimalā hyūrdhvaretasaḥ  || 1,24.132 ||
rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham  |
ete pāśupatāḥ siddhā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ  || 1,24.133 ||
liṅgārcanaratā nityaṃ bāhyābhyantarataḥ sthitāḥ  |
bhaktyā mayi ca yogena dhyānaniṣṭhā jitendriyāḥ  || 1,24.134 ||
saṃsārabandhacchedārthaṃ jñānamārgaprakāśakam  |
svarūpajñānasiddhyarthaṃ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ mahat || 1,24.135 ||
yogamārgā anekāśca jñānamārgāstvanekaśaḥ  |
na nivṛttimupāyānti vinā pañcākṣarīṃ kvacit || 1,24.136 ||
yadācarettapaścāyaṃ sarvadvandvavivarjitam  |
tadā sa mukto mantavyaḥ pakvaṃ phalamiva sthitaḥ  || 1,24.137 ||
ekāhaṃ yaḥ pumānsamyakcaretpāśupatavratam  |
na sāṃkhye pañcarātre vā na prāpnoti gatiṃ kadā  || 1,24.138 ||
ityetadvai mayā proktamavatāreṣu lakṣaṇam  |
manvādikṛṣṇaparyantamaṣṭāviṃśadyugakramāt || 1,24.139 ||
tatra śrutisamūhānāṃ vibhāgo dharmalakṣaṇaḥ  |
bhaviṣyati tadā kalpe kṛṣṇadvaipāyano yadā  || 1,24.140 ||

sūta uvāca
niśamyaivaṃ mahātejā mahādevena kīrtitam  |
rudrāvatāraṃ bhagavān praṇipatya maheśvaram  || 1,24.141 ||
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ punaḥ prāha ca śaṅkaram  |

pitāmaha uvāca
sarve viṣṇumayā devāḥ sarve viṣṇumayā gaṇāḥ  || 1,24.142 ||
na hi viṣṇusamā kācidgatiranyā vidhīyate  |
ityevaṃ satataṃ vedā gāyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,24.143 ||
sa devadevo bhagavāṃstava liṅgārcane rataḥ  |
tava praṇāmaparamaḥ kathaṃ devo hyabhūtprabhuḥ  || 1,24.144 ||

sūta uvāca
niśamya vacanaṃ tasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
prapibanniva cakṣurbhyāṃ prītastatpraśnagauravāt || 1,24.145 ||
pūjāprakaraṇaṃ tasmai tamālokyāha śaṅkaraḥ  |
bhavānnārāyaṇaścaiva śakraḥ sākṣātsurottamaḥ  || 1,24.146 ||
munayaśca sadā liṅgaṃ sampūjya vidhipūrvakam  |
svaṃsvaṃ padaṃ vibho prāptāstasmātsampūjayanti te  || 1,24.147 ||
liṅgārcanaṃ vinā niṣṭhā nāsti tasmājjanārdanaḥ  |
ātmano yajate nityaṃ śraddhayā bhagavānprabhuḥ  || 1,24.148 ||
ityevamuktvā brahmāṇamanugṛhya maheśvaraḥ  |
punaḥ samprekṣya deveśaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata  || 1,24.149 ||
tamuddiśya tadā brahmā namaskṛtya kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
sraṣṭuṃ tvaśeṣaṃ bhagavāṃllabdhasaṃjñastu śaṅkarāt || 1,24.150 ||



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 25
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ pūjyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtirmaheśvaraḥ  |
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa sāṃpratam  || 1,25.1 ||

sūta uvāca
devyā pṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ kailāse tāṃ nagātmajām  |
aṅkasthāmāha deveśo liṅgārcanavidhiṃ kramāt || 1,25.2 ||
tadā pārśve sthito nandī śālaṅkāyanakātmajaḥ  |
śrutvākhilaṃ purā prāha brahmaputrāya suvratāḥ  || 1,25.3 ||
sanatkumārāya śubhaṃ liṅgārcanavidhiṃ param  |
tasmādvyāso mahātejāḥ śrutavāñchrutisaṃmitam  || 1,25.4 ||
snānayogopacāraṃ ca yathā śailādino mukhāt |
śrutavān tatpravakṣyāmi snānādyaṃ cārcanāvidhim  || 1,25.5 ||

śailādiruvāca
atha snānavidhiṃ vakṣye brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ sākṣācchivena kathitaṃ purā  || 1,25.6 ||
anena vidhinā snātvā sakṛtpūjya ca śaṅkaram  |
brahmakūrcaṃ ca pītvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 1,25.7 ||
trividhaṃ snānamākhyātaṃ devadevena śaṃbhunā  |
hitāya brāhmaṇādyānāṃ caturmukhasutottama  || 1,25.8 ||
vāruṇaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā tataścāgneyamuttamam  |
mantrasnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayetparameśvaram  || 1,25.9 ||
bhāvaduṣṭo'mbhasi snātvā bhasmanā ca na śudhyati  |
bhāvaśuddhaścarecchaucamanyathā na samācaret || 1,25.10 ||
saritsarastaḍāgeṣu sarveṣvā pralayaṃ naraḥ  |
snātvāpi bhāvaduṣṭaścenna śudhyati na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,25.11 ||
nṛṇāṃ hi cittakamalaṃ prabuddhamabhavadyadā  |
prasuptaṃ tamasā jñāna bhānorbhāsā tadā śuciḥ  || 1,25.12 ||
mṛcchakṛttilapuṣpaṃ ca snānārthaṃ bhasitaṃ tathā  |
ādāya tīre niḥkṣipya snānatīrthe kuśāni ca  || 1,25.13 ||
prakṣālyācamya pādau ca malaṃ dehādviśodhya ca  |
dravyaistu tīradeśasthaistataḥ snānaṃ samācaret || 1,25.14 ||
uddhṛtāsītimantreṇa punardehaṃ viśodhayet |
mṛdādāya tataścānyadvastraṃ snātvā hyanulbaṇam  || 1,25.15 ||
gandhadvārāṃ durādharṣāmiti mantreṇa mantravit |
kapilāgomayenaiva khasthenaiva tu lepayet || 1,25.16 ||
punaḥ snātvā parityajya tadvastraṃ malinaṃ tataḥ  |
śuklavastraparīdhāno bhūtvā snānaṃ samācaret || 1,25.17 ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthamāvāhya varuṇaṃ tathā  |
sampūjya manasā devaṃ dhyānayajñena vai bhavam  || 1,25.18 ||
ācamya tristadā tīrthe hyavagāhya bhavaṃ smaran  |
punarācamya vidhivadabhimantrya mahājalam  || 1,25.19 ||
avagāhya punastasmin japedvai cāghamarṣaṇam  |
tattoye bhānusomāgni maṇḍalaṃ ca smaredvaśī  || 1,25.20 ||
ācamya ca punastasmājjalāduttīrya mantravit |
praviśya tīrthamadhye tu punaḥ puṇyavivṛddhaye  || 1,25.21 ||
śṛṅgeṇa parṇapuṭakaiḥ pālāśaiḥ kṣālitaistathā  |
sakuśena sapuṣpeṇa jalenaivābhiṣecayet || 1,25.22 ||
rudreṇa pavamānena tvaritākhyena mantravit |
taratsamandīvargādyaistathā śāntidvayena ca  || 1,25.23 ||
śāntidharmeṇa caikena pañcabrahmapavitrakaiḥ  |
tattanmantrādhidevānāṃ svarūpaṃ ca ṛṣīn smaran  || 1,25.24 ||
evaṃ hi cābhiṣicyātha svamūrdhni payasā dvijāḥ  |
dhyāyecca tryambakaṃ devaṃ hṛdi pañcāsyamīśvaram  || 1,25.25 ||
ācamyācamanaṃ kuryātsvasūtroktaṃ samīkṣya ca  |
pavitrahastaḥ svāsīnaḥ śucau deśe yathāvidhi  || 1,25.26 ||
abhyukṣya sakuśaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇena kareṇa tu  |
pibetprakṣipya tristoyaṃ cakrī bhūtvā hyatandritaḥ  || 1,25.27 ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhiṃsāpāpapraśāntaye  |
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ snānācamanamuttamam  || 1,25.28 ||
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu hitārthe dvijasattamāḥ  || 1,25.29 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge snānavidhirnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 26

nandyuvāca
āvāhayettato devīṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram  |
āyātu varadā devītyanenaiva maheśvarīm  || 1,26.1 ||
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca tasyāścārghyaṃ pradāpayet |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā samāsīnaḥ sthito'pi vā  || 1,26.2 ||
sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā  |
gāyatrīṃ praṇavenaiva trividheṣvekamācaret || 1,26.3 ||
arghyaṃ dattvā samabhyarcya praṇamya śirasā svayam  |
uttame śikhare devītyuktvodvāsya ca mātaram  || 1,26.4 ||
prācyālokyābhivandyeśāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prārthayedbhāskaraṃ tathā  || 1,26.5 ||
udutyaṃ ca tathā citraṃ jātavedasameva ca  |
abhivandya punaḥ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca vidhānataḥ  || 1,26.6 ||
tathā saurāṇi sūktāni ṛgyajuḥsāmajāni ca  |
japtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paścāttriḥ kṛtvā ca vibhāvasoḥ  || 1,26.7 ||
ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva ca  |
abhivandya punaḥ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca vibhāvasum  || 1,26.8 ||
munīn pitṝn yathānyāyaṃ svanāmnāvāhayettataḥ  |
sarvānāvāhayāmīti devānāvāhya sarvataḥ  || 1,26.9 ||
tarpayedvidhinā paścātprāṅmukho vā hyudaṅmukhaḥ  |
dhyātvā svarūpaṃ tattattvamabhivandya yathākramam  || 1,26.10 ||
devānāṃ puṣpatoyena ṛṣīṇāṃ tu kuśāṃbhasā  |
pitṝṇāṃ tilatoyena gandhayuktena sarvataḥ  || 1,26.11 ||
yajñopavītī devānāṃ nivītī ṛṣitarpaṇam  |
prācīnāvītī viprendra pitṝṇāṃ tarpayetkramāt || 1,26.12 ||
aṅgulyagreṇa vai dhīmāṃstarpayeddevatarpaṇam  |
ṛṣīn kaniṣṭhāṅgulinā śrotriyaḥ sarvasiddhaye  || 1,26.13 ||
pitṝṃstu tarpayedvidvān dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakena tu  |
tathaivaṃ muniśārdūla brahmayajñaṃ yajeddvijaḥ  || 1,26.14 ||
devayajñaṃ ca mānuṣyaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathaiva ca  |
pitṛyajñaṃ ca pūtātmā yajñakarmaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,26.15 ||
svaśākhādhyayanaṃ vipra brahmayajña iti smṛtaḥ  |
agnau juhoti yaccānnaṃ devayajña iti smṛtaḥ  || 1,26.16 ||
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ balidānaṃ vidhānataḥ  |
bhūtayajña iti prokto bhūtidaḥ sarvadehinām  || 1,26.17 ||
sadārān sarvatattvajñān brāhmaṇān vedapāragān  |
praṇamya tebhyo yaddattamannaṃ mānuṣa ucyate  || 1,26.18 ||
pitṝnuddiśya yaddattaṃ pitṛyajñaḥ sa ucyate  |
evaṃ pañca mahāyajñān kuryātsarvārthasiddhaye  || 1,26.19 ||
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇu yajñānāṃ brahmayajñaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ  |
brahmayajñarato martyo brahmaloke mahīyate  || 1,26.20 ||
brahmayajñena tuṣyanti sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ  |
brahmā ca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ  || 1,26.21 ||
vedāśca pitaraḥ sarve nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
grāmādbahirgato bhūtvā brāhmaṇo brahmayajñavit || 1,26.22 ||
yāvattvadṛṣṭamabhavaduṭajānāṃ chadaṃ naraḥ  |
prācyāmudīcyāṃ ca tathā prāgudīcyāmathāpi vā  || 1,26.23 ||
puṇyamācamanaṃ kuryādbrahmayajñārthameva tat |
prītyarthaṃ ca ṛcāṃ viprāḥ triḥ pītvā plāvya plāvya ca  || 1,26.24 ||
yajuṣāṃ parimṛjyaivaṃ dviḥ prakṣālya ca vāriṇā  |
prītyarthaṃ sāmavedānāmupaspṛśya ca mūrdhani  || 1,26.25 ||
spṛśedatharvavedānāṃ netre cāṅgirasāṃ tathā  |
nāsike brāhmaṇo'ṅgānāṃ kṣālya kṣālya ca vāriṇā  || 1,26.26 ||
aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ brahmādyānāṃ tathaiva ca  |
tathā copapurāṇānāṃ saurādīnāṃ yathākramam  || 1,26.27 ||
puṇyānāmitihāsānāṃ śaivādīnāṃ tathaiva ca  |
śrotre spṛśeddhi tuṣṭyarthaṃ hṛddeśaṃ tu tataḥ spṛśet || 1,26.28 ||
kalpādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ kalpavitkalpavittamāḥ  |
evamācamya cāstīrya darbhapiñjūlamātmanaḥ  || 1,26.29 ||
kṛtvā pāṇitale dhīmānātmano dakṣiṇottaram  |
hemāṅgulīyasaṃyukto brahmabandhayuto'pi vā  || 1,26.30 ||
vidhivadbrahmayajñaṃ ca kuryātsūtrī samāhitaḥ  |
akṛtvā ca muniḥ pañca mahāyajñāndvijottamaḥ  || 1,26.31 ||
bhuktvā ca sūkarāṇāṃ tu yonau vai jāyate naraḥ  |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kartavyāḥ śubhamicchatā  || 1,26.32 ||
brahmayajñādatha snānaṃ kṛtvādau sarvathātmanaḥ  |
tīrthaṃ saṃgṛhya vidhivatpraviśecchibiraṃ vaśī  || 1,26.33 ||
bahireva gṛhātpādau hastau prakṣālya vāriṇā  |
bhasmasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryādvidhivaddehaśuddhaye  || 1,26.34 ||
śodhya bhasma yathānyāyaṃ praṇavenāgnihotrajam  |
jyotiḥ sūrya iti prātarjuhuyādudite yataḥ  || 1,26.35 ||
jyotiragnistathā sāyaṃ samyakcānudite mṛṣā  |
tasmāduditahomasthaṃ bhasitaṃ pāvanaṃ śubham  || 1,26.36 ||
nāsti satyasamaṃ yasmādasatyaṃ pātakaṃ ca yat |
īśānena śirodeśaṃ mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa ca  || 1,26.37 ||
urodeśamaghoreṇa guhyaṃ vāmena suvratāḥ  |
sadyena pādau sarvāṅgaṃ praṇavenābhiṣecayet || 1,26.38 ||
tataḥ prakṣālayetpādaṃ hastaṃ brahmavidāṃ varaḥ  |
vyapohya bhasma cādāya devadevamanusmaran  || 1,26.39 ||
mantrasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryādāpohiṣṭhādibhiḥ kramāt |
puṇyaiścaiva tathā mantrairṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃbhavaiḥ  || 1,26.40 ||
dvijānāṃ tu hitāyaivaṃ kathitaṃ snānamadya te  |
saṃkṣipya yaḥ sakṛtkuryātsa yāti paramaṃ padam  || 1,26.41 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pañcayajñavidhānaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ


_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 27

śailādiruvāca
vakṣyāmi śṛṇu saṃkṣepālliṅgārcanāvidhikramam  |
vaktuṃ varṣaśatenāpi na śakyaṃ vistareṇa yat || 1,27.1 ||
evaṃ snātvā yathānyāyaṃ pūjāsthānaṃ praviśya ca  |
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyeddevaṃ triyaṃbakam  || 1,27.2 ||
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham  |
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ citrāṃbaravibhūṣitam  || 1,27.3 ||
tasya rūpaṃ samāśritya dāhanaplāvanādibhiḥ  |
śaivīṃ tanuṃ samāsthāya pūjayetparameśvaram  || 1,27.4 ||
dehaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvaiva mūlamantraṃ nyasetkramāt |
sarvatra praṇavenaiva brahmāṇi ca yathākramam  || 1,27.5 ||
sūtre namaḥ śivāyeti chandāṃsi parame śubhe  |
mantrāṇi sūkṣmarūpeṇa saṃsthitāni yatastataḥ  || 1,27.6 ||
nyagrodhabīje nyagrodhastathā sūtre tu śobhane  |
mahatyapi mahadbrahma saṃsthitaṃ sūkṣmavatsvayam  || 1,27.7 ||
secayedarcanasthānaṃ gandhacandanavāriṇā  |
dravyāṇi śodhayetpaścātkṣālanaprokṣaṇādibhiḥ  || 1,27.8 ||
kṣālanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva praṇavena vidhīyate  |
prokṣaṇī cārghyapātraṃ ca pādyapātramanukramāt || 1,27.9 ||
tathā hyācamanīyārthaṃ kalpitaṃ pātrameva ca  |
sthāpayedvidhinā dhīmānavaguṇṭhya yathāvidhi  || 1,27.10 ||
darbhairācchādayeccaiva prokṣayecchuddhavāriṇā  |
teṣu teṣvatha sarveṣu kṣipettoyaṃ suśītalam  || 1,27.11 ||
praṇavena kṣipetteṣu dravyāṇyālokya buddhimān  |
uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva pādye tu parikalpayet || 1,27.12 ||
jātikaṅkolakarpūra bahumūlatamālakam  |
cūrṇayitvā yathānyāyaṃ kṣipedācamanīyake  || 1,27.13 ||
evaṃ sarveṣu pātreṣu dāpayeccandanaṃ tathā  |
karpūraṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca  || 1,27.14 ||
kuśāgramakṣatāṃścaiva yavavrīhitilāni ca  |
ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ cārghyapātrake  || 1,27.15 ||
kuśapuṣpayavavrīhi bahumūlatamālakam  |
dāpayetprokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ praṇavena ca  || 1,27.16 ||
nyasetpañcākṣaraṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ rudradevatām  |
kevalaṃ praṇavaṃ vāpi vedasāramanuttamam  || 1,27.17 ||
atha saṃprokṣayetpaścāddravyāṇi praṇavena tu  |
prokṣaṇīpātrasaṃsthena īśānādyaiśca pañcabhiḥ  || 1,27.18 ||
pārśvato devadevasya nandinaṃ māṃsamarcayet |
dīptānalāyutaprakhyaṃ trinetraṃ tridaśeśvaram  || 1,27.19 ||
bālendumukuṭaṃ caiva harivaktraṃ caturbhujam  |
puṣpamālādharaṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam  || 1,27.20 ||
uttare cātmanaḥ puṇyāṃ bhāryāṃ ca marutāṃ śubhām  |
suyaśāṃ suvratāṃ cāmbāṃ pādamaṇḍanatatparām  || 1,27.21 ||
evaṃ pūjya praviśyāntarbhavanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ bhaktyā pañcamūrdhasu pañcabhiḥ  || 1,27.22 ||
gandhapuṣpaistathā dhūpairvividhaiḥ pūjya śaṅkaram  |
skandaṃ vināyakaṃ devīṃ liṅgaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet || 1,27.23 ||
japtvā sarvāṇi mantrāṇi praṇavādinamo'ntakam  |
kalpayedāsanaṃ paścātpadmākhyaṃ praṇavena tat || 1,27.24 ||
tasya pūrvadalaṃ sākṣādaṇimāmayamakṣaram  |
laghimā dakṣiṇaṃ caiva mahimā paścimaṃ tathā  || 1,27.25 ||
prāptistathottaraṃ patraṃ prākāmyaṃ pāvakasya tu  |
īśitvaṃ nairṛtaṃ patraṃ vaśitvaṃ vāyugocare  || 1,27.26 ||
sarvajñatvaṃ tathaiśānyaṃ karṇikā soma ucyate  |
somasyādhastathā sūryastasyādhaḥ pāvakaḥ svayam  || 1,27.27 ||
dharmādayo vidikṣvete tvanantaṃ kalpayetkramāt |
avyaktādicaturdikṣu somasyānte guṇatrayam  || 1,27.28 ||
ātmatrayaṃ tataścordhvaṃ tasyānte śivapīṭhikā  |
sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmītyāvāhya parameśvaram  || 1,27.29 ||
vāmadevena mantreṇa sthāpayedāsanopari  |
sānnidhyaṃ rudragāyatryā aghoreṇa nirudhya ca  || 1,27.30 ||
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmiti mantreṇa pūjayet |
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca vibhoścārghyaṃ pradāpayet || 1,27.31 ||
snāpayedvidhinā rudraṃ gandhacandanavāriṇā  |
pañcagavyavidhānena gṛhya pātre'bhimantrya ca  || 1,27.32 ||
praṇavenaiva gavyaistu snāpayecca yathāvidhi  |
ājyena madhunā caiva tathā cekṣurasena ca  || 1,27.33 ||
puṇyairdravyairmahādevaṃ praṇavenābhiṣecayet |
jalabhāṇḍaiḥ pavitraistu mantraistoyaṃ kṣipettataḥ  || 1,27.34 ||
śuddhiṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ sitavastreṇa sādhakaḥ  |
kuśāpāmārgakarpūra jātipuṣpakacampakaiḥ  || 1,27.35 ||
karavīraiḥ sitaiścaiva mallikākamalotpalaiḥ  |
āpūrya puṣpaiḥ suśubhaiḥ candanādyaiśca tajjalam  || 1,27.36 ||
nyasenmantrāṇi tattoye sadyojātādikāni tu  |
suvarṇakalaśenātha tathā vai rājatena vā  || 1,27.37 ||
tāmreṇa padmapatreṇa pālāśena dalena vā  |
śaṃkhena mṛnmayenātha śodhitena śubhena vā  || 1,27.38 ||
sakūrcena sapuṣpeṇa snāpayenmantrapūrvakam  |
mantrāṇi te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvārthasiddhaye  || 1,27.39 ||
yairliṅgaṃ sakṛdapyevaṃ snāpya mucyeta mānavaḥ  |
pavamānena mantrajñāḥ tathā vāmīyakena ca  || 1,27.40 ||
rudreṇa nīlarudreṇa śrīsūktena śubhena ca  |
rajanīsūktakenaiva camakena śubhena ca  || 1,27.41 ||
hotāreṇātha śirasā atharveṇa śubhena ca  |
śāntyā cātha punaḥ śāntyā bhāruṇḍenāruṇena ca  || 1,27.42 ||
vāruṇena ca jyeṣṭhena tathā vedavratena ca  |
tathāntareṇa puṇyena sūktena puruṣeṇa ca  || 1,27.43 ||
tvaritenaiva rudreṇa kapinā ca kapardinā  |
āvosajeti sāmnā tu bṛhaccandreṇa viṣṇunā  || 1,27.44 ||
virūpākṣeṇa skandena śataṛgbhiḥ śivaistathā  |
pañcabrahmaiśca sūtreṇa kevalapraṇavena ca  || 1,27.45 ||
snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ sarvapāpapraśāntaye  |
vastraṃ śivopavītaṃ ca tathā hyācamanīyakam  || 1,27.46 ||
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpamannaṃ krameṇa tu  |
toyaṃ sugandhitaṃ caiva punarācamanīyakam  || 1,27.47 ||
mukuṭaṃ ca śubhaṃ channaṃ tathā vai bhūṣaṇāni ca  |
dāpayetpraṇavenaiva mukhavāsādikāni ca  || 1,27.48 ||
tataḥ sphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ devaṃ niṣkalamakṣaram  |
kāraṇaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvalokamayaṃ param  || 1,27.49 ||
brahmendraviṣṇurudrādyairṛṣidevairagocaram  |
vedavidbhirhi vedāntaistvagocaramiti śrutiḥ  || 1,27.50 ||
ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām  |
śivatattvamiti khyātaṃ śivaliṅge vyavasthitam  || 1,27.51 ||
praṇavenaiva mantreṇa pūjayelliṅgamūrdhani  |
stotraṃ japecca vidhinā namaskāraṃ pradakṣiṇam  || 1,27.52 ||
arghyaṃ dattvātha puṣpāṇi pādayostu vikīrya ca  |
praṇipatya ca deveśamātmanyāropayecchivam  || 1,27.53 ||
evaṃ saṃkṣipya kathitaṃ liṅgārcanamanuttamam  |
ābhyantaraṃ pravakṣyāmi liṅgārcanamihādya te  || 1,27.54 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge liṅgārcanavidhirnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 28

śailādiruvāca
āgneyaṃ sauramamṛtaṃ bimbaṃ bhāvyaṃ tatopari  |
guṇatrayaṃ ca hṛdaye tathā cātmatrayaṃ kramāt || 1,28.1 ||
tasyopari mahādevaṃ niṣkalaṃ sakalākṛtim  |
kāntārdharūḍhadehaṃ ca pūjayeddhyānavidyayā  || 1,28.2 ||
tato bahuvidhaṃ proktaṃ cintyaṃ tatrāsti cedyataḥ  |
cintakasya tataścintā anyathā nopapadyate  || 1,28.3 ||
tasmāddhyeyaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ yajamānaḥ prayojanam  |
smarettannānyathā jātu budhyate puruṣasya ha  || 1,28.4 ||
pure śete puraṃ dehaṃ tasmātpuruṣa ucyate  |
yājyaṃ yajñena yajate yajamānastu sa smṛtaḥ  || 1,28.5 ||
dhyeyo maheśvaro dhyānaṃ cintanaṃ nirvṛtiḥ phalam  |
pradhānapuruṣeśānaṃ yāthātathyaṃ prapadyate  || 1,28.6 ||
iha ṣaḍviṃśako dhyeyo dhyātā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ  |
caturviṃśakamavyaktaṃ mahadādyāstu sapta ca  || 1,28.7 ||
mahāṃstathā tvahaṅkāraṃ tanmātraṃ pañcakaṃ punaḥ  |
karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva tathā buddhīndriyāṇi ca  || 1,28.8 ||
manaśca pañca bhūtāni śivaḥ ṣaḍviṃśakastataḥ  |
sa eva bhartā kartā ca vidherapi maheśvaraḥ  || 1,28.9 ||
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ rudro'sau janayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ  |
viśvādhikaśca viśvātmā viśvarūpa iti smṛtaḥ  || 1,28.10 ||
vinā yathā hi pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tanayāstviha  |
na jāyante tathā somaṃ vinā nāsti jagattrayam  || 1,28.11 ||
sanatkumāra uvāca
kartā yadi mahādevaḥ paramātmā maheśvaraḥ  |
tathā kārayitā caiva kurvato'lpātmanastathā  || 1,28.12 ||
nityo viśuddho buddhaśca niṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ  |
tvayokto muktidaḥ kiṃ vā niṣkalaścetkaroti kim  || 1,28.13 ||

śailādiruvāca
kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ kālaṃ kalayate sadā  |
niṣkalaṃ ca manaḥ sarvaṃ manyate so'pi niṣkalaḥ  || 1,28.14 ||
karmaṇā tasya caiveha jagatsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  |
kimatra devadevasya mūrtyaṣṭakamidaṃ jagat || 1,28.15 ||
vinākāśaṃ jagannaiva vinā kṣmāṃ vāyunā vinā  |
tejasā vāriṇā caiva yajamānaṃ tathā vinā  || 1,28.16 ||
bhānunā śaśinā lokastasyaitāstanavaḥ prabhoḥ  |
vicāratastu rudrasya sthūlametaccarācaram  || 1,28.17 ||
sūkṣmaṃ vadanti ṛṣayo yanna vācyaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha  || 1,28.18 ||
ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvānna bibheti kutaścana  |
na bhetavyaṃ tathā tasmājjñātvānandaṃ pinākinaḥ  || 1,28.19 ||
vibhūtayaśca rudrasya matvā sarvatra bhāvataḥ  |
sarvaṃ rudra iti prāhurmunayastattvadarśinaḥ  || 1,28.20 ||
namaskāreṇa satataṃ gauravātparameṣṭhinaḥ  |
sarvaṃ tu khalvidaṃ brahma sarvo vai rudra īśvaraḥ  || 1,28.21 ||
puruṣo vai mahādevo maheśānaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ  |
evaṃ vibhurvinirdiṣṭo dhyānaṃ tatraiva cintanam  || 1,28.22 ||
caturvyūheṇa mārgeṇa vicāryālokya suvrata  |
saṃsārahetuḥ saṃsāro mokṣahetuśca nirvṛtiḥ  || 1,28.23 ||
caturvyūhaḥ samākhyātaścintakasyeha yoginaḥ  |
cintā bahuvidhā khyātā saikatra parameṣṭhinā  || 1,28.24 ||
suniṣṭhetyatra kathitā rudraṃ raudrī na saṃśayaḥ  |
aindrī cendre tathā saumyā some nārāyaṇe tathā  || 1,28.25 ||
sūrye vahnau ca sarveṣāṃ sarvatraivaṃ vicārataḥ  |
saivāhaṃ so'hamityevaṃ dvidhā saṃsthāpya bhāvataḥ  || 1,28.26 ||
bhakto'sau nāsti yastasmāccintā brāhmī na saṃśayaḥ  |
evaṃ brahmamayaṃ dhyāyetpūrvaṃ vipra carācaram  || 1,28.27 ||
carācaravibhāgaṃ ca tyajedabhimataṃ smaran  |
tyājyaṃ grāhyamalabhyaṃ ca kṛtyaṃ cākṛtyameva ca  || 1,28.28 ||
yasya nāsti sutṛptasya tasya brāhmī na cānyathā  |
ābhyantaraṃ samākhyātamevamabhyarcanaṃ kramāt || 1,28.29 ||
ābhyantarārcakāḥ pūjyā namaskārādibhistathā  |
virūpā vikṛtāścāpi na nindyā brahmavādinaḥ  || 1,28.30 ||
ābhyantarārcakāḥ sarve na parīkṣyā vijānatā  |
nindakā eva duḥkhārtā bhaviṣyantyalpacetasaḥ  || 1,28.31 ||
yathā dāruvane rudraṃ vinindya munayaḥ purā  |
tasmātsevyā namaskāryāḥ sadā brahmavidastathā  || 1,28.32 ||
varṇāśramavinirmuktā varṇāśramaparāyaṇaiḥ  || 1,28.33 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivārcanatattvasaṃkhyādivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 29

sanatkumāra uvāca
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi purā dāruvane vibho  |
pravṛttaṃ tadvanasthānāṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanām  || 1,29.1 ||
kathaṃ dāruvanaṃ prāpto bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ  |
vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthāya cordhvaretā digambaraḥ  || 1,29.2 ||
kiṃ pravṛttaṃ vane tasmin rudrasya paramātmanaḥ  |
vaktumarhasi tattvena devadevasya ceṣṭitam  || 1,29.3 ||

sūta uvāca
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śrutisāravidāṃ varaḥ  |
śilādasūnurbhagavān prāha kiṃcidbhavaṃ hasan  || 1,29.4 ||

śailādiruvāca
<ḍāruvana>
munayo dārugahane tapastepuḥ sudāruṇam  |
tuṣṭyarthaṃ devadevasya sadāratanayāgnayaḥ  || 1,29.5 ||
tuṣṭo rudro jagannāthaścekitāno vṛṣadhvajaḥ  |
dhūrjaṭiḥ parameśāno bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ  || 1,29.6 ||
pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ jñātuṃ dāruvanaukasām  |
parīkṣārthaṃ jagannāthaḥ śraddhayā krīḍayā ca saḥ  || 1,29.7 ||
nivṛttilakṣaṇajñāna pratiṣṭhārthaṃ ca śaṅkaraḥ  |
devadāruvanasthānāṃ pravṛttijñānacetasām  || 1,29.8 ||
vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthāya digvāsā viṣamekṣaṇaḥ  |
mugdho dvihastaḥ kṛṣṇāṅgo divyaṃ dāruvanaṃ yayau  || 1,29.9 ||
mandasmitaṃ ca bhagavān strīṇāṃ manasijodbhavam  |
bhrūvilāsaṃ ca gānaṃ ca cakārātīva suṃdaraḥ  || 1,29.10 ||
saṃprokṣya nārīvṛndaṃ vai muhurmuhuranaṅgahā  |
anaṅgavṛddhimakarodatīva madhurākṛtiḥ  || 1,29.11 ||
vane taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtaṃ nīlalohitam  |
striyaḥ pativratāścāpi tamevānvayurādarāt || 1,29.12 ||
vanoṭajadvāragatāśca nāryo visrastavastrābharaṇā viceṣṭāḥ  |
labdhvā smitaṃ tasya mukhāravindāddrumālayasthāstamathānvayustāḥ  || 1,29.13 ||
dṛṣṭvā kāścidbhavaṃ nāryo madaghūrṇitalocanāḥ  |
vilāsabāhyāstāścāpi bhrūvilāsaṃ pracakrire  || 1,29.14 ||
atha dṛṣṭvāparā nāryaḥ kiṃcitprahasitānanāḥ  |
kiṃcidvisrastavasanāḥ srastakāñcīguṇā jaguḥ  || 1,29.15 ||
kāścittadā taṃ vipine tu dṛṣṭvā viprāṅganāḥ srastanavāṃśukaṃ vā  |
svānsvānvicitrān valayānpravidhya madānvitā bandhujanāṃśca jagmuḥ  || 1,29.16 ||
kācittadā taṃ na viveda dṛṣṭvā vivāsanā srastamahāṃśukā ca  |
śākhāvicitrān viṭapānprasiddhānmadānvitā bandhujanāṃstathānyāḥ  || 1,29.17 ||
kāścijjagustaṃ nanṛturnipetuśca dharātale  |
niṣedurgajavaccānyā provāca dvijapuṅgavāḥ  || 1,29.18 ||
anyonyaṃ sasmitaṃ prekṣya cāliliṅguḥ samantataḥ  |
nirudhya mārgaṃ rudrasya naipuṇāni pracakrire  || 1,29.19 ||
ko bhavāniti cāhustaṃ āsyatāmiti cāparāḥ  |
kutretyatha prasīdeti jajalpuḥ prītamānasāḥ  || 1,29.20 ||
viparītā nipeturvai visrastāṃśukamūrdhajāḥ  |
pativratāḥ patīnāṃ tu saṃnidhau bhavamāyayā  || 1,29.21 ||
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā bhavastāsāṃ ceṣṭāvākyāni cāvyayaḥ  |
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi noktavānparameśvaraḥ  || 1,29.22 ||
dṛṣṭvā nārīkulaṃ viprāstathābhūtaṃ ca śaṅkaram  |
atīva paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ jajalpuste munīśvarāḥ  || 1,29.23 ||
tapāṃsi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāhanyanta śaṅkare  |
yathādityaprakāśena tārakā nabhasi sthitāḥ  || 1,29.24 ||
śrūyate ṛṣiśāpena brahmaṇastu mahātmanaḥ  |
samṛddhaśreyasāṃ yoniryajñā vai nāśamāptavān  || 1,29.25 ||
bhṛgorapi ca śāpena viṣṇuḥ paramavīryavān  |
prādurbhāvāndaśa prāpto duḥkhitaśca sadā kṛtaḥ  || 1,29.26 ||
indrasyāpi ca dharmajña chinnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ purā  |
ṛṣiṇā gautamenorvyāṃ kruddhena vinipātitam  || 1,29.27 ||
garbhavāso vasūnāṃ ca śāpena vihitastathā  |
ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva śāpena nahuṣaḥ sarpatāṃ gataḥ  || 1,29.28 ||
kṣīrodaśca samudro'sau nivāsaḥ sarvadā hareḥ  |
dvitīyaścāmṛtādhāro hyapeyo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ  || 1,29.29 ||
avimukteśvaraṃ prāpya vārāṇasyāṃ janārdanaḥ  |
kṣīreṇa cābhiṣicyeśaṃ devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam  || 1,29.30 ||
śraddhayā parayā yukto dehāśleṣāmṛtena vai  |
niṣiktena svayaṃ devaḥ kṣīreṇa madhusūdanaḥ  || 1,29.31 ||
secayitvātha bhagavān brahmaṇā munibhiḥ samam  |
kṣīrodaṃ pūrvavaccakre nivāsaṃ cātmanaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,29.32 ||
dharmaścaiva tathā śapto māṇḍavyena mahātmanā  |
vṛṣṇayaścaiva kṛṣṇena durvāsādyairmahātmabhiḥ  || 1,29.33 ||
rāghavaḥ sānujaścāpi durvāsena mahātmanā  |
śrīvatsaśca muneḥ pāda patanāttasya dhīmataḥ  || 1,29.34 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo viprāṇāṃ vaśamāgatāḥ  |
varjayitvā virūpākṣaṃ devadevamumāpatim  || 1,29.35 ||
evaṃ hi mohitāstena nāvabudhyanta śaṅkaram  |
atyugravacanaṃ procuścogro'pyantaradhīyata  || 1,29.36 ||
te'pi dāruvanāttasmātprātaḥ saṃvignamānasāḥ  |
pitāmahaṃ mahātmānamāsīnaṃ paramāsane  || 1,29.37 ||
gatvā vijñāpayāmāsuḥ pravṛttamakhilaṃ vibhoḥ  |
śubhe dāruvane tasminmunayaḥ kṣīṇacetasaḥ  || 1,29.38 ||
so'pi saṃcintya manasā kṣaṇādeva pitāmahaḥ  |
teṣāṃ pravṛttamakhilaṃ puṇye dāruvane purā  || 1,29.39 ||
utthāya prāñjalirbhūtvā praṇipatya bhavāya ca  |
uvāca satvaraṃ brahmā munīndāruvanālayān  || 1,29.40 ||
dhigyuṣmān prāptanidhanānmahānidhimanuttamam  |
vṛthākṛtaṃ yato viprā yuṣmābhirbhāgyavarjitaiḥ  || 1,29.41 ||
yastu dāruvane tasmiṃlliṅgī dṛṣṭo'pyaliṅgibhiḥ  |
yuṣmābhirvikṛtākāraḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ  || 1,29.42 ||
gṛhasthaiśca na nindyāstu sadā hyatithayo dvijāḥ  |
virūpāśca surūpāśca malināścāpyapaṇḍitāḥ  || 1,29.43 ||
<storyof ṣudarśana>
sudarśanena muninā kālamṛtyurapi svayam  |
purā bhūmau dvijāgryeṇa jito hyatithipūjayā  || 1,29.44 ||
anyathā nāsti saṃtartuṃ gṛhasthaiśca dvijottamaiḥ  |
tyaktvā cātithipūjāṃ tāmātmano bhuvi śodhanam  || 1,29.45 ||
gṛhastho'pi purā jetuṃ sudarśana iti śrutaḥ  |
pratijñāmakarojjāyāṃ bhāryāmāha pativratām  || 1,29.46 ||
suvrate subhru subhage śṛṇu sarvaṃ prayatnataḥ  |
tvayā vai nāvamantavyā gṛhe hyatithayaḥ sadā  || 1,29.47 ||
sarva eva svayaṃ sākṣādatithiryatpinākadhṛk |
tasmādatithaye dattvā ātmānamapi pūjaya  || 1,29.48 ||
evamuktvātha saṃtaptā vivaśā sā pativratā  |
patimāha rudantī ca kimuktaṃ bhavatā prabho  || 1,29.49 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā punaḥ prāha sudarśanaḥ  |
deyaṃ sarvaṃ śivāyārye śiva evātithiḥ svayam  || 1,29.50 ||
tasmātsarve pūjanīyāḥ sarve'pyatithayaḥ sadā  |
evamuktā tadā bhartrā bhāryā tasya pativratā  || 1,29.51 ||
śeṣāmivājñāmādāya mūrdhnā sā prācarattadā  |
parīkṣituṃ tathā śraddhāṃ tayoḥ sākṣāddvijottamāḥ  || 1,29.52 ||
dharmo dvijottamo bhūtvā jagāmātha munergṛham  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cārcayāmāsa sārghyādyairanaghā dvijam  || 1,29.53 ||
sampūjitastayā tāṃ tu prāha dharmo dvijaḥ svayam  |
bhadre kutaḥ patirdhīmāṃstava bhartā sudarśanaḥ  || 1,29.54 ||
annādyairalamadyārye svaṃ dātumiha cārhasi  |
sā ca lajjāvṛtā nārī smarantī kathitaṃ purā  || 1,29.55 ||
bhartrā nyamīlayannetre cacāla ca pativratā  |
kiṃcetyāha punastaṃ vai dharme cakre ca sā matim  || 1,29.56 ||
nivedituṃ kilātmānaṃ tasmai patyurihājñayā  |
etasminnantare bhartā tasyā nāryāḥ sudarśanaḥ  || 1,29.57 ||
gṛhadvāraṃ gato dhīmāṃstāmuvāca mahāmuniḥ  |
ehyehi kva gatā bhadre tamuvācātithiḥ svayam  || 1,29.58 ||
bhāryayā tvanayā sārdhaṃ maithunastho'hamadya vai  |
sudarśana mahābhāga kiṃ kartavyamihocyatām  || 1,29.59 ||
suratāntastu viprendra saṃtuṣṭo'haṃ dvijottama  |
sudarśanastataḥ prāha suprahṛṣṭo dvijottamaḥ  || 1,29.60 ||
bhuṅkṣva caināṃ yathākāmaṃ gamiṣye'haṃ dvijottama  |
hṛṣṭo'tha darśayāmāsa svātmānaṃ dharmarāṭsvayam  || 1,29.61 ||
pradadau cepsitaṃ sarvaṃ tamāha ca mahādyutiḥ  |
eṣā na bhuktā viprendra manasāpi suśobhanā  || 1,29.62 ||
mayā caiṣā na saṃdehaḥ śraddhāṃ jñātumihāgataḥ  |
jito vai yastvayā mṛtyurdharmeṇaikena suvrata  || 1,29.63 ||
aho'sya tapaso vīryamityuktvā prayayau ca saḥ  |
tasmāttathā pūjanīyāḥ sarve hyatithayaḥ sadā  || 1,29.64 ||
bahunātra kimuktena bhāgyahīnā dvijottamāḥ  |
tameva śaraṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ gantumarhatha śaṅkaram  || 1,29.65 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇo brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ  |
brahmāṇamabhivandyārtāḥ procurākulitekṣaṇāḥ  || 1,29.66 ||

brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ
nāpekṣitaṃ mahābhāga jīvitaṃ vikṛtāḥ striyaḥ  |
dṛṣṭo'smābhirmahādevo nindito yastvaninditaḥ  || 1,29.67 ||
śaptaśca sarvagaḥ śūlī pinākī nīlalohitaḥ  |
ajñānācchāpajā śaktiḥ kuṇṭhitāsyanirīkṣaṇāt || 1,29.68 ||
vaktumarhasi deveśa saṃnyāsaṃ vai krameṇa tu  |
draṣṭuṃ vai devadeveśamugraṃ bhīmaṃ kapardinam  || 1,29.69 ||

pitāmaha uvāca
ādau vedānadhītyaiva śraddhayā ca guroḥ sadā  |
vicāryārthaṃ munerdharmān pratijñāya dvijottamāḥ  || 1,29.70 ||
grahaṇāntaṃ hi vā vidvānatha dvādaśavārṣikam  |
snātvāhṛtya ca dārānvai putrānutpādya suvratān  || 1,29.71 ||
vṛttibhiścānurūpābhistān vibhajya sutānmuniḥ  |
agniṣṭomādibhiśceṣṭvā yajñairyajñeśvaraṃ vibhum  || 1,29.72 ||
pūjayetparamātmānaṃ prāpyāraṇyaṃ vibhāvasau  |
munirdvādaśavarṣaṃ vā varṣamātramathāpi vā  || 1,29.73 ||
pakṣadvādaśakaṃ vāpi dinadvādaśakaṃ tu vā  |
kṣīrabhuksaṃyutaḥ śāntaḥ sarvān sampūjayetsurān  || 1,29.74 ||
iṣṭvaivaṃ juhuyādagnau yajñapātrāṇi mantrataḥ  |
apsu vai pārthivaṃ nyasya gurave taijasāni tu  || 1,29.75 ||
svadhanaṃ sakalaṃ caiva brāhmaṇebhyo viśaṅkayā  |
praṇipatya guruṃ bhūmau viraktaḥ saṃnyasedyatiḥ  || 1,29.76 ||
nikṛtya keśān saśikhānupavītaṃ visṛjya ca  |
pañcabhirjuhuyādapsu bhūḥ svāheti vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 1,29.77 ||
tataścordhvaṃ caredevaṃ yatiḥ śivavimuktaye  |
vratenānaśanenāpi toyavṛttyāpi vā punaḥ  || 1,29.78 ||
parṇavṛttyā payovṛttyā phalavṛttyāpi vā yatiḥ  |
evaṃ jīvanmṛto no cetṣaṇmāsādvatsarāttu vā  || 1,29.79 ||
prasthānādikamāyāsaṃ svadehasya caredyatiḥ  |
śivasāyujyamāpnoti karmaṇāpyevamācaran  || 1,29.80 ||
sadyo'pi labhate muktiṃ bhaktiyukto dṛḍhavratāḥ  || 1,29.81 ||
tyāgena vā kiṃ vidhināpyanena bhaktasya rudrasya śubhairvrataiśca  |
yajñaiśca dānairvividhaiśca homairlabdhaiścaśāstrairvividhaiśca vedaiḥ  || 1,29.82 ||
śvetenaivaṃ jito mṛtyurbhavabhaktyā mahātmanā  |
vo'stu bhaktirmahādeve śaṅkare paramātmani  || 1,29.83 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 30

śailādiruvāca
evamuktāstadā tena brahmaṇā brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ  |
śvetasya ca kathāṃ puṇyāmapṛcchan paramarṣayaḥ  || 1,30.1 ||

pitāmaha uvāca
śveto nāma muniḥ śrīmān gatāyurgirigahvare  |
sakto hyabhyarcya yadbhaktyā tuṣṭāva ca maheśvaram  || 1,30.2 ||
rudrādhyāyena puṇyena namastetyādinā dvijāḥ  |
tataḥ kālo mahātejāḥ kālaprāptaṃ dvijottamam  || 1,30.3 ||
netuṃ saṃcintya viprendrāḥ sānnidhyamakaronmuneḥ  |
śveto'pi dṛṣṭvā taṃ kālaṃ kālaprāpto'pi śaṅkaram  || 1,30.4 ||
pūjayāmāsa puṇyātmā triyaṃbakamanusmaran  |
triyaṃbakaṃ yajedevaṃ sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam  || 1,30.5 ||
kiṃ kariṣyati me mṛtyurmṛtyormṛtyurahaṃ yataḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sasmitaṃ prāha śvetaṃ lokabhayaṃkaraḥ  || 1,30.6 ||
ehyehi śveta cānena vidhinā kiṃ phalaṃ tava  |
rudro vā bhagavān viṣṇurbrahmā vā jagadīśvaraḥ  || 1,30.7 ||
kaḥ samarthaḥ paritrātuṃ mayā grastaṃ dvijottama  |
anena mama kiṃ vipra raudreṇa vidhinā prabhoḥ  || 1,30.8 ||
netuṃ yasyotthitaścāhaṃ yamalokaṃ kṣaṇena vai  |
yasmādgatāyustvaṃ tasmānmune netumihodyataḥ  || 1,30.9 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhairavaṃ dharmamiśritam  |
hā rudra rudra rudreti lalāpa munipuṅgavaḥ  || 1,30.10 ||
taṃ prāha ca mahādevaṃ kālaṃ samprekṣya vai dṛśā  |
netreṇa bāṣpamiśreṇa saṃbhrāntena samākulaḥ  || 1,30.11 ||

śveta uvāca
tvayā kiṃ kāla no nāthaścāsti ceddhi vṛṣadhvajaḥ  |
liṅge'smin śaṅkaro rudraḥ sarvadevabhavodbhavaḥ  || 1,30.12 ||
atīva bhavabhaktānāṃ madvidhānāṃ mahātmanām  |
vidhinā kiṃ mahābāho gaccha gaccha yathāgatam  || 1,30.13 ||
tato niśamya kupitastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro bhayaṅkaraḥ  |
śrutvā śvetasya tadvākyaṃ pāśahasto bhayāvahaḥ  || 1,30.14 ||
siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā cāsphāṭya ca muhurmuhuḥ  |
babandha ca muniṃ kālaḥ kālaprāptaṃ tamāha ca  || 1,30.15 ||
mayā baddho'si viprarṣe śvetaṃ netuṃ yamālayam  |
adya vai devadevena tava rudreṇa kiṃ kṛtam  || 1,30.16 ||
kva śarvastava bhaktiśca kva pūjā pūjayā phalam  |
kva cāhaṃ kva ca me bhītiḥ śveta baddho'si vai mayā  || 1,30.17 ||
liṅge'smin saṃsthitaḥ śveta tava rudro maheśvaraḥ  |
niśceṣṭo'sau mahādevaḥ kathaṃ pūjyo maheśvaraḥ  || 1,30.18 ||
tataḥ sadāśivaḥ svayaṃ dvijaṃ nihantumāgatam  |
nihantumantakaṃ smayan smarāriyajñahā haraḥ  || 1,30.19 ||
tvaran vinirgataḥ paraḥ śivaḥ svayaṃ trilocanaḥ  |
triyaṃbako'mbayā samaṃ sanandinā gaṇeśvaraiḥ  || 1,30.20 ||
sasarja jīvitaṃ kṣaṇādbhavaṃ nirīkṣya vai bhayāt |
papāta cāśu vai balī munestu saṃnidhau dvijāḥ  || 1,30.21 ||
nanāda cordhvamuccadhīrnirīkṣya cāntakāntakam  |
nirīkṣaṇena vai mṛtaṃ bhavasya viprapuṅgavāḥ  || 1,30.22 ||
vineduruccamīśvarāḥ sureśvarā maheśvaram  |
praṇemuraṃbikāmumāṃ munīśvarāstu harṣitāḥ  || 1,30.23 ||
sasarjurasya mūrdhni vai munerbhavasya khecarāḥ  |
suśobhanaṃ suśītalaṃ supuṣpavarṣamaṃbarāt || 1,30.24 ||
aho nirīkṣya cāntakaṃ mṛtaṃ tadā suvismitaḥ  |
śilāśanātmajo'vyayaṃ śivaṃ praṇamya śaṅkaram  || 1,30.25 ||
uvāca bāladhīrmṛtaḥ prasīda ceti vai muneḥ  |
maheśvaraṃ maheśvarasya cānugo gaṇeśvaraḥ  || 1,30.26 ||
tato viveśa bhagavānanugṛhya dvijottamam  |
kṣaṇādgūḍhaśarīraṃ hi dhvastaṃ dṛṣṭvāntakaṃ kṣaṇāt || 1,30.27 ||
tasmānmṛtyuñjayaṃ caiva bhaktyā sampūjaye dvijāḥ  |
muktidaṃ bhuktidaṃ caiva sarveṣāmapi śaṅkaram  || 1,30.28 ||
bahunā kiṃ pralāpena saṃnyasyābhyarcya vai bhavam  |
bhaktyā cāparayā tasmin viśokā vai bhaviṣyatha  || 1,30.29 ||

śailādiruvāca
evamuktāstadā tena brahmaṇā brahmavādinaḥ  |
prasīda bhaktirdeveśe bhavedrudre pinākini  || 1,30.30 ||
kena vā tapasā deva yajñenāpyatha kena vā  |
vratairvā bhagavadbhaktā bhaviṣyanti dvijātayaḥ  || 1,30.31 ||

pitāmaha uvāca
na dānena muniśreṣṭhāstapasā ca na vidyayā  |
yajñairhomairvratairvedairyogaśāstrairnirodhanaiḥ  || 1,30.32 ||
prasāde naiva sā bhaktiḥ śive paramakāraṇe  |
atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarve te paramarṣayaḥ  || 1,30.33 ||
sadāratanayāḥ śrāntāḥ praṇemuśca pitāmaham  |
tasmātpāśupatī bhaktirdharmakāmārthasiddhidā  || 1,30.34 ||
munervijayadā caiva sarvamṛtyujayapradā  |
dadhīcastu purā bhaktyā hariṃ jitvāmarairvibhum  || 1,30.35 ||
kṣayaṃ jaghāna pādena vajrāsthitvaṃ ca labdhavān  |
mayāpi nirjito mṛtyurmahādevasya kīrtanāt || 1,30.36 ||
śvetenāpi gatenāsyaṃ mṛtyormunivareṇa tu  |
mahādevaprasādena jito mṛtyuryathā mayā  || 1,30.37 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 31

sanatkumāra uvāca
kathaṃ bhavaprasādena devadāruvanaukasaḥ  |
prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ vaktumarhasi me prabho  || 1,31.1 ||

śailādiruvāca
tānuvāca mahābhāgān bhagavānātmabhūḥ svayam  |
devadāruvanasthāṃstu tapasā pāvakaprabhān  || 1,31.2 ||

pitāmaha uvāca
eṣa devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ  |
na tasmātparamaṃ kiṃcitpadaṃ samadhigamyate  || 1,31.3 ||
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ caiva sa prabhuḥ  |
sahasrayugaparyante pralaye sarvadehinaḥ  || 1,31.4 ||
saṃharatyeṣa bhagavān kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ  |
eṣa caiva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjatyekaḥ svatejasā  || 1,31.5 ||
eṣa cakrī ca vajrī ca śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ  |
yogī kṛtayuge caiva tretāyāṃ kraturucyate  || 1,31.6 ||
dvāpare caiva kālāgnirdharmaketuḥ kalau smṛtaḥ  |
rudrasya mūrtayastvetā ye'bhidhyāyanti paṇḍitāḥ  || 1,31.7 ||
caturasraṃ bahiścāntaraṣṭāsraṃ piṇḍikāśraye  |
vṛttaṃ sudarśanaṃ yogyamevaṃ liṅgaṃ prapūjayet || 1,31.8 ||
tamo hyagnī rajo brahmā sattvaṃ viṣṇuḥ prakāśakam  |
mūrtirekā sthitā cāsya mūrtayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ  || 1,31.9 ||
yatra tiṣṭhati tadbrahma yogena tu samanvitam  |
tasmāddhi devadeveśamīśānaṃ prabhumavyayam  || 1,31.10 ||
ārādhayanti viprendrā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ  |
liṅgaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam  || 1,31.11 ||
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ suśubhaṃ suvṛttaṃ sarvasaṃmatam  |
samanābhaṃ tathāṣṭāsraṃ ṣoḍaśāsramathāpi vā  || 1,31.12 ||
suvṛttaṃ maṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  |
vedikā dviguṇā tasya samā vā sarvasaṃmatā  || 1,31.13 ||
gomukhī ca tribhāgaikā vedyā lakṣaṇasaṃyutā  |
paṭṭikā ca samantādvai yavamātrā dvijottamāḥ  || 1,31.14 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śailaṃ kṛtvā tāmramayaṃ tathā  |
vedikāyāśca vistāraṃ triguṇaṃ vai samantataḥ  || 1,31.15 ||
vartulaṃ caturasraṃ vā ṣaḍasraṃ vā trirasrakam  |
samantānnirvraṇaṃ śubhraṃ lakṣaṇaistatsulakṣitam  || 1,31.16 ||
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ pūjālakṣaṇasaṃyutam  |
kalaśaṃ sthāpayettasya vedimadhye tathā dvijāḥ  || 1,31.17 ||
sahiraṇyaṃ sabījaṃ ca brahmabhiścābhimantritam  |
secayecca tato liṅgaṃ pavitraiḥ pañcabhiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 1,31.18 ||
pūjayecca yathālābhaṃ tataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha  |
samāhitāḥ pūjayadhvaṃ saputrāḥ saha bandhubhiḥ  || 1,31.19 ||
sarve prāñjalayo bhūtvā śūlapāṇiṃ prapadyata  |
tato drakṣyatha deveśaṃ durdarśamakṛtātmabhiḥ  || 1,31.20 ||
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvamajñānamadharmaśca praṇaśyati  |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇamamitaujasam  || 1,31.21 ||
samprasthitā vanaukāste devadāruvanaṃ tataḥ  |
ārādhayitumārabdhā brahmaṇā kathitaṃ yathā  || 1,31.22 ||
sthaṇḍileṣu vicitreṣu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca  |
nadīnāṃ ca vivikteṣu pulineṣu śubheṣu ca  || 1,31.23 ||
śaivālaśobhanāḥ kecitkecidantarjaleśayāḥ  |
keciddarbhāvakāśāstu pādāṅguṣṭhāgradhiṣṭhitāḥ  || 1,31.24 ||
dantolūkhalinastvanye aśmakuṭṭāstathā pare  |
sthānavīrāsanāstvanye mṛgacaryāratāḥ pare  || 1,31.25 ||
kālaṃ nayanti tapasā pūjayā ca mahādhiyaḥ  |
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe vasante samupasthite  || 1,31.26 ||
tatasteṣāṃ prasādārthaṃ bhaktānāmanukampayā  |
devaḥ kṛtayuge tasmin girau himavataḥ śubhe  || 1,31.27 ||
devadāruvanaṃ prāptaḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ  |
bhasmapāṃsūpadigdhāṅgo nagno vikṛtalakṣaṇaḥ  || 1,31.28 ||
ulmukavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ  |
kvacicca hasate raudraṃ kvacidgāyati vismitaḥ  || 1,31.29 ||
kvacinnṛtyati śṛṅgāraṃ kvacidrauti muhurmuhuḥ  |
āśrame hyaṭate bhaikṣyaṃ yācate ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 1,31.30 ||
māyāṃ kṛtvā tathārūpāṃ devastadvanamāgataḥ  |
tataste munayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuśca samāhitāḥ  || 1,31.31 ||
adbhirvividhamālyaiśca dhūpairgandhaistathaiva ca  |
sapatnīkā mahābhāgāḥ saputrāḥ saparicchadāḥ  || 1,31.32 ||
munayaste tathā vāgbhirīśvaraṃ cedamabruvan  |
ajñānāddevadeveśa yadasmābhiranuṣṭhitam  || 1,31.33 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi  |
caritāni vicitrāṇi guhyāni gahanāni ca  || 1,31.34 ||
brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ durvijñeyāni te hara  |
agatiṃ te na jānīmo gatiṃ naiva ca naiva ca  || 1,31.35 ||
viśveśvara mahādeva yo'si so'si namo'stu te  |
stuvanti tvāṃ mahātmāno devadevaṃ maheśvaram  || 1,31.36 ||
namo bhavāya bhavyāya bhāvanāyodbhavāya ca  |
anantabalavīryāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,31.37 ||
saṃhartre ca piśaṅgāya avyayāya vyayāya ca  |
gaṅgāsaliladhārāya ādhārāya guṇātmane  || 1,31.38 ||
tryaṃbakāya trinetrāya triśūlavaradhāriṇe  |
kandarpāya hutāśāya namo'stu paramātmane  || 1,31.39 ||
śaṅkarāya vṛṣāṅkāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
daṇḍahastāya kālāya pāśahastāya vai namaḥ  || 1,31.40 ||
vedamantrapradhānāya śatajihvāya vai namaḥ  |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yat || 1,31.41 ||
tava dehātsamutpannaṃ deva sarvamidaṃ jagat |
pāsi haṃsi ca bhadraṃ te prasīda bhagavaṃstataḥ  || 1,31.42 ||
ajñānādyadi vijñānādyatkiṃcitkurute naraḥ  |
tatsarvaṃ bhagavāneva kurute yogamāyayā  || 1,31.43 ||
evaṃ stutvā tu munayaḥ prahṛṣṭairantarātmabhiḥ  |
yācanta tapasā yuktāḥ paśyāmastvāṃ yathāpurā  || 1,31.44 ||
tato devaḥ prasannātmā svamevāsthāya śaṅkaraḥ  |
rūpaṃ tryakṣaṃ ca saṃdraṣṭuṃ divyaṃ cakṣuradātprabhuḥ  || 1,31.45 ||
labdhadṛṣṭyā tayā dṛṣṭvā devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam  |
punastuṣṭuvurīśānaṃ devadāruvanaukasaḥ  || 1,31.46 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 32

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
namo digvāsase nityaṃ kṛtāntāya triśūline  |
vikaṭāya karālāya karālavadanāya ca  || 1,32.1 ||
arūpāya surūpāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ  |
kaṭaṅkaṭāya rudrāya svāhākārāya vai namaḥ  || 1,32.2 ||
sarvapraṇatadehāya svayaṃ ca praṇatātmane  |
nityaṃ nīlaśikhaṇḍāya śrīkaṇṭhāya namonamaḥ  || 1,32.3 ||
nīlakaṇṭhāya devāya citābhasmāṅgadhāriṇe  |
tvaṃ brahmā sarvadevānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ  || 1,32.4 ||
ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sāṃkhyaiḥ puruṣa ucyate  |
parvatānāṃ mahāmerurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ  || 1,32.5 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhastvaṃ devānāṃ vāsavastathā  |
oṅkāraḥ sarvavedānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāma ca sāmasu  || 1,32.6 ||
āraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca siṃhastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ  |
grāmyāṇāmṛṣabhaścāsi bhagavāṃllokapūjitaḥ  || 1,32.7 ||
sarvathā vartamāno'pi yo yo bhāvo bhaviṣyati  |
tvāmeva tatra paśyāmo brahmaṇā kathitaṃ tathā  || 1,32.8 ||
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca viṣādo mada eva ca  |
etadicchāmahe boddhuṃ prasīda parameśvara  || 1,32.9 ||
mahāsaṃharaṇe prāpte tvayā deva kṛtātmanā  |
karaṃ lalāṭe saṃvidhya vahnirutpāditastvayā  || 1,32.10 ||
tenāgninā tadā lokā arcirbhiḥ sarvato vṛtāḥ  |
tasmādagnisamā hyete bahavo vikṛtāgnayaḥ  || 1,32.11 ||
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho dambha upadravaḥ  |
yāni cānyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca  || 1,32.12 ||
dahyante prāṇinaste tu tvatsamutthena vahninā  |
asmākaṃ dahyamānānāṃ trātā bhava sureśvara  || 1,32.13 ||
tvaṃ ca lokahitārthāya bhūtāni pariṣiñcasi  |
maheśvara mahābhāga prabho śubhanirīkṣaka  || 1,32.14 ||
ājñāpaya vayaṃ nātha kartāro vacanaṃ tava  |
bhūtakoṭisahasreṣu rūpakoṭiśateṣu ca  || 1,32.15 ||
antaṃ gantuṃ na śaktāḥ sma devadeva namo'stu te  || 1,32.16 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 33

nandyuvāca
tatastutoṣa bhagavānanugṛhya maheśvaraḥ  |
stutiṃ śrutvā stutasteṣāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 1,33.1 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi yuṣmābhiḥ kīrtitaṃ stavam  |
śrāvayedvā dvijānvipro gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || 1,33.2 ||
vakṣyāmi vo hitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktānāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  |
<advantagesof the ড়āśupata behaviour>
strīliṅgamakhilaṃ devī prakṛtirmama dehajā  || 1,33.3 ||
puṃlliṅgaṃ puruṣo viprā mama dehasamudbhavaḥ  |
ubhābhyāmeva vai sṛṣṭirmama viprā na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,33.4 ||
na nindedyatinaṃ tasmāddigvāsasamanuttamam  |
bālonmattaviceṣṭaṃ tu matparaṃ brahmavādinam  || 1,33.5 ||
ye hi māṃ bhasmaniratā bhasmanā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ  |
yathoktakāriṇo dāntā viprā dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ  || 1,33.6 ||
mahādevaparā nityaṃ caranto hyūrdhvaretasaḥ  |
arcayanti mahādevaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃyatāḥ  || 1,33.7 ||
rudralokamanuprāpya na nivartanti te punaḥ  |
tasmādetadvrataṃ divyamavyaktaṃ vyaktaliṅginaḥ  || 1,33.8 ||
bhasmavratāśca muṇḍāśca vratino viśvarūpiṇaḥ  |
na tānparivadedvidvānna caitānnābhilaṅghayet || 1,33.9 ||
na hasennāpriyaṃ brūyādamutreha hitārthavān  |
yastānnindati mūḍhātmā mahādevaṃ sa nindati  || 1,33.10 ||
yastvetān pūjayennityaṃ sa pūjayati śaṅkaram  |
evameṣa mahādevo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 1,33.11 ||
yuge yuge mahāyogī krīḍate bhasmaguṇṭhitaḥ  |
evaṃ carata bhadraṃ vastataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha  || 1,33.12 ||
atulamiha mahābhayapraṇāśahetuṃ śivakathitaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ viditvā  |
vyapagatabhavalobhamohacittāḥ praṇipatitāḥ sahasā śirobhirugram  || 1,33.13 ||
tataḥ pramuditā viprāḥ śrutvaivaṃ kathitaṃ tadā  |
gandhodakaiḥ suśuddhaiśca kuśapuṣpavimiśritaiḥ  || 1,33.14 ||
snāpayanti mahākumbhairadbhireva maheśvaram  |
gāyanti vividhairguhyairhuṃkāraiścāpi susvaraiḥ  || 1,33.15 ||
namo devādhidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ  |
ardhanārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravartine  || 1,33.16 ||
meghavāhanakṛṣṇāya gajacarmanivāsine  |
kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya vyālayajñopavītine  || 1,33.17 ||
suracitasuvicitrakuṇḍalāya suracitamālyavibhūṣaṇāya tubhyam  |
mṛgapativaracarmavāsase ca prathitayaśase namo'stu śaṅkarāya  || 1,33.18 ||
tatastān sa munīn prītaḥ pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ  |
prīto'smi tapasā yuṣmān varaṃ vṛṇuta suvratāḥ  || 1,33.19 ||
tataste munayaḥ sarve praṇipatya maheśvaram  |
bhṛgvaṅgirā vasiṣṭhaśca viśvāmitrastathaiva ca  || 1,33.20 ||
gautamo'triḥ sukeśaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ  |
marīciḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇvaḥ saṃvartaśca mahātapāḥ  || 1,33.21 ||
te praṇamya mahādevamidaṃ vacanamabruvan  |
bhasmasnānaṃ ca nagnatvaṃ vāmatvaṃ pratilomatā  || 1,33.22 ||
sevyāsevyatvamevaṃ ca hyetadicchāma veditum  |
tatasteṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānparameśvaraḥ  || 1,33.23 ||
sasmitaṃ prāha samprekṣya sarvānmunivarāṃstadā  || 1,33.24 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ṛṣivākyaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
