liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 70

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ādisargastvayā sūta sūcito na prakāśitaḥ  |
sāṃprataṃ vistareṇaiva vaktumarhasi suvrata  || 1,70.1 ||

sūta uvāca
maheśvaro mahādevaḥ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca  |
paratve saṃsthito devaḥ paramātmā munīśvarāḥ  || 1,70.2 ||
<creation fromavyakta>
avyaktaṃ ceśvarāttasmādabhavatkāraṇaṃ param  |
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiśceti yadāhustattvacintakāḥ  || 1,70.3 ||
gandhavarṇarasairhīnaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam  |
ajaraṃ dhruvamakṣayyaṃ nityaṃ svātmanyavasthitam  || 1,70.4 ||
jagadyoniṃ mahābhūtaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam  |
vigrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāmīśvarājñāpracoditam  || 1,70.5 ||
anādyantamajaṃ sūkṣmaṃ triguṇaṃ prabhavāvyayam  |
aprakāśamavijñeyaṃ brahmāgre samavartata  || 1,70.6 ||
asyātmanā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ tvāsīcchivecchayā  |
guṇasāmye tadā tasminnavibhāge tamomaye  || 1,70.7 ||
<mahant>
sargakāle pradhānasya kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitasya vai  |
guṇabhāvādvyajyamāno mahān prādurbabhūva ha  || 1,70.8 ||
sūkṣmeṇa mahatā cātha avyaktena samāvṛtam  |
sattvodrikto mahānagre sattāmātraprakāśakaḥ  || 1,70.9 ||
mano mahāṃstu vijñeyamekaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ smṛtam  |
samutpannaṃ liṅgamātraṃ kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ hi tat || 1,70.10 ||
dharmādīni ca rūpāṇi lokatattvārthahetavaḥ  |
mahān sṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaḥ sisṛkṣayā  || 1,70.11 ||
mano mahānmatirbrahma pūrbuddhiḥ khyātirīśvaraḥ  |
prajñā citiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃvidviśveśaśceti sa smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.12 ||
manute sarvabhūtānāṃ yasmācceṣṭā phalaṃ tataḥ  |
saukṣmyāttena vibhaktaṃ tu yena tanmana ucyate  || 1,70.13 ||
tattvānāmagrajo yasmānmahāṃśca parimāṇataḥ  |
viśeṣebhyo guṇebhyo'pi mahāniti tataḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.14 ||
bibharti mānaṃ manute vibhāgaṃ manyate'pi ca  |
puruṣo bhogasaṃbandhāttena cāsau matiḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.15 ||
bṛhattvādbṛṃhaṇatvācca bhāvānāṃ sakalāśrayāt |
yasmāddhārayate bhāvān brahma tena nirucyate  || 1,70.16 ||
yaḥ pūrayati yasmācca kṛtsnāndevānanugrahaiḥ  |
nayate tattvabhāvaṃ ca tena pūriti cocyate  || 1,70.17 ||
budhyate puruṣaścātra sarvān bhāvān hitaṃ tathā  |
yasmādbodhayate caiva buddhistena nirucyate  || 1,70.18 ||
khyātiḥ pratyupabhogaśca yasmātsaṃvartate tataḥ  |
bhogasya jñānaniṣṭhatvāttena khyātiriti smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.19 ||
khyāyate tadguṇairvāpi jñānādibhiranekaśaḥ  |
tasmācca mahataḥ saṃjñā khyātirityabhidhīyate  || 1,70.20 ||
sākṣātsarvaṃ vijānāti mahātmā tena ceśvaraḥ  |
yasmājjñānānugaścaiva prajñā tena sa ucyate  || 1,70.21 ||
jñānādīni ca rūpāṇi bahukarmaphalāni ca  |
cinoti yasmādbhogārthaṃ tenāsau citirucyate  || 1,70.22 ||
vartamānavyatītāni tathaivānāgatānyapi  |
smarate sarvakāryāṇi tenāsau smṛtirucyate  || 1,70.23 ||
kṛtsnaṃ ca vindate jñānaṃ yasmānmāhātmyamuttamam  |
tasmādvindervideścaiva saṃvidityabhidhīyate  || 1,70.24 ||
vidyate'pi ca sarvatra tasminsarvaṃ ca vindati  |
tasmātsaṃviditi prokto mahadbhirmunisattamāḥ  || 1,70.25 ||
jānāterjñānamityāhurbhagavān jñānasaṃnidhiḥ  |
bandhanādiparībhāvādīśvaraḥ procyate budhaiḥ  || 1,70.26 ||
paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdaistattvamādyamanuttamam  |
vyākhyātaṃ tattvabhāvajñairdevasadbhāvacetakaiḥ  || 1,70.27 ||
mahānsṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaḥ sisṛkṣayā  |
saṃkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca tasya vṛttidvayaṃ smṛtam  || 1,70.28 ||
triguṇādrajasodriktādahaṅkārastato'bhavat |
mahatā ca vṛtaḥ sargo bhūtādirbāhyatastu saḥ  || 1,70.29 ||
tasmādeva tamodriktādahaṅkārādajāyata  |
bhūtatanmātrasargastu bhūtādistāmasastu saḥ  || 1,70.30 ||
<creationof mahābhūtas>
bhūtādistu vikurvāṇaḥ śabdamātraṃ sasarja ha  |
ākāśaṃ suṣiraṃ tasmādutpannaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam  || 1,70.31 ||
ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ tu sparśamātraṃ samāvṛṇot |
vāyuścāpi vikurvāṇo rūpamātraṃ sasarja ha  || 1,70.32 ||
jyotirutpadyate vāyostadrūpaguṇamucyate  |
sparśamātrastu vai vāyū rūpamātraṃ samāvṛṇot || 1,70.33 ||
jyotiścāpi vikurvāṇaṃ rasamātraṃ sasarja ha  |
sambhavanti tato hyāpastā vai sarvarasātmikāḥ  || 1,70.34 ||
rasamātrāstu tā hyāpo rūpamātro'gnirāvṛṇot |
āpaścāpi vikurvatyo gandhamātraṃ sasarjire  || 1,70.35 ||
saṃghāto jāyate tasmāttasya gandho guṇo mataḥ  |
tasmiṃstasmiṃśca tanmātraṃ tena tanmātratā smṛtā  || 1,70.36 ||
aviśeṣavācakatvādaviśeṣāstatastu te  |
praśāntaghoramūḍhatvādaviśeṣāstataḥ punaḥ  || 1,70.37 ||
bhūtatanmātrasargo'yaṃ vijñeyastu parasparam  |
vaikārikādahaṅkārātsattvodriktāttu sāttvikāt || 1,70.38 ||
vaikārikaḥ sa sargastu yugapatsampravartate  |
<indriyas>
buddhīndriyāṇi pañcaiva pañca karmendriyāṇi ca  || 1,70.39 ||
sādhakānīndriyāṇi syurdevā vaikārikā daśa  |
ekādaśaṃ manastatra svaguṇenobhayātmakam  || 1,70.40 ||
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī  |
śabdādīnāmavāptyarthaṃ buddhiyuktāni tāni vai  || 1,70.41 ||
pādau pāyurupasthaśca hastau vāgdaśamī bhavet |
gatirvisargo hyānandaḥ śilpaṃ vākyaṃ ca karma tat || 1,70.42 ||
ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ ca sparśamātraṃ samāviśat |
dviguṇastu tato vāyuḥ śabdasparśātmako'bhavat || 1,70.43 ||
rūpaṃ tathaiva viśataḥ śabdasparśaguṇāvubhau  |
triguṇastu tatastvagniḥ saśabdasparśarūpavān  || 1,70.44 ||
saśabdasparśarūpaṃ ca rasamātraṃ samāviśat |
tasmāccaturguṇā āpo vijñeyāstu rasātmikāḥ  || 1,70.45 ||
śabdasparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca raso vai gandhamāviśat |
saṃgatā gandhamātreṇa āviśanto mahīmimām  || 1,70.46 ||
tasmātpañcaguṇā bhūmiḥ sthūlā bhūteṣu śasyate  |
śāntā ghorāśca mūḍhāśca viśeṣāstena te smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.47 ||
parasparānupraveśāddhārayanti parasparam  |
bhūmerantastvidaṃ sarvaṃ lokālokācalāvṛtam  || 1,70.48 ||
viśeṣāścendriyagrāhyā niyatatvācca te smṛtāḥ  |
guṇaṃ pūrvasya sargasya prāpnuvantyuttarottarāḥ  || 1,70.49 ||
teṣāṃ yāvacca tadyacca yacca tāvadguṇaṃ smṛtam  |
upalabhyāpsu vai gandhaṃ kecidbrūyurapāṃ guṇam  || 1,70.50 ||
pṛthivyāmeva taṃ vidyādapāṃ vāyośca saṃśrayāt |
ete sapta mahātmāno hyanyonyasya samāśrayāt || 1,70.51 ||
puruṣādhiṣṭhitatvācca avyaktānugraheṇa ca  |
<aṇḍa>
mahādayo viśeṣāntā hyaṇḍamutpādayanti te  || 1,70.52 ||
ekakālasamutpannaṃ jalabudbudavacca tat |
viśeṣebhyo'ṇḍamabhavanmahattadudakeśayam  || 1,70.53 ||
adbhirdaśaguṇābhistu bāhyato'ṇḍaṃ samāvṛtam  |
āpo daśaguṇenaitāstejasā bāhyato vṛtāḥ  || 1,70.54 ||
tejo daśaguṇenaiva vāyunā bāhyato vṛtam  |
vāyurdaśaguṇenaiva bāhyato nabhasā vṛtaḥ  || 1,70.55 ||
ākāśenāvṛto vāyuḥ khaṃ tu bhūtādināvṛtam  |
bhūtādirmahatā cāpi avyaktenāvṛto mahān  || 1,70.56 ||
śarvaścāṇḍakapālastho bhavaścāṃbhasi suvratāḥ  |
rudro'gnimadhye bhagavānugro vāyau punaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.57 ||
bhīmaścāvanimadhyastho hyahaṅkāre maheśvaraḥ  |
buddhau ca bhagavānīśaḥ sarvataḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,70.58 ||
etairāvaraṇairaṇḍaṃ saptabhiḥ prākṛtairvṛtam  |
etā āvṛtya cānyonyamaṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ sthitāḥ  || 1,70.59 ||
prasargakāle sthitvā tu grasantyetāḥ parasparam  |
evaṃ parasparotpannā dhārayanti parasparam  || 1,70.60 ||
<firstpuruṣa>
ādhārādheyabhāvena vikārāste vikāriṣu  |
maheśvaraḥ paro'vyaktādaṇḍamavyaktasaṃbhavam  || 1,70.61 ||
aṇḍājjajñe sa eveśaḥ puruṣo'rkasamaprabhaḥ  |
tasminkāryasya karaṇaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ svecchayaiva tu  || 1,70.62 ||
sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate  |
tasya vāmāṅgajo viṣṇuḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ  || 1,70.63 ||
lakṣmyā devyā hyabhūddeva icchayā parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
dakṣiṇāṅgabhavo brahmā sarasvatyā jagadguruḥ  || 1,70.64 ||
tasminnaṇḍe ime lokā antarviśvamidaṃ jagat |
candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā  || 1,70.65 ||
lokālokadvayaṃ kiṃcidaṇḍe hyasminsamarpitam  |
<human <> divine time>
yattu sṛṣṭau prasaṃkhyātaṃ mayā kālāntaraṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,70.66 ||
etatkālāntaraṃ jñeyamaharvai pārameśvaram  |
rātriścaitāvatī jñeyā parameśasya kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 1,70.67 ||
ahastasya tu yā sṛṣṭiḥ rātriśca pralayaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
nāhastu vidyate tasya na rātririti dhārayet || 1,70.68 ||
upacārastu kriyate lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  |
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca mahābhūtāni pañca ca  || 1,70.69 ||
tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni buddhiśca saha daivataiḥ  |
ahastiṣṭhanti sarvāṇi parameśasya dhīmataḥ  || 1,70.70 ||
aharante pralīyante rātryante viśvasaṃbhavaḥ  |
svātmanyavasthite vyakte vikāre pratisaṃhṛte  || 1,70.71 ||
<prakṛti andpuruṣa>
sādharmyeṇāvatiṣṭhete pradhānapuruṣāvubhau  |
tamaḥsattvarajopetau samatvena vyavasthitau  || 1,70.72 ||
anupṛktāvabhūtāṃ tāvotaprotau parasparam  |
guṇasāmye layo jñeyo vaiṣamye sṛṣṭirucyate  || 1,70.73 ||
tile yathā bhavettailaṃ ghṛtaṃ payasi vā sthitam  |
tathā tamasi sattve ca rajasyanusṛtaṃ jagat || 1,70.74 ||
upāsya rajanīṃ kṛtsnāṃ parāṃ māheśvarīṃ tathā  |
arhamukhe pravṛttaśca paraḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,70.75 ||
kṣobhayāmāsa yogena pareṇa parameśvaraḥ  |
pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva praviśya sa maheśvaraḥ  || 1,70.76 ||
<trimūrti>
maheśvarāttrayo devā jajñire jagadīśvarāt |
śāśvatāḥ paramā guhyaḥ sarvātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ  || 1,70.77 ||
eta eva trayo devā eta eva trayo guṇāḥ  |
eta eva trayo lokā eta eva trayo'gnayaḥ  || 1,70.78 ||
parasparāśritā hyete parasparamanuvratāḥ  |
paraspareṇa vartante dhārayanti parasparam  || 1,70.79 ||
anyonyamithunā hyete anyonyamupajīvinaḥ  |
kṣaṇaṃ viyogo na hyeṣāṃ na tyajanti parasparam  || 1,70.80 ||
īśvarastu paro devo viṣṇuśca mahataḥ paraḥ  |
brahmā ca rajasā yuktaḥ sargādau hi pravartate  || 1,70.81 ||
paraḥ sa puruṣo jñeyaḥ prakṛtiḥ sā parā smṛtā  || 1,70.82 ||
adhiṣṭhitā sā hi maheśvareṇa pravartate codyamane samantāt |
anupravṛttastu mahāṃstadenāṃ cirasthiratvādviṣayaṃ śriyaḥ svayam  || 1,70.83 ||
pradhānaguṇavaiṣamyātsargakālaḥ pravartate  |
īśvarādhiṣṭhitātpūrvaṃ tasmātsadasadātmakāt || 1,70.84 ||
saṃsiddhaḥ kāryakaraṇe rudraścāgre hyavartata  |
tejasāpratimo dhīmānavyaktaḥ samprakāśakaḥ  || 1,70.85 ||
sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate  |
brahmā ca bhagavāṃstasmāccaturvaktraḥ prajāpatiḥ  || 1,70.86 ||
saṃsiddhaḥ kāryakāraṇe tathā vai samavartata  |
eka eva mahādevastridhaivaṃ sa vyavasthitaḥ  || 1,70.87 ||
apratīpena jñānena aiśvaryeṇa samanvitaḥ  |
dharmeṇa cāpratīpena vairāgyeṇa ca te'nvitāḥ  || 1,70.88 ||
avyaktājjāyate teṣāṃ manasā yadyadīhitam  |
vaśīkṛtatvāttraiguṇyaṃ sāpekṣatvātsvabhāvataḥ  || 1,70.89 ||
caturmukhastu brahmatve kālatve cāntakaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
sahasramūrdhā puruṣastisro'vasthāḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ  || 1,70.90 ||
brahmatve sṛjate lokān kālatve saṃkṣipatyapi  |
puruṣatve hyudāsīnastisro'vasthāḥ prajāpateḥ  || 1,70.91 ||
brahmā kamalagarbhābho rudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ  |
puruṣaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo rūpaṃ tatparamātmanaḥ  || 1,70.92 ||
ekadhā sa dvidhā caiva tridhā ca bahudhā punaḥ  |
maheśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca  || 1,70.93 ||
nānākṛtikriyārūpa nāmavanti svalīlayā  |
maheśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca  || 1,70.94 ||
tridhā yadvartate loke tasmāttriguṇa ucyate  |
caturdhā pravibhaktatvāccaturvyūhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  || 1,70.95 ||
yadāpnoti yadādatte yaccātti viṣayānayam  |
yaccāsya satataṃ bhāvastasmādātmā nirucyate  || 1,70.96 ||
ṛṣiḥ sarvagatatvācca śarīrī so'sya yatprabhuḥ  |
svāmitvamasya yatsarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvapraveśanāt || 1,70.97 ||
bhagavān bhagavadbhāvānnirmalatvācchivaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
paramaḥ samprakṛṣṭatvādavanādomiti smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.98 ||
sarvajñaḥ sarvavijñānātsarvaḥ sarvamayo yataḥ  |
tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ trailokyaṃ sampravartate  || 1,70.99 ||
sṛjate grasate caiva rakṣate ca tribhiḥ svayam  |
āditvādādidevo'sāvajātatvādajaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.100 ||
pāti yasmātprajāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatiriti smṛtaḥ  |
deveṣu ca mahāndevo mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.101 ||
sarvagatvācca devānāmavaśyatvācca īśvaraḥ  |
bṛhattvācca smṛto brahmā bhūtatvādbhūta ucyate  || 1,70.102 ||
kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetravijñānādekatvātkevalaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
yasmātpuryāṃ sa śete ca tasmātpūruṣa ucyate  || 1,70.103 ||
anāditvācca pūrvatvātsvayaṃbhūriti saṃsmṛtaḥ  |
yājyatvāducyate yajñaḥ kavirvikrāntadarśanāt || 1,70.104 ||
kramaṇaḥ kramaṇīyatvātpālakaścāpi pālanāt |
ādityasaṃjñaḥ kapilo hyagrajo'gniriti smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.105 ||
hiraṇyamasya garbho'bhūddhiraṇyasyāpi garbhajaḥ  |
tasmāddhiraṇyagarbhatvaṃ purāṇe'sminnirucyate  || 1,70.106 ||
svayaṃbhuvo'pi vṛttasya kālo viśvātmanastu yaḥ  |
na śakyaḥ parisaṃkhyātumapi varṣaśatairapi  || 1,70.107 ||
kālasaṃkhyāvivṛttasya parārdho brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
tāvaccheṣo'sya kālo'nyastasyānte pratisṛjyate  || 1,70.108 ||
koṭikoṭisahasrāṇi aharbhūtāni yāni vai  |
<vārāhakalpa>
samatītāni kalpānāṃ tāvaccheṣāḥ pare tu ye  |
yastvayaṃ vartate kalpo vārāhastaṃ nibodhata  || 1,70.109 ||
prathamaḥ sāṃpratasteṣāṃ kalpo'yaṃ vartate dvijāḥ  |
yasminsvāyaṃbhuvādyāstu manavaste caturdaśa  || 1,70.110 ||
atītā vartamānāśca bhaviṣyā ye ca vai punaḥ  |
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā saparvatā  || 1,70.111 ||
pūrṇaṃ yugasahasraṃ vai paripālyā maheśvaraiḥ  |
prajābhistapasā caiva teṣāṃ śṛṇuta vistaram  || 1,70.112 ||
manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi ca  |
kathitāni bhaviṣyanti kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi  || 1,70.113 ||
atītāni ca kalpāni sodarkāṇi sahānvayaiḥ  |
anāgateṣu tadvacca tarkaḥ kāryo vijānatā  || 1,70.114 ||
<ṣṃndflut>
āpo hyagre samabhavannaṣṭe ca pṛthivītale  |
śāntatāraikanīre'sminna prājñāyata kiṃcana  || 1,70.115 ||
ekārṇave tadā tasminnaṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  |
tadā bhavati vai brahmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || 1,70.116 ||
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇastvatīndriyaḥ  |
brahmā nārāyaṇākhyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā  || 1,70.117 ||
sattvodrekātprabuddhastu śūnyaṃ lokamudaikṣata  |
imaṃ codāharantyatra ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati  || 1,70.118 ||
āpo nārāśca sūnava ityapāṃ nāma śuśrumaḥ  |
āpūrya tābhirayanaṃ kṛtavānātmano yataḥ  || 1,70.119 ||
apsu śete yatastasmāttato nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
caturyugasahasrasya naiśaṃ kālamupāsyataḥ  || 1,70.120 ||
śarvaryante prakurute brahmatvaṃ sargakāraṇāt |
brahmā tu salile tasmin vāyurbhūtvā samācarat || 1,70.121 ||
niśāyāmiva khadyotaḥ prāvṛṭkāle tatastu saḥ  |
<Earthrisedfroṃ the water>
tatastu salile tasmin vijñāyāntargatāṃ mahīm  || 1,70.122 ||
anumānādasaṃmūḍho bhūmeruddharaṇaṃ punaḥ  |
akarotsa tanūmanyāṃ kalpādiṣu yathāpurā  || 1,70.123 ||
tato mahātmā bhagavān divyarūpamacintayat |
salilenāplutāṃ bhūmiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa tu samantataḥ  || 1,70.124 ||
kiṃnu rūpamahaṃ kṛtvā uddhareyaṃ mahīmimām  |
jalakrīḍānusadṛśaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāviśat || 1,70.125 ||
adhṛṣyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vāṅmayaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam  |
pṛthivyuddharaṇārthāya praviveśa rasātalam  || 1,70.126 ||
adbhiḥ saṃchāditāṃ bhūmiṃ sa tāmāśu prajāpatiḥ  |
upagamyojjahāraināmāpaścāpi samāviśat || 1,70.127 ||
sāmudrā vai samudreṣu nādeyāśca nadīṣu ca  |
rasātalatale magnāṃ rasātalapuṭe gatām  || 1,70.128 ||
prabhurlokahitārthāya daṃṣṭrayābhyujjahāra gām  |
tataḥ svasthānamānīya pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīdharaḥ  || 1,70.129 ||
mumoca pūrvavadasau dhārayitvā dharādharaḥ  |
tasyopari jalaughasya mahatī nauriva sthitā  || 1,70.130 ||
tatsamā hyurudehatvānna mahī yāti saṃplavam  |
tata utkṣipya tāṃ devo jagataḥ sthāpanecchayā  || 1,70.131 ||
pṛthivyāḥ pravibhāgāya manaścakre'mbujekṣaṇaḥ  |
pṛthivīṃ ca samāṃ kṛtvā pṛthivyāṃ so'cinodgirīn  || 1,70.132 ||
prāksarge dahyamāne tu tadā saṃvartakāgninā  |
tenāgninā viśīrṇāste parvatā bhūrivistarāḥ  || 1,70.133 ||
śaityādekārṇave tasmin vāyunā tena saṃhatāḥ  |
niṣiktā yatra yatrāsaṃstatra tatrācalābhavan  || 1,70.134 ||
tadācalatvādacalāḥ parvabhiḥ parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
girayo hi nigīrṇatvācchayānatvācchiloccayāḥ  || 1,70.135 ||
tatasteṣu vikīrṇeṣu koṭiśo hi giriṣvatha  |
viśvakarmā vibhajate kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ  || 1,70.136 ||
sasamudrāmimāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatām  |
bhūrādyāṃścaturo lokān punaḥ so'tha vyakalpayat || 1,70.137 ||
<Brahmā createsanimalsetc.>
lokān prakalpayitvātha prajāsargaṃ sasarja ha  |
brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavān sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ  || 1,70.138 ||
sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ kalpādiṣu yathāpurā  |
tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ tathā vai buddhipūrvakam  || 1,70.139 ||
buddhyāśca samakāle vai prādurbhūtastamomayaḥ  |
tamomoho mahāmohastāmisraścāndhasaṃjñitaḥ  || 1,70.140 ||
avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ  |
pañcadhāvasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyataḥ so'bhimāninaḥ  || 1,70.141 ||
saṃvṛtastamasā caiva bījāṅkuravadāvṛtaḥ  |
bahirantaścāprakāśastabdho niḥsaṃjña eva ca  || 1,70.142 ||
yasmātteṣāṃ vṛtā buddhirduḥkhāni karaṇāni ca  |
tasmātte saṃvṛtātmāno nagā mukhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  || 1,70.143 ||
mukhyasargaṃ tathābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā hyasādhakam  |
aprasannamanāḥ so'tha tato'nyaṃ so hyamanyata  || 1,70.144 ||
tasyābhidhyāyataścaiva tiryaksrotā hyavartata  |
tasmāttiryakpravṛttaḥ sa tiryaksrotāstataḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.145 ||
paśvādayaste vikhyātā utpathagrāhiṇo dvijāḥ  |
tasyābhidhyāyato'nyaṃ vai sāttvikaḥ samavartata  || 1,70.146 ||
ūrdhvasrotāstṛtīyastu sa vai cordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ  |
yasmātpravartate cordhvamūrdhvasrotāstataḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.147 ||
te sukhaprītibahulā bahirantaśca saṃvṛtāḥ  |
prakāśā bahirantaśca ūrdhvasrotobhavāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.148 ||
te sattvasya ca yogena sṛṣṭāḥ sattvodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
ūrdhvasrotāstṛtīyo vai devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.149 ||
prakāśādbahirantaśca ūrdhvasrotodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
te ūrdhvasrotaso jñeyāstuṣṭātmāno budhaiḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.150 ||
ūrdhvasrotaḥsu sṛṣṭeṣu deveṣu varadaḥ prabhuḥ  |
prītimānabhavadbrahmā tato'nyaṃ so'bhyamanyata  || 1,70.151 ||
sasarja sargamanyaṃ hi sādhakaṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ  |
tato'bhidhyāyatastasya satyābhidhyāyinastadā  || 1,70.152 ||
prādurāsīttadā vyaktādarvāksrotāstu sādhakaḥ  |
yasmādarvāṅnyavartanta tato'rvāksrotasastu te  || 1,70.153 ||
te ca prakāśabahulāstamaḥpṛktā rajo'dhikāḥ  |
tasmātte duḥkhabahulā bhūyobhūyaśca kāriṇaḥ  || 1,70.154 ||
saṃvṛtā bahirantaśca manuṣyāḥ sādhakāśca te  || 1,70.155 ||
lakṣaṇaistārakādyaiste hyaṣṭadhā tu vyavasthitāḥ  || 1,70.156 ||
siddhātmāno manuṣyāste gandharvasahadharmiṇaḥ  |
ityeṣa taijasaḥ sargo hyarvāksrotaḥprakīrtitaḥ  || 1,70.157 ||
pañcamo'nugrahaḥ sargaścaturdhā tu vyavasthitaḥ  |
viparyayeṇa śaktyā ca siddhyā tuṣṭyā tathaiva ca  || 1,70.158 ||
sthāvareṣu viparyāsastiryagyoniṣu śaktitaḥ  |
siddhātmāno manuṣyāstu ṛṣideveṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 1,70.159 ||
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargo vaikṛto navamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
bhūtādikānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ sa ucyate  || 1,70.160 ||
nivṛttaṃ vartamānaṃ ca teṣāṃ jānanti vai punaḥ  |
bhūtādikānāṃ bhūtānāṃ saptamaḥ sarga eva ca  || 1,70.161 ||
te parigrāhiṇaḥ sarve saṃvibhāgaratāḥ punaḥ  |
svādanāścāpyaśīlāśca jñeyā bhūtādikāśca te  || 1,70.162 ||
viparyayeṇa bhūtādiraśaktyā ca vyavasthitaḥ  |
prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.163 ||
tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargaḥ sa ucyate  |
vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.164 ||
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ sambhūto buddhipūrvakaḥ  |
mukhyasargaścaturthaśca mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.165 ||
tato'rvāksrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ  |
aṣṭamo'nugrahaḥ sargaḥ sāttvikastāmasaśca saḥ  || 1,70.166 ||
pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāstu trayaḥ smṛtāḥ  |
prākṛto vaikṛtaścaiva kaumāro navamaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,70.167 ||
abuddhipūrvakāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāstu trayaḥ smṛtāḥ  |
buddhipūrvaṃ pravartante ṣaṭpunarbrahmaṇastu te  || 1,70.168 ||
vistarānugrahaḥ sargaḥ kīrtyamāno nibodhata  |
caturdhāvasthitaḥ so'tha sarvabhūteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 1,70.169 ||
ityete prākṛtāścaiva vaikṛtāśca nava smṛtāḥ  |
parasparānuraktāśca kāraṇaiśca budhaiḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.170 ||
<Brahmā'ssons>
agre sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān  |
ṛbhuḥ sanatkumāraśca dvāvetāvūrdhvaretasau  || 1,70.171 ||
pūrvotpannau purā tebhyaḥ sarveṣāmapi pūrvajau  |
vyatīte tvaṣṭame kalpe purāṇau lokasākṣiṇau  || 1,70.172 ||
tau vārāhe tu bhūrloke tejaḥ saṃkṣipya dhiṣṭhitau  |
tāvubhau mokṣakarmāṇāvāropyātmānamātmani  || 1,70.173 ||
prajāṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitau  |
yathotpannastathaiveha kumāraḥ sa ihocyate  || 1,70.174 ||
tasmātsanatkumāreti nāmāsyeha prakīrtitam  |
sanandaṃ sanakaṃ caiva vidvāṃsaṃ ca sanātanam  || 1,70.175 ||
vijñānena nivṛttāste vyavartanta mahaujasaḥ  |
saṃbuddhāścaiva nānātve apravṛttāśca yoginaḥ  || 1,70.176 ||
asṛṣṭvaiva prajāsargaṃ pratisargaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ  |
tatasteṣu vyatīteṣu tato'nyān sādhakān sutān  || 1,70.177 ||
mānasānasṛjadbrahmā punaḥ sthānābhimāninaḥ  |
ā bhūtasamplavāvasthā yairiyaṃ vidhṛtā mahī  || 1,70.178 ||
āpo'gniṃ pṛthivīṃ vāyumantarikṣaṃ divaṃ tathā  |
samudrāṃśca nadīścaiva tathā śailavanaspatīn  || 1,70.179 ||
oṣadhīnāṃ tathātmāno vallīnāṃ vṛkṣavīrudhām  |
latāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhūrtāḥ saṃdhirātryahān  || 1,70.180 ||
ardhamāsāṃśca māsāṃśca ayanābdayugāni ca  |
sthānābhimāninaḥ sarve sthānākhyāścaiva te smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.181 ||
<Brahma'seleven sons>
devānṛṣīṃśca mahato gadatastānnibodhata  |
marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum  || 1,70.182 ||
dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so'sṛjanmānasānnava  |
nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ  || 1,70.183 ||
teṣāṃ brahmātmakānāṃ vai sarveṣāṃ brahmavādinām  |
sthānāni kalpayāmāsa pūrvavatpadmasaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,70.184 ||
tato'sṛjacca saṃkalpaṃ dharmaṃ caiva sukhāvaham  |
so'sṛjadvyavasāyāttu dharmaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ  || 1,70.185 ||
saṃkalpaṃ caiva saṃkalpātsarvalokapitāmahaḥ  |
mānasaśca rucirnāma vijajñe brahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,70.186 ||
prāṇādbrahmāsṛjaddakṣaṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ ca marīcinam  |
bhṛgustu hṛdayājjajñe ṛṣiḥ salilajanmanaḥ  || 1,70.187 ||
śiraso'ṅgirasaścaiva śrotrādatriṃ tathāsṛjat |
pulastyaṃ ca tathodānādvyānācca pulahaṃ punaḥ  || 1,70.188 ||
samānajo vasiṣṭhaśca apānānnirmame kratum  |
ityete brahmaṇaḥ putrā divyā ekādaśā smṛtāḥ  || 1,70.189 ||
dharmādayaḥ prathamajāḥ sarve te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ  |
bhṛgvādayastu te sṛṣṭā navaite brahmavādinaḥ  || 1,70.190 ||
gṛhamedhinaḥ purāṇāste dharmastaiḥ sampravartitaḥ  |
teṣāṃ dvādaśa te vaṃśā divyā devaguṇānvitāḥ  || 1,70.191 ||
kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhiralaṃkṛtāḥ  |
<ṛbhu, ṣanatkumāra>
ṛbhuḥ sanatkumāraśca dvāvetāvūrdhvaretasau  || 1,70.192 ||
pūrvotpannau paraṃ tebhyaḥ sarveṣāmapi pūrvajau  |
vyatīte tvaṣṭame kalpe purāṇau lokasākṣiṇau  || 1,70.193 ||
virājetāmubhau loke tejaḥ saṃkṣipya dhiṣṭhitau  |
tāvubhau yogakarmāṇāvāropyātmānamātmani  || 1,70.194 ||
prajāṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitau  |
yathotpannaḥ sa eveha kumāraḥ sa ihocyate  || 1,70.195 ||
tasmātsanatkumāreti nāmāsyeha pratiṣṭhitam  |
tato'bhidhyāyatastasya jajñire mānasāḥ prajāḥ  || 1,70.196 ||
taccharīrasamutpannaiḥ kāryaistaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ saha  |
kṣetrajñāḥ samavartanta gātrebhyastasya dhīmataḥ  || 1,70.197 ||
tato devāsurapitṝnmānuṣāṃśca catuṣṭayam  |
sisṛkṣurambhāṃsyetāni svamātmānamayūyujat || 1,70.198 ||
tatastu yuñjatastasya tamomātrasamudbhavam  |
samabhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ prayatnena prajāpateḥ  || 1,70.199 ||
tato'sya jaghanātpūrvamasurā jajñire sutāḥ  |
<asura̱̱ nirukti>
asuḥ prāṇaḥ smṛto viprāstajjanmānastato'surāḥ  || 1,70.200 ||
yayā sṛṣṭāsurāḥ sarve tāṃ tanuṃ sa vyapohata  |
<originof time units(nightetc.̭ => 218)>
sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyo rātrirajāyata  || 1,70.201 ||
sā tamobahulā yasmāttato rātrirniyāmikā  |
āvṛtāstamasā rātrau prajāstasmātsvapantyuta  || 1,70.202 ||
sṛṣṭvāsurāṃstataḥ so vai tanumanyāmagṛhṇata  |
avyaktāṃ sattvabahulāṃ tatastāṃ so'bhyapūjayat || 1,70.203 ||
tatastāṃ yuñjatastasya priyamāsītprajāpateḥ  |
<deva̱̱ nirukti>
tato mukhātsamutpannā dīvyatastasya devatāḥ  || 1,70.204 ||
yato'sya dīvyato jātāstena devāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  |
dhāturdiviti yaḥ proktaḥ krīḍāyāṃ sa vibhāvyate  || 1,70.205 ||
yasmāttasya tu dīvyanto jajñire tena devatāḥ  |
devānsṛṣṭvātha deveśastanumanyāmapadyata  || 1,70.206 ||
utsṛṣṭā sā tanustena sadyo'haḥ samajāyata  |
tasmādaho dharmayuktaṃ devatāḥ samupāsate  || 1,70.207 ||
sattvamātrātmikāmeva tato'nyāṃ so'bhyamanyata  |
pitṛvanmanyamānasya putrāṃstāndhyāyataḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,70.208 ||
pitaro hyupapakṣābhyāṃ rātryahṇorantare'bhavan  |
tasmātte pitaro devāḥ pitṛtvaṃ tena teṣu tat || 1,70.209 ||
yayā sṛṣṭāstu pitarastanuṃ tāṃ sa vyapohata  |
sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyaḥ saṃdhyā vyajāyata  || 1,70.210 ||
yasmādahardevatānāṃ rātriryā sāsurī smṛtā  |
tayormadhye tu paitrī yā tanuḥ sā tu garīyasī  || 1,70.211 ||
tasmāddevā surāḥ sarve ṛṣayo mānavāstathā  |
upāsante mudāyuktā rātryahṇormadhyamāṃ tanum  || 1,70.212 ||
tato hyanyāṃ punarbrahmā tanuṃ vai samagṛhṇata  |
rajomātrātmikāyāṃ tu manasā so'sṛjatprabhuḥ  || 1,70.213 ||
rajaḥpriyāṃstataḥ so'tha mānasānasṛjatsutān  |
manasvinastatastasya mānavā jajñire sutāḥ  || 1,70.214 ||
sṛṣṭvā punaḥ prajāścāpi svāṃ tanuṃ tāmapohata  |
sāpaviddhā tanustena jyotsnā sadyastvajāyata  || 1,70.215 ||
yasmādbhavanti saṃhṛṣṭā jyotsnāyā udbhave prajāḥ  |
ityetāstanavastena hyapaviddhā mahātmanā  || 1,70.216 ||
sadyo rātryahanī caiva saṃdhyā jyotsnā ca jajñire  |
jyotsnā saṃdhyā ahaścaiva sattvamātrātmakaṃ trayam  || 1,70.217 ||
tamomātrātmikā rātriḥ sā vai tasmānniśātmikā  |
tasmāddevā divātanvā tuṣṭyā sṛṣṭā mukhāttu vai  || 1,70.218 ||
yasmātteṣāṃ divā janma balinastena vai divā  |
tanvā yayāsurān rātrau jaghanādasṛjatprabhuḥ  || 1,70.219 ||

<creationof sacrifice>

<śatarūpā>

sarvāśca brahmavādinyaḥ sarvā viśvasya mātaraḥ  |

<daughtersandgrandchildrenof ḍakṣa>
satī khyātyatha saṃbhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā  |

ityeṣa vai sutodarkaḥ sargo dharmasya kīrtitaḥ  |

<śiva createsmental+ immortalsons= ṛudras>

bhramanto'bhidravantaśca plavantaśca sahasraśaḥ  |
