gaṇāṃbikā mahādevī nandinī jātavedasī  || 1,70.333 ||
ekarūpamathaitasyāḥ pṛthagdehavibhāvanāt |
sāvitrī varadā puṇyā pāvanī lokaviśrutā  || 1,70.334 ||
ājñā āveśanī kṛṣṇā tāmasī sāttvikī śivā  |
prakṛtirvikṛtā raudrī durgā bhadrā pramāthinī  || 1,70.335 ||
kālarātrirmahāmāyā revatī bhūtanāyikā  |
dvāparāntavibhāge ca nāmānīmāni suvratāḥ  || 1,70.336 ||
gautamī kauśikī cāryā caṇḍī kātyāyanī satī  |
kumārī yādavī devī varadā kṛṣṇapiṅgalā  || 1,70.337 ||
barhidhvajā śūladharā paramā brahmacāriṇī  |
mahendropendrabhaginī dṛṣadvatyekaśūladhṛk || 1,70.338 ||
aparājitā bahubhujā pragalbhā siṃhavāhinī  |
śumbhādidaityahantrī ca mahāmahiṣamardinī  || 1,70.339 ||
amoghā vindhyanilayā vikrāntā gaṇanāyikā  |
devyā nāmavikārāṇi ityetāni yathākramam  || 1,70.340 ||
bhadrakālyā mayoktāni samyakphalapradāni ca  |
ye paṭhanti narāsteṣāṃ vidyate na ca pātakam  || 1,70.341 ||
araṇye parvate vāpi pure vāpyathavā gṛhe  |
rakṣāmetāṃ prayuñjīta jale vātha sthale'pi vā  || 1,70.342 ||
vyāghrakumbhīnacorebhyo bhayasthāne viśeṣataḥ  |
āpatsvapi ca sarvāsu devyā nāmāni kīrtayet || 1,70.343 ||
āryakagrahabhūtaiśca pūtanāmātṛbhistathā  |
abhyarditānāṃ bālānāṃ rakṣāmetāṃ prayojayet || 1,70.344 ||
mahādevīkale dve tu prajñā śrīśca prakīrtite  |
ābhyāṃ devīsahasrāṇi yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat || 1,70.345 ||
anayā devadevo'sau satyā rudro maheśvaraḥ  |
ātiṣṭhatsarvalokānāṃ hitāya parameśvaraḥ  || 1,70.346 ||
rudraḥ paśupatiścāsītpurā dagdhaṃ puratrayam  |
devāśca paśavaḥ sarve babhūvustasya tejasā  || 1,70.347 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi ādisargakramaṃ śubham  |
sa yāti brahmaṇo lokaṃ śrāvayedvā dvijottamān  || 1,70.348 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge sṛṣṭivistāro nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ


_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 71

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
samāsādvistarāccaiva sargaḥ proktastvayā śubhaḥ  |
kathaṃ paśupatiścāsītpuraṃ dagdhuṃ maheśvaraḥ  || 1,71.1 ||
kathaṃ ca paśavaścāsan devāḥ sabrahmakāḥ prabhoḥ  |
mayasya tapasā pūrvaṃ sudurgaṃ nirmitaṃ puram  || 1,71.2 ||
haimaṃ ca rājataṃ divyamayasmayamanuttamam  |
sudurgaṃ devadevena dagdhamityeva naḥ śrutam  || 1,71.3 ||
kathaṃ dadāha bhagavān bhaganetranipātanaḥ  |
ekeneṣunipātena divyenāpi tadā katham  || 1,71.4 ||
viṣṇunotpāditairbhūtairna dagdhaṃ tatpuratrayam  |
purasya saṃbhavaḥ sarvo varalābhaḥ purā śrutaḥ  || 1,71.5 ||
idānīṃ dahanaṃ sarvaṃ vaktumarhasi suvrata  |
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ  || 1,71.6 ||
yathā śrutaṃ tathā prāha vyāsādviśvārthasūcakāt |

sūta uvāca
trailokyasyāsya śāpāddhi manovākkāyasaṃbhavāt || 1,71.7 ||
nihate tārake daitye tāraputre sabāndhave  |
skandena vā prayatnena tasya putrā mahābalāḥ  || 1,71.8 ||
vidyunmālī tārakākṣaḥ kamalākṣaśca vīryavān  |
tapastepurmahātmāno mahābalaparākramāḥ  || 1,71.9 ||
tapa ugraṃ samāsthāya niyame parame sthitāḥ  |
tapasā karśayāmāsurdehān svāndānavottamāḥ  || 1,71.10 ||
teṣāṃ pitāmahaḥ prīto varadaḥ pradadau varam  |

daityā ūcuḥ
avadhyatvaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā  || 1,71.11 ||
sahitā varayāmāsuḥ sarvalokapitāmaham  |
tānabravīttadā devo lokānāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ  || 1,71.12 ||
nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ vai nivartadhvamato'surāḥ  |
anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ vai yādṛśaṃ samprarocate  || 1,71.13 ||
tataste sahitā daityāḥ sampradhārya parasparam  |
brahmāṇamabruvandaityāḥ praṇipatya jagadgurum  || 1,71.14 ||
vayaṃ purāṇi trīṇyeva samāsthāya mahīmimām  |
vicariṣyāma lokeśa tvatprasādājjagadguro  || 1,71.15 ||
tathā varṣasahasreṣu sameṣyāmaḥ parasparam  |
ekībhāvaṃ gamiṣyanti purāṇyetāni cānagha  || 1,71.16 ||
samāgatāni caitāni yo hanyādbhagavaṃstadā  |
ekenaiveṣuṇā devaḥ sa no mṛtyurbhaviṣyati  || 1,71.17 ||
evamastviti tāndevaḥ pratyuktvā prāviśaddivam  |
tato mayaḥ svatapasā cakre vīraḥ purāṇyatha  || 1,71.18 ||
kāñcanaṃ divi tatrāsīdantarikṣe ca rājatam  |
āyasaṃ cābhavadbhūmau puraṃ teṣāṃ mahātmanām  || 1,71.19 ||
ekaikaṃ yojanaśataṃ vistārāyāmataḥ samam  |
kāñcanaṃ tārakākṣasya kamalākṣasya rājatam  || 1,71.20 ||
vidyunmāleścāyasaṃ vai trividhaṃ durgamuttamam  |
mayaśca balavāṃstatra daityadānavapūjitaḥ  || 1,71.21 ||
hairaṇye rājate caiva kṛṣṇāyasamaye tathā  |
ālayaṃ cātmanaḥ kṛtvā tatrāste balavāṃstadā  || 1,71.22 ||
evaṃ babhūvurdaityānāmatidurgāṇi suvratāḥ  |
purāṇi trīṇi viprendrāstrailokyamiva cāparam  || 1,71.23 ||
puratraye tadā jāte sarve daityā jagattraye  |
puratrayaṃ praviśyaiva babhūvuste balādhikāḥ  || 1,71.24 ||
kalpadrumasamākīrṇaṃ gajavājisamākulam  |
nānāprasādasaṃkīrṇaṃ maṇijālaiḥ samāvṛtam  || 1,71.25 ||
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃkāśairvimānairviśvatomukhaiḥ  |
padmarāgamayaiḥ śubhraiḥ śobhitaṃ candrasaṃnibhaiḥ  || 1,71.26 ||
prāsādairgopurairdivyaiḥ kailāsaśikharopamaiḥ  |
śobhitaṃ tripuraṃ teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthaganuttamaiḥ  || 1,71.27 ||
divyastrībhiḥ susampūrṇaṃ gandharvaiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ  |
rudrālayaiḥ pratigṛhaṃ sāgnihotrairdvijottamāḥ  || 1,71.28 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgaiśca dīrghikābhistu sarvataḥ  |
mattamātaṅgayūthaiśca turaṅgaiśca suśobhanaiḥ  || 1,71.29 ||
rathaiśca vividhākārairvicitrairviśvatomukhaiḥ  |
sabhāprapādibhiścaiva krīḍāsthānaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 1,71.30 ||
vedādhyayanaśālābhirvividhābhiḥ samantataḥ  |
adhṛṣyaṃ manasāpyanyairmayasyaiva ca māyayā  || 1,71.31 ||
<pietyof ṭripura'sinhabitants>
pativratābhiḥ sarvatra sevitaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  |
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpamapāpaiḥ śaṅkarārcanāt || 1,71.32 ||
daityeśvarairmahābhāgaiḥ sadāraiḥ sasutairdvijāḥ  |
śrautasmārtārthadharmajñaistaddharmanirataiḥ sadā  || 1,71.33 ||
mahādevetaraṃ tyaktvā devaṃ tasyārcane sthitaiḥ  |
vyūḍhoraskairvṛṣaskandhaiḥ sarvāyudhadharaiḥ sadā  || 1,71.34 ||
sarvadā kṣudhitaiścaiva dāvāgnisadṛśekṣaṇaiḥ  |
praśāntaiḥ kupitaiścaiva kubjairvāmanakaistathā  || 1,71.35 ||
nīlotpaladalaprakhyairnīlakuñcitamūrdhajaiḥ  |
nīlādrimerusaṃkāśairnīradopamaniḥsvanaiḥ  |
mayena rakṣitaiḥ sarvaiḥ śikṣitairyuddhalālasaiḥ  || 1,71.36 ||
atha samararataiḥ sadā samantācchivapadapūjanayā sulabdhavīryaiḥ  |
ravimarudamarendrasaṃnikāśaiḥ suramathanaiḥ sudṛḍhaiḥ susevitaṃ tat || 1,71.37 ||
sendrā devā dvijaśreṣṭhā drumā dāvāgninā yathā  |
puratrayāgninā dagdhā hyabhavan daityavaibhavāt || 1,71.38 ||
athaivaṃ te tadā dagdhā devā deveśvaraṃ harim  |
abhivandya tadā prāhustamapratimavarcasam  || 1,71.39 ||
so'pi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān cintayāmāsa cetasā  |
kiṃ kāryaṃ devakāryeṣu bhagavāniti sa prabhuḥ  || 1,71.40 ||
tadā sasmāra vai yajñaṃ yajñamūrtirjanārdanaḥ  |
yajvā yajñabhugīśāno yajvanāṃ phaladaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,71.41 ||
tato yajñaḥ smṛtastena devakāryārthasiddhaye  |
devaṃ te puruṣaṃ caiva praṇemustuṣṭuvustadā  || 1,71.42 ||
bhagavānapi taṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñaṃ prāha sanātanam  |
sanātanastadā sendrān devānālokya cācyutaḥ  || 1,71.43 ||

śrīviṣṇuruvāca
anenopasadā devā yajadhvaṃ parameśvaram  |
puratrayavināśāya jagattrayavibhūtaye  || 1,71.44 ||

sūta uvāca
atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devadevasya dhīmataḥ  |
siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā yajñeśaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ  || 1,71.45 ||
tataḥ saṃcintya bhagavān svayameva janārdanaḥ  |
punaḥ prāha sa sarvāṃstāṃstridaśāṃstridaśeśvaraḥ  || 1,71.46 ||
hatvā dagdhvā ca bhūtāni bhuktvā cānyāyato'pi vā  |
yajedyadi mahādevamapāpo nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,71.47 ||
apāpā naiva hantavyāḥ pāpā eva na saṃśayaḥ  |
hantavyāḥ sarvayatnena kathaṃ vadhyāḥ surottamāḥ  || 1,71.48 ||
asurā durmadāḥ pāpā api devairmahābalaiḥ  |
tasmānna vadhyā rudrasya prabhāvātparameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,71.49 ||
ko'haṃ brahmāthavā devā daityā devārisūdanāḥ  |
munayaśca mahātmānaḥ prasādena vinā prabhoḥ  || 1,71.50 ||
yaḥ saptaviṃśako nityaḥ parātparataraḥ prabhuḥ  |
viśvāmareśvaro vandyo viśvādhāro maheśvaraḥ  || 1,71.51 ||
sa eva sarvadeveśaḥ sarveṣāmapi śaṅkaraḥ  |
līlayā devadaityendra vibhāgamakaroddharaḥ  || 1,71.52 ||
tasyāṃśamekaṃ sampūjya devā devatvamāgatāḥ  |
brahmā brahmatvamāpanno hyahaṃ viṣṇutvameva ca  || 1,71.53 ||
tamapūjya jagatyasmin kaḥ pumān siddhimicchati  |
tasmāttenaiva hantavyā liṅgārcanavidherbalāt || 1,71.54 ||
dharmaniṣṭhāśca te sarve śrautasmārtavidhau sthitāḥ  |
tathāpi yajamānena raudreṇopasadā prabhum  |
rudramiṣṭvā yathānyāyaṃ jeṣyāmo daityasattamān  || 1,71.55 ||
satārakākṣeṇa mayena guptaṃ svasthaṃ ca guptaṃ sphaṭikābhamekam  |
ko nāma hantuṃ tripuraṃ samartho muktvā trinetraṃ bhagavantamekam  || 1,71.56 ||

sūta uvāca
evamuktvā hariśceṣṭvā yajñenopasadā prabhum  |
upaviṣṭo dadarśātha bhūtasaṃghānsahasraśaḥ  || 1,71.57 ||
śūlaśaktigadāhastān ṭaṅkopalaśilāyudhān  |
nānāpraharaṇopetānnānāveṣadharāṃstadā  || 1,71.58 ||
kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśān kālarudropamāṃstadā  |
prāha devo hariḥ sākṣātpraṇipatya sthitān prabhuḥ  || 1,71.59 ||

viṣṇuruvāca
dagdhvā bhittvā ca bhuktvā ca gatvā daityapuratrayam  |
punaryathāgataṃ vīrā gantumarhatha bhūtaye  || 1,71.60 ||
tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ bhūtasaṃghāḥ puratrayam  |
praviśya naṣṭāste sarve śalabhā iva pāvakam  || 1,71.61 ||
tatastu naṣṭāste sarve bhūtā deveśvarājñayā  |
nanṛturmumuduścaiva jagurdaityāḥ sahasraśaḥ  || 1,71.62 ||
tuṣṭuvurdevadeveśaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram  |
tataḥ parājitā devā dhvastavīryāḥ kṣaṇena tu  || 1,71.63 ||
sendrāḥ saṃgamya deveśamupendraṃ dhiṣṭhitā bhayāt |
tāndṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ  || 1,71.64 ||
kiṃ kṛtyamiti saṃtaptaḥ saṃtaptānsendrakānkṣaṇam  |
kathaṃ tu teṣāṃ daityānāṃ balaṃ hatvā prayatnataḥ  || 1,71.65 ||
devakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ  |
pāpaṃ vicārato nāsti dharmiṣṭhānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,71.66 ||
tasmāddaityā na vadhyāste bhūtaiścopasadodbhavaiḥ  |
pāpaṃ nudati dharmeṇa dharme sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  || 1,71.67 ||
dharmādaiśvaryamityeṣā śrutireṣā sanātanī  |
daityāścaite hi dharmiṣṭhāḥ sarve tripuravāsinaḥ  || 1,71.68 ||
tasmādavadhyatāṃ prāptā nānyathā dvijapuṅgavāḥ  |
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ rudramabhyarcayanti ye  || 1,71.69 ||
mucyante pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ padmapatramivāṃbhasā  |
pūjayā bhogasaṃpattiravaśyaṃ jāyate dvijāḥ  || 1,71.70 ||
tasmātte bhogino daityā liṅgārcanaparāyaṇāḥ  |
tasmātkṛtvā dharmavighnamahaṃ devāḥ svamāyayā  || 1,71.71 ||
daityānāṃ devakāryārthaṃ jeṣye'haṃ tripuraṃ kṣaṇāt |

sūta uvāca
vicāryaivaṃ tatasteṣāṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ  |
kartuṃ vyavasitaścābhūddharmavighnaṃ surāriṇām  || 1,71.72 ||
asṛjacca mahātejāḥ puruṣaṃ cātmasaṃbhavam  |
māyī māyāmayaṃ teṣāṃ dharmavighnārthamacyutaḥ  || 1,71.73 ||
śāstraṃ ca śāstā sarveṣāmakarotkāmarūpadhṛk |
sarvasaṃmohanaṃ māyī dṛṣṭapratyayasaṃyutam  || 1,71.74 ||
etatsvāṅgabhavāyaiva puruṣāyopadiśya tu  |
māyī māyāmayaṃ śāstraṃ granthaṣoḍaśalakṣakam  || 1,71.75 ||
śrautasmārtaviruddhaṃ ca varṇāśramavivarjitam  |
ihaiva svarganarakaṃ pratyayaṃ nānyathā punaḥ  || 1,71.76 ||
tacchāstramupadiśyaiva puruṣāyācyutaḥ svayam  |
puratrayavināśāya prāhainaṃ puruṣaṃ hariḥ  || 1,71.77 ||
gantumarhasi nāśāya bho tūrṇaṃ puravāsinām  |
dharmāstathā praṇaśyantu śrautasmārtā na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,71.78 ||
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ māyī māyāśāstraviśāradaḥ  |
praviśya tatpuraṃ tūrṇaṃ munirmāyāṃ tadākarot || 1,71.79 ||
māyayā tasya te daityāḥ puratrayanivāsinaḥ  |
śrautaṃ smārtaṃ ca saṃtyajya tasya śiṣyāstadābhavan  || 1,71.80 ||
tatyajuśca mahādevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ parameśvaram  |
nārado'pi tadā māyī niyogānmāyinaḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,71.81 ||
praviśya tatpuraṃ tena māyinā saha dīkṣitaḥ  |
muniḥ śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ sarvataḥ svayam  || 1,71.82 ||
strīdharmaṃ cākarotstrīṇāṃ duścāraphalasiddhidam  |
cakrustāḥ sarvadā labdhvā sadya eva phalaṃ striyaḥ  || 1,71.83 ||
janāsaktā babhūvustā vinindya patidevatāḥ  |
adyāpi gauravāttasya nāradasya kalau muneḥ  || 1,71.84 ||
nāryaścaranti saṃtyajya bhartṝn svairaṃ vṛthādhamāḥ  |
strīṇāṃ mātā pitā bandhuḥ sakhā mitraṃ ca bāndhavaḥ  || 1,71.85 ||
bhartā eva na saṃdehastathāpyāsahamāyayā  |
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yā bhartuḥ premasaṃyutā  || 1,71.86 ||
prāpnuyātparamaṃ svargaṃ narakaṃ ca viparyayāt |
puraikā muniśārdūlāḥ sarvadharmān sadā patim  || 1,71.87 ||
saṃtyajyāpūjayansādhvyo devānanyāñjagadgurūn  |
tāḥ svargalokamāsādya modante vigatajvarāḥ  || 1,71.88 ||
narakaṃ ca jagāmānyā tasmādbhartā parā gatiḥ  |
tathāpi bhartṝn svāṃstyaktvā babhūvuḥ svairavṛttayaḥ  || 1,71.89 ||
māyayā devadevasya viṣṇostasyājñayā prabhoḥ  |
alakṣmīśca svayaṃ tasya niyogāttripuraṃ gatā  || 1,71.90 ||
yā lakṣmīstapasā teṣāṃ labdhā deveśvarādajāt |
bahirgatā parityajya niyogādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,71.91 ||
buddhimohaṃ tathābhūtaṃ viṣṇumāyāvinirmitam  |
teṣāṃ dattvā kṣaṇaṃ devastāsāṃ māyī ca nāradaḥ  || 1,71.92 ||
sukhāsīnau hyasaṃbhrāntau dharmavighnārthamavyayau  |
evaṃ naṣṭe tadā dharme śrautasmārte suśobhane  || 1,71.93 ||
pāṣaṇḍe khyāpite tena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā  |
tyakte maheśvare daityaistyakte liṅgārcane tathā  || 1,71.94 ||
strīdharme nikhile naṣṭe durācāre vyavasthite  |
kṛtārtha iva deveśo devaiḥ sārdhamumāpatim  || 1,71.95 ||
tapasā prāpya sarvajñaṃ tuṣṭāva puruṣottamaḥ  |

śrībhagavānuvāca
maheśvarāya devāya namaste paramātmane  || 1,71.96 ||
nārāyaṇāya śarvāya brahmaṇe brahmarūpiṇe  |
śāśvatāya hyanantāya avyaktāya ca te namaḥ  || 1,71.97 ||

sūta uvāca
evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca  |
jajāpa rudraṃ bhagavān koṭivāraṃ jale sthitaḥ  || 1,71.98 ||
devāśca sarve te devaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram  |
sendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sayamāḥ sarudrāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ  || 1,71.99 ||

devā ūcuḥ
namaḥ sarvātmane tubhyaṃ śaṅkarāyārtihāriṇe  |
rudrāya nīlarudrāya kadrudrāya pracetase  || 1,71.100 ||
gatirnaḥ sarvadāsmābhirvandyo devārimardanaḥ  |
tvamādistvamanantaśca anantaścākṣayaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,71.101 ||
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣātsraṣṭā hartā jagadguro  |
trātā netā jagatyasmin dvijānāṃ dvijavatsala  || 1,71.102 ||
varado vāṅmayo vācyo vācyavācakavarjitaḥ  |
yājyo muktyarthamīśāno yogibhiryogavibhramaiḥ  || 1,71.103 ||
hṛtpuṇḍarīkasuṣire yogināṃ saṃsthitaḥ sadā  |
vadanti sūrayaḥ santaṃ paraṃ brahmasvarūpiṇam  || 1,71.104 ||
bhavantaṃ tattvamityāryāstejorāśiṃ parātparam  |
paramātmānamityāhurasmiñjagati tadvibho  || 1,71.105 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ sthitaṃ sarvaṃ jāyamānaṃ jagadguro  |
aṇoralpataraṃ prāhurmahato'pi mahattaram  || 1,71.106 ||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tvāṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham  |
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi  || 1,71.107 ||
mahādevamanirdeśyaṃ sarvajñaṃ tvāmanāmayam  |
viśvarūpaṃ virūpākṣaṃ sadāśivamanāmayam  || 1,71.108 ||
koṭibhāskarasaṃkāśaṃ koṭiśītāṃśusannibham  |
koṭikālāgnisaṃkāśaṃ ṣaḍviṃśakamanīśvaram  || 1,71.109 ||
pravartakaṃ jagatyasmin prakṛteḥ prapitāmaham  |
vadanti varadaṃ devaṃ sarvāvāsaṃ svayaṃbhuvam  || 1,71.110 ||
śrutayaḥ śrutisāraṃ tvāṃ śrutisāravido janāḥ  || 1,71.111 ||
adṛṣṭamasmābhiranekamūrte vinā kṛtaṃ yadbhavatātha loke  |
tvameva daityāsurabhūtasaṃghān devānnarān sthāvarajaṅgamāṃśca  || 1,71.112 ||
pāhi nānyā gatiḥ śaṃbho vinihatyāsurottamān  |
māyayā mohitāḥ sarve bhavataḥ parameśvara  || 1,71.113 ||
yathā taraṅgā laharīsamūhā yudhyanti cānyonyamapāṃnidhau ca  |
jalāśrayādeva jaḍīkṛtāśca surāsurāstadvadajasya sarvam  || 1,71.114 ||

sūta uvāca
ya idaṃ prātarutthāya śucirbhūtvā japennaraḥ  |
śṛṇuyādvā stavaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmamavāpnuyāt || 1,71.115 ||
stutastvevaṃ surairviṣṇorjapena ca maheśvaraḥ  |
somaḥ somāmathāliṅgya nandidattakaraḥ smayan  || 1,71.116 ||
prāha gaṃbhīrayā vācā devānālokya śaṅkaraḥ  |
jñātaṃ mayedamadhunā devakāryaṃ sureśvarāḥ  || 1,71.117 ||
viṣṇormāyābalaṃ caiva nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ  |
teṣāmadharmaniṣṭhānāṃ daityānāṃ devasattamāḥ  || 1,71.118 ||
puratrayavināśaṃ ca kariṣye'haṃ surottamāḥ  |

sūta uvāca
atha sabrahmakā devāḥ sendropendrāḥ samāgatāḥ  || 1,71.119 ||
śrutvā prabhostadā vākyaṃ praṇemustuṣṭuvuśca te  |
apyetadantare devī devamālokya vismitā  || 1,71.120 ||
līlāṃbujena cāhatya kalamāha vṛṣadhvajam  |

devyuvāca
krīḍamānaṃ vibho paśya ṣaṇmukhaṃ ravisannibham  || 1,71.121 ||
putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
mukuṭaiḥ kaṭakaiścaiva kuṇḍalairvalayaiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 1,71.122 ||
nūpuraiśchannavāraiśca tathā hyudarabandhanaiḥ  |
kiṅkiṇībhiranekābhirhaimairaśvatthapatrakaiḥ  || 1,71.123 ||
kalpakadrumajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śobhitairalakaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
hārairvārijarāgādi maṇicitraistathāṅgadaiḥ  || 1,71.124 ||
muktāphalamayairhāraiḥ pūrṇacandrasamaprabhaiḥ  |
tilakaiśca mahādeva paśya putraṃ suśobhanam  || 1,71.125 ||
aṅkitaṃ kuṅkumādyaiśca vṛttaṃ bhasitanirmitam  |
vaktravṛndaṃ ca paśyeśa vṛndaṃ kāmalakaṃ yathā  || 1,71.126 ||
netrāṇi ca vibho paśya śubhāni tvaṃ śubhāni ca  |
añjanāni vicitrāṇi maṅgalārthaṃ ca mātṛbhiḥ  || 1,71.127 ||
gaṅgādibhiḥ kṛttikādyaiḥ svāhayā ca viśeṣataḥ  |
ityevaṃ lokamātuśca vāgbhiḥ saṃbodhitaḥ śivaḥ  || 1,71.128 ||
na yayau tṛptimīśānaḥ pibanskandānanāmṛtam  |
na sasmāra ca tāndevān daityaśastranipīḍitān  || 1,71.129 ||
skandamāliṅgya cāghrāya nṛtya putretyuvāca ha  |
so'pi līlālaso bālo nanartārtiharaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,71.130 ||
sahaiva nanṛtuścānye saha tena gaṇeśvarāḥ  |
trailokyamakhilaṃ tatra nanarteśājñayā kṣaṇam  || 1,71.131 ||
nāgāśca nanṛtuḥ sarve devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ  |
tuṣṭuvurgaṇapāḥ skandaṃ mumodāṃbā ca mātaraḥ  || 1,71.132 ||
sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ  |
nṛtyāmṛtaṃ tadā pītvā pārvatīparameśvarau  |
avāpatustadā tṛptiṃ nandinā ca gaṇeśvarāḥ  || 1,71.133 ||
tataḥ sa nandī saha ṣaṇmukhena tathā ca sārdhaṃ girirājaputryā  |
viveśa divyaṃ bhavanaṃ bhavo'pi yathāmbudo'nyāmbudamambudābhaḥ  || 1,71.134 ||
dvārasya pārśve te tasthurdevā devasya dhīmataḥ  |
tuṣṭuvuśca mahādevaṃ kiṃcidudvignacetasaḥ  || 1,71.135 ||
kiṃtu kiṃtviti cānyonyaṃ prekṣya caitatsamākulāḥ  |
pāpā vayamiti hyanye abhāgyāśceti cāpare  || 1,71.136 ||
bhāgyavantaśca daityendrā iti cānye sureśvarāḥ  |
pūjāphalamimaṃ teṣāmityanye neti cāpare  || 1,71.137 ||
etasminnantare teṣāṃ śrutvā śabdānanekaśaḥ  |
kumbhodaro mahātejā daṇḍenātāḍayatsurān  || 1,71.138 ||
dudruvuste bhayāviṣṭā devā hāhetivādinaḥ  |
apatanmunayaścānye devāśca dharaṇītale  || 1,71.139 ||
aho vidherbalaṃ ceti munayaḥ kaśyapādayaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvāpi devadeveśaṃ devānāṃ cāsuradviṣām  || 1,71.140 ||
abhāgyānna samāptaṃ tu kāryamityapare dvijāḥ  |
procurnamaḥ śivāyeti pūjya cālpataraṃ hṛdi  || 1,71.141 ||
tataḥ kapardī nandīśo mahādevapriyo muniḥ  |
śūlī mālī tathā hālī kuṇḍalī valayī gadī  || 1,71.142 ||
vṛṣamāruhya suśvetaṃ yayau tasyājñayā tadā  |
tato vai nandinaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇaḥ kumbhodaro'pi saḥ  || 1,71.143 ||
praṇamya nandinaṃ mūrdhnā saha tena tvaran yayau  |
nandī bhāti mahātejā vṛṣapṛṣṭhe vṛṣadhvajaḥ  || 1,71.144 ||
sagaṇo gaṇasenānīrmeghapṛṣṭhe yathā bhavaḥ  |
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ muktājālairalaṃkṛtam  || 1,71.145 ||
sitātapatraṃ śailāderākāśamiva bhāti tat |
tatrāntarbaddhamālā sā muktāphalamayī śubhā  || 1,71.146 ||
gaṅgākāśānnipatitā bhāti mūrdhni vibhoryathā  |
atha dṛṣṭvā gaṇādhyakṣaṃ devadundubhayaḥ śubhāḥ  || 1,71.147 ||
niyogādvajriṇaḥ sarve vinedurmunipuṅgavāḥ  |
tuṣṭuvuśca gaṇeśānaṃ vāgbhiriṣṭapradaṃ śubham  || 1,71.148 ||
yathā devā bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ  |
niyogādvajriṇo mūrdhni puṣpavarṣaṃ ca khecarāḥ  || 1,71.149 ||
vavṛṣuśca sugandhāḍhyaṃ nandino gaganoditam  |
vṛṣṭyā tuṣṭastadā reje tuṣṭyā puṣṭyā yathārthayā  || 1,71.150 ||
nandī bhavaścāndrayātu snātayā gandhavāriṇā  |
puṣpairnānāvidhaistatra bhāti pṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣasya tat || 1,71.151 ||
saṃkīrṇaṃ tu divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ nakṣatrairiva suvratāḥ  |
kusumaiḥ saṃvṛto nandī vṛṣapṛṣṭhe rarāja saḥ  || 1,71.152 ||
divaḥ pṛṣṭhe yathā candro nakṣatrairiva suvratāḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandinaṃ devāḥ sendropendrāstathāvidham  || 1,71.153 ||
tuṣṭuvurgaṇapeśānaṃ devadevamivāparam  |

devā ūcuḥ
namaste rudrabhaktāya rudrajāpyaratāya ca  || 1,71.154 ||
rudrabhaktārtināśāya raudrakarmaratāya te  |
kūṣmāṇḍagaṇanāthāya yogināṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,71.155 ||
sarvadāya śaraṇyāya sarvajñāyārtihāriṇe  |
vedānāṃ pataye caiva vedavedyāya te namaḥ  || 1,71.156 ||
vajriṇe vajradaṃṣṭrāya vajrivajranivāriṇe  |
vajrālaṃkṛtadehāya vajriṇārādhitāya te  || 1,71.157 ||
raktāya raktanetrāya raktāṃbaradharāya te  |
raktānāṃ bhavapādābje rudralokapradāyine  || 1,71.158 ||
namaḥ senādhipataye rudrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
bhūtānāṃ bhuvaneśānāṃ pataye pāpahāriṇe  || 1,71.159 ||
rudrāya rudrapataye raudrapāpaharāya te  |
namaḥ śivāya saumyāya rudrabhaktāya te namaḥ  || 1,71.160 ||

sūta uvāca
tataḥ prīto gaṇādhyakṣaḥ prāha devāṃśchivātmajaḥ  |
rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ śaṃbhoḥ kārmukaṃ śaramuttamam  || 1,71.161 ||
kartumarhatha yatnena naṣṭaṃ matvā puratrayam  |
atha te brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ tathā vai viśvakarmaṇā  || 1,71.162 ||
rathaṃ cakruḥ susaṃrabdhā devadevasya dhīmataḥ  || 1,71.163 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge puradāhe nandikeśvaravākyaṃ nāma ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 72

sūta uvāca
<śivaschariotfordestructionof ṭripura>
atha rudrasya devasya nirmito viśvakarmaṇā  |
sarvalokamayo divyo ratho yatnena sādaram  || 1,72.1 ||
sarvabhūtamayaścaiva sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ  |
sarvadevamayaścaiva sauvarṇaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ  || 1,72.2 ||
rathāṅgaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ sūryo vāmāṅgaṃ soma eva ca  |
dakṣiṇaṃ dvādaśāraṃ hi ṣoḍaśāraṃ tathottaram  || 1,72.3 ||
areṣu teṣu viprendrāścādityā dvādaśaiva tu  |
śaśinaḥ ṣoḍaśāreṣu kalā vāmasya suvratāḥ  || 1,72.4 ||
ṛkṣāṇi ca tadā tasya vāmasyaiva tu bhūṣaṇam  |
nemyaḥ ṣaḍṛtavaścaiva tayorvai viprapuṅgavāḥ  || 1,72.5 ||
puṣkaraṃ cāntarikṣaṃ vai rathanīḍaśca mandaraḥ  |
astādrirudayādriśca ubhau tau kūbarau smṛtau  || 1,72.6 ||
adhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāmerurāśrayāḥ kesarācalāḥ  |
vegaḥ saṃvatsarastasya ayane cakrasaṃgamau  || 1,72.7 ||
muhūrtā bandhurāstasya śamyāścaiva kalāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
tasya kāṣṭhāḥ smṛtā ghoṇā cākṣadaṇḍāḥ kṣaṇāśca vai  || 1,72.8 ||
nimeṣāścānukarṣāśca īṣā cāsya lavāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
dyaurvarūthaṃ rathasyāsya svargamokṣāvubhau dhvajau  || 1,72.9 ||
dharmo virāgo daṇḍo'sya yajñā daṇḍāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
dakṣiṇāḥ saṃdhayastasya lohāḥ pañcāśadagnayaḥ  || 1,72.10 ||
yugāntakoṭī tau tasya dharmakāmāvubhau smṛtau  |
īṣādaṇḍastathāvyaktaṃ buddhistasyaiva naḍvalaḥ  || 1,72.11 ||
koṇastathā hyahaṅkāro bhūtāni ca balaṃ smṛtam  |
indriyāṇi ca tasyaiva bhūṣaṇāni samantataḥ  || 1,72.12 ||
śraddhā ca gatirasyaiva vedāstasya hayāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
padāni bhūṣaṇānyeva ṣaḍaṅgānyupabhūṣaṇam  || 1,72.13 ||
purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsā dharmaśāstrāṇi suvratāḥ  |
vālāśrayāḥ paṭāścaiva sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ  || 1,72.14 ||
mantrā ghaṇṭāḥ smṛtāsteṣāṃ varṇāḥ pādāstathāśramāḥ  |
avacchedo hyanantastu sahasraphaṇabhūṣitaḥ  || 1,72.15 ||
diśaḥ pādā rathasyāsya tathā copadiśaśca ha  |
puṣkarādyāḥ patākāśca sauvarṇā ratnabhūṣitāḥ  || 1,72.16 ||
samudrāstasya catvāro rathakambalikāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ  || 1,72.17 ||
cāmarāsaktahastāgrāḥ sarvāḥ strīrūpaśobhitāḥ  |
tatratatra kṛtasthānāḥ śobhayāṃcakrire ratham  || 1,72.18 ||
āvahādyāstathā sapta sopānaṃ haimamuttamam  |
sārathirbhagavānbrahmā devābhīṣudharāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,72.19 ||
pratodo brahmaṇastasya praṇavo brahmadaivatam  |
lokālokācalastasya sasopānaḥ samantataḥ  || 1,72.20 ||
viṣamaśca tadā bāhyo mānasādriḥ suśobhanaḥ  |
nāsāḥ samantatastasya sarva evācalāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,72.21 ||
talāḥ kapotāḥ kāpotāḥ sarve talanivāsinaḥ  |
merureva mahāchatraṃ mandaraḥ pārśvaḍiṇḍimaḥ  || 1,72.22 ||
śailendraḥ kārmukaṃ caiva jyā bhujaṅgādhipaḥ svayam  |
kālarātryā tathaiveha tathendradhanuṣā punaḥ  || 1,72.23 ||
ghaṇṭā sarasvatī devī dhanuṣaḥ śrutirūpiṇī  |
iṣurviṣṇurmahātejāḥ śalyaṃ somaḥ śarasya ca  || 1,72.24 ||
kālāgnistaccharasyaiva sākṣāttīkṣṇaḥ sudāruṇaḥ  |
anīkaṃ viṣasambhūtaṃ vāyavo vājakāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,72.25 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ divyaṃ kārmukaṃ ca śaraṃ tathā  |
sārathiṃ jagatāṃ caiva brahmāṇaṃ prabhumīśvaram  || 1,72.26 ||
āruroha rathaṃ divyaṃ raṇamaṇḍanadhṛgbhavaḥ  |
sarvadevagaṇairyuktaṃ kampayanniva rodasī  || 1,72.27 ||
<śiva mountsthe chariot>
ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānaśca vandyamānaśca bandibhiḥ  |
upanṛttaścāpsarasāṃ gaṇairnṛtyaviśāradaiḥ  || 1,72.28 ||
suśobhamāno varadaḥ samprekṣyaiva ca sārathim  |
tasminnārohati rathaṃ kalpitaṃ lokasaṃbhṛtam  || 1,72.29 ||
śirobhiḥ patitā bhūmīṃ turagā vedasaṃbhavāḥ  |
athādhastādrathasyāsya bhagavān dharaṇīdharaḥ  || 1,72.30 ||
vṛṣendrarūpī cotthāpya sthāpayāmāsa vai kṣaṇam  |
kṣaṇāntare vṛṣendro'pi jānubhyāmagamaddharām  || 1,72.31 ||
abhīṣuhasto bhagavānudyamya ca hayān vibhuḥ  |
sthāpayāmāsa devasya vacanādvai rathaṃ śubham  || 1,72.32 ||
tato'śvāṃścodayāmāsa manomārutaraṃhasaḥ  |
purāṇyuddiśya khasthāni dānavānāṃ tarasvinām  || 1,72.33 ||
athāha bhagavān rudro devānālokya śaṅkaraḥ  |
paśūnāmādhipatyaṃ me dattaṃ hanmi tato'surān  || 1,72.34 ||
pṛthakpaśutvaṃ devānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ surottamāḥ  |
kalpayitvaiva vadhyāste nānyathā naiva sattamāḥ  || 1,72.35 ||
iti śrutvā vacaḥ sarvaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ  |
viṣādamagaman sarve paśutvaṃ prati śaṅkitāḥ  || 1,72.36 ||
teṣāṃ bhāvaṃ tato jñātvā devastānidamabravīt |
mā vo'stu paśubhāve'smin bhayaṃ vibudhasattamāḥ  || 1,72.37 ||
śrūyatāṃ paśubhāvasya vimokṣaḥ kriyatāṃ ca saḥ  |
yo vai pāśupataṃ divyaṃ cariṣyati sa mokṣyati  || 1,72.38 ||
paśutvāditi satyaṃ ca pratijñātaṃ samāhitāḥ  |
ye cāpyanye cariṣyanti vrataṃ pāśupataṃ mama  || 1,72.39 ||
mokṣyanti te na saṃdehaḥ paśutvātsurasattamāḥ  |
naiṣṭhikaṃ dvādaśābdaṃ vā tadardhaṃ varṣakatrayam  || 1,72.40 ||
śuśrūṣāṃ kārayedyastu sa paśutvādvimucyate  |
tasmātparamidaṃ divyaṃ cariṣyatha surottamāḥ  || 1,72.41 ||
tatheti cābruvandevāḥ śive lokanamaskṛte  |
tasmādvai paśavaḥ sarve devāsuranarāḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,72.42 ||
rudraḥ paśupatiścaiva paśupāśavimocakaḥ  |
yaḥ paśustatpaśutvaṃ ca vratenānena saṃtyajet || 1,72.43 ||
tatkṛtvā na ca pāpīyāniti śāstrasya niścayaḥ  |
<ṅaṇeśa pacified>
tato vināyakaḥ sākṣādbālo'bālaparākramaḥ  || 1,72.44 ||
apūjitastadā devaiḥ prāha devānnivārayan  |

śrīvināyaka uvāca
māmapūjya jagatyasmin bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 1,72.45 ||
kaḥ pumānsiddhimāpnoti devo vā dānavo'pi vā  |
tatastasmin kṣaṇādeva devakārye sureśvarāḥ  || 1,72.46 ||
vighnaṃ kariṣye deveśa kathaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ  |
tataḥ sendrāḥ surāḥ sarve bhītāḥ sampūjya taṃ prabhum  || 1,72.47 ||
bhakṣyabhojyādibhiścaiva uṇḍaraiścaiva modakaiḥ  |
abruvaṃste gaṇeśānaṃ nirvighnaṃ cāstu naḥ sadā  || 1,72.48 ||
bhavo'pyanekaiḥ kusumairgaṇeśaṃ bhakṣyaiśca bhojyaiḥ surasaiḥ sugandhaiḥ  |*
āliṅgya cāghrāya sutaṃ tadānīmapūjayatsarvasurendramukhyaḥ  || 1,72.49 ||*
sampūjya pūjyaṃ saha devasaṃghairvināyakaṃ nāyakamīśvarāṇām  |
gaṇeśvaraireva nagendradhanvā puratrayaṃ dagdhumasau jagāma  || 1,72.50 ||
<armyof the gods>
taṃ devadevaṃ surasiddhasaṃghā maheśvaraṃ bhūtagaṇāśca sarve  |
gaṇeśvarā nandimukhāstadānīṃ svavāhanairanvayurīśamīśāḥ  || 1,72.51 ||
agre surāṇāṃ ca gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ tadātha nandī girirājakalpam  |
vimānamāruhya puraṃ prahartuṃ jagāma mṛtyuṃ bhagavāniveśaḥ  || 1,72.52 ||
yāntaṃ tadānīṃ tu śilādaputramāruhya nāgendravṛṣāśvavaryān  |
devāstadānīṃ gaṇapāśca sarve gaṇā yayuḥ svāyudhacihnahastāḥ  || 1,72.53 ||
khagendramāruhya nagendrakalpaṃ khagadhvajo vāmata eva śaṃbhoḥ  |*
jagāma jagatāṃ hitāya puratrayaṃ dagdhumaluptaśaktiḥ  || 1,72.54 ||*
taṃ sarvadevāḥ suralokanāthaṃ samantataścānvayuraprameyam  |*
surāsureśaṃ sahasraraśmirbhagavān sutīkṣṇaḥ  || 1,72.55 ||*
rarāja madhye bhagavānsurāṇāṃ vivāhano vārijapatravarṇaḥ  |
yathā sumeroḥ śikharādhirūḍhaḥ sahasraraśmirbhagavān sutīkṣṇaḥ  || 1,72.56 ||
sahasranetraḥ prathamaḥ surāṇāṃ gajendramāruhya ca dakṣiṇe'sya  |
jagāma rudrasya puraṃ nihantuṃ yathoragāṃstatra tu vainateyaḥ  || 1,72.57 ||
taṃ siddhagandharvasurendravīrāḥ surendravṛndādhipamindramīśam  |
samantatastuṣṭuvuriṣṭadaṃ te jayeti śakraṃ varapuṣpavṛṣṭyā  || 1,72.58 ||
tadā hyahalyopapatiṃ sureśaṃ jagatpatiṃ diviṣṭhāḥ  |*
praṇemurālokya sahasranetraṃ salīlamaṃbā tanayaṃ yathendram  || 1,72.59 ||*
yamapāvakavitteśā vāyurnirṛtireva ca  |
apāmpatistatheśāno bhavaṃ cānu samāgatāḥ  || 1,72.60 ||
vīrabhadro raṇe bhadro nairṛtyāṃ vai rathasya tu  |
vṛṣabhendraṃ samāruhya romajaiśca samāvṛtaḥ  || 1,72.61 ||
sevāṃ cakre puraṃ hantuṃ devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam  |
mahākālo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ  || 1,72.62 ||
vāyavyāṃ sagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sevāṃ cakre rathasya tu  || 1,72.63 ||
ṣaṇmukho'pi saha siddhacāraṇaiḥ senayā ca girirājasaṃnibhaḥ  |
devanāthagaṇavṛndasaṃvṛto vāraṇena ca tathāgnisaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,72.64 ||
vighnaṃ gaṇeśo'pyasureśvarāṇāṃ kṛtvā surāṇāṃ bhagavānavighnam  |
vighneśvaro vighnagaṇaiśca sārdhaṃ taṃ deśamīśānapadaṃ jagāma  || 1,72.65 ||
kālī tadā kālaniśāprakāśaṃ śūlaṃ kapālābharaṇā kareṇa  |
prakampayantī ca tadā surendrānmahāsurāsṛṅmadhupānamattā  || 1,72.66 ||
mattebhagāmī madalolanetrā mattaiḥ piśācaiśca gaṇaiśca mattaiḥ  |
mattebhacarmāṃbaraveṣṭitāṅgī yayau purastācca gaṇeśvarasya  || 1,72.67 ||
tāṃ siddhagandharvapiśācayakṣa vidyādharāhīndrasurendramukhyāḥ  |
praṇemuruccairabhituṣṭuvuśca jayeti devīṃ himaśailaputrīm  || 1,72.68 ||
mātaraḥ suravarārisūdanāḥ sādaraṃ suragaṇaiḥ supūjitāḥ  |
mātaraṃ yayuratha svavāhanaiḥ svairgaṇairdhvajadharaiḥ samantataḥ  || 1,72.69 ||
durgārūḍhamṛgādhipā duratigā dordaṇḍavṛndaiḥ śivā bibhrāṇāṅkuśaśūlapāśaparaśuṃ cakrāsiśaṅkhāyudham  |
prauḍhādityasahasrasadṛśairnetrairdahantī pathaṃ bālā bālaparākramā bhagavatī daityānprahartuṃ yayau  || 1,72.70 ||
taṃ devamīśaṃ tripuraṃ nihantuṃ tadā tu devendraraviprakāśāḥ  |
gajairhayaiḥ siṃhavarai rathaiśca vṛṣairyayuste gaṇarājamukhyāḥ  || 1,72.71 ||
halaiśca phālairmusalairbhuśuṇḍairgirīndrakūṭairgirisannibhāste  |
yayuḥ purastāddhi maheśvarasya sureśvarā bhūtagaṇeśvarāśca  || 1,72.72 ||
tathendrapadmodbhavaviṣṇumukhyāḥ surā gaṇeśāśca gaṇeśamīśam  |
jayeti vāgbhirbhagavantamūcuḥ kirīṭadattāñjalayaḥ samantāt || 1,72.73 ||
nanṛturmunayaḥ sarve daṇḍahastā jaṭādharāḥ  |
vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ  |
puratrayaṃ ca viprendrāḥ prāṇadatsarvatastathā  || 1,72.74 ||
gaṇeśvarairdevagaṇaiśca bhṛṅgī sahāvṛtaḥ sarvagaṇendravaryaḥ  |
jagāma yogī tripuraṃ nihantuṃ vimānamāruhya yathā mahendraḥ  || 1,72.75 ||
keśo vigatavāsāśca mahākeśo mahājvaraḥ  |
somavallī savarṇaśca somapaḥ senakastathā  || 1,72.76 ||
somadhṛksūryavācaśca sūryapeṣaṇakastathā  |
sūryākṣaḥ sūrināmā ca suraḥ sundara eva ca  || 1,72.77 ||
prakudaḥ kakudantaśca kampanaśca prakampanaḥ  |
indraścendrajayaścaiva mahābhīrbhīmakastathā  || 1,72.78 ||
śatākṣaścaiva pañcākṣaḥ sahasrākṣo mahodaraḥ  |
yamajihvaḥ śatāśvaśca kaṇṭhanaḥ kaṇṭhapūjanaḥ  || 1,72.79 ||
dviśikhastriśikhaścaiva tathā pañcaśikho dvijāḥ  |
muṇḍo'rdhamuṇḍo dīrghaśca piśācāsyaḥ pinākadhṛk || 1,72.80 ||
pippalāyatanaścaiva tathā hyaṅgārakāśanaḥ  |
śithilaḥ śithilāsyaśca akṣapādo hyajaḥ kujaḥ  || 1,72.81 ||
ajavaktro hayavaktro gajavaktro'rdhvavaktrakaḥ  |
ityādyāḥ parivāryeśaṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇavarjitāḥ  || 1,72.82 ||
vṛndaśastaṃ samāvṛtya jagmuḥ somaṃ gaṇairvṛtāḥ  |
sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi rudrāṇāmūrdhvaretasām  || 1,72.83 ||
samāvṛtya mahādevaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram  |
dagdhuṃ puratrayaṃ jagmuḥ koṭikoṭigaṇairvṛtāḥ  || 1,72.84 ||
trayastriṃśatsurāścaiva trayaśca triśatāstathā  |
trayaśca trisahasrāṇi jagmurdevāḥ samantataḥ  || 1,72.85 ||
mātaraḥ sarvalokānāṃ gaṇānāṃ caiva mātaraḥ  |
bhūtānāṃ mātaraścaiva jagmurdevasya pṛṣṭhataḥ  || 1,72.86 ||
bhāti madhye gaṇānāṃ ca rathamadhye gaṇeśvaraḥ  |
nabhasyamalanakṣatre tārāmadhya ivoḍurāṭ || 1,72.87 ||
rarāja devī devasya girijā pārśvasaṃsthitā  |
tadā prabhāvato gaurī bhavasyeva jaganmayī  || 1,72.88 ||
śubhāvatī tadā devī pārśvasaṃsthā vibhāti sā  |
cāmarāsaktahastāgrā sā hemāṃbujavarṇikā  || 1,72.89 ||
atha vibhāti vibhorviśadaṃ vapurbhasitabhāsitamaṃbikayā tayā  |
sitamivābhramaho saha vidyutā nabhasi devapateḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,72.90 ||
bhātīndradhanuṣākāśaṃ meruṇā ca yathā jagat |
hiraṇyadhanuṣā saumyaṃ vapuḥ śaṃbhoḥ śaśidyuti  || 1,72.91 ||
sitātapatraṃ ratnāṃśu miśritaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
yathodaye śaśāṅkasya bhātyakhaṇḍaṃ hi maṇḍalam  || 1,72.92 ||
sadukūlā śive raktā lambitā bhāti mālikā  |
chatrāntā ratnajākāśātpatantīva saridvarā  || 1,72.93 ||
atha mahendraviriñcivibhāvasu prabhṛtibhirnatapādasaroruhaḥ  |
saha tadā ca jagāma tayāṃbayā sakalalokahitāya puratrayam  || 1,72.94 ||
dagdhuṃ samartho manasā kṣaṇena carācaraṃ sarvamidaṃ triśūlī  |
kimatra dagdhuṃ tripuraṃ pinākī svayaṃ gataścātra gaṇaiśca sārdham  || 1,72.95 ||
rathena kiṃ ceṣuvareṇa tasya gaṇaiśca kiṃ devagaṇaiśca śaṃbhoḥ  |
puratrayaṃ dagdhumaluptaśakteḥ kimetadityāhurajendramukhyāḥ  || 1,72.96 ||
manvāma nūnaṃ bhagavānpinākī līlārthametatsakalaṃ pravarttum  |
vyavasthitaśceti tathānyathā cedāḍambareṇāsya phalaṃ kimanyat || 1,72.97 ||
puratrayasyāsya samīpavartī sureśvarairnandimukhaiśca nandī  |
gaṇairgaṇeśastu rarāja devyā jagadratho merurivāṣṭaśṛṅgaiḥ  || 1,72.98 ||
atha nirīkṣya sureśvaramīśvaraṃ sagaṇamadrisutāsahitaṃ tadā  |
tripuraraṅgatalopari saṃsthitaḥ suragaṇo'nujagāma svayaṃ tathā  || 1,72.99 ||
jagattrayaṃ sarvamivāparaṃ tatpuratrayaṃ tatra vibhāti samyak |
nareśvaraiścaiva gaṇaiśca devaiḥ suretaraiśca trividhairmunīndrāḥ  || 1,72.100 ||
<śiva burnsṭripura>
atha sajyaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarvaḥ saṃdhāya taṃ śaram  |
yuktvā pāśupatāstreṇa tripuraṃ samacintayat || 1,72.101 ||
tasmin sthite mahādeve rudre vitatakārmuke  |
purāṇi tena kālena jagmurekatvamāśu vai  || 1,72.102 ||
ekībhāvaṃ gate caiva tripure samupāgate  |
babhūva tumulo harṣo devatānāṃ mahātmanām  || 1,72.103 ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ  |
jayeti vāco mumucuḥ saṃstuvanto'ṣṭamūrtikam  || 1,72.104 ||
athāha bhagavānbrahmā bhaganetranipātanam  |
puṣyayoge'pi samprāpte līlāvaśamumāpatim  || 1,72.105 ||
sthāne tava mahādeva ceṣṭeyaṃ parameśvara  |
pūrvadevāśca devāśca samāstava yataḥ prabho  || 1,72.106 ||
tathāpi devā dharmiṣṭhāḥ pūrvadevāśca pāpinaḥ  |
yatastasmājjagannātha līlāṃ tyaktumihārhasi  || 1,72.107 ||
kiṃ rathena dhvajeneśa tava dagdhuṃ puratrayam  |
iṣuṇā bhūtasaṃghaiśca viṣṇunā ca mayā prabho  || 1,72.108 ||
puṣyayoge tvanuprāpte puraṃ dagdhumihārhasi  |
yāvanna yānti deveśa viyogaṃ tāvadeva tu  || 1,72.109 ||
dagdhumarhasi śīghraṃ tvaṃ trīṇyetāni purāṇi vai  |
atha devo mahādevaḥ sarvajñastadavaikṣata  || 1,72.110 ||
puratrayaṃ virūpākṣastatkṣaṇādbhasma vai kṛtam  |
somaśca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kālāgnirvāyureva ca  || 1,72.111 ||
śare vyavasthitāḥ sarve devamūcuḥ praṇamya tam  |
dagdhamapyatha deveśa vīkṣaṇena puratrayam  || 1,72.112 ||
asmaddhitārthaṃ deveśa śaraṃ moktumihārhasi  |
atha saṃmṛjya dhanuṣo jyāṃ hasan tripurārdanaḥ  || 1,72.113 ||
mumoca bāṇaṃ viprendrā vyākṛṣyākarṇamīśvaraḥ  |
tatkṣaṇāttripuraṃ dagdhvā tripurāntakaraḥ śaraḥ  || 1,72.114 ||
devadevaṃ samāsādya namaskṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ  |
reje puratrayaṃ dagdhaṃ daityakoṭiśatairvṛtam  || 1,72.115 ||
iṣuṇā tena kalpānte rudreṇeva jagattrayam  |
ye pūjayanti tatrāpi daityā rudraṃ sabāndhavāḥ  || 1,72.116 ||
gāṇapatyaṃ tadā śaṃbhoryayuḥ pūjāvidherbalāt |
na kiṃcidabruvan devāḥ sendropendrā gaṇeśvarāḥ  || 1,72.117 ||
bhayāddevaṃ nirīkṣyaiva devīṃ himavataḥ sutām  |
dṛṣṭvā bhītaṃ tadānīkaṃ devānāṃ devapuṅgavaḥ  || 1,72.118 ||
kiṃ cetyāha tadā devān praṇemustaṃ samantataḥ  || 1,72.119 ||
vavandire nandinamindubhūṣaṇaṃ vavandire parvatarājasaṃbhavām  |
vavandire cādrisutāsutaṃ prabhuṃ vavandire devagaṇā maheśvaram  || 1,72.120 ||
tuṣṭāva hṛdaye brahmā devaiḥ saha samāhitaḥ  |
viṣṇunā ca bhavaṃ devaṃ tripurārātimīśvaram  || 1,72.121 ||

śrīpitāmaha uvāca
prasīda devadeveśa prasīda parameśvara  |
prasīda jagatāṃ nātha prasīdānandadāvyaya  || 1,72.122 ||
pañcāsyarudrarudrāya pañcāśatkoṭimūrtaye  |
ātmatrayopaviṣṭāya vidyātattvāya te namaḥ  || 1,72.123 ||
śivāya śivatattvāya aghorāya namonamaḥ  |
aghorāṣṭakatattvāya dvādaśātmasvarūpiṇe  || 1,72.124 ||
vidyutkoṭipratīkāśamaṣṭakāśaṃ suśobhanam  |
rūpamāsthāya loke'smin saṃsthitāya śivātmane  || 1,72.125 ||
agnivarṇāya raudrāya aṃbikārdhaśarīriṇe  |
dhavalaśyāmaraktānāṃ muktidāyāmarāya ca  || 1,72.126 ||
jyeṣṭhāya rudrarūpāya somāya varadāya ca  |
trilokāya tridevāya vaṣaṭkārāya vai namaḥ  || 1,72.127 ||
madhye gaganarūpāya gaganasthāya te namaḥ  |
aṣṭakṣetrāṣṭarūpāya aṣṭatattvāya te namaḥ  || 1,72.128 ||
caturdhā ca caturdhā ca caturdhā saṃsthitāya ca  |
pañcadhā pañcadhā caiva pañcamantraśarīriṇe  || 1,72.129 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭiprakārāya akārāya namonamaḥ  |
dvātriṃśattattvarūpāya ukārāya namonamaḥ  || 1,72.130 ||
ṣoḍaśātmasvarūpāya makārāya namonamaḥ  |
aṣṭadhātmasvarūpāya ardhamātrātmane namaḥ  || 1,72.131 ||
oṅkārāya namastubhyaṃ caturdhā saṃsthitāya ca  |
gaganeśāya devāya svargeśāya namo namaḥ  || 1,72.132 ||
saptalokāya pātāla narakeśāya vai namaḥ  |
aṣṭakṣetrāṣṭarūpāya parātparatarāya ca  || 1,72.133 ||
sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasrāya ca te namaḥ  |
sahasrapādayuktāya śarvāya parameṣṭhine  || 1,72.134 ||
navātmatattvarūpāya navāṣṭātmātmaśaktaye  |
punaraṣṭaprakāśāya tathāṣṭāṣṭakamūrtaye  || 1,72.135 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭyātmatattvāya punaraṣṭavidhāya te  |
guṇāṣṭakavṛtāyaiva guṇine nirguṇāya te  || 1,72.136 ||
mūlasthāya namastubhyaṃ śāśvatasthānavāsine  |
nābhimaṇḍalasaṃsthāya hṛdi niḥsvanakāriṇe  || 1,72.137 ||
kandhare ca sthitāyaiva tālurandhrasthitāya ca  |
bhrūmadhye saṃsthitāyaiva nādamadhye sthitāya ca  || 1,72.138 ||
candrabimbasthitāyaiva śivāya śivarūpiṇe  |
vahnisomārkarūpāya ṣaṭtriṃśacchaktirūpiṇe  || 1,72.139 ||
tridhā saṃvṛtya lokānvai prasuptabhujagātmane  |
triprakāraṃ sthitāyaiva tretāgnimayarūpiṇe  || 1,72.140 ||
sadāśivāya śāntāya maheśāya pinākine  |
sarvajñāya śaraṇyāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ  || 1,72.141 ||
aghorāya namastubhyaṃ vāmadevāya te namaḥ  |
tatpuruṣāya namo'stu īśānāya namonamaḥ  || 1,72.142 ||
namastriṃśatprakāśāya śāntātītāya vai namaḥ  |
ananteśāya sūkṣmāya uttamāya namo'stu te  || 1,72.143 ||
ekākṣāya namastubhyamekarudrāya te namaḥ  |
namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ śrīkaṇṭhāya śikhaṇḍine  || 1,72.144 ||
anantāsanasaṃsthāya anantāyāntakāriṇe  |
vimalāya viśālāya vimalāṅgāya te namaḥ  || 1,72.145 ||
vimalāsanasaṃsthāya vimalārthārtharūpiṇe  |
yogapīṭhāntarasthāya yogine yogadāyine  || 1,72.146 ||
yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthāya sadā nīvāraśūkavat |
pratyāhārāya te nityaṃ pratyāhāraratāya te  || 1,72.147 ||
pratyāhāraratānāṃ ca pratisthānasthitāya ca  |
dhāraṇāyai namastubhyaṃ dhāraṇābhiratāya te  || 1,72.148 ||
dhāraṇābhyāsayuktānāṃ purastātsaṃsthitāya ca  |
dhyānāya dhyānarūpāya dhyānagamyāya te namaḥ  || 1,72.149 ||
dhyeyāya dhyeyagamyāya dhyeyadhyānāya te namaḥ  |
dhyeyānāmapi dhyeyāya namo dhyeyatamāya te  || 1,72.150 ||
samādhānābhigamyāya samādhānāya te namaḥ  |
samādhānaratānāṃ tu nirvikalpārtharūpiṇe  || 1,72.151 ||
dagdhvoddhṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ tvayādya jagattrayaṃ rudra puratrayaṃ hi  |
kaḥ stotumicchetkathamīdṛśaṃ tvāṃ stoṣye hi tuṣṭāya śivāya tubhyam  || 1,72.152 ||
bhaktyā ca tuṣṭyādbhutadarśanācca martyā amartyā api devadeva  |
ete gaṇāḥ siddhagaṇaiḥ praṇāmaṃ kurvanti deveśa gaṇeśa tubhyam  || 1,72.153 ||
nirīkṣaṇādeva vibho'si dagdhuṃ puratrayaṃ caiva jagattrayaṃ ca  |
līlālasenāṃbikayā kṣaṇena dagdhaṃ kileṣuśca tadātha muktaḥ  || 1,72.154 ||
kṛto rathaśceṣuvaraśca śubhraṃ śarasanaṃ te tripurakṣayāya  |
anekayatnaiśca mayātha tubhyaṃ phalaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ surasiddhasaṃghaiḥ  || 1,72.155 ||
ratho rathī devavaro hariśca rudraḥ svayaṃ śakrapitāmahau ca  |
tvameva sarve bhagavan kathaṃ tu stoṣye hyatoṣyaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā  || 1,72.156 ||
anantapādastvamanantabāhuranantamūrdhāntakaraḥ śivaśca  |
anantamūrtiḥ kathamīdṛśaṃ tvāṃ toṣye hyatoṣyaṃ kathamīdṛśaṃ tvām  || 1,72.157 ||
namonamaḥ sarvavide śivāya rudrāya śarvāya bhavāya tubhyam  |
sthūlāya sūkṣmāya susūkṣmasūkṣma sūkṣmāya sūkṣmārthavide vidhātre  || 1,72.158 ||
sraṣṭre namaḥ sarvasurāsurāṇāṃ bhartre ca hartre jagatāṃ vidhātre  |
netre surāṇāmasureśvarāṇāṃ dātre praśāstre mama sarvaśāstre  || 1,72.159 ||
vedāntavedyāya sunirmalāya vedārthavidbhiḥ satataṃ stutāya  |
vedātmarūpāya bhavāya tubhyamantāya madhyāya sumadhyamāya  || 1,72.160 ||
ādyantaśūnyāya ca saṃsthitāya tathā tvaśūnyāya ca liṅgine ca  |
aliṅgine liṅgamayāya tubhyaṃ liṅgāya vedādimayāya sākṣāt || 1,72.161 ||
rudrāya mūrdhānanikṛntanāya mamādidevasya ca yajñamūrteḥ  |
vidhvāntabhaṅgaṃ mama kartumīśa dṛṣṭvaiva bhūmau karajāgrakoṭyā  || 1,72.162 ||
aho vicitraṃ tava devadeva viceṣṭitaṃ sarvasurāsureśa  |
dehīva devaiḥ saha devakāryaṃ kariṣyase nirguṇarūpatattva  || 1,72.163 ||
ekaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmamekaṃ susūkṣmaṃ mūrtāmūrtaṃ mūrtamekaṃ hyamūrtam  |
ekaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vāṅmayaṃ caikamīśaṃ dhyeyaṃ caikaṃ tattvamatrādbhutaṃ te  || 1,72.164 ||
svapne dṛṣṭaṃ yatpadārthaṃ hyalakṣyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nūnaṃ bhāti manye na cāpi  |
mūrtirno vai daivakīśāna devairlakṣyā yatnairapyalakṣyaṃ kathaṃ tu  || 1,72.165 ||
divyaḥ kva deveśa bhavatprabhāvo vayaṃ kva bhaktiḥ kva ca te stutiśca  |
tathāpi bhaktyā vilapantamīśa pitāmahaṃ māṃ bhagavankṣamasva  || 1,72.166 ||

sūta uvāca
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyāddvijottamā bhuvi devaṃ praṇipatya paṭhet |
sa ca muñcati pāpabandhanaṃ bhavabhaktyā puraśāsituḥ stavam  || 1,72.167 ||
śrutvā ca bhaktyā caturānanena stuto hasañśailasutāṃ nirīkṣya  |
stavaṃ tadā prāha mahānubhāvaṃ mahābhujo mandaraśṛṅgavāsī  || 1,72.168 ||

śiva uvāca
stavenānena tuṣṭo'smi tava bhaktyā ca padmaja  |
varān varaya bhadraṃ te devānāṃ ca yathepsitān  || 1,72.169 ||

sūta uvāca
tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prāhedaṃ prītamānasaḥ  || 1,72.170 ||

śrīpitāmaha uvāca
bhagavandevadeveśa tripurāntaka śaṅkara  |
tvayi bhaktiṃ parāṃ me'dya prasīda parameśvaram  || 1,72.171 ||
devānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ tvayi sarvārthadeśvara  |
prasīda bhaktiyogena sārathyena ca sarvadā  || 1,72.172 ||
janārdano'pi bhagavānnamaskṛtya maheśvaram  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prāha sāṃbaṃ triyaṃbakam  || 1,72.173 ||
vāhanatvaṃ taveśāna nityamīhe prasīda me  |
tvayi bhaktiṃ ca deveśa devadeva namo'stu te  || 1,72.174 ||
sāmarthyaṃ ca sadā mahyaṃ bhavantaṃ voḍhumīśvaram  |
sarvajñatvaṃ ca varada sarvagatvaṃ ca śaṅkara  || 1,72.175 ||

sūta uvāca
tayoḥ śrutvā mahādevo vijñaptiṃ parameśvaraḥ  |
sārathye vāhanatve ca kalpayāmāsa vai bhavaḥ  || 1,72.176 ||
dattvā tasmai brahmaṇe viṣṇave ca dagdhvā daityāndevadevo mahātmā  |
sārdhaṃ devyā nandinā bhūtasaṃghairantardhānaṃ kārayāmāsa śarvaḥ  || 1,72.177 ||
tatastadā maheśvare gate raṇādgaṇaiḥ saha  |
sureśvarāḥ suvismitā bhavaṃ praṇamya pārvatīm  || 1,72.178 ||
yayuśca duḥkhavarjitāḥ svavāhanairdivaṃ tataḥ  |
sureśvarā munīśvarā gaṇeśvarāśca bhāskarāḥ  || 1,72.179 ||
tripurārerimaṃ puṇyaṃ nirmitaṃ brahmaṇā purā  |
yaḥ paṭhecchrāddhakāle vā daive karmaṇi ca dvijāḥ  || 1,72.180 ||
śrāvayedvā dvijān bhaktyā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati  |
mānasairvācikaiḥ pāpaistathā vai kāyikaiḥ punaḥ  || 1,72.181 ||
sthūlaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ susūkṣmaiśca mahāpātakasaṃbhavaiḥ  |
pātakaiśca dvijaśreṣṭhā upapātakasaṃbhavaiḥ  || 1,72.182 ||
pāpaiśca mucyate jantuḥ śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ śubham  |
śatravo nāśamāyānti saṃgrāme vijayībhavet || 1,72.183 ||
sarvarogairna bādhyeta āpado na spṛśanti tam  |
dhanamāyuryaśo vidyāṃ prabhāvamatulaṃ labhet || 1,72.184 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge tripuradāhe brahmastavo nāma dvisaptitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 73

sūta uvāca
gate maheśvare deve dagdhvā ca tripuraṃ kṣaṇāt |
sadasyāha surendrāṇāṃ bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,73.1 ||

pitāmaha uvāca
saṃtyajya devadeveśaṃ liṅgamūrtimaheśvaram  |
tārapautro mahātejāstārakasya suto balī  || 1,73.2 ||
tārakākṣo'pi ditijaḥ kamalākṣaśca vīryavān  |
vidyunmālī ca daityeśaḥ anye cāpi sabāndhavāḥ  || 1,73.3 ||
tyaktvā devaṃ mahādevaṃ māyayā ca hareḥ prabhoḥ  |
sarve vinaṣṭāḥ pradhvastāḥ svapuraiḥ purasaṃbhavaiḥ  || 1,73.4 ||
tasmātsadā pūjanīyo liṅgamūrtiḥ sadāśivaḥ  |
yāvatpūjā sureśānāṃ tāvadeva sthitiryataḥ  || 1,73.5 ||
pūjanīyaḥ śivo nityaṃ śraddhayā devapuṅgavaiḥ  |
sarvaliṅgamayo lokaḥ sarvaṃ liṅge pratiṣṭhitam  || 1,73.6 ||
tasmātsampūjayelliṅgaṃ ya icchetsiddhimātmanaḥ  |
sarve liṅgārcanādeva devā daityāśca dānavāḥ  || 1,73.7 ||
yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ  |
pitaro munayaścāpi piśācāḥ kinnarādayaḥ  || 1,73.8 ||
arcayitvā liṅgamūrti saṃsiddhā nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
tasmālliṅgaṃ yajennityaṃ yena kenāpi vā surāḥ  || 1,73.9 ||
paśavaśca vayaṃ tasya devadevasya dhīmataḥ  |
paśutvaṃ ca parityajya kṛtvā pāśupataṃ tataḥ  || 1,73.10 ||
pūjanīyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ  |
viśodhya caiva bhūtāni pañcabhiḥ praṇavaiḥ samam  || 1,73.11 ||
prāṇāyāmaiḥ samāyuktaiḥ pañcabhiḥ surapuṅgavāḥ  |
caturbhiḥ praṇavaiścaiva prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaiḥ  || 1,73.12 ||
tribhiśca praṇavairdevāḥ prāṇāyāmaistathāvidhaiḥ  |
dvidhā nyasya tathauṃkāraṃ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,73.13 ||
tataścauṃkāramuccārya prāṇāpānau niyamya ca  |
jñānāmṛtena sarvāṅgānyāpūrya praṇavena ca  || 1,73.14 ||
guṇatrayaṃ caturdhākhyamahaṅkāraṃ ca suvratāḥ  |
tanmātrāṇi ca bhūtāni tathā buddhīndriyāṇi ca  || 1,73.15 ||
karmendriyāṇi saṃśodhya puruṣaṃ yugalaṃ tathā  |
cidātmānaṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā cāgnirbhasmeti saṃspṛśet || 1,73.16 ||
vāyurbhasmeti ca vyoma tathāmbhaḥ pṛthivī tathā  |
triyāyuṣaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ ca dhūlayedbhasitena yaḥ  || 1,73.17 ||
sa yogī sarvatattvajño vrataṃ pāśupataṃ tvidam  |
bhavena pāśamokṣārthaṃ kathitaṃ devasattamāḥ  || 1,73.18 ||
evaṃ pāśupataṃ kṛtvā sampūjya parameśvaram  |
liṅge purā mayā dṛṣṭe viṣṇunā ca mahātmanā  || 1,73.19 ||
paśavo naiva jāyante varṣamātreṇa devatāḥ  |
asmābhiḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ devamabhyarcya yatnataḥ  || 1,73.20 ||
bāhye cābhyantare caiva manye kartavyamīśvaram  |
pratijñā mama viṣṇośca divyaiṣā surasattamāḥ  || 1,73.21 ||
munīnāṃ ca na saṃdehastasmātsampūjayecchivam  |
sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sa mohaḥ sā ca mūkatā  || 1,73.22 ||
yatkṣaṇaṃ vā muhūrtaṃ vā śivamekaṃ na cintayet |
bhavabhaktiparā ye ca bhavapraṇatacetasaḥ  || 1,73.23 ||
bhavasaṃsmaraṇodyuktā na te duḥkhasya bhājanam  |
bhavanāni manojñāni divyamābharaṇaṃ striyaḥ  || 1,73.24 ||
dhanaṃ vā tuṣṭiparyantaṃ śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam  |
ye vāñchanti mahābhogān rājyaṃ ca tridaśālaye  |
te'rcayantu sadā kālaṃ liṅgamūrtiṃ maheśvaram  || 1,73.25 ||
hatvā bhittvā ca bhūtāni dagdhvā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 1,73.26 ||
yajedekaṃ virūpākṣaṃ na pāpaiḥ sa pralipyate  |
śailaṃ liṅgaṃ madīyaṃ hi sarvadevanamaskṛtam  || 1,73.27 ||
ityuktvā pūrvamabhyarcya rudraṃ tribhuvaneśvaram  |
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirdevadevaṃ triyaṃbakam  || 1,73.28 ||
tadāprabhṛti śakrādyāḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvaram  |
sākṣātpāśupataṃ kṛtvā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ  || 1,73.29 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge brahmaproktaliṅgārcanavidhirnāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 74

sūta uvāca
<deity=> liṅga>
liṅgāni kalpayitvaivaṃ svādhikārānurūpataḥ  |
viśvakarmā dadau teṣāṃ niyogādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,74.1 ||
indranīlamayaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇunā pūjitaṃ sadā  |
padmarāgamayaṃ śakro haimaṃ viśravasaḥ sutaḥ  || 1,74.2 ||
viśvedevāstathā raupyaṃ vasavaḥ kāntikaṃ śubham  |
ārakūṭamayaṃ vāyuraśvinau pārthivaṃ sadā  || 1,74.3 ||
sphāṭikaṃ varuṇo rājā ādityāstāmranirmitam  |
mauktikaṃ somarāḍdhīmāṃstathā liṅgamanuttamam  || 1,74.4 ||
anantādyā mahānāgāḥ pravālakamayaṃ śubham  |
daityā hyayomayaṃ liṅgaṃ rākṣasāśca mahātmanaḥ  || 1,74.5 ||
trailohikaṃ guhyakāśca sarvalohamayaṃ gaṇāḥ  |
cāmuṇḍā saikataṃ sākṣānmātaraśca dvijottamāḥ  || 1,74.6 ||
dārujaṃ nairṛtirbhaktyā yamo mārakataṃ śubham  |
nīlādyāśca tathā rudrāḥ śuddhaṃ bhasmamayaṃ śubham  || 1,74.7 ||
lakṣmīvṛkṣamayaṃ lakṣmīrguho vai gomayātmakam  |
munayo muniśārdūlāḥ kuśāgramayamuttamam  || 1,74.8 ||
vāmādyāḥ puṣpaliṅgaṃ tu gandhaliṅgaṃ manonmanī  |
sarasvatī ca ratnena kṛtaṃ rudrasya vāgbhavā  || 1,74.9 ||
durgā haimaṃ mahādevaṃ savedikamanuttamam  |
ugrā piṣṭamayaṃ sarve mantrā hyājyamayaṃ śubham  || 1,74.10 ||
vedāḥ sarve dadhimayaṃ piśācāḥ sīsanirmitam  |
lebhire ca yathāyogyaṃ prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ padam  || 1,74.11 ||
bahunātra kimuktena carācaramidaṃ jagat |
śivaliṅgaṃ samabhyarcya sthitamatra na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,74.12 ||
<typesof liṅgasacc. to material>
ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṅgamityāhurdravyāṇāṃ ca prabhedataḥ  |
teṣāṃ bhedāścaturyukta catvāriṃśaditi smṛtāḥ  || 1,74.13 ||
śailajaṃ prathamaṃ proktaṃ taddhi sākṣāccaturvidham  |
dvitīyaṃ ratnajaṃ tacca saptadhā munisattamāḥ  || 1,74.14 ||
tṛtīyaṃ dhātujaṃ liṅgamaṣṭadhā parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
turīyaṃ dārujaṃ liṅgaṃ tattu ṣoḍaśadhocyate  || 1,74.15 ||
mṛnmayaṃ pañcamaṃ liṅgaṃ dvidhā bhinnaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu kṣaṇikaṃ liṅgaṃ saptadhā parikīrtitam  || 1,74.16 ||
śrīpradaṃ ratnajaṃ liṅgaṃ śailajaṃ sarvasiddhidam  |
dhātujaṃ dhanadaṃ sākṣāddārujaṃ bhogasiddhidam  || 1,74.17 ||
mṛnmayaṃ caiva viprendrāḥ sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubham  |
śailajaṃ cottamaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva dhātujam  || 1,74.18 ||
bahudhā liṅgabhedāśca nava caiva samāsataḥ  |
mūle brahmā tathā madhye viṣṇustribhuvaneśvaraḥ  || 1,74.19 ||
rudropari mahādevaḥ praṇavākhyaḥ sadāśivaḥ  |
liṅgavedī mahādevī triguṇā trimayāṃbikā  || 1,74.20 ||
tayā ca pūjayedyastu devī devaśca pūjitau  |
śailajaṃ ratnajaṃ vāpi dhātujaṃ vāpi dārujam  || 1,74.21 ||
mṛnmayaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vāpi bhaktyā sthāpya phalaṃ śubham  |
surendrāmbhojagarbhāgni yamāmbupadhaneśvaraiḥ  || 1,74.22 ||
siddhavidyādharāhīndrairyakṣadānavakinnaraiḥ  |
stūyamānaḥ supuṇyātmā devadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ  || 1,74.23 ||
bhūrbhūvaḥsvarmaharlokān kramādvai janataḥ param  |
tapaḥ satyaṃ parākramya bhāsayan svena tejasā  || 1,74.24 ||
liṅgasthāpanasanmārga nihitasvāyatāsinā  |
āśu brahmāṇḍamudbhidya nirgacchannirviśaṅkayā  || 1,74.25 ||
śailajaṃ ratnajaṃ vāpi dhātujaṃ vāpi dārujam  |
mṛnmayaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ tyaktvā sthāpayetsakalaṃ vapuḥ  || 1,74.26 ||
vidhinā caiva kṛtvā tu skandomāsahitaṃ śubham  |
kundagokṣīrasaṃkāśaṃ liṅgaṃ yaḥ sthāpayennaraḥ  || 1,74.27 ||
nṛṇāṃ tanuṃ samāsthāya sthito rudro na saṃśayaḥ  |
darśanātsparśanāttasya labhante nirvṛtiṃ narāḥ  || 1,74.28 ||
tasya puṇyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ samyagyugaśatairapi  |
śakyate naiva viprendrāstasmādvai sthāpayettathā  || 1,74.29 ||
sarveṣāmeva martyānāṃ vibhordivyaṃ vapuḥ śubham  |
sakalaṃ bhāvanāyogyaṃ yogināmeva niṣkalam  || 1,74.30 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivaliṅgabhedasaṃsthāpanādivarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 75

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
niṣkalo nirmalo nityaḥ sakalatvaṃ kathaṃ gataḥ  |
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ yathā śrutam  || 1,75.1 ||

sūta uvāca
paramārthavidaḥ kecidūcuḥ praṇavarūpiṇam  |
vijñānamiti viprendrāḥ śrutvā śrutiśirasyajam  || 1,75.2 ||
śabdādiviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ jñānamityabhidhīyate  |
tajjñānaṃ bhrāntirahitamityanye neti cāpare  || 1,75.3 ||
yajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirāśrayam  |
guruprakāśakaṃ jñānamityanye munayo dvijāḥ  || 1,75.4 ||
jñānenaiva bhavenmuktiḥ prasādo jñānasiddhaye  |
ubhābhyāṃ mucyate yogī tatrānandamayo bhavet || 1,75.5 ||
vadanti munayaḥ kecitkarmaṇā tasya saṃgatim  |
kalpanākalpitaṃ rūpaṃ saṃhṛtya svecchayaiva hi  || 1,75.6 ||
dyaurmūrdhā tu vibhostasya khaṃ nābhiḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
somasūryāgnayo netre diśaḥ śrotraṃ mahātmanaḥ  || 1,75.7 ||
caraṇau caiva pātālaṃ samudrastasya cāṃbaram  |
devāstasya bhujāḥ sarve nakṣatrāṇi ca bhūṣaṇam  || 1,75.8 ||
prakṛtistasya patnī ca puruṣo liṅgamucyate  |
vaktrādvai brāhmaṇāḥ sarve brahmā ca bhagavānprabhuḥ  || 1,75.9 ||
indropendrau bhujābhyāṃ tu kṣatriyāśca mahātmanaḥ  |
vaiśyāścorupradeśāttu śūdrāḥ pādātpinākinaḥ  || 1,75.10 ||
puṣkarāvartakādyāstu keśāstasya prakīrtitāḥ  |
vāyavo ghrāṇajāstasya gatiḥ śrautaṃ smṛtistathā  || 1,75.11 ||
athānenaiva karmātmā prakṛtestu pravartakaḥ  |
puṃsāṃ tu puruṣaḥ śrīmān jñānagamyo na cānyathā  || 1,75.12 ||
karmayajñasahasrebhyastapoyajño viśiṣyate  |
tapoyajñasahasrebhyo japayajño viśiṣyate  || 1,75.13 ||
japayajñasahasrebhyo dhyānayajño viśiṣyate  |
dhyānayajñātparo nāsti dhyānaṃ jñānasya sādhanam  || 1,75.14 ||
yadā samarase niṣṭho yogī dhyānena paśyati  |
dhyānayajñaratasyāsya tadā saṃnihitaḥ śivaḥ  || 1,75.15 ||
nāsti vijñānināṃ śaucaṃ prāyaścittādi codanā  |
viśuddhā vidyayā sarve brahmavidyāvido janāḥ  || 1,75.16 ||
nāsti kriyā ca lokeṣu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vicārataḥ  |
dharmādharmau japo homo dhyānināṃ saṃnidhiḥ sadā  || 1,75.17 ||
parānandātmakaṃ liṅgaṃ viśuddhaṃ śivamakṣaram  |
niṣkalaṃ sarvagaṃ jñeyaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam  || 1,75.18 ||
liṅgaṃ tu dvividhaṃ prāhurbāhyamābhyantaraṃ dvijāḥ  |
bāhyaṃ sthūlaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sūkṣmamābhyantaraṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,75.19 ||
karmayajñaratāḥ sthūlāḥ sthūlaliṅgārcane ratāḥ  |
asatāṃ bhāvanārthāya nānyathā sthūlavigrahaḥ  || 1,75.20 ||
ādhyātmikaṃ ca yalliṅgaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yasya no bhavet |
asau mūḍho bahiḥ sarvaṃ kalpayitvaiva nānyathā  || 1,75.21 ||
jñānināṃ sūkṣmamamalaṃ bhavetpratyakṣamavyayam  |
yathā sthūlamayuktānāṃ mṛtkāṣṭhādyaiḥ prakalpitam  || 1,75.22 ||
artho vicārato nāstītyanye tattvārthavedinaḥ  |
niṣkalaḥ sakalaśceti sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ tataḥ  || 1,75.23 ||
vyomaikamapi dṛṣṭaṃ hi śarāvaṃ prati suvratāḥ  |
pṛthaktvaṃ cāpṛthaktvaṃ ca śaṅkarasyeti cāpare  || 1,75.24 ||
pratyayārthaṃ hi jagatāmekastho'pi divākaraḥ  |
eko'pi bahudhā dṛṣṭo jalādhāreṣu suvratāḥ  || 1,75.25 ||
jantavo divi bhūmau ca sarve vai pāñcabhautikāḥ  |
tathāpi bahulā dṛṣṭā jātivyaktivibhedataḥ  || 1,75.26 ||
dṛśyate śrūyate yadyattattadviddhi śivātmakam  |
bhedo janānāṃ loke'smin pratibhāso vicārataḥ  || 1,75.27 ||
svapne ca vipulān bhogān bhuktvā martyaḥ sukhī bhavet |
duḥkhī ca bhogaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca nānubhūtaṃ vicārataḥ  || 1,75.28 ||
evamāhustathānye ca sarve vedārthatattvagāḥ  |
hṛdi saṃsāriṇāṃ sākṣātsakalaḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,75.29 ||
yogināṃ niṣkalo devo jñānināṃ ca jaganmayaḥ  |
trividhaṃ parameśasya vapurloke praśasyate  || 1,75.30 ||
niṣkalaṃ prathamaṃ caikaṃ tataḥ sakalaniṣkalam  |
tṛtīyaṃ sakalaṃ caiva nānyatheti dvijottamāḥ  || 1,75.31 ||
arcayanti muhuḥ kecitsadā sakalaniṣkalam  |
sarvajñaṃ hṛdaye kecicchivaliṅge vibhāvasau  || 1,75.32 ||
sakalaṃ munayaḥ kecitsadā saṃsāravartinaḥ  |
evamabhyarcayantyeva sadārāḥ sasutā narāḥ  || 1,75.33 ||
yathā śivastathā devī yathā devī tathā śivaḥ  |
tasmādabhedabuddhyaiva saptaviṃśatprabhedataḥ  || 1,75.34 ||
yajanti dehe bāhye ca catuṣkoṇe ṣaḍasrake  |
daśāre dvādaśāre ca ṣoḍaśāre trirasrake  || 1,75.35 ||
sa svecchayā śivaḥ sākṣāddevyā sārdhaṃ sthitaḥ prabhuḥ  |
saṃtāraṇārthaṃ ca śivaḥ sadasadvyaktivarjitaḥ  || 1,75.36 ||
tamekamāhurdviguṇaṃ ca kecitkecittamāhustriguṇātmakaṃ ca  |
ūcustathā taṃ ca śivaṃ tathānye saṃsāriṇaṃ vedavido vadanti  || 1,75.37 ||
bhaktyā ca yogena śubhena yuktā viprāḥ sadā dharmaratā viśiṣṭāḥ  |
yajanti yogeśamaśeṣamūrtiṃ ṣaḍasramadhye bhagavantameva  || 1,75.38 ||
ye tatra paśyanti śivaṃ trirasre tritattvamadhye triguṇaṃ triyakṣam  |
te yānti cainaṃ na ca yogino'nye tayā ca devyā puruṣaṃ purāṇam  || 1,75.39 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivādvaitakathanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 76

sūta uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi svecchāvigrahasaṃbhavam  |
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ phalaṃ sarvaṃ sarvalokahitāya vai  || 1,76.1 ||
skandomāsahitaṃ devamāsīnaṃ paramāsane  |
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 1,76.2 ||
skandomāsahitaṃ devaṃ sampūjya vidhinā sakṛt |
yatphalaṃ labhate martyastadvadāmi yathāśrutam  || 1,76.3 ||
sūryakoṭipratikāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ  |
rudrakanyāsamākīrṇairgeyanāṭyasamanvitaiḥ  || 1,76.4 ||
śivavatkrīḍate yogī yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ  || 1,76.5 ||
aumaṃ kaumāramaiśānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmameva ca  |
prājāpatyaṃ mahātejā janalokaṃ mahastathā  || 1,76.6 ||
aindramāsādya caindratvaṃ kṛtvā varṣāyutaṃ punaḥ  |
bhuktvā caiva bhuvarloke bhogān divyān suśobhanān  || 1,76.7 ||
merumāsādya devānāṃ bhavaneṣu pramodate  |
ekapādaṃ caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ śūlasaṃyutam  || 1,76.8 ||
sṛṣṭvā sthitaṃ hariṃ vāme dakṣiṇe caturānanam  |
aṣṭāviṃśatirudrāṇāṃ koṭiḥ sarvāṅgasuprabham  || 1,76.9 ||
pañcaviṃśatikaṃ sākṣātpuruṣaṃ hṛdayāttathā  |
prakṛtiṃ vāmataścaiva buddhiṃ vai buddhideśataḥ  || 1,76.10 ||
ahaṅkāramahaṅkārāttanmātrāṇi tu tatra vai  |
indriyāṇīndriyādeva līlayā parameśvaram  || 1,76.11 ||
pṛthivīṃ pādamūlāttu guhyadeśājjalaṃ tathā  |
nābhideśāttathā vahniṃ hṛdayādbhāskaraṃ tathā  || 1,76.12 ||
kaṇṭhātsomaṃ tathātmānaṃ bhrūmadhyānmastakāddivam  |
sṛṣṭaivaṃ saṃsthitaṃ sākṣājjagatsarvaṃ carācaram  || 1,76.13 ||
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ kṛtvā vidyāvidhānataḥ  |
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 1,76.14 ||
tripādaṃ saptahastaṃ ca catuḥśṛṅgaṃ dviśīrṣakam  |
kṛtvā yajñeśamīśānaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate  || 1,76.15 ||
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān kalpalakṣaṃ sukhī naraḥ  |
kramādāgatya loke'smin sarvayajñāntago bhavet || 1,76.16 ||
vṛṣārūḍhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryātsomaṃ somārdhabhūṣaṇam  |
hayamedhāyutaṃ kṛtvā yatpuṇyaṃ tadavāpya saḥ  || 1,76.17 ||
kāñcanena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā  |
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ tatraiva sa vimucyate  || 1,76.18 ||
nandinā sahitaṃ devaṃ sāmbaṃ sarvagaṇairvṛtam  |
kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti vakṣye tadvai yathāśrutam  || 1,76.19 ||
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃkāśairvimānairvṛṣasaṃyutaiḥ  |
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇairdevadānavadurlabhaiḥ  || 1,76.20 ||
nṛtyadbhirapsaraḥsaṃghaiḥ sarvataḥ sarvaśobhitaiḥ  |
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || 1,76.21 ||
nṛtyantaṃ devadeveśaṃ śailajāsahitaṃ prabhum  |
sahasrabāhuṃ sarvajñaṃ caturbāhumathāpi vā  || 1,76.22 ||
bhṛgvādyairbhūtasaṃghaiśca saṃvṛtaṃ parameśvaram  |
śailajāsahitaṃ sākṣādvṛṣabhadhvajamīśvaram  || 1,76.23 ||
brahmendraviṣṇusomādyaiḥ sadā sarvairnamaskṛtam  |
mātṛbhirmunibhiścaiva saṃvṛtaṃ parameśvaram  || 1,76.24 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya yatphalaṃ tadvadāmyaham  |
sarvayajñatapodāna tīrthadeveṣu yatphalam  || 1,76.25 ||
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ labdhvā yāti śivaṃ padam  |
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 1,76.26 ||
sṛṣṭyantare punaḥ prāpte mānavaṃ padamāpnuyāt |
nagnaṃ caturbhujaṃ śvetaṃ trinetraṃ sarpamekhalam  || 1,76.27 ||
kapālahastaṃ deveśaṃ kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajam  |
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 1,76.28 ||
ibhendradārakaṃ devaṃ sāṃbaṃ siddhārthadaṃ prabhum  |
sudhūmravarṇaṃ raktākṣaṃ trinetraṃ candrabhūṣaṇam  || 1,76.29 ||
kākapakṣadharaṃ mūrdhnā nāgaṭaṅkadharaṃ haram  |
siṃhājinottarīyaṃ ca mṛgacarmāṃbaraṃ prabhum  || 1,76.30 ||
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ gadāhastaṃ kapālodyatapāṇinam  |
huṃphaṭkāre mahāśabda śabditākhiladiṅmukham  || 1,76.31 ||
puṇḍarīkājinaṃ dorbhyāṃ bibhrantaṃ kambukaṃ tathā  |
hasantaṃ ca nadantaṃ ca pibantaṃ kṛṣṇasāgaram  || 1,76.32 ||
nṛtyantaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiśca gaṇasaṃghaistvalaṃkṛtam  |
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvibhavavistaram  || 1,76.33 ||
sarvavighnānatikramya śivaloke mahīyate  |
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 1,76.34 ||
jñānaṃ vicārato labdhvā rudrebhyastatra mucyate  |
ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ caturbhujamanuttamam  || 1,76.35 ||
varadābhayahastaṃ ca śūlapadmadharaṃ prabhum  |
strīpuṃbhāvena saṃsthānaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam  || 1,76.36 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya śivaloke mahīyate  |
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānaṇimādiguṇairyutaḥ  || 1,76.37 ||
ācandratārakaṃ jñānaṃ tato labdhvā vimucyate  |
yaḥ kuryāddevadeveśaṃ sarvajñaṃ lakulīśvaram  || 1,76.38 ||
vṛtaṃ śiṣyapraśiṣyaiśca vyākhyānodyatapāṇinam  |
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 1,76.39 ||
bhuktvā tu vipulāṃstatra bhogān yugaśataṃ naraḥ  |
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya tatraiva ca vimucyate  || 1,76.40 ||
pūrvadevāmarāṇāṃ ca yatsthānaṃ sakalepsitam  |
kṛtamudrasya devasya citābhasmānulepinaḥ  || 1,76.41 ||
tripuṇḍradhāriṇasteṣāṃ śiromālādharasya ca  |
brahmaṇaḥ keśakenaikamupavītaṃ ca bibhrataḥ  || 1,76.42 ||
bibhrato vāmahastena kapālaṃ brahmaṇo varam  |
viṣṇoḥ kalevaraṃ caiva bibhrataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,76.43 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya mucyate bhavasāgarāt |
oṃnamo nīlakaṇṭhāya iti puṇyākṣarāṣṭakam  || 1,76.44 ||
mantramāha sakṛdvā yaḥ pātakaiḥ sa vimucyate  |
mantreṇānena gandhādyairbhaktyā vittānusārataḥ  || 1,76.45 ||
sampūjya devadeveśaṃ śivaloke mahīyate  |
jālandharāntakaṃ devaṃ sudarśanadharaṃ prabhum  || 1,76.46 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya dvidhābhūtaṃ jalaṃdharam  |
prayāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,76.47 ||
sudarśanapradaṃ devaṃ sākṣātpūrvoktalakṣaṇam  |
arcamānena devena cārcitaṃ netrapūjayā  || 1,76.48 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya śivaloke mahīyate  |
tiṣṭhato'tha nikumbhasya pṛṣṭhataścaraṇāṃbujam  || 1,76.49 ||
vāmetaraṃ suvinyasya vāme cāliṅgya cādrijām  |
śūlāgre kūrparaṃ sthāpya kiṅkiṇīkṛtapannagam  || 1,76.50 ||
samprekṣya cāndhakaṃ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam  |
rūpaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 1,76.51 ||
yaḥ kuryāddevadeveśaṃ tripurāntakamīśvaram  |
dhanurbāṇasamāyuktaṃ somaṃ somārdhabhūṣaṇam  || 1,76.52 ||
rathe susaṃsthitaṃ devaṃ caturānanasārathim  |
tadākāratayā so'pi gatvā śivapuraṃ sukhī  || 1,76.53 ||
krīḍate nātra saṃdeho dvitīya iva śaṅkaraḥ  |
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān yāvadicchā dvijottamāḥ  || 1,76.54 ||
jñānaṃ vicāritaṃ labdhvā tatraiva sa vimucyate  || 1,76.55 ||
gaṅgādharaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ candraśekharameva ca  || 1,76.56 ||
gaṅgayā sahitaṃ caiva vāmotsaṅge'ṃbikānvitam  |
vināyakaṃ tathā skandaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ durgāṃ suśobhanām  || 1,76.57 ||
bhāskaraṃ ca tathā somaṃ brahmāṇīṃ ca maheśvarīm  |
kaumārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ devīṃ vārāhīṃ varadāṃ tathā  || 1,76.58 ||
indrāṇīṃ caiva cāmuṇḍāṃ vīrabhadrasamanvitām  |
vighneśena ca yo dhīmān śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 1,76.59 ||
liṅgamūrtiṃ mahājvālāmālāsaṃvṛtamavyayam  |
liṅgasya madhye vai kṛtvā candraśekharamīśvaram  || 1,76.60 ||
vyomni kuryāttathā liṅgaṃ brahmāṇaṃ haṃsarūpiṇam  |
viṣṇuṃ varāharūpeṇa liṅgasyādhastvadhomukham  || 1,76.61 ||
brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam  |
madhye liṅgaṃ mahāghoraṃ mahāmbhasi ca saṃsthitam  || 1,76.62 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
kṣetrasaṃrakṣakaṃ devaṃ tathā pāśupataṃ prabhum  || 1,76.63 ||
kṛtvā bhaktyā yathānyāyaṃ śivaloke mahīyate  || 1,76.64 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivamūrtipratiṣṭhāphalakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 77

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
liṅgapratiṣṭhāpuṇyaṃ ca liṅgasthāpanameva ca  |
liṅgānāṃ caiva bhedāśca śrutaṃ tava mukhādiha  || 1,77.1 ||
mṛdādiratnaparyantairdravyaiḥ kṛtvā śivālayam  |
yatphalaṃ labhate martyastatphalaṃ vaktumarhasi  || 1,77.2 ||

sūta uvāca
yasya bhakto'pi loke'smin putradāragṛhādibhiḥ  |
bādhyate jñānayuktaścenna ca tasya gṛhaistu kim  || 1,77.3 ||
tathāpi bhaktāḥ parameśvarasya kṛtveṣṭaloṣṭairapi rudralokam  |
prayānti divyaṃ hi vimānavaryaṃ surendrapadmodbhavavanditasya  || 1,77.4 ||
bālyāttu loṣṭena ca kṛtvā mṛdāpi vā pāṃsubhirādidevam  |*
gṛhaṃ ca tādṛgvidhamasya śaṃbhoḥ sampūjya rudratvamavāpnuvanti  || 1,77.5 ||*
tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhaktyā bhaktaiḥ śivālayam  |
kartavyaṃ sarvayatnena dharmakāmārthasiddhaye  || 1,77.6 ||
kesaraṃ nāgaraṃ vāpi drāviḍaṃ vā tathāparam  |
kṛtvā rudrālayaṃ bhaktyā śivaloke mahīyate  || 1,77.7 ||
kailāsākhyaṃ ca yaḥ kuryātprāsādaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
kailāsaśikharākārairvimānairmodate sukhī  || 1,77.8 ||
mandaraṃ vā prakurvīta śivāya vidhipūrvakam  |
bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa uttamādhamamadhyamam  || 1,77.9 ||
mandarādripratīkāśairvimānairviśvatomukhaiḥ  |
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇairdevadānavadurlabhaiḥ  || 1,77.10 ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ ramyaṃ bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān  |
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya gāṇapatyaṃ labhennaraḥ  || 1,77.11 ||
yaḥ kuryānmerunāmānaṃ prāsādaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
sa yatphalamavāpnoti na tatsarvairmahāmakhaiḥ  || 1,77.12 ||
sarvayajñatapodāna tīrthavedeṣu yatphalam  |
tatphalaṃ sakalaṃ labdhvā śivavanmodate ciram  || 1,77.13 ||
niṣadhaṃ nāma yaḥ kuryātprāsādaṃ bhaktitaḥ sudhīḥ  |
śivalokamanuprāpya śivavanmodate ciram  || 1,77.14 ||
kuryādvā yaḥ śubhaṃ viprā himaśailamanuttamam  |
himaśailopamairyānairgatvā śivapuraṃ śubham  || 1,77.15 ||
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt |
nīlādriśikharākhyaṃ vā prāsādaṃ yaḥ suśobhanam  || 1,77.16 ||
kṛtvā vittānusāreṇa bhaktyā rudrāya śaṃbhave  |
yatphalaṃ labhate martyastatphalaṃ pravadāmyaham  || 1,77.17 ||
himaśaile kṛte bhaktyā yatphalaṃ prāktavoditam  |
tatphalaṃ sakalaṃ labdhvā sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ  || 1,77.18 ||
rudralokamanuprāpya rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate  |
mahendraśailanāmānaṃ prāsādaṃ rudrasaṃmatam  || 1,77.19 ||
kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ pravadāmyaham  |
mahendraparvatākārairvimānairvṛṣasaṃyutaiḥ  || 1,77.20 ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān  |
jñānaṃ vicāritaṃ rudraiḥ samprāpya munipuṅgavāḥ  || 1,77.21 ||
viṣayān viṣavattyaktvā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
hemnā yastu prakurvīta prāsādaṃ ratnaśobhitam  || 1,77.22 ||
drāviḍaṃ nāgaraṃ vāpi kesaraṃ vā vidhānataḥ  |
kūṭaṃ vā maṇḍapaṃ vāpi samaṃ vā dīrghameva ca  || 1,77.23 ||
na tasya śakyate vaktuṃ puṇyaṃ śatayugairapi  |
jīrṇaṃ vā patitaṃ vāpi khaṇḍitaṃ sphuṭitaṃ tathā  || 1,77.24 ||
pūrvavatkārayedyastu dvārādyaiḥ suśubhaṃ dvijāḥ  |
prāsādaṃ maṇḍapaṃ vāpi prākāraṃ gopuraṃ tu vā  || 1,77.25 ||
karturapyadhikaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
vṛttyarthaṃ vā prakurvīta naraḥ karma śivālaye  || 1,77.26 ||
yaḥ sa yāti na saṃdehaḥ svargalokaṃ sabāndhavaḥ  |
yaścātmabhogasiddhyarthamapi rudrālaye sakṛt || 1,77.27 ||
karma kuryādyadi sukhaṃ labdhvā cāpi pramodate  |
tasmādāyatanaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ kuryānmunisattamāḥ  || 1,77.28 ||
kāṣṭheṣṭakādibhirmartyaḥ śivaloke mahīyate  |
prasādārthaṃ maheśasya prāsāde munipuṅgavāḥ  || 1,77.29 ||
kartavyaḥ sarvayatnena dharmakāmārthamuktaye  |
aśaktaścenmuniśreṣṭhāḥ prāsādaṃ kartumuttamam  || 1,77.30 ||
saṃmārjanādibhirvāpi sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt |
saṃmārjanaṃ tu yaḥ kuryānmārjanyā mṛdusūkṣmayā  || 1,77.31 ||
cāndrāyaṇasahasrasya phalaṃ māsena labhyate  |
yaḥ kuryādvastrapūtena gandhagomayavāriṇā  || 1,77.32 ||
ālepanaṃ yathānyāyaṃ varṣacāndrāyaṇaṃ labhet |
ardhakrośaṃ śivakṣetraṃ śivaliṅgātsamantataḥ  || 1,77.33 ||
yastyajeddustyajān prāṇāñśivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
svāyaṃbhuvasya mānaṃ hi tathā bāṇasya suvratāḥ  || 1,77.34 ||
svāyaṃbhuve tadardhaṃ syātsyādārṣe ca tadardhakam  |
mānuṣe ca tadardhaṃ syātkṣetramānaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 1,77.35 ||
evaṃ yatīnāmāvāse kṣetramānaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
rudrāvatāre cādyaṃ yacchiṣye caiva praśiṣyake  || 1,77.36 ||
narāvatāre tacchiṣye tacchiṣye ca praśiṣyake  |
śrīparvate mahāpuṇye tasya prānte ca vā dvijāḥ  || 1,77.37 ||
tasminvā yastyajetprāṇāñchivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
vārāṇasyāṃ tathāpyevamavimukte viśeṣataḥ  || 1,77.38 ||
kedāre ca mahākṣetre prayāge ca viśeṣataḥ  |
kurukṣetre ca yaḥ prāṇān saṃtyajedyāti nirvṛtim  || 1,77.39 ||
prabhāse puṣkare'vantyāṃ tathā caivāmareśvare  |
vaṇīśailākule caiva mṛto yāti śivātmatām  || 1,77.40 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ mṛto janturna jātu jantutāṃ vrajet |
triviṣṭape vimukte ca kedāre saṃgameśvare  || 1,77.41 ||
śālaṅke vā tyajetprāṇāṃstathā vai jambukeśvare  |
śukreśvare vā gokarṇe bhāskareśe guheśvare  || 1,77.42 ||
hiraṇyagarbhe nandīśe sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  |
niyamaiḥ śoṣya yo dehaṃ tyajetkṣetre śivasya tu  || 1,77.43 ||
sa yāti śivatāṃ yogī mānuṣe daivike'pi vā  |
ārṣe vāpi muniśreṣṭhāstathā svāyaṃbhuve'pi vā  || 1,77.44 ||
svayaṃbhūte tathā deve nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
ādhāyāgniṃ śivakṣetre sampūjya parameśvaram  || 1,77.45 ||
svadehapiṇḍaṃ juhuyādyaḥ sa yāti parāṃ gatim  |
yāvattāvannirāhāro bhūtvā prāṇān parityajet || 1,77.46 ||
śivakṣetre muniśreṣṭhāḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
chittvā pādadvayaṃ cāpi śivakṣetre vasettu yaḥ  || 1,77.47 ||
sa yāti śivatāṃ caiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
kṣetrasya darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ praveśastacchatādhikaḥ  || 1,77.48 ||
tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam  |
tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jalasnānamataḥ param  || 1,77.49 ||
kṣīrasnānaṃ tato viprāḥ śatādhikamanuttamam  |
dadhnā sahasramākhyātaṃ madhunā tacchatādhikam  || 1,77.50 ||
ghṛtasnānena cānantaṃ śārkare tacchatādhikam  |
śivakṣetrasamīpasthāṃ nadīṃ prāpyāvagāhya ca  || 1,77.51 ||
tyajeddehaṃ vihāyānnaṃ śivaloke mahīyate  |
śivakṣetrasamīpasthā nadyaḥ sarvāḥ suśobhanāḥ  || 1,77.52 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgāśca śivatīrthā iti smṛtāḥ  |
snātvā teṣu naro bhaktyā tīrtheṣu dvijasattamāḥ  || 1,77.53 ||
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
prātaḥ snātvā muniśreṣṭhāḥ śivatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ  || 1,77.54 ||
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati  |
madhyāhne śivatīrtheṣu snātvā bhaktyā sakṛnnaraḥ  || 1,77.55 ||
gaṅgāsnānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
astaṃ gate tathā cārke snātvā gacchecchivaṃ padam  || 1,77.56 ||
pāpakañcukamutsṛjya śivatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ  |
dvijāstriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā śivatīrthe sakṛnnaraḥ  || 1,77.57 ||
śivasāyujyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
purātha sūkaraḥ kaścitśvānaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayātpathi  || 1,77.58 ||
prasaṃgādvāramekaṃ tu śivatīrthe'vagāhya ca  |
mṛtaḥ svayaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā gāṇapatyamavāptavān  || 1,77.59 ||
yaḥ prātardevadeveśaṃ śivaṃ liṅgasvarūpiṇam  |
paśyetsa yāti sarvasmādadhikāṃ gatimeva ca  || 1,77.60 ||
madhyāhne ca mahādevaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet |
sāyāhne sarvayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpya vimucyate  || 1,77.61 ||
mānasairvācikaiḥ pāpaiḥ kāyikaiśca mahattaraiḥ  |
tathopapātakaiścaiva pāpaiścaivānupātakaiḥ  || 1,77.62 ||
saṃkrame devamīśānaṃ dṛṣṭvā liṅgākṛtiṃ prabhum  |
māsena yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tyaktvā yāti śivaṃ padam  || 1,77.63 ||
ayane cārdhamāsena dakṣiṇe cottarāyaṇe  |
viṣuve caiva sampūjya prayāti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,77.64 ||
pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryādyaḥ prāsādaṃ samantataḥ  |
savyāpasavyanyāyena mṛdugatyā śucirnaraḥ  || 1,77.65 ||
pade pade'śvamedhasya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt |
vācā yastu śivaṃ nityaṃ saṃrauti parameśvaram  || 1,77.66 ||
so'pi yāti śivaṃ sthānaṃ prāpya kiṃ punareva ca  |
kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ kṣetraṃ gandhagomayavāriṇā  || 1,77.67 ||
muktāphalamayaiścūrṇairindranīlamayaistathā  |
padmarāgamayaiścaiva sphāṭikaiśca suśobhanaiḥ  || 1,77.68 ||
tathā mārakataiścaiva sauvarṇai rājataistathā  |
tadvarṇairlaukikaiścaiva cūrṇairvittavivarjitaiḥ  || 1,77.69 ||
ālikhya kamalaṃ bhadraṃ daśahastapramāṇataḥ  |
sakarṇikaṃ mahābhāgā mahādevasamīpataḥ  || 1,77.70 ||
tatrāvāhya mahādevaṃ navaśaktisamanvitam  |
pañcabhiśca tathā ṣaḍbhiraṣṭābhiśceṣṭadaṃ param  || 1,77.71 ||
punaraṣṭābhirīśānaṃ daśāre daśabhistathā  |
punarbāhye ca daśabhiḥ sampūjya praṇipatya ca  || 1,77.72 ||
nivedya devadevāya kṣitidānaphalaṃ labhet |
śālipiṣṭādibhirvāpi padmamālikhya nirdhanaḥ  || 1,77.73 ||
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
dvādaśāraṃ tathālikhya maṇḍalaṃ padamuttamam  || 1,77.74 ||
ratnacūrṇādibhiścūrṇaistathā dvādaśamūrtibhiḥ  |
maṇḍalasya ca madhye tu bhāskaraṃ sthāpya pūjayet || 1,77.75 ||
grahaiśca saṃvṛtaṃ vāpi sūryasāyujyamuttamam  |
evaṃ prākṛtamapyārthyāṃ ṣaḍasraṃ parikalpya ca  || 1,77.76 ||
madhyadeśe ca deveśīṃ prakṛtiṃ brahmarūpiṇīm  |
dakṣiṇe sattvamūrtiṃ ca vāmataśca rajoguṇam  || 1,77.77 ||
agratastu tamomūrtiṃ madhye devīṃ tathāṃbikām  |
pañcabhūtāni tanmātrā pañcakaṃ caiva dakṣiṇe  || 1,77.78 ||
karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva tathā buddhīndriyāṇi ca  |
uttare vidhivatpūjya ṣaḍasre caiva pūjayet || 1,77.79 ||
ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ yugalaṃ buddhimeva ca  |
ahaṅkāraṃ ca mahatā sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 1,77.80 ||
evaṃ vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ maṇḍalaṃ param  |
ato vakṣyāmi viprendrāḥ sarvakāmārthasādhanam  || 1,77.81 ||
gocarmamātramālikhya maṇḍalaṃ gomayena tu  |
caturaśraṃ vidhānena cādbhirabhyukṣya mantravit || 1,77.82 ||
alaṃkṛtya vitānādyaiśchatrairvāpi manoramaiḥ  |
budbudairardhacandraiśca haimairaśvatthapatrakaiḥ  || 1,77.83 ||
sitairvikasitaiḥ padmai raktairnīlotpalaistathā  |
muktādāmairvitānānte lambitastu sitairdhvajaiḥ  || 1,77.84 ||
sitamṛtpātrakaiścaiva suślakṣṇaiḥ pūrṇakumbhakaiḥ  |
phalapallavamālābhirvaijayantībhiraṃśukaiḥ  || 1,77.85 ||
pañcāśaddīpamālābhirdhūpaiḥ pañcavidhaistathā  |
pañcāśaddalasaṃyuktamālikhetpadmamuttamam  || 1,77.86 ||
tattadvarṇaistathā cūrṇaiḥ śvetacūrṇairathāpi vā  |
ekahastapramāṇena kṛtvā padmaṃ vidhānataḥ  || 1,77.87 ||
karṇikāyāṃ nyaseddevaṃ devyā deveśvaraṃ bhavam  |
varṇāni ca nyasetpatre rudraiḥ prāgādyanukramāt || 1,77.88 ||
praṇavādinamo'ntāni sarvavarṇāni suvratāḥ  |
sampūjyaivaṃ muniśreṣṭhā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || 1,77.89 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra pañcāśadvidhipūrvakam  |
akṣamālopavītaṃ ca kuṇḍalaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum  || 1,77.90 ||
āsanaṃ ca tathā daṇḍamuṣṇīṣaṃ vastrameva ca  |
dattvā teṣāṃ munīndrāṇāṃ devadevāya śaṃbhave  || 1,77.91 ||
mahācaruṃ nivedyaivaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gomithunaṃ tathā  |
ante ca devadevāya dāpayeccūrṇamaṇḍalam  || 1,77.92 ||
yāgopayogadravyāṇi śivāya vinivedayet |
oṅkārādyaṃ japeddhīmān prativarṇamanukramāt || 1,77.93 ||
evamālikhya yo bhaktyā sarvamaṇḍalamuttamam  |
yatphalaṃ labhate martyastadvadāmi samāsataḥ  || 1,77.94 ||
sāṅgān vedān yathānyāyamadhītya vidhipūrvakam  |
iṣṭvā yajñairyathānyāyaṃ jyotiṣṭomādibhiḥ kramāt || 1,77.95 ||
tato viśvajidantaiśca putrānutpādya tādṛśān  |
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā sadāraḥ sāgnireva ca  || 1,77.96 ||
cāndrāyaṇādikāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtvā nyasya kriyā dvijāḥ  |
brahmavidyāmadhītyaiva jñānamāsādya yatnataḥ  || 1,77.97 ||
jñānena jñeyamālokya yogī yatkāmamāpnuyāt |
tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ varṇamaṇḍaladarśanāt || 1,77.98 ||
yena kenāpi vā martyaḥ pralipyāyatanāgrataḥ  |
uttare dakṣiṇe vāpi pṛṣṭhato vā dvijottamāḥ  || 1,77.99 ||
catuṣkoṇaṃ tu vā cūrṇairalaṃkṛtya samantataḥ  |
puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ pūjya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 1,77.100 ||
yastu garbhagṛhaṃ bhaktyā sakṛdālipya sarvataḥ  |
candanādyaiḥ sakarpūrairgandhadravyaiḥ samantataḥ  || 1,77.101 ||
vikīrya gandhakusumairdhūpairdhūpya caturvidhaiḥ  |
prārthayeddevamīśānaṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 1,77.102 ||
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān kalpakoṭiśataṃ naraḥ  |
svadehagandhakusumaiḥ pūrayañchivamandiram  || 1,77.103 ||
kramādgāndharvamāsādya gandharvaiśca supūjitaḥ  |
kramādāgatya loke'smin rājā bhavati vīryavān  || 1,77.104 ||
ādidevo mahādevaḥ pralayasthitikārakaḥ  |
sargaśca bhuvanādhīśaḥ śarvavyāpī sadāśivaḥ  |
śivabrahmāmṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ mokṣasādhanamuttamam  || 1,77.105 ||
vyaktāvyaktaṃ sadā nityamacintyamarcayetprabhum  || 1,77.106 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge upalepanādikathanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ
