liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 78

sūta uvāca
vastrapūtena toyena kāryaṃ caivopalepanam  |
śivakṣetre muniśreṣṭhā nānyathā siddhiriṣyate  || 1,78.1 ||
āpaḥ pūtā bhavantyetā vastrapūtāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ  |
aphenā muniśārdūlā nādeyāśca viśeṣataḥ  || 1,78.2 ||
tasmādvai sarvakāryāṇi daivikāni dvijottamāḥ  |
adbhiḥ kāryāṇi pūtābhiḥ sarvakāryaprasiddhaye  || 1,78.3 ||
jantubhirmiśritā hyāpaḥ sūkṣmābhistānnihatya tu  |
yatpāpaṃ sakalaṃ cādbhirapūtābhiściraṃ labhet || 1,78.4 ||
saṃmārjane tathā nṝṇāṃ mārjane ca viśeṣataḥ  |
agnau kaṇḍanake caiva peṣaṇe toyasaṃgrahe  || 1,78.5 ||
hiṃsā sadā gṛhasthānāṃ tasmāddhiṃsāṃ vivarjayet |
ahiṃseyaṃ paro dharmaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,78.6 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena vastrapūtaṃ samācaret |
taddānamabhayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadānottamottamam  || 1,78.7 ||
tasmāttu parihartavyā hiṃsā sarvatra sarvadā  |
manasā karmaṇā vācā sarvadāhiṃsakaṃ naram  || 1,78.8 ||
rakṣanti jantavaḥ sarve hiṃsakaṃ bādhayanti ca  |
trailokyamakhilaṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ vedapārage  || 1,78.9 ||
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ labhate'hiṃsako naraḥ  |
manasā karmaṇā vācā sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ  || 1,78.10 ||
dayādarśitapanthāno rudralokaṃ vrajanti ca  |
svāmivatparirakṣanti bahūni vividhāni ca  || 1,78.11 ||
ye putrapautravatsnehādrudralokaṃ vrajanti te  |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena vastrapūtena vāriṇā  || 1,78.12 ||
kāryamabhyukṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ snapanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  |
trailokyamakhilaṃ hatvā yatphalaṃ parikīrtyate  || 1,78.13 ||
śivālaye nihatyaikamapi tatsakalaṃ labhet |
śivārthaṃ sarvadā kāryā puṣpahiṃsā dvijottamāḥ  || 1,78.14 ||
yajñārthaṃ paśuhiṃsā ca kṣatriyairduṣṭaśāsanam  |
vihitāvihitaṃ nāsti yogināṃ brahmavādinām  || 1,78.15 ||
yatastasmānna hantavyā niṣiddhānāṃ niṣevaṇāt |
sarvakarmāṇi vinyasya saṃnyastā brahmavādinaḥ  || 1,78.16 ||
na hantavyāḥ sadā pūjyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api  |
pavitrāstu striyaḥ sarvā atreśca kulasaṃbhavāḥ  || 1,78.17 ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpamātreyīṃ vinihatya ca  |
striyaḥ sarvā na hantavyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api  || 1,78.18 ||
na yajñārthaṃ striyo grāhyāḥ sarvaiḥ sarvatra sarvadā  |
sarvavarṇeṣu viprendrāḥ pāpakarmaratā api  || 1,78.19 ||
malinā rūpavatyaśca virūpā malināṃbarāḥ  |
na hantavyāḥ sadā martyaiḥ śivavacchaṅkayā tathā  || 1,78.20 ||
vedabāhyavratācārāḥ śrautasmārtabahiṣkṛtāḥ  |
pāṣaṇḍina iti khyātā na saṃbhāṣyā dvijātibhiḥ  || 1,78.21 ||
na spṛṣṭavyā na draṣṭavyā dṛṣṭvā bhānuṃ samīkṣate  |
tathāpi tena vadhyāśca nṛpairanyaiśca jantubhiḥ  || 1,78.22 ||
prasaṃgādvāpi yo martyaḥ satāṃ sakṛdaho dvijāḥ  |
rudralokamavāpnoti samabhyarcya maheśvaram  || 1,78.23 ||
bhavanti duḥkhitāḥ sarve nirdayā munisattamāḥ  |
bhaktihīnā narāḥ sarve bhave paramakāraṇe  || 1,78.24 ||
ye bhaktā devadevasya śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
bhāgyavanto vimucyante bhuktvā bhogānihaiva te  || 1,78.25 ||
putreṣu dāreṣu gṛheṣu nṝṇāṃ bhaktaṃ yathā cittamathādideve  |
sakṛtprasaṃgādyatitāpasānāṃ teṣāṃ na dūraḥ parameśalokaḥ  || 1,78.26 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhaktimahimavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 79
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ pūjyo mahādevo martyairmandairmahāmate  |
kalpāyuṣairalpavīryairalpasattvaiḥ prajāpatiḥ  || 1,79.1 ||
saṃvatsarasahasraiśca tapasā pūjya śaṅkaram  |
na paśyanti surāścāpi kathaṃ devaṃ yajanti te  || 1,79.2 ||

sūta uvāca
kathitaṃ tathyamevātra yuṣmābhirmunipuṅgavāḥ  |
tathāpi śraddhayā dṛśyaḥ pūjyaḥ saṃbhāṣya eva ca  || 1,79.3 ||
prasaṃgāccaiva sampūjya bhaktihīnairapi dvijāḥ  |
bhāvānurūpaphalado bhagavāniti kīrtitaḥ  || 1,79.4 ||
ucchiṣṭaḥ pūjayanyāti paiśācaṃ tu dvijādhamaḥ  |
saṃkruddho rākṣasaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyānmūḍhadhīrdvijāḥ  || 1,79.5 ||
abhakṣyabhakṣī sampūjya yākṣaṃ prāpnoti durjanaḥ  |
gānaśīlaśca gāndharvaṃ nṛtyaśīlastathaiva ca  || 1,79.6 ||
khyātiśīlastathā cāndraṃ strīṣu sakto narādhamaḥ  |
madārtaḥ pūjayan rudraṃ somasthānamavāpnuyāt || 1,79.7 ||
gāyatryā devamabhyarcya prājāpatyamavāpnuyāt |
brāhmaṃ hi praṇavenaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ cābhinandya ca  || 1,79.8 ||
śraddhayā sakṛdevāpi samabhyarcya maheśvaram  |
rudralokamanuprāpya rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate  || 1,79.9 ||
saṃśodhya ca śubhaṃ liṅgamamarāsurapūjitam  |
jalaiḥ pūtaistathā pīṭhe devamāvāhya bhaktitaḥ  || 1,79.10 ||
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ yathānyāyaṃ praṇipatya ca śaṅkaram  |
kalpite cāsane sthāpya dharmajñānamaye śubhe  || 1,79.11 ||
vairāgyaiśvaryasampanne sarvalokanamaskṛte  |
oṅkārapadmamadhye tu somasūryāgnisaṃbhave  || 1,79.12 ||
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ dattvā rudrāya śaṃbhave  |
snāpayeddivyatoyaiśca ghṛtena payasā tathā  || 1,79.13 ||
dadhnā ca snāpayedrudraṃ śodhayecca yathāvidhi  |
tataḥ śuddhāṃbunā snāpya candanādyaiśca pūjayet || 1,79.14 ||
rocanādyaiśca sampūjya divyapuṣpaiśca pūjayet |
bilvapatrairakhaṇḍaiśca padmairnānāvidhaistathā  || 1,79.15 ||
nīlotpalaiśca rājīvairnadyāvartaiśca mallikaiḥ  |
campakairjātipuṣpaiśca bakulaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ  || 1,79.16 ||
śamīpuṣpairbṛhatpuṣpairunmattāgastyajairapi  |
apāmārgakadambaiśca bhūṣaṇairapi śobhanaiḥ  || 1,79.17 ||
dattvā pañcavidhaṃ dhūpaṃ pāyasaṃ ca nivedayet |
dadhibhaktaṃ ca madhvājya pariplutamataḥ param  || 1,79.18 ||
śuddhānnaṃ caiva mudgānnaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ ca nivedayet |
atha pañcavidhaṃ vāpi saghṛtaṃ vinivedayet || 1,79.19 ||
kevalaṃ cāpi śuddhānnamāḍhakaṃ taṇḍulaṃ pacet |
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ cānte namaskṛtya muhurmuhuḥ  || 1,79.20 ||
stutvā ca devamīśānaṃ punaḥ sampūjya śaṅkaram  |
īśānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva aghoraṃ vāmameva ca  || 1,79.21 ||
sadyojātaṃ japaṃścāpi pañcabhiḥ pūjayecchivam  |
anena vidhinā devaḥ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ  || 1,79.22 ||
vṛkṣāḥ puṣpādipatrādyairupayuktāḥ śivārcane  |
gāvaścaiva dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,79.23 ||
pūjayedyaḥ śivaṃ rudraṃ śarvaṃ bhavamajaṃ sakṛt |
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam  || 1,79.24 ||
arcitaṃ parameśānaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim  |
sakṛtprasaṃgādvā dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 1,79.25 ||
pūjitaṃ vā mahādevaṃ pūjyamānamathāpi vā  |
dṛṣṭvā prayāti vai martyo brahmalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,79.26 ||
śrutvānumodayeccāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  |
yo dadyādghṛtadīpaṃ ca sakṛlliṅgasya cāgrataḥ  || 1,79.27 ||
sa tāṃ gatimavāpnoti svāśramairdurlabhāṃ sthirām  |
dīpavṛkṣaṃ pārthivaṃ vā dāravaṃ vā śivālaye  || 1,79.28 ||
dattvā kulaśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate  |
āyasaṃ tāmrajaṃ vāpi raupyaṃ sauvarṇikaṃ tathā  || 1,79.29 ||
śivāya dīpaṃ yo dadyādvidhinā vāpi bhaktitaḥ  |
sūryāyutasamaiḥ ślakṣṇairyānaiḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 1,79.30 ||
kārtike māsi yo dadyādghṛtadīpaṃ śivāgrataḥ  |
sampūjyamānaṃ vā paśyedvidhinā parameśvaram  || 1,79.31 ||
sa yāti brahmaṇo lokaṃ śraddhayā munisattamāḥ  |
āvāhanaṃ susānnidhyaṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā  || 1,79.32 ||
samproktaṃ rudragāyatryā āsanaṃ praṇavena vai  |
pañcabhiḥ snapanaṃ proktaṃ rudrādyaiśca viśeṣataḥ  || 1,79.33 ||
evaṃ sampūjayennityaṃ devadevamumāpatim  |
brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya praṇavena samarcayet || 1,79.34 ||
uttare devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ gāyatriyā yajet |
vahnau hutvā yathānyāyaṃ pañcabhiḥ praṇavena ca  || 1,79.35 ||
sa yāti śivasāyujyamevaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaram  |
iti saṃkṣepataḥ prokto liṅgārcanavidhikramaḥ  || 1,79.36 ||
vyāsena kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ śrutvā rudramukhātsvayam  || 1,79.37 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivārcanavidhirnāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 80

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ paśupatiṃ dṛṣṭvā paśupāśavimokṣaṇam  |
paśutvaṃ tatyajurdevāstanno vaktumihārhasi  || 1,80.1 ||

sūta uvāca
purā kailāsaśikhare bhogyākhye svapure sthitam  |
sametya devāḥ sarvajñamājagmustatprasādataḥ  || 1,80.2 ||
hitāya sarvadevānāṃ brahmaṇā ca janārdanaḥ  |
garuḍasya tathā skandhamāruhya puruṣottamaḥ  || 1,80.3 ||
jagāma devatābhirvai devadevāntikaṃ hariḥ  |
sarve samprāpya devasya sārdhaṃ girivaraṃ śubham  || 1,80.4 ||
sendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sayamāḥ praṇemurgirimuttamam  |
bhagavān vāsudevo'sau garuḍādgaruḍadhvajaḥ  |
avatīrya giriṃ merumāruroha surottamaiḥ  || 1,80.5 ||
<descriptionof ṃt. ṃeru>
sakaladuritahīnaṃ sarvadaṃ bhogamukhyaṃ muditakuraravṛndaṃ nāditaṃ nāgavṛndaiḥ  |
madhuraraṇitagītaṃ sānukūlāndhakāraṃ padaracitavanāntaṃ kāntavātāntatoyam  || 1,80.6 ||
bhavanaśatasahasrairjuṣṭamādityakalpairlalitagatividagdhairhaṃsavṛndaiśca bhinnam  |
dhavakhadirapalāśaiścandanādyaiśca vṛkṣairdvijavaragaṇavṛndaiḥ kokilādyairdvirephaiḥ  || 1,80.7 ||
kvacidaśeṣasuradrumasaṃkulaṃ kurabakaiḥ priyakaistilakaistathā  |
bahukadambatamālalatāvṛtaṃ girivaraṃ śikharairvividhaistathā  || 1,80.8 ||
<descriptionof śivascityon ṃt. ṃeru>
gireḥ pṛṣṭhe paraṃ śārvaṃ kalpitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā  |
krīḍārthaṃ devadevasya bhavasya parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,80.9 ||
apaśyaṃstatpuraṃ devāḥ sendropendrāḥ samāhitāḥ  |
praṇemurdūrataścaiva prabhāvādeva śūlinaḥ  || 1,80.10 ||
sahasrasūryapratimaṃ mahāntaṃ sahasraśaḥ sarvaguṇaiśca bhinnam  |
jagāma kailāsagiriṃ mahātmā meruprabhāge puramādidevaḥ  || 1,80.11 ||
tato'tha nārigajavājisaṃkulaṃ rathairanekairamarārisūdanaḥ  |
gaṇairgaṇeśaiśca girīndrasaṃnibhaṃ mahāpuradvāramajo hariśca  || 1,80.12 ||
atha jāṃbūnadamayairbhavanairmaṇibhūṣitaiḥ  |
vimānairvividhākāraiḥ prākāraiśca samāvṛtam  || 1,80.13 ||
dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhoḥ puraṃ bāhyaṃ devaiḥ sabrahmakairhariḥ  |
prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā praviveśa tataḥ puram  || 1,80.14 ||
harmyaprāsādasambādhaṃ mahāṭṭālasamanvitam  |
dvitīyaṃ devadevasya caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam  || 1,80.15 ||
vajravaiḍūryamāṇikya maṇijālaiḥ samāvṛtam  |
dolāvikṣepasaṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam  || 1,80.16 ||
mṛdaṅgamurajairjuṣṭaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam  |
nṛtyadbhirapsaraḥsaṃghairbhūtasaṃghaiśca saṃvṛtam  |
devendrabhavanākārairbhavanairdṛṣṭimohanaiḥ  || 1,80.17 ||
prāsādaśṛṅgeṣvatha pauranāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ puṣpaphalākṣatādyaiḥ  |
sthitāḥ karaistasya hareḥ samantātpracikṣipurmūrdhni yathā bhavasya  || 1,80.18 ||
dṛṣṭvā nāryastadā viṣṇuṃ madāghūrṇitalocanāḥ  || 1,80.19 ||
viśālajaghanāḥ sadyo nanṛturmumudurjaguḥ  |
kāściddṛṣṭvā hariṃ nāryaḥ kiṃcitprahasitānanāḥ  || 1,80.20 ||
kiṃcidvisrastavastrāśca srastakāñcīguṇā jaguḥ  |
caturthaṃ pañcamaṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca saptamaṃ tathā  || 1,80.21 ||
aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ caiva daśamaṃ ca purottamam  |
atītyāsādya devasya puraṃ śaṃbhoḥ suśobhanam  || 1,80.22 ||
suvṛttaṃ sutarāṃ śubhraṃ kailāsaśikhare śubhe  |
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃkāśairvimānaiśca vibhūṣitam  || 1,80.23 ||
sphāṭikairmaṇḍapaiḥ śubhrairjāṃbūnadamayaistathā  |
nānāratnamayaiścaiva digvidikṣu vibhūṣitam  || 1,80.24 ||
gopurairgopateḥ śaṃbhornānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ  |
anekaiḥ sarvatobhadraiḥ sarvaratnamayaistathā  || 1,80.25 ||
prākārairvividhākārairaṣṭāviṃśatibhirvṛtam  |
upadvārairmahādvārairvidikṣu vividhairdṛḍhaiḥ  || 1,80.26 ||
guhyālayairguhyagṛhairguhasya bhavanaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
grāmyairanyairmahābhāgā mauktikairdṛṣṭimohanaiḥ  || 1,80.27 ||
gaṇeśāyatanairdivyaiḥ padmarāgamayaistathā  |
candanairvividhākāraiḥ puṣpodyānaiśca śobhanaiḥ  || 1,80.28 ||
taḍāgairdirghikābhiśca hemasopānapaṅktibhiḥ  |
strīṇāṃ gatijitairhaṃsaiḥ sevitābhiḥ samantataḥ  || 1,80.29 ||
mayūraiścaiva kāraṇḍaiḥ kokilaiścakravākakaiḥ  |
śobhitābhiśca vāpībhirdivyāmṛtajalaistathā  || 1,80.30 ||
saṃlāpālāpakuśalaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ  |
stanabhārāvanamraiśca madāghūrṇitalocanaiḥ  || 1,80.31 ||
geyanādaratairdivyai rudrakanyāsahasrakaiḥ  |
nṛtyadbhirapsaraḥsaṃghairamarairapi durlabhaiḥ  || 1,80.32 ||
praphullāṃbujavṛndādyaistathā dvijavarairapi  |
rudrastrīgaṇasaṃkīrṇairjalakrīḍārataistathā  || 1,80.33 ||
ratotsavarataiścaiva lalitaiśca pade pade  |
grāmarāgānuraktaiśca padmarāgasamaprabhaiḥ  || 1,80.34 ||
strīsaṃghairdevadevasya bhavasya paramātmanaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpannāstasthurdevāḥ samantataḥ  || 1,80.35 ||
tatraiva dadṛśurdevā vṛndaṃ rudragaṇasya ca  |
gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ vīrāṇāmapi vṛndaṃ sahasraśaḥ  || 1,80.36 ||
suvarṇakṛtasopānān vajravaiḍūryabhūṣitān  |
sphāṭikān devadevasya dadṛśuste vimānakān  || 1,80.37 ||
teṣāṃ śṛṅgeṣu hṛṣṭāśca nāryaḥ kamalalocanāḥ  |
viśālajaghanā yakṣā gandharvāpsarasastathā  || 1,80.38 ||
kinnaryaḥ kiṃnarāścaiva bhujaṅgāḥ siddhakanyakāḥ  |
nānāveṣadharāścānyā nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ  || 1,80.39 ||
nānāprabhāvasaṃyuktā nānābhogaratipriyāḥ  |
nīlotpaladalaprakhyāḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ  || 1,80.40 ||
padmakiñjalkasaṃkāśairaṃśukairatiśobhanāḥ  |
valayairnūpurairhāraiśchatraiścitraistathāṃśukaiḥ  || 1,80.41 ||
bhūṣitā bhūṣitaiścānyairmaṇḍitā maṇḍanapriyāḥ  |
dṛṣṭvātha vṛndaṃ surasundarīṇāṃ gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ surasundarīṇām  |
jagmurgaṇeśasya puraṃ sureśāḥ puradviṣaḥ śakrapurogamāśca  || 1,80.42 ||
dṛṣṭvā ca tasthuḥ surasiddhasaṃghāḥ purasya madhye puruhūtapūrvāḥ  |
bhavasya bālārkasahasravarṇaṃ vimānamādyaṃ parameśvarasya  || 1,80.43 ||
atha tasya vimānasya dvāri saṃsthaṃ gaṇeśvaram  |
nandinaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ  || 1,80.44 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandinaṃ sarve praṇamyāhurgaṇeśvaram  |
jayeti devāstaṃ dṛṣṭvā so'pyāha ca gaṇeśvaraḥ  || 1,80.45 ||
bho bho devā mahābhāgāḥ sarve nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ  |
samprāptāḥ sarvalokeśā vaktumarhatha suvratāḥ  || 1,80.46 ||
tamāhurvaradaṃ devaṃ vāraṇendrasamaprabham  |
paśupāśavimokṣārthaṃ darśayāsmānmaheśvaram  || 1,80.47 ||
purā puratrayaṃ dagdhuṃ paśutvaṃ paribhāṣitam  |
śaṅkitāśca vayaṃ tatra paśutvaṃ prati suvrata  || 1,80.48 ||
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ proktaṃ bhavena parameṣṭhinā  |
vratenānena bhūteśa paśutvaṃ naiva vidyate  || 1,80.49 ||
atha dvādaśavarṣaṃ vā māsadvādaśakaṃ tu vā  |
dinadvādaśakaṃ vāpi kṛtvā tadvratamuttamam  || 1,80.50 ||
mucyante paśavaḥ sarve paśupāśairbhavasya tu  |
darśayāmāsa tāndevānnārāyaṇapurogamān  || 1,80.51 ||
nandī śilādatanayaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇāgraṇīḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamīśānaṃ sāṃbaṃ sagaṇamavyayam  || 1,80.52 ||
praṇemustuṣṭuvuścaiva prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ  |
vijñāpya śitikaṇṭhāya paśupāśavimokṣaṇam  || 1,80.53 ||
tasthustadāgrataḥ śaṃbhoḥ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ  |
tataḥ samprekṣya tān sarvān devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ  || 1,80.54 ||
viśodhya teṣāṃ devānāṃ paśutvaṃ parameśvaraḥ  |
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caiva svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ  || 1,80.55 ||
upadiśya munīnāṃ ca sahāste cāṃbayā bhavaḥ  |
tadāprabhṛti te devāḥ sarve pāśupatāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 1,80.56 ||
paśūnāṃ ca patiryasmātteṣāṃ sākṣāddhi devatāḥ  |
tasmātpāśupatāḥ proktāstapastepuśca te punaḥ  || 1,80.57 ||
tato dvādaśavarṣānte muktapāśāḥ surottamāḥ  |
yayuryathāgataṃ sarve brahmaṇā saha viṣṇunā  || 1,80.58 ||
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pitāmahamukhācchrutam  |
purā sanatkumāreṇa tasmādvyāsena dhīmatā  || 1,80.59 ||
yaḥ śrāvayecchucirviprāñchṛṇuyādvā śucirnaraḥ  |
sa dehabhedamāsādya paśupāśaiḥ pramucyate  || 1,80.60 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pāśupatavratamāhātmyaṃ nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 81

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vratametattvayā proktaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam  |
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ laiṅgaṃ purā devairanuṣṭhitam  || 1,81.1 ||
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tvayā śrutam  |

sūta uvāca
purā sanatkumāreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ śailādirādarāt || 1,81.2 ||
nandī prāha vacastasmai pravadāmi samāsataḥ  |
<resultof liṅga worship>
devairdaityaistathā siddhairgandharvaiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ  || 1,81.3 ||
munibhiśca mahābhāgairanuṣṭhitamanuttamam  |
vrataṃ dvādaśaliṅgākhyaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam  || 1,81.4 ||
bhogadaṃ yogadaṃ caiva kāmadaṃ muktidaṃ śubham  |
aviyogakaraṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhayanāśanam  || 1,81.5 ||
ṣaḍaṅgasahitān vedānmathitvā tena nirmitam  |
sarvadānottamaṃ puṇyamaśvamedhāyutādhikam  || 1,81.6 ||
sarvamaṅgaladaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam  |
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmapi mokṣadam  || 1,81.7 ||
sarvavyādhiharaṃ caiva sarvajvaravināśanam  |
devairanuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā  || 1,81.8 ||
<creationof a liṅga>
kṛtvā kanīyasaṃ liṅgaṃ snāpya candanavāriṇā  |
caitramāsādi viprendrāḥ śivaliṅgavrataṃ caret || 1,81.9 ||
kṛtvā haimaṃ śubhaṃ padmaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam  |
navaratnaiśca khacitamaṣṭapatraṃ yathāvidhi  || 1,81.10 ||
karṇikāyāṃ nyaselliṅgaṃ sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhasaṃyutam  |
tatra bhaktyā yathānyāyamarcayedbilvapatrakaiḥ  || 1,81.11 ||
sitaiḥ sahasrakamalai raktairnīlotpalairapi  |
śvetārkakarṇikāraiśca karavīrairbakairapi  || 1,81.12 ||
etairanyairyathālābhaṃ gāyatryā tasya suvratāḥ  |
sampūjya caiva gandhādyairdhūpairdīpaiśca maṅgalaiḥ  || 1,81.13 ||
nīrājanādyaiścānyaiśca liṅgamūrtimaheśvaram  |
agaruṃ dakṣiṇe dadyādaghoreṇa dvijottamāḥ  || 1,81.14 ||
paścime sadyamantreṇa divyāṃ caiva manaḥśilām  |
uttare vāmadevena candanaṃ vāpi dāpayet || 1,81.15 ||
puruṣeṇa muniśreṣṭhā haritālaṃ ca pūrvataḥ  |
sitāgarūdbhavaṃ viprāstathā kṛṣṇāgarūdbhavam  || 1,81.16 ||
tathā gugguludhūpaṃ ca saugandhikamanuttamam  |
sitāraṃ nāma dhūpaṃ ca dadyādīśāya bhaktitaḥ  || 1,81.17 ||
mahācarurnivedyaḥ syādāḍhakānnamathāpi vā  |
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ śivaliṅgamahāvratam  || 1,81.18 ||
<time forthisvrata>
sarvamāseṣu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo'pi ca kīrtyate  |
vaiśākhe vajraliṅgaṃ ca jyeṣṭhe mārakataṃ tathā  || 1,81.19 ||
āṣāḍhe mauktikaṃ liṅgaṃ śrāvaṇe nīlanirmitam  |
māsi bhādrapade liṅgaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ śubham  || 1,81.20 ||
āśvine caiva viprendrāḥ gomedakamayaṃ śubham  |
pravālenaiva kārtikyāṃ tathā vai mārgaśīrṣake  || 1,81.21 ||
<materialfora liṅga>
vaiḍūryanirmitaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣparāgeṇa puṣyake  |
māghe ca sūryakāntena phālgune sphāṭikena ca  || 1,81.22 ||
sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimamekaṃ vidhīyate  |
alābhe rājataṃ vāpi kevalaṃ kamalaṃ tu vā  || 1,81.23 ||
ratnānāmapyalābhe tu hemnā vā rājatena vā  |
rajatasyāpyalābhe tu tāmralohena kārayet || 1,81.24 ||
śailaṃ vā dārujaṃ vāpi mṛnmayaṃ vā savedikam  |
sarvagandhamayaṃ vāpi kṣaṇikaṃ parikalpayet || 1,81.25 ||
haimantike mahādevaṃ śrīpattreṇaiva pūjayet |
sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimamekamathāpi vā  || 1,81.26 ||
rājataṃ vāpi kamalaṃ haimakarṇikamuttamam  |
rājatasyāpyabhāve tu bilvapatraiḥ samarcayet || 1,81.27 ||
sahasrakamalālābhe tadardhenāpi pūjayet |
tadardhārdhena vā rudramaṣṭottaraśatena vā  || 1,81.28 ||
<flower=> deity>
bilvapatre sthitā lakṣmīrdevī lakṣaṇasaṃyutā  |
nīlotpale'ṃbikā sākṣādutpale ṣaṇmukhaḥ svayam  || 1,81.29 ||
padmāśrito mahādevaḥ sarvadevapatiḥ śivaḥ  |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrīpattraṃ na tyajedbudhaḥ  || 1,81.30 ||
nīlotpalaṃ cotpalaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  |
sarvavaśyakaraṃ padmaṃ śilā sarvārthasiddhidā  || 1,81.31 ||
kṛṣṇāgarusamudbhūtaṃ sarvapāpanikṛntanam  |
gugguluprabhṛtīnāṃ caiva dīpānāṃ ca nivedanam  || 1,81.32 ||
sarvarogakṣayaṃ caiva candanaṃ sarvasiddhidam  |
saugandhikaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam  || 1,81.33 ||
śvetāgarūdbhavaṃ caiva tathā kṛṣṇāgarūdbhavam  |
saumyaṃ sītāridhūpaṃ ca sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidam  || 1,81.34 ||
śvetārkakusume sākṣāccaturvaktraḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
karṇikārasya kusume medhā sākṣādvyavasthitā  || 1,81.35 ||
karavīre gaṇādhyakṣo bake nārāyaṇaḥ svayam  |
sugandhiṣu ca sarveṣu kusumeṣu nagātmajā  || 1,81.36 ||
tasmādetairyathālābhaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ  || 1,81.37 ||
nivedayettato bhaktyā pāyasaṃ ca mahācarum  |
saghṛtaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ ca sarvadravyasamanvitam  || 1,81.38 ||
śuddhānnaṃ vāpi mudgānnamāḍhakaṃ cārdhakaṃ tu vā  |
cāmaraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca tasmai bhaktyā nivedayet || 1,81.39 ||
upahārāṇi puṇyāni nyāyenaivārjitānyapi  |
nānāvidhāni cārhāṇi prokṣitānyaṃbhasā punaḥ  || 1,81.40 ||
nivedayecca rudrāya bhaktiyuktena cetasā  |
kṣīrādvai sarvadevānāṃ sthityarthamamṛtaṃ dhruvam  || 1,81.41 ||
viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā sākṣādanne sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  |
bhūtānāmannadānena prītirbhavati śaṅkare  || 1,81.42 ||
tasmātsampūjayeddevamanne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ  |
upahāre tathā tuṣṭirvyañjane pavanaḥ svayam  || 1,81.43 ||
sarvātmako mahādevo gandhatoye hyapāmpatiḥ  |
pīṭhe vai prakṛtiḥ sākṣānmahadādyairvyavasthitā  || 1,81.44 ||
tasmāddevaṃ yajedbhaktyā pratimāsaṃ yathāvidhi  |
paurṇamāsyāṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye  || 1,81.45 ||
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā śāntiḥ saṃtoṣo dānameva ca  |
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāmupavāsaṃ ca kārayet || 1,81.46 ||
saṃvatsarānte godānaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ viśeṣataḥ  |
bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā śrotriyān vedapāragān  || 1,81.47 ||
talliṅgaṃ pūjitaṃ tena sarvadravyasamanvitam  |
sthāpayedvā śivakṣetre dāpayedbrāhmaṇāya vā  || 1,81.48 ||
ya evaṃ sarvamāseṣu śivaliṅgamahāvratam  |
kuryādbhaktyā muniśreṣṭhāḥ sa eva tapatāṃ varaḥ  || 1,81.49 ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ  |
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ nehāyāti kadācana  || 1,81.50 ||
athavā hyekamāsaṃ vā caredevaṃ vratottamam  |
śivalokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,81.51 ||
athavā saktacittaścedyānyān saṃcintayedvarān  |
varṣamekaṃ caredevaṃ tāṃstānprāpya śivaṃ vrajet || 1,81.52 ||
devatvaṃ vā pitṛtvaṃ vā devarājatvameva ca  |
gāṇapatyapadaṃ vāpi sakto'pi labhate naraḥ  || 1,81.53 ||
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt |
dravyārthī ca nidhiṃ paśyedāyuḥkāmaścirāyuṣam  || 1,81.54 ||
yānyāṃścintayate kāmāṃstāṃstānprāpyeha modate  |
ekamāsavratādeva so'nte rudratvamāpnuyāt || 1,81.55 ||
idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ vratottamaṃ viśvasṛjāpi sṛṣṭam  |
hitāya devāsurasiddhamartya vidyādharāṇāṃ paramaṃ śivena  || 1,81.56 ||
sampūjya pūjyaṃ vidhinaivamīśaṃ praṇamya mūrdhnā saha bhṛtyaputraiḥ  |
vyapohanaṃ nāma japetstavaṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtya śivaṃ prayatnāt || 1,81.57 ||
purākṛtaṃ viśvasṛjā stavaṃ ca hitāya devena jagattrayasya  |
pitāmahenaiva suraiśca sārdhaṃ mahānubhāvena mahārghyametat || 1,81.58 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge paśupāśavimocanaliṅgapūjādikathanaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 82

sūta uvāca
vyapohanastavaṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham  |
nandinaśca mukhācchrutvā kumāreṇa mahātmanā  || 1,82.1 ||
vyāsāya kathitaṃ tasmādbahumānena vai mayā  |
namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya nirmalāya yaśasvine  || 1,82.2 ||
duṣṭāntakāya sarvāya bhavāya paramātmane  |
pañcavaktro daśabhujo hyakṣapañcadaśairyutaḥ  || 1,82.3 ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ  |
sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śāntaḥ sarvopari susaṃsthitaḥ  || 1,82.4 ||
padmāsanasthaḥ someśaḥ pāpamāśu vyapohatu  |
īśānaḥ puruṣaścaiva aghoraḥ sadya eva ca  || 1,82.5 ||
vāmadevaśca bhagavān pāpamāśu vyapohatu  |
anantaḥ sarvavidyeśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,82.6 ||
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
sūkṣmaḥ surāsureśāno viśveśo gaṇapūjitaḥ  || 1,82.7 ||
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
śivottamo mahāpūjyaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,82.8 ||
sarvagaḥ sarvadaḥ śāntaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
ekākṣo bhagavānīśaḥ śivārcanaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,82.9 ||
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
trimūrtirbhagavānīśaḥ śivabhaktiprabodhakaḥ  || 1,82.10 ||
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñśivadhyānarataḥ sadā  || 1,82.11 ||
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī  || 1,82.12 ||
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī  || 1,82.13 ||
dākṣāyaṇī mahādevī gaurī haimavatī śubhā  |
ekaparṇāgrajā saumyā tathā vai caikapāṭalā  || 1,82.14 ||
aparṇā varadā devī varadānaikatatparā  |
umā suraharā sākṣātkauśikī vā kapardinī  || 1,82.15 ||
khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇī divyā karāgratarupallavā  |
naigameyādibhirdivyaiścaturbhiḥ putrakairvṛtā  || 1,82.16 ||
menāyā nandinī devī vārijā vārijekṣaṇā  |
aṃbāyā vītaśokasya nandinaśca mahātmanaḥ  || 1,82.17 ||
śubhāvatyāḥ sakhī śāntā pañcacūḍā varapradā  |
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtitvaṃ gatāvyayā  || 1,82.18 ||
trayoviṃśatibhistattvairmahadādyairvijṛmbhitā  |
lakṣmyādiśaktibhirnityaṃ namitā nandanandinī  || 1,82.19 ||
manonmanī mahādevī māyāvī maṇḍanapriyā  |
māyayā yā jagatsarvaṃ brahmādyaṃ sacarācaram  || 1,82.20 ||
kṣobhiṇī mohinī nityaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitā  |
ekānekasthitā loke indīvaranibhekṣaṇā  || 1,82.21 ||
bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ sarvadevairabhiṣṭutā  |
gaṇendrāmbhojagarbhendra yamavitteśapūrvakaiḥ  || 1,82.22 ||
saṃstutā jananī teṣāṃ sarvopadravanāśinī  |
bhaktānāmārtihā bhavyā bhavabhāvavināśanī  || 1,82.23 ||
bhuktimuktipradā divyā bhaktānāmaprayatnataḥ  |
sā me sākṣānmahādevī pāpamāśu vyapohatu  || 1,82.24 ||
caṇḍaḥ sarvagaṇeśāno mukhācchaṃbhorvinirgataḥ  |
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.25 ||
śālaṅkāyanaputrastu halamārgotthitaḥ prabhuḥ  |
jāmātā marutāṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtamaheśvaraḥ  || 1,82.26 ||
sarvagaḥ sarvadṛkśarvaḥ sarveśasadṛśaḥ prabhuḥ  |
sanārāyaṇakairdevaiḥ sendracandradivākaraiḥ  || 1,82.27 ||
siddhaiśca yakṣagandharvairbhūtairbhūtavidhāyakaiḥ  |
uragairṛṣibhiścaiva brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā  || 1,82.28 ||
stutastrailokyanāthastu munirantaḥ puraṃ sthitaḥ  |
sarvadā pūjitaḥ sarvairnandī pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.29 ||
mahākāyo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ  |
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.30 ||
merumandārakailāsa taṭakūṭaprabhedanaḥ  |
airāvatādibhirdivyairdiggajaiśca supūjitaḥ  || 1,82.31 ||
saptapātālapādaśca saptadvīporujaṅghakaḥ  |
saptārṇavāṅkuśaścaiva sarvatīrthodaraḥ śivaḥ  || 1,82.32 ||
ākāśadeho digbāhuḥ somasūryāgnilocanaḥ  |
hatāsuramahāvṛkṣo brahmavidyāmahotkaṭaḥ  || 1,82.33 ||
brahmādyādhoraṇairdivyairyogapāśasamanvitaiḥ  |
baddho hṛtpuṇḍarīkākhye staṃbhe vṛttiṃ nirudhya ca  || 1,82.34 ||
nāgendravaktro yaḥ sākṣādgaṇakoṭiśatairvṛtaḥ  |
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.35 ||
bhṛṅgīśaḥ piṅgalākṣo'sau bhasitāśastu dehayuk |
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.36 ||
caturbhistanubhirnityaṃ sarvāsuranibarhaṇaḥ  |
skandaḥ śaktidharaḥ śāntaḥ senānīḥ śikhivāhanaḥ  || 1,82.37 ||
devasenāpatiḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  |
bhavaḥ śarvastatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatistathā  || 1,82.38 ||
ugro bhīmo mahādevaḥ śivārcanarataḥ sadā  |
etāḥ pāpaṃ vyapohantu mūrtayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,82.39 ||
mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ  |
īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ  || 1,82.40 ||
kapālīśaśca vijñeyo rudrā rudrāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ  |
śivapraṇāmasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.41 ||
vikartano vivasvāṃśca mārtaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ  |
lokaprakāśakaścaiva lokasākṣītrivikramaḥ  || 1,82.42 ||
ādityaśca tathā sūryaścāṃśumāṃśca divākaraḥ  |
ete vai dvādaśādityā vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.43 ||
gaganaṃ sparśanaṃ tejo rasaśca pṛthivī tathā  |
candraḥ sūryastathātmā ca tanavaḥ śivabhāṣitāḥ  || 1,82.44 ||
pāpaṃ vyapohantu mama bhayaṃ nirṇāśayantu me  |
vāsavaḥ pāvakaścaiva yamo nirṛtireva ca  || 1,82.45 ||
varuṇo vāyusomau ca īśāno bhagavān hariḥ  |
pitāmahaśca bhagavān śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,82.46 ||
ete pāpaṃ vyapohantu manasā karmaṇā kṛtam  |
nabhasvānsparśano vāyuranilo mārutastathā  || 1,82.47 ||
prāṇaḥ prāṇeśajīveśau mārutaḥ śivabhāṣitāḥ  |
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.48 ||
khecarī vasucārī ca brahmeśo brahmabrahmadhīḥ  |
suṣeṇaḥ śāśvataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ supuṣṭaśca mahābalaḥ  || 1,82.49 ||
ete vai cāraṇāḥ śaṃbhoḥ pūjayātīva bhāvitāḥ  |
vyapohantu malaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam  || 1,82.50 ||
mantrajño mantravitprājño mantrarāṭsiddhapūjitaḥ  |
siddhavatparamaḥ siddhaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyinaḥ  || 1,82.51 ||
vyapohantu malaṃ sarve siddhāḥ śivapadārcakāḥ  |
yakṣo yakṣeśadhanado jṛmbhako maṇibhadrakaḥ  || 1,82.52 ||
pūrṇabhadreśvaro mālī śitikuṇḍalireva ca  |
narendraścaiva yakṣeśā vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.53 ||
anantaḥ kulikaścaiva vāsukistakṣakastathā  |
karkoṭako mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkhapālo mahābalaḥ  || 1,82.54 ||
śivapraṇāmasampannāḥ śivadehaprabhūṣaṇāḥ  |
mama pāpaṃ vyapohantu viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam  || 1,82.55 ||
vīṇājñaḥ kinnaraścaiva surasenaḥ pramardanaḥ  |
atīśayaḥ sa prayogī gītajñaścaiva kinnarāḥ  || 1,82.56 ||
śivapraṇāmasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama  |
vidyādharaśca vibudho vidyārāśirvidāṃ varaḥ  || 1,82.57 ||
vibuddho vibudhaḥ śrīmān kṛtajñaśca mahāyaśāḥ  |
ete vidyādharāḥ sarve śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ  || 1,82.58 ||
vyapohantu malaṃ ghoraṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ  |
vāmadevī mahājambhaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ  || 1,82.59 ||
sugrīvo mardakaścaiva piṅgalo devamardanaḥ  |
prahrādaścāpyanuhrādaḥ saṃhrādaḥ kila bāṣkalau  || 1,82.60 ||
jambhaḥ kuṃbhaśca māyāvī kārtavīryaḥ kṛtaṃjayaḥ  |
ete'surā mahātmāno mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ  || 1,82.61 ||
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoramāsuraṃ bhāvameva ca  |
garutmān khagatiścaiva pakṣirāṭnāgamardanaḥ  || 1,82.62 ||
nāgaśatrurhiraṇyāṅgo vainateyaḥ prabhañjanaḥ  |
nāgāśīrviṣanāśaśca viṣṇuvāhana eva ca  || 1,82.63 ||
ete hiraṇyavarṇābhā garuḍā viṣṇuvāhanāḥ  |
nānābharaṇasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.64 ||
agastyaśca vasiṣṭhaśca aṅgirā bhṛgureva ca  |
kāśyapo nāradaścaiva dadhīcaścyavanastathā  || 1,82.65 ||
upamanyustathānye ca ṛṣayaḥ śivabhāvitāḥ  |
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.66 ||
pitaraḥ pitāmahāśca tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ  |
agniṣvāttā barhiṣadastathā mātāmahādayaḥ  || 1,82.67 ||
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ  |
lakṣmīśca dharaṇī caiva gāyatrī ca sarasvatī  || 1,82.68 ||
durgā uṣā śacī jyeṣṭhā mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ  |
devānāṃ mātaraścaiva gaṇānāṃ mātarastathā  || 1,82.69 ||
bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvā yatra yā gaṇamātaraḥ  |
prasādāddevadevasya vyapohantu malaṃ mama  || 1,82.70 ||
urvaśī menakā caiva raṃbhā ratitilottamāḥ  |
sumukhī durmukhī caiva kāmukī kāmavardhanī  || 1,82.71 ||
tathānyāḥ sarvalokeṣu divyāścāpsarasastathā  |
śivāya tāṇḍavaṃ nityaṃ kurvantyo'tīva bhāvitāḥ  || 1,82.72 ||
devyaḥ śivārcanaratā vyapohantu malaṃ mama  |
arkaḥ somo'ṅgārakaśca budhaścaiva bṛhaspatiḥ  || 1,82.73 ||
śukraḥ śanaiścaraścaiva rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca  |
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoraṃ grahapīḍāṃ śivārcakāḥ  || 1,82.74 ||
meṣo vṛṣo'tha mithunastathā karkaṭakaḥ śubhaḥ  |
siṃhaśca kanyā vipulā tulā vai vṛścikastathā  || 1,82.75 ||
dhanuśca makaraścaiva kuṃbho mīnastathaiva ca  |
rāśayo dvādaśa hyete śivapūjāparāyaṇāḥ  || 1,82.76 ||
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ  |
aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā  || 1,82.77 ||
śrīmanmṛgaśiraścārdrā punarvasupuṣyasārpakāḥ  |
maghā vai pūrvaphālgunya uttarāphālgunī tathā  || 1,82.78 ||
hastacitrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā  |
jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ mahābhāgā pūrvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca  || 1,82.79 ||
uttarāṣāḍhikā caiva śravaṇaṃ ca śraviṣṭhikā  |
śatabhiṣakpūrvabhadrā tathā proṣṭhapadā tathā  || 1,82.80 ||
pauṣṇaṃ ca devyaḥ satataṃ vyapohantu malaṃ mama  |
jvaraḥ kumbhodaraścaiva śaṅkukarṇo mahābalaḥ  || 1,82.81 ||
mahākarṇaḥ prabhātaśca mahābhūtapramardanaḥ  |
śyenajicchivadūtaśca pramathāḥ prītivardhanāḥ  || 1,82.82 ||
koṭikoṭiśataiścaiva bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sadā  |
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ  || 1,82.83 ||
śivadhyānaikasampanno himarāḍaṃbusannibhaḥ  |
kundendusadṛśākāraḥ kuṃbhakundendubhūṣaṇaḥ  || 1,82.84 ||
vaḍavānalaśatruryo vaḍavāmukhabhedanaḥ  |
catuṣpādasamāyuktaḥ kṣīroda iva pāṇḍuraḥ  || 1,82.85 ||
rudraloke sthito nityaṃ rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ  |
vṛṣendro viśvadhṛgdevo viśvasya jagataḥ pitā  || 1,82.86 ||
vṛto nandādibhirnityaṃ mātṛbhirmakhamardanaḥ  |
śivārcanarato nityaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.87 ||
gaṅgā mātā jaganmātā rudraloke vyavasthitā  |
śivabhaktā tu yā nandā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.88 ||
bhadrā bhadrapadā devī śivaloke vyavasthitā  |
mātā gavāṃ mahābhāgā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.89 ||
surabhiḥ sarvatobhadrā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī  |
rudrapūjāratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.90 ||
suśīlā śīlasampannā śrīpradā śivabhāvitā  |
śivaloke sthitā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.91 ||
vedaśāstrārthatattvajñaḥ sarvakāryābhicintakaḥ  |
samastaguṇasampannaḥ sarvadeveśvarātmajaḥ  || 1,82.92 ||
jyeṣṭhaḥ sarveśvaraḥ saumyo mahāviṣṇutanuḥ svayam  |
āryaḥ senāpatiḥ sākṣādgahano makhamardanaḥ  || 1,82.93 ||
airāvatagajārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ  |
kṛṣṇāṅgo raktanayanaḥ śaśipannagabhūṣaṇaḥ  || 1,82.94 ||
bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācaiśca kūṣmāṇḍaiśca samāvṛtaḥ  |
śivārcanarataḥ sākṣātsa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.95 ||
brahmāṇī caiva māheśī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā  |
vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍāgneyikā tathā  || 1,82.96 ||
etā vai mātaraḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokaprapūjitāḥ  |
yoginībhirmahāpāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ  || 1,82.97 ||
vīrabhadro mahātejā himakundendusannibhaḥ  |
rudrasya tanayo raudraḥ śūlāsaktamahākaraḥ  || 1,82.98 ||
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvāyudhadharaḥ svayam  |
tretāgninayano devastrailokyābhayadaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,82.99 ||
mātṝṇāṃ rakṣako nityaṃ mahāvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ  |
trailokyanamitaḥ śrīmān śivapādārcane rataḥ  || 1,82.100 ||
yajñasya ca śiraśchettā pūṣṇo dantavināśanaḥ  |
vahnerhastaharaḥ sākṣādbhaganetranipātanaḥ  || 1,82.101 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhena somāṅga peṣakaḥ prabhusaṃjñakaḥ  |
upendrendrayamādīnāṃ devānāmaṅgarakṣakaḥ  || 1,82.102 ||
sarasvatyā mahādevyā nāsikoṣṭhāvakartanaḥ  |
gaṇeśvaro yaḥ senānīḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.103 ||
jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā varadā varābharaṇabhūṣitā  |
mahālakṣmīrjaganmātā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.104 ||
mahāmohā mahābhāgā mahābhūtagaṇairvṛtā  |
śivārcanaratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.105 ||
lakṣmīḥ sarvaguṇopetā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā  |
sarvadā sarvagā devī sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.106 ||
siṃhārūḍhā mahādevī pārvatyāstanayāvyayā  |
viṣṇornidrā mahāmāyā vaiṣṇavī surapūjitā  || 1,82.107 ||
trinetrā varadā devī mahiṣāsuramardinī  |
śivārcanaratā durgā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu  || 1,82.108 ||
brahmāṇḍadhārakā rudrāḥ sarvalokaprapūjitāḥ  |
satyāśca mānasāḥ sarve vyapohantu bhayaṃ mama  || 1,82.109 ||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍagaṇanāyakāḥ  |
kūṣmāṇḍakāśca te pāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ  || 1,82.110 ||
anena devaṃ stutvā tu cānte sarvaṃ samāpayet |
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pratimāse dvijottamāḥ  || 1,82.111 ||
vyapohanastavaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi  |
vidhūya sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate  || 1,82.112 ||
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ jayakāmo jayaṃ labhet |
arthakāmo labhedarthaṃ putrakāmo bahūn sutān  || 1,82.113 ||
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt |
yānyānprārthayate kāmānmānavaḥ śravaṇādiha  || 1,82.114 ||
tānsarvān śīghramāpnoti devānāṃ ca priyo bhavet |
paṭhyamānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yamuddiśya tu paṭhyate  || 1,82.115 ||
tasya rogā na bādhante vātapittādisaṃbhavāḥ  |
nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya na sarpairapi daśyate  || 1,82.116 ||
yatpuṇyaṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ yajñānāṃ caiva yatphalam  |
dānānāṃ caiva yatpuṇyaṃ vratānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  || 1,82.117 ||
tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ japtvā cāpnoti mānavaḥ  |
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca vīrahā brahmahā bhavet || 1,82.118 ||
śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśvāsaghātakaḥ  |
duṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā  || 1,82.119 ||
vyapohya sarvapāpāni śivaloke mahīyate  || 1,82.120 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vyapohanastavanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ


_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 83

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vyapohanastavaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutamasmābhirādarāt |
prasaṃgālliṅgadānasya vratānyapi vadasva naḥ  || 1,83.1 ||

sūta uvāca
vratāni vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śubhāni munisattamāḥ  |
nandinā kathitānīha brahmaputrāya dhīmate  || 1,83.2 ||
tāni vyāsādupaśrutya yuṣmākaṃ pravadāmyaham  |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi  || 1,83.3 ||
varṣamekaṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivam  |
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,83.4 ||
pṛthivīṃ bhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā parvasu mānavaḥ  |
ahorātreṇa caikena trirātraphalamaśnute  || 1,83.5 ||
dvayormāsasya pañcamyordvayoḥ pratipadornaraḥ  |
kṣīradhārāvrataṃ kuryātso'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 1,83.6 ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu naktena yāvatkṛṣṇacaturdaśī  |
bhuñjanbhogānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati  || 1,83.7 ||
yo'bdamekaṃ prakurvīta naktaṃ parvasu parvasu  |
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,83.8 ||
saṃvatsarānte viprendrān bhojayedvidhipūrvakam  |
sa yāti śāṅkaraṃ lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,83.9 ||
upavāsātparaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyātparamayācitam  |
ayācitātparaṃ naktaṃ tasmānnaktena vartayet || 1,83.10 ||
devairbhuktaṃ tu pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne ṛṣibhistathā  |
aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ  || 1,83.11 ||
sarvavelāmatikramya naktabhojanamuttamam  |
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyamāhāralāghavam  || 1,83.12 ||
agnikāryamadhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret |
pratimāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śivavratamanuttamam  || 1,83.13 ||
dharmakāmārthamokṣārthaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye  |
puṣyamāse ca sampūjya yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam  || 1,83.14 ||
satyavādī jitakrodhaḥ śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ  |
pakṣayoraṣṭamīṃ yatnādupavāsena vartayet || 1,83.15 ||
bhūmiśayyāṃ ca māsānte paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ  |
snāpya rudraṃ mahādevaṃ sampūjya vidhipūrvakam  || 1,83.16 ||
yāvakaṃ caudanaṃ dattvā sakṣīraṃ saghṛtaṃ dvijāḥ  |
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñśiṣṭāñjapecchāntiṃ viśeṣataḥ  || 1,83.17 ||
tathā gomithunaṃ caiva kapilaṃ vinivedayet |
bhavāya devadevāya śivāya parameṣṭhine  || 1,83.18 ||
sa yāti muniśārdūla vāhneyaṃ lokamuttamam  |
bhuktvā sa vipulān lokān tatraiva sa vimucyate  || 1,83.19 ||
māghamāse tu sampūjya yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam  |
kṛśaraṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ  || 1,83.20 ||
sopavāsaṃ caturdaśyāṃ bhavedubhayapakṣayoḥ  |
rudrāya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu dadyādvai ghṛtakambalam  || 1,83.21 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ gomithunaṃ dadyātpūjayeccaiva śaṃkaram  |
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva yathāvibhavavistaram  || 1,83.22 ||
yāmyamāsādya vai lokaṃ yamena saha modate  |
phālgune caiva samprāpte kuryādvai naktabhojanam  || 1,83.23 ||
śyāmākānnaghṛtakṣīrairjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ  |
caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ ca kārayet || 1,83.24 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ mahādevaṃ snāpya sampūjya śaṅkaram  |
dadyādgomithunaṃ vāpi tāmrābhaṃ śūlapāṇaye  || 1,83.25 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu prārthayetparameśvaram  |
sa yāti candrasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,83.26 ||
caitre'pi rudramabhyarcya kuryādvai naktabhojanam  |
śālyannaṃ payasā yuktaṃ ghṛtena ca yathāsukham  || 1,83.27 ||
goṣṭhaśāyī muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṣitau niśi bhavaṃ smaret |
paurṇamāsyāṃ śivaṃ snāpya dadyādgomithunaṃ sitam  || 1,83.28 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayeccaiva nirṛteḥ sthānamāpnuyāt |
vaiśākhe ca tathā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam  || 1,83.29 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ bhavaṃ snāpya pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ  |
śvetaṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 1,83.30 ||
jyeṣṭhe māse ca deveśaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim  |
sampūjya śraddhayā bhaktyā kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam  || 1,83.31 ||
raktaśālyannamadhvā ca adbhiḥ pūtaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ  |
vīrāsano niśārdhaṃ ca gavāṃ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ  || 1,83.32 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sampūjya devadevamumāpatim  |
snāpya śaktyā yathānyāyaṃ caruṃ dadyācca śūline  || 1,83.33 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca yathāvibhavavistaram  |
dhūmraṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā vāyuloke mahīyate  || 1,83.34 ||
āṣāḍhe māsi cāpyevaṃ naktabhojanatatparaḥ  |
bhūrikhaṇḍājyasaṃmiśraṃ saktubhiścaiva gorasam  || 1,83.35 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādyaistu snāpya pūjya yathāvidhi  |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śrotriyān vedapāragān  || 1,83.36 ||
dadyādgomithunaṃ gauraṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt |
śrāvaṇe ca dvijā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam  || 1,83.37 ||
kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam  |
paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādyaistu snāpya pūjya yathāvidhi  || 1,83.38 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śrotriyān vedapāragān  |
śvetāgrapādaṃ pauṇḍraṃ ca dadyādgomithunaṃ punaḥ  || 1,83.39 ||
sa yāti vāyusāyujyaṃ vāyuvatsarvago bhavet |
prāpte bhādrapade māse kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam  || 1,83.40 ||
hutaśeṣaṃ ca viprendrān vṛkṣamūlāśrito divā  |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu deveśaṃ snāpya sampūjya śaṅkaram  || 1,83.41 ||
nīlaskandhaṃ vṛṣaṃ gāṃ ca dattvā bhaktyā yathāvidhi  |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca vedavedāṅgapāragān  || 1,83.42 ||
yakṣalokamanuprāpya yakṣarājo bhavennaraḥ  |
tataścāśvayuje māsi kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam  || 1,83.43 ||
saghṛtaṃ śaṅkaraṃ pūjya paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvavat |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śivabhaktān sadā śucīn  || 1,83.44 ||
vṛṣabhaṃ nīlavarṇābhamurodeśasamunnatam  |
gāṃ ca dattvā yathānyāyamaiśānaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 1,83.45 ||
kārtike ca tathā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam  |
kṣīraudanena sājyena sampūjya ca bhavaṃ prabhum  || 1,83.46 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca vidhivatsnāpya dattvā caruṃ punaḥ  |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca yathāvibhavavistaram  || 1,83.47 ||
dattvā gomithunaṃ caiva kāpilaṃ pūrvavaddvijāḥ  |
sūryasāyujyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,83.48 ||
mārgaśīrṣe ca māse'pi kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam  |
yavānnena yathānyāyamājyakṣīrādibhiḥ samam  || 1,83.49 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ kṛtvā śarvāya śaṃbhave  |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca daridrānvedapāragān  || 1,83.50 ||
dattvā gomithunaṃ caiva pāṇḍuraṃ vidhipūrvakam  |
somalokamanuprāpya somena saha modate  || 1,83.51 ||
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṣamā dayā  |
triḥsnānaṃ cāgnihotraṃ ca bhūśayyā naktabhojanam  || 1,83.52 ||
pakṣayorupavāsaṃ ca caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca  || 1,83.53 ||
ityetadakhilaṃ proktaṃ pratimāsaṃ śivavratam  || 1,83.54 ||
kuryādvarṣaṃ krameṇaiva vyutkrameṇāpi vā dvijāḥ  |
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ jñānayogamavāpnuyāt || 1,83.55 ||
iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivavratakathanaṃ nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 84

sūta uvāca
umāmaheśvaraṃ vakṣye vratamīśvarabhāṣitam  |
naranāryādijantūnāṃ hitāya munisattamāḥ  || 1,84.1 ||
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca  |
naktamabdaṃ prakurvīta haviṣyaṃ pūjayedbhavam  || 1,84.2 ||
umāmaheśapratimāṃ hemnā kṛtvā suśobhanām  |
rājatīṃ vātha varṣānte pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi  || 1,84.3 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca dattvā śaktyā ca dakṣiṇām  |
rathādyairvāpi deveśaṃ nītvā rudrālayaṃ prati  || 1,84.4 ||
sarvātiśayasaṃyuktaiśchatracāmarabhūṣaṇaiḥ  |
nivedayedvrataṃ caiva śivāya parameṣṭhine  || 1,84.5 ||
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nārī devyā yadi prabho  |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī  || 1,84.6 ||
varṣamekaṃ na bhuñjati kanyā vā vidhavāpi vā  |
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ  || 1,84.7 ||
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ dattvā rudrālaye punaḥ  |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca bhavānyā saha modate  || 1,84.8 ||
yā nāryevaṃ caredabdaṃ kṛṣṇāmekāṃ caturdaśīm  |
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā yena kenāpi vā dvijāḥ  || 1,84.9 ||
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyā saha modate  |
amāvāsyāṃ nirāhārā bhavedabdaṃ suyantritā  || 1,84.10 ||
śūlaṃ ca vidhinā kṛtvā varṣānte vinivedayet |
snāpyeśānaṃ yajedbhaktyā sahasraiḥ kamalaiḥ sitaiḥ  || 1,84.11 ||
rājataṃ kamalaṃ caiva jāṃbūnadasukarṇikam  |
dattvā bhavāya viprebhyaḥ pradadyāddakṣiṇāmapi  || 1,84.12 ||
kāmato'pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyādikaṃ ca yat |
tatsarvaṃ śūladānena bhindyānnārī na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,84.13 ||
sāyujyaṃ caivamāpnoti bhavānyā dvijasattamāḥ  |
kuryādyadvā naraḥ so'pi rudrasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 1,84.14 ||
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ varṣamekamatandritā  |
upavāsaratā nārī naro'pi dvijasattamāḥ  || 1,84.15 ||
niyogādeva tatkāryaṃ bhartṝṇāṃ dvijasattamāḥ  |
japaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ sarvamasvatantrā yataḥ striyaḥ  || 1,84.16 ||
varṣānte sarvagandhāḍhyāṃ pratimāṃ saṃnivedayet |
sā bhavānyāśca sāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ cāpi suvratā  || 1,84.17 ||
labhate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham  |
kārtikyāṃ vā tu yā nārī ekabhaktena vartate  || 1,84.18 ||
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyuktā brahmacāriṇī  |
dadyātkṛṣṇatilānāṃ ca bhāramekamatandritā  || 1,84.19 ||
saghṛtaṃ saguḍaṃ caiva odanaṃ parameṣṭhine  |
dattvā ca brāhmaṇebhyaśca yathā vibhavavistaram  || 1,84.20 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmupavāsaratā ca sā  |
bhavānyā modate sārdhaṃ sārūpyaṃ prāpya suvratā  || 1,84.21 ||
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ  |
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo rudrapūjanam  || 1,84.22 ||
samāsādvaḥ pravakṣyāmi pratimāsamanukramāt |
mārgaśīrṣakamāsādi kārttikāntaṃ yathākramam  || 1,84.23 ||
vrataṃ suvipulaṃ puṇyaṃ nandinā paribhāṣitam  |
mārgaśīrṣakamāse'tha vṛṣaṃ pūrṇāṅgamuttamam  || 1,84.24 ||
alaṃkṛtya yathānyāyaṃ śivāya vinivedayet |
sā ca sārdhaṃ bhavānyā vai modate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,84.25 ||
puṣyamāse tu vai śūlaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nivedayet |
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyā saha modate  || 1,84.26 ||
māghamāse rathaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam  |
dadyātsampūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścaiva bhojayet || 1,84.27 ||
sā ca devyā mahābhāgā modate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
phālgune pratimāṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyena yathāvidhi  || 1,84.28 ||
rājatenāpi tāmreṇa yathāvibhavavistaram  |
pratiṣṭhāpya samabhyarcya sthāpayecchaṅkarālaye  || 1,84.29 ||
sā ca sārdhaṃ mahādevyā modate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
caitre bhavaṃ kumāraṃ ca bhavānīṃ ca yathāvidhi  || 1,84.30 ||
tāmrādyairvidhivatkṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi  |
bhavānyā modate sārdhaṃ dattvā rudrāya śaṃbhave  || 1,84.31 ||
kṛtvālayaṃ hi kauberaṃ rājataṃ rajatena vai  |
īśvaromāsamāyuktaṃ gaṇeśaiśca samantataḥ  || 1,84.32 ||
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi  |
sthāpayetparameśasya bhavasyāyatane śubhe  || 1,84.33 ||
vaiśākhe vai caredevaṃ kailāsākhyaṃ vratottamam  |
kailāsaparvataṃ prāpya bhavānyā saha modate  || 1,84.34 ||
jyeṣṭhe māsi mahādevaṃ liṅgamūrtimumāpatim  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭenaiva brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā  || 1,84.35 ||
madhye bhavena saṃyuktaṃ liṅgamūrti dvijottamāḥ  |
haṃsena ca varāheṇa kṛtvā tāmrādibhiḥ śubhām  || 1,84.36 ||
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ  |
śivāya śivamāsādya śivasthāne yathāvidhi  || 1,84.37 ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitāṃ sthāpya devyāḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt |
āṣāḍhe ca śubhe māse gṛhaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam  || 1,84.38 ||
pakveṣṭakābhirvidhivadyathāvibhavavistaram  |
sarvabījarasaiścāpi sampūrṇaṃ sarvaśobhanaiḥ  || 1,84.39 ||
gṛhopakaraṇaiścaiva musalolūkhalādibhiḥ  |
dāsīdāsādibhiścaiva śayanairaśanādibhiḥ  || 1,84.40 ||
sampūrṇaiśca gṛhaṃ vastrairācchādya ca samantataḥ  |
devaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ snāpya mahādevamumāpatim  || 1,84.41 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayitvā yathāvidhi  |
vidyāvinayasampannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam  || 1,84.42 ||
prathamāśramiṇaṃ bhaktyā sampūjya ca yathāvidhi  |
kanyāṃ sumadhyamāṃ yāvatkālajīvanasaṃyutām  || 1,84.43 ||
kṣetraṃ gomithunaṃ caiva tadgṛhe ca nivedayet |
sāyanairvividhairdivyairmeruparvatasannibhaiḥ  || 1,84.44 ||
golokaṃ samanuprāpya bhavānyā saha modate  |
bhavānyā sadṛśībhūtvā sarvakalpeṣu sāvyayā  || 1,84.45 ||
bhavānyāścaiva sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
sarvadhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam  || 1,84.46 ||
nivedayīta śarvāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam  |
vitānadhvajavastrādyairdhātubhiśca nivedayet || 1,84.47 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca pūrvoktamakhilaṃ bhavet |
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi śobhanaṃ śāliparvatam  || 1,84.48 ||
vitānadhvajavastrādyairdhātubhiśca nivedayet |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca dāpayecca yathāvidhi  || 1,84.49 ||
sā ca sūryāṃśusaṃkāśā bhavānyā saha modate  |
kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam  || 1,84.50 ||
suvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ dattvā sampūjya śaṅkaram  |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca pūrvoktamakhilaṃ bhavet || 1,84.51 ||
sarvadhānyasamāyuktaṃ sarvabījarasādibhiḥ  |
sarvadhātusamāyuktaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam  || 1,84.52 ||
śṛṅgaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vitānacchatraśobhitam  |
gandhamālyaistathā dhūpaiścitraiścāpi suśobhitam  || 1,84.53 ||
vicitrairnṛtyageyaiśca śaṅkhavīṇādibhistathā  |
brahmaghoṣairmahāpuṇyaṃ maṅgalaiśca viśeṣataḥ  || 1,84.54 ||
mahādhvajāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalam  |
nagendraṃ merunāmānaṃ trailokyādhāramuttamam  || 1,84.55 ||
tasya mūrdhni śivaṃ kuryānmadhyato dhātunaiva tu  |
dakṣiṇe ca yathānyāyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca caturmukham  || 1,84.56 ||
uttare devadeveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam  |
indrādilokapālāṃśca kṛtvā bhaktyā yathāvidhi  || 1,84.57 ||
pratiṣṭhāpya tataḥ snāpya samabhyarcya maheśvaram  |
devasya dakṣiṇe haste śūlaṃ tridaśapūjitam  || 1,84.58 ||
vāme pāśaṃ bhavānyāśca kamalaṃ hemabhūṣitam  |
viṣṇośca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca gadāmabjaṃ prayatnataḥ  || 1,84.59 ||
brahmaṇaścākṣasūtraṃ ca kamaṇḍalumanuttamam  |
indrasya vajramagneśca śaktyākhyaṃ paramāyudham  || 1,84.60 ||
yamasya daṇḍaṃ nirṛteḥ khaḍgaṃ niśicarasya tu  |
varuṇasya mahāpāśaṃ nāgākhyaṃ rudramadbhutam  || 1,84.61 ||
vāyoryaṣṭiṃ kuberasya gadāṃ lokaprapūjitām  |
ṭaṅkaṃ ceśānadevasya nivedyaivaṃ krameṇa ca  || 1,84.62 ||
śivasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā carusamanvitām  |
pūjayetsarvadevāṃśca yathāvibhavavistaram  || 1,84.63 ||
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ  |
mahāmeruvrataṃ kṛtvā mahādevāya dāpayet || 1,84.64 ||
mahāmerumanuprāpya mahādevyā pramodate  |
ciraṃ sāyujyamāpnoti mahādevyā na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,84.65 ||
kārtikyāmapi yā nārī kṛtvā devīmumāṃ śubhām  |
sarvābharaṇasampūrṇāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām  || 1,84.66 ||
hematāmrādibhiścaiva pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānataḥ  |
devaṃ ca kṛtvā deveśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam  || 1,84.67 ||
tayoragre hutāśaṃ ca sruvahastaṃ pitāmaham  |
nārāyaṇaṃ ca dātāraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam  || 1,84.68 ||
lokapālaistathā siddhaiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ sthāpya yatnataḥ  |
rudrālaye vrataṃ tasmai dāpayedbhaktipūrvakam  || 1,84.69 ||
sā bhavānyāstanuṃ gatvā bhavena saha modate  |
ekabhaktavrataṃ puṇyaṃ pratimāsamanukramāt || 1,84.70 ||
mārgaśīrṣakamāsādi kārtikāntaṃ pravartitam  |
naranāryādijantūnāṃ hitāya munisattamāḥ  || 1,84.71 ||
naraḥ kṛtvā vrataṃ caiva śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
nārī devyā na saṃdehaḥ śivena paribhāṣitam  || 1,84.72 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge umāmaheśvaravrataṃ nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 85

sūta uvāca
sarvavrateṣu sampūjya devadevamumāpatim  |
japetpañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vidhinaiva dvijottamāḥ  || 1,85.1 ||
japādeva na saṃdeho vratānāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ  |
samāptirnānyathā tasmājjapetpañcākṣarīṃ śubhām  || 1,85.2 ||

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ pañcākṣarī vidyā prabhāvo vā kathaṃ vada  |
kramopāyaṃ mahābhāga śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 1,85.3 ||

sūta uvāca
purā devena rudreṇa devadevena śaṃbhunā  |
pārvatyāḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ  || 1,85.4 ||

śrīdevyuvāca
bhagavandevadeveśa sarvalokamaheśvara  |
pañcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ  || 1,85.5 ||

śrībhagavānuvāca
<pralaya andsṛṣṭi>
pañcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi  |
na śakyaṃ kathituṃ devi tasmātsaṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu  || 1,85.6 ||
pralaye samanuprāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  |
naṣṭe devāsure caiva naṣṭe coragarākṣase  || 1,85.7 ||
sarvaṃ prakṛtimāpannaṃ tvayā pralayameṣyati  |
eko'haṃ saṃsthito devi na dvitīyo'sti kutracit || 1,85.8 ||
tasminvedāśca śāstrāṇi mantre pañcākṣare sthitāḥ  |
te nāśaṃ naiva samprāptā macchaktyā hyanupālitāḥ  || 1,85.9 ||
ahameko dvidhāpyāsaṃ prakṛtyātmaprabhedataḥ  |
sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ śete devo māyāmayīṃ tanum  || 1,85.10 ||
āsthāya yogaparyaṅka śayane toyamadhyagaḥ  |
tannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 1,85.11 ||
<Brahmā creates10 sons̭ theygetpowerfrom śiva>
sisṛkṣamāṇo lokānvai trīnaśakto'sahāyavān  |
daśa brahmā sasarjādau mānasānamitaujasaḥ  || 1,85.12 ||
teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiprasiddhyarthaṃ māṃ provāca pitāmahaḥ  |
matputrāṇāṃ mahādeva śaktiṃ dehi maheśvara  || 1,85.13 ||
iti tena samādiṣṭaḥ pañcavaktradharo hyaham  |
pañcākṣarānpañcamukhaiḥ proktavān padmayonaye  || 1,85.14 ||
tānpañcavadanairgṛhṇan brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ  |
vācyavācakabhāvena jñātavānparameśvaram  || 1,85.15 ||
vācyaḥ pañcākṣarairdevi śivastrailokyapūjitaḥ  |
vācakaḥ paramo mantrastasya pañcākṣaraḥ sthitaḥ  || 1,85.16 ||
jñātvā prayogaṃ vidhinā ca siddhiṃ labdhvā tathā pañcamukho mahātmā  |
provāca putreṣu jagaddhitāya mantraṃ mahārthaṃ kila pañcavarṇam  || 1,85.17 ||
te labdhvā mantraratnaṃ tu sākṣāllokapitāmahāt |
tamārādhayituṃ devaṃ parātparataraṃ śivam  || 1,85.18 ||
tatastutoṣa bhagavān trimūrtīnāṃ paraḥ śivaḥ  |
dattavānakhilaṃ jñānamaṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam  || 1,85.19 ||
te'pi labdhvā varānviprāstadārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ  |
merostu śikhare ramye muñjavānnāma parvataḥ  || 1,85.20 ||
matpriyaḥ satataṃ śrīmānmadbhūtaiḥ parirakṣitaḥ  |
tasyābhyāśe tapastīvraṃ lokasṛṣṭisamutsukāḥ  || 1,85.21 ||
divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu vāyubhakṣāḥ samācaran  |
tiṣṭhanto'nugrahārthāya devi te ṛṣayaḥ purā  || 1,85.22 ||
teṣāṃ bhaktimahaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ pratyakṣatāmiyām  |
pañcākṣaramṛṣicchando daivataṃ śaktibījavat || 1,85.23 ||
nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ digbandhaṃ viniyogamaśeṣataḥ  |
proktavānahamāryāṇāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 1,85.24 ||
tacchrutvā mantramāhātmyamṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ  |
mantrasya viniyogaṃ ca kṛtvā sarvamanuṣṭhitāḥ  || 1,85.25 ||
tanmāhātmyāttadā lokān sadevāsuramānuṣān  |
varṇānvarṇavibhāgāṃśca sarvadharmāṃśca śobhanān  || 1,85.26 ||
pūrvakalpasamudbhūtāñchrutavanto yathā purā  |
pañcākṣaraprabhāvācca lokā vedā maharṣayaḥ  || 1,85.27 ||
<descriptionof pañcākṣara mantra>
tiṣṭhanti śāśvatā dharmā devāḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat |
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu cāvahitākhilam  || 1,85.28 ||
alpākṣaraṃ mahārthaṃ ca vedasāraṃ vimuktidam  |
ājñāsiddhamasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametacchivātmakam  || 1,85.29 ||
nānāsiddhiyutaṃ divyaṃ lokacittānurañjakam  |
suniścitārthaṃ gaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ me pārameśvaram  || 1,85.30 ||
mantraṃ mukhasukhoccāryamaśeṣārthaprasādhakam  |
tadbījaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ mantramādyaṃ suśobhanam  || 1,85.31 ||
atisūkṣmaṃ mahārthaṃ ca jñeyaṃ tadvaṭabījavat |
vedaḥ sa triguṇātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛtprabhuḥ  || 1,85.32 ||
omityekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ sthitaḥ sarvagataḥ śivaḥ  |
mantre ṣaḍakṣare sūkṣme pañcākṣaratanuḥ śivaḥ  || 1,85.33 ||
vācyavācakabhāvena sthitaḥ sākṣātsvabhāvataḥ  |
vācyaḥ śivaḥ prameyatvānmantrastadvācakaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,85.34 ||
vācyavācakabhāvo'yamanādiḥ saṃsthitastayoḥ  |
vede śivāgame vāpi yatra yatra ṣaḍakṣaraḥ  || 1,85.35 ||
mantraḥ sthitaḥ sadā mukhyo loke pañcākṣaro mataḥ  |
kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ śāstrairvā bahuvistṛtaiḥ  || 1,85.36 ||
yasyaivaṃ hṛdi saṃstho'yaṃ mantraḥ syātpārameśvaraḥ  |
tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam  || 1,85.37 ||
yo vidvānvai japetsamyagadhītyaiva vidhānataḥ  |
etāvaddhi śivajñānametāvatparamaṃ padam  || 1,85.38 ||
etāvadbrahmavidyā ca tasmānnityaṃ japedbudhaḥ  |
pañcākṣaraiḥ sapraṇavo mantro'yaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama  || 1,85.39 ||
guhyādguhyataraṃ sākṣānmokṣajñānamanuttamam  |
asya mantrasya vakṣyāmi ṛṣicchando'dhidaivatam  || 1,85.40 ||
bījaṃ śaktiṃ svaraṃ varṇaṃ sthānaṃ caivākṣaraṃ prati  |
vāmadevo nāma ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtaḥ  || 1,85.41 ||
devatā śiva evāhaṃ mantrasyāsya varānane  |
nakārādīni bījāni pañcabhūtātmakāni ca  || 1,85.42 ||
ātmānaṃ praṇavaṃ viddhi sarvavyāpinamavyayam  |
śaktistvameva deveśi sarvadevanamaskṛte  || 1,85.43 ||
tvadīyaṃ praṇavaṃ kiṃcinmadīyaṃ praṇavaṃ tathā  |
tvadīyaṃ devi mantrāṇāṃ śaktibhūtaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,85.44 ||
akārokāramakārā madīye praṇave sthitāḥ  |
ukāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca akāraṃ ca krameṇa vai  || 1,85.45 ||
tvadīyaṃ praṇavaṃ viddhi trimātraṃ plutamuttamam  |
oṅkārasya svarodātta ṛṣirbrahma sitaṃ vapuḥ  || 1,85.46 ||
chando devī ca gāyatrī paramātmādhidevatā  |
udāttaḥ prathamastadvaccaturthaśca dvitīyakaḥ  || 1,85.47 ||
pañcamaḥ svaritaścaiva madhyamo niṣadhaḥ smṛtāḥ  |
nakāraḥ pītavarṇaśca sthānaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ smṛtam  || 1,85.48 ||
indro'dhidaivataṃ chando gāyatrī gautama ṛṣiḥ  |
makāraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo'sya sthānaṃ vai dakṣiṇāmukham  || 1,85.49 ||
chando'nuṣṭupṛṣiścātrī rudro daivatamucyate  |
śikāro dhūmravarṇo'sya sthānaṃ vai paścimaṃ mukham  || 1,85.50 ||
viśvāmitra ṛṣistriṣṭupchando viṣṇustu daivatam  |
vākāro hemavarṇo'sya sthānaṃ caivottaraṃ mukham  || 1,85.51 ||
brahmādhidaivataṃ chando bṛhatī cāṅgirā ṛṣiḥ  |
yakāro raktavarṇaśca sthānamūrdhvaṃ mukhaṃ virāṭ || 1,85.52 ||
chanda ṛṣirbharadvājaḥ skando daivatamucyate  |
nyāsamasya pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubham  || 1,85.53 ||
<nyāsa (def., description)>
sarvapāpaharaṃ caiva trividho nyāsa ucyate  |
utpattisthitisaṃhāra bhedatastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,85.54 ||
brahmacārigṛhasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ kramaśo bhavet |
utpattirbrahmacāriṇāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ sthitiḥ sadā  || 1,85.55 ||
yatīnāṃ saṃhṛtirnyāsaḥ siddhirbhavati nānyathā  |
aṅganyāsaḥ karanyāso dehanyāsa iti tridhā  || 1,85.56 ||
utpattyāditribhedena vakṣyate te varānane  |
nyasetpūrvaṃ karanyāsaṃ dehanyāsamanantaram  || 1,85.57 ||
aṅganyāsaṃ tataḥ paścādakṣarāṇāṃ vidhikramāt |
mūrdhādipādaparyantamutpattinyāsa ucyate  || 1,85.58 ||
pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ saṃhāro bhavati priye  |
hṛdayāsyagalanyāsaḥ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ  || 1,85.59 ||
brahmacārigṛhasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ caiva śobhane  |
saśiraskaṃ tato dehaṃ sarvamantreṇa saṃspṛśet || 1,85.60 ||
sa dehanyāsa ityuktaḥ sarveṣāṃ sama eva sa  |
dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamārabhya vāmāṅguṣṭhānta eva hi  || 1,85.61 ||
nyasyate yattadutpattirviparītaṃ tu saṃhṛtiḥ  |
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyasyate hastayordvayoḥ  || 1,85.62 ||
atīva bhogado devi sthitinyāsaḥ kuṭuṃbinām  |
karanyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā dehanyāsamanantaram  || 1,85.63 ||
aṅganyāsaṃ nyasetpaścādeṣa sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ  |
oṅkāraṃ saṃpuṭīkṛtya sarvāṅgeṣu ca vinyaset || 1,85.64 ||
karayorubhayoścaiva daśāgrāṃguliṣu kramāt |
prakṣālya pādāvācamya śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ  || 1,85.65 ||
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi nyāsakarma samācaret |
smaretpūrvamṛṣiṃ chando daivataṃ bījameva ca  || 1,85.66 ||
śaktiṃ ca paramātmānaṃ guruṃ caiva varānane  |
mantreṇa pāṇī saṃmṛjya talayoḥ praṇavaṃ nyaset || 1,85.67 ||
aṅgulīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tathā cādyantaparvasu  |
sabindukāni bījāni pañca madhyamaparvasu  || 1,85.68 ||
utpattyāditribhedena nyasedāśramataḥ kramāt |
ubhābhyāmeva pāṇibhyāmāpādatalamastakam  || 1,85.69 ||
mantreṇa saṃspṛśeddehaṃ praṇavenaiva saṃpuṭam  |
mūrdhni vaktre ca kaṇṭhe ca hṛdaye guhyake tathā  || 1,85.70 ||
pādayorubhayoścaiva guhye ca hṛdaye tathā  |
kaṇṭhe ca mukhamadhye ca mūrdhni ca praṇavādikam  || 1,85.71 ||
hṛdaye guhyake caiva pādayormūrdhni vāci vā  |
kaṇṭhe caiva nyasedeva praṇavāditribhedataḥ  || 1,85.72 ||
kṛtvāṅganyāsamevaṃ hi mukhāni parikalpayet |
pūrvādi cordhvaparyantaṃ nakārādi yathākramam  || 1,85.73 ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasetpaścādyathāsthānaṃ ca śobhanam  |
namaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍḍhuṃ ca vauṣaṭphaṭkārakaiḥ saha  || 1,85.74 ||
praṇavaṃ hṛdayaṃ vidyānnakāraḥ śira ucyate  |
śikhā makāra ākhyātaḥ śikāraḥ kavacaṃ tathā  || 1,85.75 ||
ākāro netramastraṃ tu yakāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ  |
itthamaṅgāni vinyasya tato vai bandhayeddiśaḥ  || 1,85.76 ||
vighneśo mātaro durgā kṣetrajño devatā diśaḥ  |
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu caturṣvapi yathākramam  || 1,85.77 ||
aṅguṣṭhatarjanyagrābhyāṃ saṃsthāpya sumukhaṃ śubham  |
rakṣadhvamiti coktvā tu namaskuryātpṛthakpṛthak || 1,85.78 ||
gale madhye tathāṅguṣṭhe tarjanyādyāṅgulīṣu ca  |
aṅguṣṭhena karanyāsaṃ kuryādeva vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 1,85.79 ||
evaṃ nyāsamimaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham  |
sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ śivam  || 1,85.80 ||
nyaste mantre'tha subhage śaṅkarapratimo bhavet |
janmāntarakṛtaṃ pāpamapi naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || 1,85.81 ||
evaṃ vinyasya medhāvī śuddhakāyo dṛḍhavrataḥ  |
japetpañcākṣaraṃ mantraṃ labdhvācāryaprasādataḥ  || 1,85.82 ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrasaṃgrahaṇaṃ śubhe  |
yaṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ nityaṃ yena vā saphalaṃ bhavet || 1,85.83 ||
ājñāhīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ śraddhāhīnamamānasam  |
ājñaptaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ sadā japtaṃ ca niṣphalam  || 1,85.84 ||
ājñāsiddhaṃ kriyāsiddhaṃ śraddhāsiddhaṃ sumānasam  |
evaṃ ca dakṣiṇāsiddhaṃ mantraṃ siddhaṃ yatastataḥ  || 1,85.85 ||
<guru|śiṣya>
upāgamya guruṃ vipraṃ mantratattvārthavedinam  |
jñāninaṃ sadguṇopetaṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇam  || 1,85.86 ||
toṣayettaṃ prayatnena bhāvaśuddhisamanvitaḥ  |
vācā ca manasā caiva kāyena draviṇena ca  || 1,85.87 ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayecchiṣyaḥ sarvadātiprayatnataḥ  |
hastyaśvaratharatnāni kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca  || 1,85.88 ||
bhūṣaṇāni ca vāsāṃsi dhānyāni vividhāni ca  |
etāni gurave dadyādbhaktyā ca vibhave sati  || 1,85.89 ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ  |
paścānnivedayeddevi ātmānaṃ saparicchadam  || 1,85.90 ||
evaṃ sampūjya vidhivadyathāśakti tvavañcayan  |
ādadīta gurormantraṃ jñānaṃ caiva krameṇa tu  || 1,85.91 ||
evaṃ tuṣṭo guruḥ śiṣyaṃ pūjitaṃ vatsaroṣitam  |
śuśrūṣumanahaṅkāramupavāsakṛśaṃ śucim  || 1,85.92 ||
snāpayitvā tu śiṣyāya brāhmaṇānapi pūjya ca  |
samudratīre nadyāṃ ca goṣṭhe devālaye'pi vā  || 1,85.93 ||
śucau deśe gṛhe vāpi kāle siddhikare tithau  |
nakṣatre śubhayoge ca sarvadā doṣavarjite  || 1,85.94 ||
anugṛhya tato dadyācchivajñānamanuttamam  |
svareṇoccārayetsamyagekānte'pi prasannadhīḥ  || 1,85.95 ||
uccāryoccārayitvā tu ācāryaḥ siddhidaḥ svayam  |
śivaṃ cāstu śubhaṃ cāstu śobhano'stu priyo'stviti  || 1,85.96 ||
evaṃ labdhvā paraṃ mantraṃ jñānaṃ caiva gurostataḥ  |
japennityaṃ sasaṃkalpaṃ puraścaraṇameva ca  || 1,85.97 ||
yāvajjīvaṃ japennityamaṣṭottarasahasrakam  |
anaśnaṃstatparo bhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,85.98 ||
japedakṣaralakṣaṃ vai caturguṇitamādarāt |
naktāśī saṃyamī yaśca pauraścaraṇikaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,85.99 ||
puraścaraṇajāpī vā api vā nityajāpakaḥ  |
acirātsiddhikāṅkṣī tu tayoranyataro bhavet || 1,85.100 ||
<japa>
yaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nityajāpī bhavennaraḥ  |
tasya nāsti samo loke sa siddhaḥ siddhido vaśī  || 1,85.101 ||
āsanaṃ ruciraṃ baddhvā maunī caikāgramānasaḥ  |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi japenmantramanuttamam  || 1,85.102 ||
ādyāntayorjapasyāpi kuryādvai prāṇasaṃyamān  |
tathā cānte japedbījaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ śubham  || 1,85.103 ||
catvāriṃśatsamāvṛtti prāṇānāyamya saṃsmaret |
pañcākṣarasya mantrasya prāṇāyāma udāhṛtaḥ  || 1,85.104 ||
prāṇāyāmādbhavetkṣipraṃ sarvapāpaparikṣayaḥ  |
indriyāṇāṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tasmātprāṇāṃśca saṃyamet || 1,85.105 ||
gṛhe japaḥ samaṃ vidyādgoṣṭhe śataguṇaṃ bhavet |
nadyāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu anantaḥ śivasannidhau  || 1,85.106 ||
samudratīre devahrade girau devālayeṣu ca  |
puṇyāśrameṣu sarveṣu japaḥ koṭiguṇo bhavet || 1,85.107 ||
śivasya saṃnidhāne ca sūryasyāgre gurorapi  |
dīpasya gorjalasyāpi japakarma praśasyate  || 1,85.108 ||
aṅgulījapasaṃkhyānamekamekaṃ śubhānane  |
rekhairaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ putrajīvaphalairdaśa  || 1,85.109 ||
śataṃ vai śaṅkhamaṇibhiḥ pravālaiśca sahasrakam  |
sphāṭikairdaśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate  || 1,85.110 ||
padmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyate  |
kuśagranthyā ca rudrākṣairanantaguṇamucyate  || 1,85.111 ||
pañcaviṃśati mokṣārthaṃ saptaviṃśati pauṣṭikam  |
triṃśacca dhanasaṃpattyai pañcāśaccābhicārikam  || 1,85.112 ||
tatpūrvābhimukhaṃ vaśyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cābhicārikam  |
paścimaṃ dhanadaṃ vidyāduttaraṃ śāntikaṃ bhavet || 1,85.113 ||
aṅguṣṭhaṃ mokṣadaṃ vidyāttarjanī śatrunāśanī  |
madhyamā dhanadā śāntiṃ karotyeṣā hyanāmikā  || 1,85.114 ||
kaniṣṭhā rakṣaṇīyā sā japakarmaṇi śobhane  |
aṅguṣṭhena japejjapyamanyairaṅgulibhiḥ saha  || 1,85.115 ||
aṅguṣṭhena vinā karma kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ yataḥ  |
<japayajña>
śṛṇuṣva sarvayajñebhyo japayajño viśiṣyate  || 1,85.116 ||
hiṃsayā te pravartante japayajño na hiṃsayā  |
yāvantaḥ karmayajñāḥ syuḥ pradānāni tapāṃsi ca  || 1,85.117 ||
sarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm  |
māhātmyaṃ vācikasyaiva japayajñasya kīrtitam  || 1,85.118 ||
tasmācchataguṇopāṃśuḥ sahasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
yaduccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ  || 1,85.119 ||
mantramuccārayedvācā japayajñaḥ sa vācikaḥ  |
śanairuccārayenmantramīṣadoṣṭhau tu cālayet || 1,85.120 ||
kiṃcitkarṇāntaraṃ vidyādupāṃśuḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
<mānasajapa>
dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇyā varṇādvarṇaṃ padātpadam  || 1,85.121 ||
śabdārthaṃ cintayedbhūyaḥ sa tūkto mānaso japaḥ  |
trayāṇāṃ japayajñānāṃ śreyān syāduttarottaraḥ  || 1,85.122 ||
bhavedyajñaviśeṣeṇa vaiśiṣṭyaṃ tatphalasya ca  |
japena devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdati  || 1,85.123 ||
prasannā vipulān bhogān dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāśvatīm  |
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca grahāḥ sarve ca bhīṣaṇāḥ  |
jāpinaṃ nopasarpanti bhayabhītāḥ samantataḥ  || 1,85.124 ||
japena pāpaṃ śamayedaśeṣaṃ yattatkṛtaṃ janmaparaṃparāsu  |*
japena bhogān jayate ca mṛtyuṃ japena siddhiṃ labhate ca muktim  || 1,85.125 ||*
evaṃ labdhvā śivaṃ jñānaṃ jñātvā japavidhikramam  || 1,85.126 ||
sadācārī japannityaṃ dhyāyan bhadraṃ samaśnute  |
<sadācāra>
sadācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi samyagdharmasya sādhanam  || 1,85.127 ||
yasmādācārahīnasya sādhanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet |
ācāraḥ paramo dharma ācāraḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ  || 1,85.128 ||
ācāraḥ paramā vidyā ācāraḥ paramā gatiḥ  |
sadācāravatāṃ puṃsāṃ sarvatrāpyabhayaṃ bhavet || 1,85.129 ||
tadvadācārahīnānāṃ sarvatraiva bhayaṃ bhavet |
sadācāreṇa devatvamṛṣitvaṃ ca varānane  || 1,85.130 ||
upayānti kuyonitvaṃ tadvadācāralaṅghanāt |
ācārahīnaḥ puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ  || 1,85.131 ||
tasmātsaṃsiddhimanvicchan samyagācāravān bhavet |
durvṛttaḥ śuddhibhūyiṣṭhaḥ pāpīyān jñānadūṣakaḥ  || 1,85.132 ||
varṇāśramavidhānoktaṃ dharmaṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ  || 1,85.133 ||
yasya yadvihitaṃ karma tatkurvanmatpriyaḥ sadā  |
<sandhyā>
saṃdhyopāsanaśīlaḥ syātsāyaṃ prātaḥ prasannadhīḥ  || 1,85.134 ||
udayāstamayātpūrvamāramya vidhinā śuciḥ  |
kāmānmohādbhayāllobhātsaṃdhyāṃ nātikrameddvijaḥ  || 1,85.135 ||
saṃdhyātikramaṇādvipro brāhmaṇyātpatate yataḥ  |
asatyaṃ na vadetkiṃcinna satyaṃ ca parityajet || 1,85.136 ||
yatsatyaṃ brahma ityāhurasatyaṃ brahmadūṣaṇam  |
anṛtaṃ paruṣaṃ śāṭhyaṃ paiśunyaṃ pāpahetukam  || 1,85.137 ||
paradārānparadravyaṃ parahiṃsāṃ ca sarvadā  |
kvaciccāpi na kurvīta vācā ca manasā tathā  || 1,85.138 ||
<rulesforfoodanda meal>
śūdrānnaṃ yātayāmānnaṃ naivedyaṃ śrāddhameva ca  |
gaṇānnaṃ samudāyānnaṃ rājānnaṃ ca vivarjayet || 1,85.139 ||
annaśuddhau sattvaśuddhirna mṛdā na jalena vai  |
sattvaśuddhau bhavetsiddhistato'nnaṃ pariśodhayet || 1,85.140 ||
rājapratigrahairdagdhān brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ  |
svinnānāmapi bījānāṃ punarjanma na vidyate  || 1,85.141 ||
rājapratigraho ghoro buddhvā cādau viṣopamaḥ  |
budhena parihartavyaḥ śvamāṃsaṃ cāpi varjayet || 1,85.142 ||
asnātvā na ca bhuñjīyādajapo'gnimapūjya ca  |
parṇapṛṣṭhe na bhuñjīyādrātrau dīpaṃ vinā tathā  || 1,85.143 ||
bhinnabhāṇḍe ca rathyāyāṃ patitānāṃ ca saṃnidhau  |
śūdraśeṣaṃ na bhuñjīyātsahānnaṃ śiśukairapi  || 1,85.144 ||
śuddhānnaṃ snigdhamaśnīyātsaṃskṛtaṃ cābhimantritam  |
bhoktā śiva iti smṛtvā maunī caikāgramānasaḥ  || 1,85.145 ||
āsyena na pibettoyaṃ tiṣṭhannañjalināpi vā  |
vāmahastena śayyāyāṃ tathaivānyaṃkareṇa vā  || 1,85.146 ||
vibhītakārkakārañja snuhicchāyāṃ na cāśrayet |
staṃbhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā  || 1,85.147 ||
eko na gacchedadhvānaṃ bāhubhyāṃ nottarennadīm  |
nāvaroheta kūpādiṃ nāroheduccapādapān  || 1,85.148 ||
sūryāgnijaladevānāṃ gurūṇāṃ vimukhaḥ śubhe  |
na kuryādiha kāryāṇi japakarma śubhāni vā  || 1,85.149 ||
agnau na tāpayetpādau hastaṃ padbhyāṃ na saṃspṛśet |
agnernocchrayamāsīta nāgnau kiṃcinmalaṃ tyajet || 1,85.150 ||
na jalaṃ tāḍayetpadbhyāṃ nāṃbhasyaṅgamalaṃ tyajet |
malaṃ prakṣālayettīre prakṣālya snānamācaret || 1,85.151 ||
nakhāgrakeśanirdhūta snānavastraghaṭodakam  |
aśrīkaraṃ manuṣyāṇāmaśuddhaṃ saṃspṛśedyadi  || 1,85.152 ||
<no pets!>
ajāśvānakhuroṣṭrāṇāṃ mārjanāttuṣareṇukān  |
saṃspṛśedyadi mūḍhātmā śriyaṃ hanti harerapi  || 1,85.153 ||
mārjāraśca gṛhe yasya so'pyantyajasamo naraḥ  |
bhojayedyastu viprendrānmārjārasaṃnidhau yadi  || 1,85.154 ||
taccāṇḍālasamaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
sphigvātaṃ śūrpavātaṃ ca vātaṃ prāṇamukhānilam  || 1,85.155 ||
sukṛtāni harantyete saṃspṛṣṭāḥ puruṣasya tu  |
uṣṇīṣī kañcukī nagno muktakeśo malāvṛtaḥ  || 1,85.156 ||
apavitrakaro'śuddhaḥ pralapanna japetkvacit |
krodho madaḥ kṣudhā tandrā niṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇe  || 1,85.157 ||
śvanīcadarśanaṃ nidrā pralāpāste japadviṣaḥ  |
eteṣāṃ saṃbhave vāpi kuryātsūryādidarśanam  || 1,85.158 ||
ācamya vā japeccheṣaṃ kṛtvā vā prāṇasaṃyamam  |
sūryo'gniścandramāścaiva grahanakṣatratārakāḥ  || 1,85.159 ||
ete jyotīṃṣi proktāni vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇaistathā  |
prasārya pādau na japetkukkuṭāsana eva ca  || 1,85.160 ||
<performingāsana>
anāsanaḥ śayāno vā rathyāyāṃ śūdrasannidhau  |
raktabhūmyāṃ ca khaṭvāyāṃ na japejjāpakastathā  || 1,85.161 ||
āsanastho japetsamyakmantrārthagatamānasaḥ  |
kauśeyaṃ vyāghracarmaṃ vā cailaṃ taulamathāpi vā  || 1,85.162 ||
dāravaṃ tālaparṇaṃ vā āsanaṃ parikalpayet |
trisaṃdhyaṃ tu guroḥ pūjā kartavyā hitamicchatā  || 1,85.163 ||
yo guruḥ sa śivaḥ prokto yaḥ śivaḥ sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ  |
yathā śivastathā vidyā yathā vidyā tathā guruḥ  || 1,85.164 ||
śivavidyāgurostasmādbhaktyā ca sadṛśaṃ phalam  |
sarvadevamayo devi sarvaśaktimayo hi saḥ  || 1,85.165 ||
saguṇo nirguṇo vāpi tasyājñāṃ śirasā vahet |
śreyo'rthī yastu gurvājñāṃ manasāpi na laṅghayet || 1,85.166 ||
gurvājñāpālakaḥ samyakjñānasaṃpattimaśnute  |
gacchaṃstiṣṭhansvapan bhuñjan yadyatkarma samācaret || 1,85.167 ||
samakṣaṃ yadi tatsarvaṃ kartavyaṃ gurvanujñayā  |
gurordevasamakṣaṃ vā na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet || 1,85.168 ||
gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāttadgṛhaṃ devamandiram  |
pāpinā ca yathāsaṃgāttatpāpaiḥ patanaṃ bhavet || 1,85.169 ||
tadvadācāryasaṃgena taddharmaphalabhāgbhavet |
yathaiva vahnisaṃparkānmalaṃ tyajati kāñcanam  || 1,85.170 ||
tathaiva gurusaṃparkātpāpaṃ tyajati mānavaḥ  |
yathā vahnisamīpastho ghṛtakuṃbho vilīyate  || 1,85.171 ||
tathā pāpaṃ vilīyeta ācāryasya samīpataḥ  |
yathā prajvalito vahnirviṣṭhāṃ kāṣṭhaṃ ca nirdahet || 1,85.172 ||
gurustuṣṭo dahatyevaṃ pāpaṃ tanmantratejasā  |
brahmā haristathā rudro devāśca munayastathā  || 1,85.173 ||
kurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ  |
karmaṇā manasā vācā guroḥ krodhaṃ na kārayet || 1,85.174 ||
tasya krodhena dahyante āyuḥśrījñānasatkriyāḥ  |
tatkrodhaṃ ye kariṣyanti teṣāṃ yajñāśca niṣphalāḥ  || 1,85.175 ||
japānyaniyamāścaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
gurorviruddhaṃ yadvākyaṃ na vadetsarvayatnataḥ  || 1,85.176 ||
vadedyadi mahāmohādrauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
cittenaiva ca vittena tathā vācā ca suvratāḥ  || 1,85.177 ||
mithyā na kārayeddevi kriyayā ca guroḥ sadā  |
durguṇe khyāpite tasya nairguṇyaśatabhāgbhavet || 1,85.178 ||
guṇe tu khyāpite tasya sārvaguṇyaphalaṃ bhavet |
gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryādādiṣṭo vā na vā sadā  || 1,85.179 ||
asamakṣaṃ samakṣaṃ vā guroḥ kāryaṃ samācaret |
gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryānmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ  || 1,85.180 ||
kurvanpatatyadho gatvā tatraiva parivartate  |
tasmātsa sarvadopāsyo vandanīyaśca sarvadā  || 1,85.181 ||
samīpastho'pyanujñāpya vadettadvimukho gurum  |
evamācāravān bhakto nityaṃ japaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,85.182 ||
gurupriyakaro mantraṃ viniyoktuṃ tato'rhati  |
viniyogaṃ pravakṣyāmi siddhamantraprayojanam  || 1,85.183 ||
daurbalyaṃ yāti tanmantraṃ viniyogamajānataḥ  |
yasya yena viyuñjīta kāryeṇa tu viśeṣataḥ  || 1,85.184 ||
viniyogaḥ sa vijñeya aihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam  |
viniyogajamāyuṣyamārogyaṃ tanunityatā  || 1,85.185 ||
rājyaiśvaryaṃ ca vijñānaṃ svargo nirvāṇa eva ca  |
prokṣaṇaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca aghamarṣaṇameva ca  || 1,85.186 ||
snāne ca saṃdhyayoścaiva kuryādekādaśena vai  |
śuciḥ parvatamāruhya japellakṣamatandritaḥ  || 1,85.187 ||
mahānadyāṃ dvilakṣaṃ tu dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt |
dūrvāṅkurāstilā vāṇī guḍūcī ghuṭikā tathā  || 1,85.188 ||
teṣāṃ tu daśasāhasraṃ homamāyuṣyavardhanam  |
aśvatthavṛkṣamāśritya japellakṣadvayaṃ sudhīḥ  || 1,85.189 ||
śanaiścaradine spṛṣṭvā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ labhennaraḥ  |
śanaiścaradine'śvatthaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ saṃspṛśetsudhīḥ  || 1,85.190 ||
japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ somamṛtyuharo bhavet |
ādityābhimukho bhūtvā japellakṣamananyadhīḥ  || 1,85.191 ||
arkairaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā juhvanvyādhervimucyate  |
samastavyādhiśāntyarthaṃ palāśasamidhairnaraḥ  || 1,85.192 ||
hutvā daśasahasraṃ tu nirogī manujo bhavet |
nityamaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā pibedambho'rkasannidhau  || 1,85.193 ||
audaryairvyādhibhiḥ sarvairmāsenaikena mucyate  |
ekādaśena bhuñjīyādannaṃ caivābhimantritam  || 1,85.194 ||
bhakṣyaṃ cānyattathā peyaṃ viṣamapyamṛtaṃ bhavet |
japellakṣaṃ tu pūrvāhṇe hutvā cāṣṭaśatena vai  || 1,85.195 ||
sūryaṃ nityamupasthāya samyagārogyamāpnuyāt |
nadītoyena sampūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ saṃspṛśya śobhanam  || 1,85.196 ||
japtvāyutaṃ ca tatsnānādrogāṇāṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavet |
aṣṭāviṃśajjapitvānnamaśnīyādanvahaṃ śuciḥ  || 1,85.197 ||
hutvā ca tāvatpālāśairevaṃ vārogyamaśnute  |
candrasūryagrahe pūrvamupoṣya vidhinā śuciḥ  || 1,85.198 ||
yāvadgrahaṇamokṣaṃ tu tāvannadyāṃ samāhitaḥ  |
japetsamudragāminyāṃ vimokṣe grahaṇasya tu  || 1,85.199 ||
aṣṭottarasahasreṇa pibedbrāhmīrasaṃ dvijāḥ  |
aihikāṃ labhate medhāṃ sarvaśāstradharāṃ śubhām  || 1,85.200 ||
sārasvatī bhaveddevī tasya vāgatimānuṣī  |
grahanakṣatrapīḍāsu japedbhaktyāyutaṃ naraḥ  || 1,85.201 ||
hutvā cāṣṭasahasraṃ tu grahapīḍāṃ vyapohati  |
duḥsvapnadarśane snātvā japedvai cāyutaṃ naraḥ  || 1,85.202 ||
ghṛtenāṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sadyaḥ śāntirbhaviṣyati  |
candrasūryagrahe liṅgaṃ samabhyarcya yathāvidhi  || 1,85.203 ||
yatkiṃcitprārthayeddevi japedayutamādarāt |
saṃnidhāvasya devasya śuciḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ  || 1,85.204 ||
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
gajānāṃ turagāṇāṃ tu gojātīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ  || 1,85.205 ||
vyādhyāgame śucirbhūtvā juhuyātsamidhāhutim  |
māsamabhyarcya vidhināyutaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ  || 1,85.206 ||
teṣāmṛddhiśca śāntiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ  |
utpāte śatrubādhāyāṃ juhuyādayutaṃ śuciḥ  || 1,85.207 ||
pālāśasamidhairdevi tasya śāntirbhaviṣyati  |
ābhicārikabādhāyāmetaddevi samācaret || 1,85.208 ||
pratyagbhavati tacchaktiḥ śatroḥ pīḍā bhaviṣyati  |
vidveṣaṇārthaṃ juhuyādvaibhītasamidhāṣṭakam  || 1,85.209 ||
akṣarapratilomyena ārdreṇa rudhireṇa vā  |
viṣeṇa rudhirābhyakto vidveṣaṇakaraṃ nṛṇām  || 1,85.210 ||
prāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpaviśuddhaye  |
pāpaśuddhiryathā samyakkartumabhyudyato naraḥ  || 1,85.211 ||
pāpaśuddhiryataḥ samyagjñānasaṃpattihaitukī  |
pāpaśuddhirna cetpuṃsaḥ kriyāḥ sarvāścaniṣphalāḥ  || 1,85.212 ||
jñānaṃ ca hīyate tasmātkartavyaṃ pāpaśodhanam  |
vidyālakṣmīviśuddhyarthaṃ māṃ dhyātvāñjalinā śubhe  || 1,85.213 ||
śivenaikādaśenādbhirabhiṣiñcetsamantataḥ  |
aṣṭottaraśatenaiva snāyātpāpaviśuddhaye  || 1,85.214 ||
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tacca sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham  |
saṃdhyopāsanavicchede japedaṣṭaśataṃ naraḥ  || 1,85.215 ||
viḍvarāhaiśca cāṇḍālairdurjanaiḥ kukkuṭairapi  |
spṛṣṭamannaṃ na bhuñjīta bhuktvā cāṣṭaśataṃ japet || 1,85.216 ||
brahmahatyāviśuddhyarthaṃ japellakṣāyutaṃ naraḥ  |
pātakānāṃ tadardhaṃ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,85.217 ||
upapātakaduṣṭānāṃ tadardhaṃ parikīrtitam  |
śeṣāṇāmapi pāpānāṃ japetpañcasahasrakam  || 1,85.218 ||
ātmabodhaparaṃ guhyaṃ śivabodhaprakāśakam  |
śivaḥ syātsa japenmantraṃ pañcalakṣamanākulaḥ  || 1,85.219 ||
pañcavāyujayaṃ bhadre prāpnoti manujaḥ sukham  |
japecca pañcalakṣaṃ tu vigṛhītendriyaḥ śuciḥ  || 1,85.220 ||
pañcendriyāṇāṃ vijayo bhaviṣyati varānane  |
dhyānayukto japedyastu pañcalakṣamanākulaḥ  || 1,85.221 ||
viṣayāṇāṃ ca pañcānāṃ jayaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  |
caturthaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ tu yo japedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ  || 1,85.222 ||
bhūtānāmiha pañcānāṃ vijayaṃ manujo labhet |
caturlakṣaṃ japedyastu manaḥ saṃyamya yatnataḥ  || 1,85.223 ||
samyagvijayamāpnoti karaṇānāṃ varānane  |
pañcaviṃśatilakṣāṇāṃ japena kamalānane  || 1,85.224 ||
pañcaviṃśatitattvānāṃ vijayaṃ manujo labhet |
madhyarātre'tinirvāte japedayutamādarāt || 1,85.225 ||
brahmasiddhimavāpnoti vratenānena suṃdari  |
japellakṣamanālasyo nirvāte dhvanivarjite  || 1,85.226 ||
madhyarātre ca śivayoḥ paśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ  |
andhakāravināśaśca dīpasyeva prakāśanam  || 1,85.227 ||
hṛdayāntarbahirvāpi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ  |
sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhyarthaṃ japedayutamātmavān  || 1,85.228 ||
sabījasaṃpuṭaṃ mantraṃ śatalakṣaṃ japecchuciḥ  |
matsāyujyamavāpnoti bhaktimān kimataḥ param  || 1,85.229 ||
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ pañcākṣaravidhikramam  |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,85.230 ||
śrāvayecca dvijāñchuddhān pañcākṣaravidhikramam  |
daive karmaṇi pitrye vā śivaloke mahīyate  || 1,85.231 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pañcākṣaramāhātmyaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
