liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 86

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
japācchreṣṭhatamaṃ prāhurbrāhmaṇā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ  |
viraktānāṃ prabuddhānāṃ dhyānayajñaṃ suśobhanam  || 1,86.1 ||
tasmādvadasva sūtādya dhyānayajñamaśeṣataḥ  |
vistārātsarvayatnena viraktānāṃ mahātmanām  || 1,86.2 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ dīrghasattriṇām  |
rudreṇa kathitaṃ prāha guhāṃ prāpya mahātmanām  || 1,86.3 ||
saṃhṛtya kālakūṭākhyaṃ viṣaṃ vai viśvakarmaṇā  |

sūta uvāca
guhāṃ prāpya sukhāsīnaṃ bhavānyā saha śaṅkaram  || 1,86.4 ||
munayaḥ saṃśitātmānaḥ praṇemustaṃ guhāśrayam  |
astuvaṃśca tataḥ sarve nīlakaṇṭhamumāpatim  || 1,86.5 ||
atyugraṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ bhagavaṃstvayā  |
ataḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā deva vṛṣadhvaja  || 1,86.6 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ  |
prahasanprāha viśvātmā sanandanapurogamān  || 1,86.7 ||
kimanena dvijaśreṣṭhā viṣaṃ vakṣye sudāruṇam  |
saṃharettadviṣaṃ yastu sa samartho hyanena kim  || 1,86.8 ||
<curse of saṃsāra>
na viṣaṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃsāro viṣamucyate  |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃhareta sudāruṇam  || 1,86.9 ||
saṃsāro dvividhaḥ proktaḥ svādhikārānurūpataḥ  |
puṃsāṃ saṃmūḍhacittānāmasaṃkṣīṇaḥ sudāruṇaḥ  || 1,86.10 ||
īṣaṇārāgadoṣeṇa sargo jñānena suvratāḥ  |
tadvaśādeva sarveṣāṃ dharmādharmau na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,86.11 ||
asannikṛṣṭe tvarthe'pi śāstraṃ tacchravaṇātsatām  |
buddhimutpādayatyeva saṃsāre viduṣāṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,86.12 ||
tasmāddṛṣṭānuśravikaṃ duṣṭamityubhayātmakam  |
saṃtyajetsarvayatnena viraktaḥ so'bhidhīyate  || 1,86.13 ||
śāstramityucyate bhāgaṃ śruteḥ karmasu taddvijāḥ  |
mūrdhānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sāramṛṣīṇāṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam  || 1,86.14 ||
nanu svabhāvaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāmo dṛṣṭo na cānyathā  |
śrutiḥ pravartikā teṣāmiti karmaṇyatadvidaḥ  || 1,86.15 ||
nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmaḥ samarthānāmihocyate  |
tasmādajñānamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ sarvadehinām  || 1,86.16 ||
kalā saṃśoṣamāyāti karmaṇānyasvabhāvataḥ  |
sakalastrividho jīvo jñānahīnastvavidyayā  || 1,86.17 ||
nārakī pāpakṛtsvargī puṇyakṛtpuṇyagauravāt |
vyatimiśreṇa vai jīvaścaturdhā saṃvyavasthitaḥ  || 1,86.18 ||
udbhijjaḥ svedajaścaiva aṇḍajo vai jarāyujaḥ  |
evaṃ vyavasthito dehī karmaṇājño hyanirvṛtaḥ  || 1,86.19 ||
prajayā karmaṇā muktirdhanena ca satāṃ na hi  |
tyāgenaikena muktiḥ syāttadabhāvādbhramatyasau  || 1,86.20 ||
<everythingisduḥkha>
evamajñānadoṣeṇa nānākarmavaśena ca  |
ṣaṭkauśikaṃ samudbhūtaṃ bhajatyeṣa kalevaram  || 1,86.21 ||
garbhe duḥkhānyanekāni yonimārge ca bhūtale  |
kaumāre yauvane caiva vārddhake maraṇe'pi vā  || 1,86.22 ||
vicārataḥ satāṃ duḥkhaṃ strīsaṃsargādibhirdvijāḥ  |
duḥkhenaikena vai duḥkhaṃ praśāmyatīha duḥkhinaḥ  || 1,86.23 ||
na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāmyati  |
haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate  || 1,86.24 ||
tasmādvicārato nāsti saṃyogādapi vai nṛṇām  |
arthānāmarjane'pyevaṃ pālane ca vyaye tathā  || 1,86.25 ||
paiśāce rākṣase duḥkhaṃ yākṣe caiva vicārataḥ  |
gāndharve ca tathā cāndre saumyaloke dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.26 ||
prājāpatye tathā brāhme prākṛte pauruṣe tathā  |
kṣayasātiśayādyaistu duḥkhairduḥkhāni suvratāḥ  || 1,86.27 ||
tāni bhāgyānyaśuddhāni saṃtyajecca dhanāni ca  |
tasmādaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhogaṃ tathā ṣoḍaśadhā sthitam  || 1,86.28 ||
caturviṃśatprakāreṇa saṃsthitaṃ cāpi suvratāḥ  |
dvātriṃśadbhedamanaghāścatvāriṃśadguṇaṃ punaḥ  || 1,86.29 ||
tathāṣṭacatvāriṃśacca ṣaṭpañcāśatprakārataḥ  |
catuḥṣaṣṭividhaṃ caiva duḥkhameva vivekinaḥ  || 1,86.30 ||
pārthivaṃ ca tathāpyaṃ ca taijasaṃ ca vicārataḥ  |
vāyavyaṃ ca tathā vyauma[ṃ] mānasaṃ ca yathākramam  || 1,86.31 ||
ābhimānikamapyevaṃ bauddhaṃ prākṛtameva ca  |
duḥkhameva na saṃdeho yogināṃ brahmavādinām  || 1,86.32 ||
gauṇaṃ gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ ca duḥkhameva vicārataḥ  |
ādau madhye tathā cānte sarvalokeṣu sarvadā  || 1,86.33 ||
vartamānāni duḥkhāni bhaviṣyāṇi yathātatham  |
doṣaduṣṭeṣu deśeṣu duḥkhāni vividhāni ca  || 1,86.34 ||
na bhāvayantyatītāni hyajñāne jñānamāninaḥ  |
kṣudvyādheḥ parihārārthaṃ na sukhāyānnamucyate  || 1,86.35 ||
yathetareṣāṃ rogāṇāmauṣadhaṃ na sukhāya tat |
śītoṣṇavātavarṣādyaistattatkāleṣu dehinām  || 1,86.36 ||
duḥkhameva na saṃdeho na jānanti hyapaṇḍitāḥ  |
svarge'pyevaṃ muniśreṣṭhā hyaviśuddhakṣayādibhiḥ  || 1,86.37 ||
rogairnānāvidhairgrastā rāgadveṣabhayādibhiḥ  |
chinnamūlataruryadvadavaśaḥ patati kṣitau  || 1,86.38 ||
puṇyavṛkṣakṣayāttadvadgāṃ patanti divaukasaḥ  |
duḥkhābhilāṣaniṣṭhānāṃ duḥkhabhogādisaṃpadām  || 1,86.39 ||
asmāttu patatāṃ duḥkhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ svargāddivaukasām  |
narake duḥkhamevātra narakāṇāṃ niṣevaṇāt || 1,86.40 ||
vihitākaraṇāccaiva varṇināṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  || 1,86.41 ||
yathā mṛgo mṛtyubhayasya bhīta ucchinnavāso na labheta nidrām  |
evaṃ yatirdhyānaparo mahātmā saṃsārabhīto na labheta nidrām  || 1,86.42 ||
kīṭapakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ gajavājinām  |
dṛṣṭamevāsukhaṃ tasmāttyajataḥ sukhamuttamam  || 1,86.43 ||
vaimānikānāmapyevaṃ duḥkhaṃ kalpādhikāriṇām  |
sthānābhimānināṃ caiva manvādīnāṃ ca suvratāḥ  || 1,86.44 ||
devānāṃ caiva daityānāmanyonyavijigīṣayā  |
duḥkhameva nṛpāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ jagattraye  || 1,86.45 ||
śramārthamāśramaścāpi varṇānāṃ paramārthataḥ  |
āśramairna ca devaiśca yajñaiḥ sāṃkhyairvrataistathā  || 1,86.46 ||
ugraistapobhirvividhairdānairnānāvidhairapi  |
na labhante tathātmānaṃ labhante jñāninaḥ svayam  || 1,86.47 ||
<pāśupatavrata asescape froṃ saṃsāra>
tasmātsarvaprayatnena caretpāśupatavratam  |
bhasmaśāyī bhavennityaṃ vrate pāśupate budhaḥ  || 1,86.48 ||
pañcārthajñānasampannaḥ śivatattve samāhitaḥ  |
kaivalyakaraṇaṃ yoga vidhikarmacchidaṃ budhaḥ  || 1,86.49 ||
pañcārthayogasampanno duḥkhāntaṃ vrajate sudhīḥ  |
parayā vidyayā vedyaṃ vidantyaparayā na hi  || 1,86.50 ||
dve vidye veditavye hi parā caivāparā tathā  |
aparā tatra ṛgvedo yajurvedo dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.51 ||
sāmavedastathātharvo vedaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ  |
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca  || 1,86.52 ||
jyotiṣaṃ cāparā vidyā parākṣaramiti sthitam  |
tadadṛśyaṃ tadagrāhyamagotraṃ tadavarṇakam  || 1,86.53 ||
tadacakṣustadaśrotraṃ tadapāṇi apādakam  |
tadajātamabhūtaṃ ca tadaśabdaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.54 ||
asparśaṃ tadarūpaṃ ca rasagandhavivarjitam  |
avyayaṃ cāpratiṣṭhaṃ ca tannityaṃ sarvagaṃ vibhum  || 1,86.55 ||
mahāntaṃ tadbṛhantaṃ ca tadajaṃ cinmayaṃ dvijāḥ  |
aprāṇamamanaskaṃ ca tadasnigdhamalohitam  || 1,86.56 ||
aprameyaṃ tadasthūlamadīrghaṃ tadanulbaṇam  |
ahrasvaṃ tadapāraṃ ca tadānandaṃ tadacyutam  || 1,86.57 ||
anapāvṛtamadvaitaṃ tadanantamagocaram  |
asaṃvṛtaṃ tadātmaikaṃ parā vidyā na cānyathā  || 1,86.58 ||
parāpareti kathite naiveha paramārthataḥ  |
ahameva jagatsarvaṃ mayyeva sakalaṃ jagat || 1,86.59 ||
matta utpadyate tiṣṭhanmayi mayyeva līyate  |
matto nānyaditīkṣeta manovākpāṇibhistathā  || 1,86.60 ||
sarvamātmani saṃpaśyetsaccāsacca samāhitaḥ  |
sarvaṃ hyātmani saṃpaśyanna bāhye kurute manaḥ  || 1,86.61 ||
<4 statesof mind>
adhodṛṣṭyā vitastyāṃ tu nābhyāmuparitiṣṭhati  |
hṛdayaṃ tadvijānīyādviśvasyāyatanaṃ mahat || 1,86.62 ||
hṛdayasyāsya madhye tu puṇḍarīkamavasthitam  |
dharmakandasamudbhūtaṃ jñānanālaṃ suśobhanam  || 1,86.63 ||
aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ śvetaṃ paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam  |
chidrāṇi ca diśo yasya prāṇādyāśca pratiṣṭhitāḥ  || 1,86.64 ||
prāṇādyaiścaiva saṃyuktaḥ paśyate bahudhā kramāt |
daśaprāṇavahā nāḍyaḥ pratyekaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  || 1,86.65 ||
dvisaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍyaḥ samparikīrtitāḥ  |
netrasthaṃ jāgrataṃ vidyātkaṇṭhe svapnaṃ samādiśet || 1,86.66 ||
suṣuptaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ tu turīyaṃ mūrdhani sthitam  |
jāgre brahmā ca viṣṇuśca svapne caiva yathākramāt || 1,86.67 ||
īśvarastu suṣupte tu turīye ca maheśvaraḥ  |
vadantyevamathānye'pi samastakaraṇaiḥ pumān  || 1,86.68 ||
vartamānastadā tasya jāgradityabhidhīyate  |
manobuddhirahaṅkāraṃ cittaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam  || 1,86.69 ||
yadā vyavasthitastvetaiḥ svapna ityabhidhīyate  |
karaṇāni vilīnāni yadā svātmani suvratāḥ  || 1,86.70 ||
suṣuptaḥ karaṇairbhinnasturīyaḥ parikīrtyate  |
parasturīyātīto'sau śivaḥ paramakāraṇam  || 1,86.71 ||
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiśca turīyaṃ cādhibhautikam  |
ādhyātmikaṃ ca viprendrāścādhidaivikamucyate  || 1,86.72 ||
tatsarvamahameveti veditavyaṃ vijānatā  |
buddhīndriyāṇi viprendrāstathā karmendriyāṇi ca  || 1,86.73 ||
manobuddhirahaṅkāraścittaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam  |
adhyātmaṃ pṛthagevedaṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ smṛtam  || 1,86.74 ||
draṣṭavyaṃ caiva śrotavyaṃ ghrātavyaṃ ca yathākramam  |
rasitavyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sparśitavyaṃ tathaiva ca  || 1,86.75 ||
mantavyaṃ caiva boddhavyamahaṃkartavyameva ca  |
tathā cetayitavyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  || 1,86.76 ||
ādātavyaṃ ca gantavyaṃ visargāyitameva ca  |
ānanditavyamityete hyadhibhūtamanukramāt || 1,86.77 ||
ādityo'pi diśaścaiva pṛthivī varuṇastathā  |
vāyuścandrastathā brahmā rudraḥ kṣetrajña eva ca  || 1,86.78 ||
agnirindrastathā viṣṇurmitro devaḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
ādhidaivikamevaṃ hi caturdaśavidhaṃ kramāt || 1,86.79 ||
rājñī sudarśanā caiva jitā saumyā yathākramam  |
moghā rudrāmṛtā satyā madhyamā ca dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.80 ||
nāḍī rāśiśukā caiva asurā caiva kṛttikā  |
bhāsvatī nāḍayaścaitāścaturdaśanibandhanāḥ  || 1,86.81 ||
vāyavo nāḍimadhyasthā vāhakāśca caturdaśa  |
prāṇo vyānastvapānaśca udānaśca samānakaḥ  || 1,86.82 ||
vairambhaśca tathā mukhyo hyantaryāmaḥ prabhañjanaḥ  |
kūrmakaśca tathā śyenaḥ śvetaḥ kṛṣṇastathānilaḥ  || 1,86.83 ||
nāga ityeva kathitā vāyavaśca caturdaśa  |
yaścakṣuḥṣvatha draṣṭavye tathāditye ca suvratāḥ  || 1,86.84 ||
nāḍyāṃ prāṇe ca vijñāne tvānande ca yathākramam  |
hṛdyākāśe ya etasmin sarvasminnantare paraḥ  || 1,86.85 ||
ātmā ekaśca carati tamupāsīta māṃ prabhum  |
ajaraṃ tamanantaṃ ca aśokamamṛtaṃ dhruvam  || 1,86.86 ||
caturdaśavidheṣveva saṃcaratyeka eva saḥ  |
līyante tāni tatraiva yadanyaṃ nāsti vai dvijāḥ  || 1,86.87 ||
eka eva hi sarvajñaḥ sarveśastveka eva saḥ  |
eṣa sarvādhipo devastvantaryāmī mahādyutiḥ  || 1,86.88 ||
upāsyamānaḥ sarvasya sarvasaukhyaḥ sanātanaḥ  |
upāsyati na caiveha sarvasaukhyaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.89 ||
upāsyamāno vedaiśca śāstrairnānāvidhairapi  |
na vaiṣa vedaśāstrāṇi sarvajño yāsyati prabhuḥ  || 1,86.90 ||
asyaivānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ na so'nnaṃ bhavati svayam  |
svātmanā rakṣitaṃ cādyādannabhūtaṃ na kutracit || 1,86.91 ||
sarvatra prāṇināmannaṃ prāṇināṃ granthirasmyaham  |
praśāstā nayanaścaiva pañcātmā sa vibhāgaśaḥ  || 1,86.92 ||
annamayo'sau bhūtātmā cādyate hyannamucyate  |
prāṇamayaścendriyātmā saṃkalpātmā manomayaḥ  || 1,86.93 ||
kālātmā soma eveha vijñānamaya ucyate  |
sadānandamayo bhūtvā maheśaḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,86.94 ||
so'hamevaṃ jagatsarvaṃ mayyeva sakalaṃ sthitam  |
paratantraṃ svatantre'pi tadabhāvādvicārataḥ  || 1,86.95 ||
ekatvamapi nāstyeva dvaitaṃ tatra kutastvaho  |
evaṃ nāstyatha martyaṃ ca kuto'mṛtamajodbhavaḥ  || 1,86.96 ||
<ajñāna = source of saṃsāra>
nāntaḥprajño bahiḥprajño na cobhayagatastathā  |
na prajñānaghanastvevaṃ na prājño jñānapūrvakaḥ  || 1,86.97 ||
viditaṃ nāsti vedyaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ paramārthataḥ  |
nirvāṇaṃ caiva kaivalyaṃ niḥśreyasamanāmayam  || 1,86.98 ||
amṛtaṃ cākṣaraṃ brahma paramātmā parāparam  |
nirvikalpaṃ nirābhāsaṃ jñānaṃ paryāyavācakam  || 1,86.99 ||
prasannaṃ ca yadekāgraṃ tadā jñānamiti smṛtam  |
ajñānamitaratsarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,86.100 ||
itthaṃ prasannaṃ vijñānaṃ gurusaṃparkajaṃ dhruvam  |
rāgadveṣānṛtakrodhaṃ kāmatṛṣṇādibhiḥ sadā  || 1,86.101 ||
aparāmṛṣṭamadyaiva vijñeyaṃ muktidaṃ tvidam  |
ajñānamalapūrvatvātpuruṣo malinaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,86.102 ||
tatkṣayāddhi bhavenmuktirnānyathā janmakoṭibhiḥ  |
jñānamekaṃ vinā nāsti puṇyapāpaparikṣayaḥ  || 1,86.103 ||
jñānamevābhyasettasmānmuktyarthaṃ brahmavittamāḥ  |
jñānābhyāsāddhi vai puṃsāṃ buddhirbhavati nirmalā  || 1,86.104 ||
tasmātsadābhyasejjñānaṃ tanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ  |
jñānenaikena tṛptasya tyaktasaṃgasya yoginaḥ  || 1,86.105 ||
kartavyaṃ nāsti viprendrā asti cettattvavinna ca  |
iha loke pare cāpi kartavyaṃ nāsti tasya vai  || 1,86.106 ||
jīvanmukto yatastasmādbrahmavitparamārthataḥ  |
jñānābhyāsarato nityaṃ jñānatattvārthavitsvayam  || 1,86.107 ||
kartavyābhyāsamutsṛjya jñānamevādhigacchati  |
varṇāśramābhimānī yastyaktakrodho dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.108 ||
anyatra ramate mūḍhaḥ so'jñānī nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
saṃsāraheturajñānaṃ saṃsārastanusaṃgrahaḥ  || 1,86.109 ||
mokṣahetustathā jñānaṃ muktaḥ svātmanyavasthitaḥ  |
ajñāne sati viprendrāḥ krodhādyā nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,86.110 ||
krodho harṣastathā lobho moho dambho dvijottamāḥ  |
dharmādharmau hi teṣāṃ ca tadvaśāttanusaṃgrahaḥ  || 1,86.111 ||
śarīre sati vai kleśaḥ so'vidyāṃ saṃtyajedbudhaḥ  |
avidyāṃ vidyayā hitvā sthitasyaiva ca yoginaḥ  || 1,86.112 ||
krodhādyā nāśamāyānti dharmādharmau ca vai dvijāḥ  |
tatkṣayācca śarīreṇa na punaḥ samprayujyate  || 1,86.113 ||
sa eva muktaḥ saṃsārādduḥkhatrayavivarjitaḥ  |
evaṃ jñānaṃ vinā nāsti dhyānaṃ dhyāturdvijarṣabhāḥ  || 1,86.114 ||
jñānaṃ gurorhi saṃparkānna vācā paramārthataḥ  |
caturvyūhamiti jñātvā dhyātā dhyānaṃ samabhyaset || 1,86.115 ||
sahajāgantukaṃ pāpamasthivāgudbhavaṃ tathā  |
jñānāgnirdahate kṣipraṃ śuṣkendhanamivānalaḥ  || 1,86.116 ||
jñānātparataraṃ nāsti sarvapāpavināśanam  |
abhyasecca sadā jñānaṃ sarvasaṃgavivarjitaḥ  || 1,86.117 ||
jñāninaḥ sarvapāpāni jīryante nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
krīḍannapi na lipyeta pāpairnānāvidhairapi  || 1,86.118 ||
<importance of dhyāna>
jñānaṃ yathā tathā dhyānaṃ tasmāddhyānaṃ samabhyaset |
dhyānaṃ nirviṣayaṃ proktamādau saviṣayaṃ tathā  || 1,86.119 ||
ṣaṭprakāraṃ samabhyasya catuḥṣaḍdaśabhistathā  |
tathā dvādaśadhā caiva punaḥ ṣoḍaśadhā kramāt || 1,86.120 ||
dvidhābhyasya ca yogīndro mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
śuddhajāṃbūnadākāraṃ vidhūmāṅgārasannibham  || 1,86.121 ||
pītaṃ raktaṃ sitaṃ vidyutkoṭikoṭisamaprabham  |
athavā brahmarandhrasthaṃ cittaṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ  || 1,86.122 ||
na sitaṃ vāsitaṃ pītaṃ na smaredbrahmavidbhavet |
ahiṃsakaḥ satyavādī asteyī sarvayatnataḥ  || 1,86.123 ||
parigrahavinirmukto brahmacārī dṛḍhavrataḥ  |
saṃtuṣṭaḥ śaucasampannaḥ svādhyāyanirataḥ sadā  || 1,86.124 ||
madraktaścābhyaseddhyānaṃ gurusaṃparkajaṃ dhruvam  |
na budhyati tathā dhyātā sthāpya cittaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.125 ||
na cābhimanyate yogī na paśyati samantataḥ  |
na ghrāti na śṛṇotyeva līnaḥ svātmani yaḥ svayam  || 1,86.126 ||
na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti sa vai samarasaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
pārthive paṭale brahmā vāritattve hariḥ svayam  || 1,86.127 ||
vāhneye kālarudrākhyo vāyutattve maheśvaraḥ  |
suṣire sa śivaḥ sākṣātkramādevaṃ vicintayet || 1,86.128 ||
kṣitau śarvaḥ smṛto devo hyapāṃ bhava iti smṛtaḥ  |
rudra eva tathā vahnau ugro vāyau vyavasthitaḥ  || 1,86.129 ||
bhīmaḥ suṣiranāke'sau bhāskare maṇḍale sthitaḥ  |
īśānaḥ somabimbe ca mahādeva iti smṛtaḥ  || 1,86.130 ||
puṃsāṃ paśupatirdevaścāṣṭadhāhaṃ vyavasthitaḥ  |
kāṭhinyaṃ yattanau sarvaṃ pārthivaṃ parigīyate  || 1,86.131 ||
āpyaṃ dravamiti proktaṃ varṇākhyo vahnirucyate  |
yatsaṃcarati tadvāyuḥ suṣiraṃ yaddvijottamāḥ  || 1,86.132 ||
tadākāśaṃ ca vijñānaṃ śabdajaṃ vyomasaṃbhavam  |
tathaiva viprā vijñānaṃ sparśākhyaṃ vāyusaṃbhavam  || 1,86.133 ||
rūpaṃ vāhneyamityuktamāpyaṃ rasamayaṃ dvijāḥ  |
gandhākhyaṃ pārthivaṃ bhūyaścintayedbhāskaraṃ kramāt || 1,86.134 ||
netre ca dakṣiṇe vāme somaṃ hṛdi vibhuṃ dvijāḥ  |
ājānu pṛthivītattvamānābhervārimaṇḍalam  || 1,86.135 ||
ākaṇṭhaṃ vahnitattvaṃ syāllalāṭāntaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
vāyavyaṃ vai lalāṭādyaṃ vyomākhyaṃ vā śikhāgrakam  || 1,86.136 ||
haṃsākhyaṃ ca tato brahma vyomnaścordhvaṃ tataḥ param  |
vyomākhyo vyomamadhyastho hyayaṃ prāthamikaḥ smaret || 1,86.137 ||
na jīvaḥ prakṛtiḥ sattvaṃ rajaścātha tamaḥ punaḥ  |
mahāṃstathābhimānaśca tanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca  || 1,86.138 ||
vyomādīni ca bhūtāni naiveha paramārthataḥ  |
vyāpya tiṣṭhadyato viśvaṃ sthāṇurityabhidhīyate  || 1,86.139 ||
udeti sūryo bhītaśca pavate vāta eva ca  |
dyotate candramā vahnirjvalatyāpo vahanti ca  || 1,86.140 ||
dadhāti bhūmirākāśamavakāśaṃ dadāti ca  |
tadājñayā tataṃ sarvaṃ tasmādvai cintayeddvijāḥ  || 1,86.141 ||
tenaivādhiṣṭhitaṃ tasmādetatsarvaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
sarvarūpamayaḥ śarva iti matvā smaredbhavam  || 1,86.142 ||
saṃsāraviṣataptānāṃ jñānadhyānāmṛtena vai  |
pratīkāraḥ samākhyāto nānyathā dvijasattamāḥ  || 1,86.143 ||
jñānaṃ dharmodbhavaṃ sākṣājjñānādvairāgyasaṃbhavaḥ  |
vairāgyātparamaṃ jñānaṃ paramārthaprakāśakam  || 1,86.144 ||
jñānavairāgyayuktasya yogasiddhirdvijottamāḥ  |
yogasiddhyā vimuktiḥ syātsattvaniṣṭhasya nānyathā  || 1,86.145 ||
tamovidyāpadacchannaṃ citraṃ yatpadamavyayam  |
sattvaśaktiṃ samāsthāya śivamabhyarcayeddvijāḥ  || 1,86.146 ||
yaḥ sattvaniṣṭho madbhakto madarcanaparāyaṇaḥ  |
sarvato dharmaniṣṭhaśca sadotsāhī samāhitaḥ  || 1,86.147 ||
sarvadvandvasaho dhīraḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  |
ṛjusvabhāvaḥ satataṃ svasthacitto mṛduḥ sadā  || 1,86.148 ||
amānī buddhimāñchāntastyaktaspardho dvijottamāḥ  |
sadā mumukṣurdharmajñaḥ svātmalakṣaṇalakṣaṇaḥ  || 1,86.149 ||
ṛṇatrayavinirmuktaḥ pūrvajanmani puṇyabhāk |
jarāyukto dvijo bhūtvā śraddhayā ca guroḥ kramāt || 1,86.150 ||
anyathā vāpi śuśrūṣāṃ kṛtvā kṛtrimavarjitaḥ  |
svargalokamanuprāpya bhuktvā bhogānanukramāt || 1,86.151 ||
āsādya bhārataṃ varṣaṃ brahmavijjāyate dvijāḥ  |
saṃparkājjñānamāsādya jñānino yogavidbhavet || 1,86.152 ||
kramo'yaṃ malapūrṇasya jñānaprāpterdvijottamāḥ  |
tasmādanena mārgeṇa tyaktasaṃgo dṛḍhavrataḥ  || 1,86.153 ||
saṃsārakālakūṭākhyānmucyate munipuṅgavāḥ  |
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mayā yuṣmākamacyutam  || 1,86.154 ||
jñānasyaiveha māhātmyaṃ prasaṃgādiha śobhanam  |
evaṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ kathitaṃ tvīśvareṇa tu  || 1,86.155 ||
na deyaṃ yasya kasyāpi śivoktaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  |
dātavyaṃ yogine nityaṃ bhasmaniṣṭhāya supriyam  || 1,86.156 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi saṃsāraśamanaṃ naraḥ  |
sa yāti brahmasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,86.157 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge saṃsāraviṣakathanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 87

sūta uvāca
niśamya te mahāprājñāḥ kumārādyāḥ pinākinam  |
procuḥ praṇamya vai bhītāḥ prasannaṃ parameśvaram  || 1,87.1 ||
evaṃ cedanayā devyā haimavatyā maheśvara  |
krīḍase vividhairbhogaiḥ kathaṃ vaktumihārhasi  || 1,87.2 ||

sūta uvāca
evamuktaḥ prahasyeśaḥ pinākī nīlalohitaḥ  |
prāha tāmaṃbikāṃ prekṣya praṇipatya sthitān dvijān  || 1,87.3 ||
bandhamokṣau na caiveha mama svecchā śarīriṇaḥ  |
akartajñaḥ paśurjīvo vibhurbhoktā hyaṇuḥ pumān  || 1,87.4 ||
māyī ca māyayā baddhaḥ karmabhiryujyate tu saḥ  |
jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca bandhaśca mokṣo nāstyātmano dvijāḥ  || 1,87.5 ||
yadaivaṃ mayi vidvān yastasyāpi na ca sarvataḥ  |
eṣā vidyā hyahaṃ vedyaḥ prajñaiṣā ca śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ  || 1,87.6 ||
dhṛtireṣā mayā niṣṭhā jñānaśaktiḥ kriyā tathā  |
icchākhyā ca tathā hyājñā dve vidye na ca saṃśayaḥ  || 1,87.7 ||
na hyeṣā prakṛtirjaivī vikṛtiśca vicārataḥ  |
vikāro naiva māyaiṣā sadasadvyaktivarjitā  || 1,87.8 ||
purā mamājñā madvaktrātsamutpannā sanātanī  |
pañcavaktrā mahābhāgā jagatāmabhayapradā  || 1,87.9 ||
tāmājñāṃ sampraviśyāhaṃ cintayan jagatāṃ hitam  |
saptaviṃśatprakāreṇa sarvaṃ vyāpyānayā śivaḥ  || 1,87.10 ||
tadāprabhṛti vai mokṣa pravṛttirdvijasattamāḥ  |

sūta uvāca
evamuktvā tadāpaśyadbhavānīṃ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,87.11 ||
bhavānī ca tamālokya māyāmaharadavyayā  |
te māyāmalanirmuktā munayaḥ prekṣya pārvatīm  || 1,87.12 ||
prītā babhūvurmuktāśca tasmādeṣā parā gatiḥ  |
umāśaṅkarayorbhedo nāstyeva paramārthataḥ  || 1,87.13 ||
dvidhāsau rūpamāsthāya sthita eva na saṃśayaḥ  |
yadā vidvānasaṃgaḥ syādājñayā parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,87.14 ||
tadā muktiḥ kṣaṇādeva nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ  |
kramo'vivakṣito bhūta vivṛddhaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,87.15 ||
prasādena kṣaṇānmuktiḥ pratijñaiṣā na saṃśayaḥ  |
garbhastho jāyamāno vā bālo vā taruṇo'pi vā  || 1,87.16 ||
vṛddho vā mucyate jantuḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ  |
aṇḍajaścodbhijjo vāpi svedajo vāpi mucyate  || 1,87.17 ||
prasādāddevadevasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
eṣa eva jagannātho bandhamokṣakaraḥ śivaḥ  || 1,87.18 ||
bhūrbhūvaḥsvarmahaścaiva janaḥ sākṣāttapaḥ svayam  |
satyalokastathāṇḍānāṃ koṭikoṭiśatāni ca  || 1,87.19 ||
vigrahaṃ devadevasya tathāṇḍāvaraṇāṣṭakam  |
saptadvīpeṣu sarveṣu parvateṣu vaneṣu ca  || 1,87.20 ||
samudreṣu ca sarveṣu vāyuskandheṣu sarvataḥ  |
tathānyeṣu ca lokeṣu vasanti ca carācarāḥ  || 1,87.21 ||
sarve bhavāṃśajā nūnaṃ gatistveṣāṃ sa eva vai  |
sarvo rudro namastasmai puruṣāya mahātmane  || 1,87.22 ||
viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ tathā jātaṃ bahudhā rudra eva saḥ  |
rudrājñaiṣā sthitā devī hyanayā muktiraṃbikā  || 1,87.23 ||
ityevaṃ khecarāḥ siddhā jajalpuḥ prītamānasāḥ  |
yadāvalokya tān sarvān prasādādanayāṃbikā  || 1,87.24 ||
tadā tiṣṭhanti sāyujyaṃ prāptāste khecarāḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,87.25 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge munimohaśamanaṃ nāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 88

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kena yogena vai sūta guṇaprāptiḥ satāmiha  |
aṇimādiguṇopetā bhavantyeveha yoginaḥ  |
tatsarvaṃ vistarātsūta vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam  || 1,88.1 ||

sūta uvāca
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaṃ paramadurlabham  |
pañcadhā saṃsmaredādau sthāpya citte sanātanam  || 1,88.2 ||
kalpayeccāsanaṃ padmaṃ somasūryāgnisaṃyutam  |
ṣaḍviṃśacchaktisaṃyuktamaṣṭadhā ca dvijottamāḥ  || 1,88.3 ||
tataḥ ṣoḍaśadhā caiva punardvādaśadhā dvijāḥ  |
smarecca tattathā madhye devyā devamumāpatim  || 1,88.4 ||
aṣṭaśaktisamāyuktamaṣṭamūrtimajaṃ prabhum  |
tābhiścāṣṭavidhā rudrāścatuḥṣaṣṭividhāḥ punaḥ  || 1,88.5 ||
śaktayaśca tathā sarvā guṇāṣṭakasamanvitāḥ  |
evaṃ smaretkrameṇaiva labdhvā jñānamanuttamam  || 1,88.6 ||
evaṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ mokṣasiddhipradāyakam  |
tasyāṇimādayo viprā nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ  || 1,88.7 ||
<aiśvarya>
tatrāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ yogināṃ samudāhṛtam  |
tatsarvaṃ kramayogena hyucyamānaṃ nibodhata  || 1,88.8 ||
aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca  |
prākāmyaṃ caiva sarvatra īśitvaṃ caiva sarvataḥ  || 1,88.9 ||
vaśitvamatha sarvatra yatra kāmāvasāyitā  |
taccāpi trividhaṃ jñeyamaiśvaryaṃ sārvakāmikam  || 1,88.10 ||
sāvadyaṃ niravadyaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ caiva pravartate  |
sāvadyaṃ nāma yattatra pañcabhūtātmakaṃ smṛtam  || 1,88.11 ||
indriyāṇi manaścaiva ahaṅkāraśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
tatra sūkṣmapravṛttistu pañcabhūtātmikā punaḥ  || 1,88.12 ||
indriyāṇi manaścitta buddhyahaṅkārasaṃjñitam  |
tathā sarvamayaṃ caiva ātmasthā khyātireva ca  || 1,88.13 ||
saṃyoga eva trividhaḥ sūkṣmeṣveva pravartate  |
punaraṣṭaguṇaścāpi sūkṣmeṣveva vidhīyate  || 1,88.14 ||
tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāha bhagavānprabhuḥ  |
trailokye sarvabhūteṣu yathāsya niyamaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 1,88.15 ||
aṇimādyaṃ tathāvyaktaṃ sarvatraiva pratiṣṭhitam  |
trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ duṣprāpyaṃ samudāhṛtam  || 1,88.16 ||
tattasya bhavati prāpyaṃ prathamaṃ yogināṃ balam  |
laṅghanaṃ plavanaṃ loke rūpamasya sadā bhavet || 1,88.17 ||
śīghratvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu dvitīyaṃ tu padaṃ smṛtam  |
trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ mahimnā caiva vanditam  || 1,88.18 ||
mahitvaṃ cāpi loke'smiṃstṛtīyo yoga ucyate  |
trailokye sarvabhūteṣu yatheṣṭagamanaṃ smṛtam  || 1,88.19 ||
prākāmān viṣayān bhuṅkte tathāpratihataḥ kvacit |
trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ pravartate  || 1,88.20 ||
īśo bhavati sarvatra pravibhāgena yogavit |
vaśyāni cāsya bhūtāni trailokye sacarācare  || 1,88.21 ||
icchayā tasya rūpāṇi bhavanti na bhavanti ca  |
yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ trailokye sacarācare  || 1,88.22 ||
śabdaḥ sparśo raso gandho rūpaṃ caiva manastathā  |
pravartante'sya cecchāto na bhavanti yathecchayā  || 1,88.23 ||
<yoginisfreedfromattachment>
na jāyate na mriyate chidyate na ca bhidyate  |
na dahyate na muhyeta līyate na ca lipyate  || 1,88.24 ||
na kṣīyate na kṣarati khidyate na kadācana  |
kriyate vā na sarvatra tathā vikriyate na ca  || 1,88.25 ||
agandharasarūpastu asparśaḥ śabdavarjitaḥ  |
avarṇo hyasvaraścaiva asavarṇastu karhicit || 1,88.26 ||
sa bhuṅkte viṣayāṃścaiva viṣayairna ca yujyate  |
aṇutvāttu paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmatvādapavargikaḥ  || 1,88.27 ||
vyāpakastvapavargācca vyāpakātpuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
puruṣaḥ sūkṣmabhāvāttu aiśvarye parame sthitaḥ  || 1,88.28 ||
guṇottaramathaiśvarye sarvataḥ sūkṣmamucyate  |
aiśvaryaṃ cāpratīghātaṃ prāpya yogamanuttamam  || 1,88.29 ||
apavargaṃ tato gacchetsūkṣmaṃ tatparamaṃ padam  |
evaṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ jñātavyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ  || 1,88.30 ||
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ śivasāyujyakāraṇam  |
athavā gatavijñāno rāgātkarma samācaret || 1,88.31 ||
rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi bhuktvā tatraiva mucyate  |
<brahman guaranteesliberation>
tathā sukṛtakarmā tu phalaṃ svarge samaśnute  || 1,88.32 ||
tasmātsthānātpunaḥ śreṣṭho mānuṣyamupapadyate  |
tasmādbrahma paraṃ saukhyaṃ brahma śāśvatamuttamam  || 1,88.33 ||
brahma eva hi seveta brahmaiva hi paraṃ sukham  |
pariśramo hi yajñānāṃ mahatārthena vartate  || 1,88.34 ||
bhūyo mṛtyuvaśaṃ yāti tasmānmokṣaḥ paraṃ sukham  |
athavā dhyānasaṃyukto brahmatattvaparāyaṇaḥ  || 1,88.35 ||
na tu cyāvayituṃ śakyo manvantaraśatairapi  |
dṛṣṭvā tu puruṣaṃ divyaṃ viśvākhyaṃ viśvatomukham  || 1,88.36 ||
viśvapādaśirogrīvaṃ viśveśaṃ viśvarūpiṇam  |
viśvagandhaṃ viśvamālyaṃ viśvāṃbaradharaṃ prabhum  || 1,88.37 ||
gobhirmahīṃ saṃpatate patatriṇo naivaṃ bhūyo janayatyevameva  |
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāraṃ sūkṣmācca sūkṣmaṃ mahato mahāntam  || 1,88.38 ||
yogena paśyenna ca cakṣuṣā punarnirindriyaṃ puruṣaṃ rukmavarṇam  |
aliṅginaṃ nirguṇaṃ cetanaṃ ca nityaṃ sadā sarvagaṃ sarvasāram  || 1,88.39 ||
paśyanti yuktyā hyacalaprakāśaṃ tadbhāvitāstejasā dīpyamānam  |*
apāṇipādodarapārśvajihvo hyatīndriyo vāpi susūkṣma ekaḥ  || 1,88.40 ||*
paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇo na cāstyabuddhaṃ na ca buddhirasti  |*
sa veda sarvaṃ na ca sarvavedyaṃ tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam  || 1,88.41 ||*
acetanāṃ sarvagatāṃ sūkṣmāṃ prasavadharmiṇīm  |
prakṛtiṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yuktāḥ paśyanti yoginaḥ  || 1,88.42 ||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukham  |
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati  || 1,88.43 ||
yukto yogena ceśānaṃ sarvataśca sanātanam  |
puruṣaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ taṃ vidvānna vimuhyati  || 1,88.44 ||
bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ paramātmānamavyayam  |
sarvātmānaṃ paraṃ brahma tadvai dhyātā na muhyati  || 1,88.45 ||
pavano hi yathā grāhyo vicaransarvamūrtiṣu  |
puri śete sudurgrāhyastasmātpuruṣa ucyate  || 1,88.46 ||
<developmentof anembryo>
atha celluptadharmā tu sāvaśeṣaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ  |
tatastu brahmagarbhe vai śukraśoṇitasaṃyute  || 1,88.47 ||
strīpuṃsoḥ saṃprayoge hi jāyate hi tataḥ prabhuḥ  |
tatastu garbhakālena kalalaṃ nāma jāyate  || 1,88.48 ||
kālena kalalaṃ cāpi budbudaṃ samprajāyate  |
mṛtpiṇḍastu yathā cakre cakrāvartena pīḍitaḥ  || 1,88.49 ||
hastābhyāṃ kriyamāṇastu biṃbatvamanugacchati  |
evamādhyātmikairyuktā vāyunā saṃprapūritaḥ  || 1,88.50 ||
yadi yoniṃ vimuñcāmi tatprapadye maheśvaram  |
yāvaddhi vaiṣṇavo vāyurjātamātraṃ na saṃspṛśet || 1,88.51 ||
tāvatkālaṃ mahādevamarcayāmīti cintayet |
jāyate mānuṣastatra yathārūpaṃ yathāvayaḥ  || 1,88.52 ||
vāyuḥ saṃbhavate khāttu vātādbhavati vai jalam  |
jalātsambhavati prāṇaḥ prāṇācchukraṃ vivardhate  || 1,88.53 ||
raktabhāgāstrayastriṃśadretobhāgāścaturdaśa  |
bhāgato'rdhaphalaṃ kṛtvā tato garbho niṣicyate  || 1,88.54 ||
tatastu garbhasaṃyuktaḥ pañcabhirvāyubhirvṛtaḥ  |
pituḥ śarīrātpratyaṅgaṃ rūpamasyopajāyate  || 1,88.55 ||
tato'sya māturāhārātpītalīḍhapraveśanāt |
nābhideśena vai prāṇāste hyādhārā hi dehinām  || 1,88.56 ||
navamāsātparikliṣṭaḥ saṃveṣṭitaśirodharaḥ  |
veṣṭitaḥ sarvagātraiśca aparyāptapraveśanaḥ  || 1,88.57 ||
navamāsoṣitaścāpi yonicchidrādavāṅmukhaḥ  |
<hell>
tataḥ svakarmabhiḥ pāpairnirayaṃ samprapadyate  || 1,88.58 ||
asipatravanaṃ caiva śālmalicchedanaṃ tathā  |
tāḍanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ caiva pūyaśoṇitabhakṣaṇam  || 1,88.59 ||
yathā hyāpastu saṃchinnāḥ saṃśleṣmamupayānti vai  |
tathā chinnāśca bhinnāśca yātanāsthānamāgatāḥ  || 1,88.60 ||
evaṃ jīvāstu taiḥ pāpaistapyamānāḥ svayaṃkṛtaiḥ  |
prāpnuyuḥ karmabhiḥ śeṣairduḥkhaṃ vā yadi vetarat || 1,88.61 ||
ekenaiva tu gantavyaṃ sarvamutsṛjya vai janam  |
ekenaiva tu bhoktavyaṃ tasmātsukṛtamācaret || 1,88.62 ||
na hyenaṃ prasthitaṃ kaścidgacchantamanugacchati  |
yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tadenamanugacchati  || 1,88.63 ||
te nityaṃ yamaviṣayeṣu sampravṛttāḥ krośantaḥ satatamaniṣṭasaṃprayogaiḥ  |
śuṣyante parigatavedanāḥ śarīrā bahvībhiḥ subhṛśamanantayātanābhiḥ  || 1,88.64 ||
<diff. formsof rebirth>
karmaṇā manasā vācā yadabhīkṣṇaṃ niṣevate  |
tadabhyāso haratyenaṃ tasmātkalyāṇamācaret || 1,88.65 ||
anādimānprabandhaḥ syātpūrvakarmaṇi dehinaḥ  |
saṃsāraṃ tāmasaṃ ghoraṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ pratipadyate  || 1,88.66 ||
mānuṣyātpaśubhāvaśca paśubhāvānmṛgo bhavet |
mṛgatvātpakṣibhāvaśca tasmāccaiva sarīsṛpaḥ  || 1,88.67 ||
sarīsṛpatvādgacchedvai sthāvaratvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  |
sthāvaratve punaḥ prāpte yāvadunmilate janaḥ  || 1,88.68 ||
kulālacakravadbhrāntastatraiva parivartate  |
ityevaṃ hi manuṣyādiḥ saṃsāraḥ sthāvarāntikaḥ  || 1,88.69 ||
vijñeyastāmaso nāma tatraiva parivartate  |
sāttvikaścāpi saṃsāro brahmādiḥ parikīrtitaḥ  || 1,88.70 ||
piśācāntaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ svargasthāneṣu dehinām  |
brāhme tu kevalaṃ sattvaṃ sthāvare kevalaṃ tamaḥ  || 1,88.71 ||
caturdaśānāṃ sthānānāṃ madhye viṣṭambhakaṃ rajaḥ  |
marmasu chidyamāneṣu vedanārtasya dehinaḥ  || 1,88.72 ||
tatastatparamaṃ brahma kathaṃ vipraḥ smariṣyati  |
saṃsāraḥ pūrvadharmasya bhāvanābhiḥ praṇoditaḥ  || 1,88.73 ||
mānuṣaṃ bhajate nityaṃ tasmāddhyānaṃ samācaret |
caturdaśavidhaṃ hyetadbuddhvā saṃsāramaṇḍalam  || 1,88.74 ||
nityaṃ samārabheddharmaṃ saṃsārabhayapīḍitaḥ  |
tatastarati saṃsāraṃ krameṇa parivartitaḥ  || 1,88.75 ||
tasmācca satataṃ yukto dhyānatatparayuñjakaḥ  |
tathā samārabhedyogaṃ yathātmānaṃ sa paśyati  || 1,88.76 ||
eṣa āpaḥ paraṃ jyotireṣa seturanuttamaḥ  |
vivṛtyā hyeṣa saṃbhedādbhūtānāṃ caiva śāśvataḥ  || 1,88.77 ||
tadenaṃ setumātmānamagniṃ vai viśvatomukham  |
hṛdisthaṃ sarvabhūtānāmupāsīta maheśvaram  || 1,88.78 ||
tathāntaḥ saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ svaśaktyā parimaṇḍitam  |
aṣṭadhā cāṣṭadhā caiva tathā cāṣṭavidhena ca  || 1,88.79 ||
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ saṃsthitaṃ vahniṃ saṃkṣipya ca hṛdi sthitam  |
dhyātvā yathāvaddeveśaṃ rudraṃ bhuvananāyakam  || 1,88.80 ||
hutvā pañcāhutīḥ samyaktaccintāgatamānasaḥ  |
vaiśvānaraṃ hṛdisthaṃ tu yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ  || 1,88.81 ||
āpaḥ pūtāḥ sakṛtprāśya tūṣṇīṃ hutvā hyupāviśan  |
prāṇāyeti tatastasya prathamā hyāhutiḥ smṛtā  || 1,88.82 ||
apānāya dvitīyā ca vyānāyeti tathā parā  |
udānāya caturthī syātsamānāyeti pañcamī  || 1,88.83 ||
svāhākāraiḥ pṛthagghutvā śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ  |
apaḥ punaḥ sakṛtprāśya ācamya hṛdayaṃ spṛśet || 1,88.84 ||
prāṇānāṃ granthirasyātmā rudro hyātmā viśāntakaḥ  |
rudro vai hyātmanaḥ prāṇa evamāpyāyayetsvayam  || 1,88.85 ||
prāṇe niviṣṭo vai rudrastasmātprāṇamayaḥ svayam  |
prāṇāya caiva rudrāya juhotyamṛtamuttamam  || 1,88.86 ||
śivāviśeha māmīśa svāhā brahmātmane svayam  |
evaṃ pañcāhutīścaiva prabhuḥ prīṇātu śāśvataḥ  || 1,88.87 ||
puruṣo'si pure śeṣe tvaṃ aṅguṣṭhapramāṇataḥ  |
āśritaścaiva cāṅguṣṭhamīśaḥ paramakāraṇam  || 1,88.88 ||
sarvasya jagataścaiva prabhuḥ prīṇātu śāśvataḥ  |
tvaṃ devānāmasi jyeṣṭho rudrastvaṃ ca puro vṛṣā  || 1,88.89 ||
mṛdustvamannamasmabhyametadastu hutaṃ tava  |
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ guṇaprāptiviśeṣataḥ  || 1,88.90 ||
yogācāraḥ svayaṃ tena brahmaṇā kathitaḥ purā  |
evaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ jñātavyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ  || 1,88.91 ||
bhasmasnāyī bhavennityaṃ bhasmaliptaḥ sadā bhavet |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā dvijottamān  || 1,88.92 ||
daive karmaṇi pitrye vā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,88.93 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge'ṇimādyaṣṭasiddhitriguṇasaṃsāraprāgnau homādivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 89

sūta uvāca
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śaucācārasya lakṣaṇam  |
yadanuṣṭhāya śuddhātmā paretya gatimāpnuyāt || 1,89.1 ||
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvabhūtahitāya vai  |
saṃkṣepātsarvavedārthaṃ saṃcayaṃ brahmavādinām  || 1,89.2 ||
udayārthaṃ tu śaucānāṃ munīnāmuttamaṃ padam  |
yastatrāthāpramattaḥ syātsa munirnāvasīdati  || 1,89.3 ||
mānāvamānau dvāvetau tāvevāhurviṣāmṛte  |
avamāno'mṛtaṃ tatra sanmāno viṣamucyate  || 1,89.4 ||
gurorapi hite yuktaḥ sa tu saṃvatsaraṃ vaset |
niyameṣvapramattastu yameṣu ca sadā bhavet || 1,89.5 ||
prāpyānujñāṃ tataścaiva jñānayogamanuttamam  |
avirodhena dharmasya careta pṛthivīmimām  || 1,89.6 ||
cakṣuḥpūtaṃ carenmārgaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet |
satyapūtaṃ vadedvākyaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret || 1,89.7 ||
matsyagṛhyasya yatpāpaṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare bhavet |
ekāhaṃ tatsamaṃ jñeyamapūtaṃ yajjalaṃ bhavet || 1,89.8 ||
apūtodakapāne tu japecca śatapañcakam  |
aghoralakṣaṇaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ śuddhimavāpnuyāt || 1,89.9 ||
athavā pūjayecchaṃbhuṃ ghṛtasnānādivistaraiḥ  |
tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,89.10 ||
ātithyaśrāddhayajñeṣu na gacchedyogavitkvacit |
evaṃ hyahiṃsako yogī bhavediti vicāritam  || 1,89.11 ||
<rulesforbhaikṣyacaraṇa>
vahnau vidhūme'tyaṅgāre sarvasminbhuktavajjane  |
carettu matimān bhaikṣyaṃ na tu teṣveva nityaśaḥ  || 1,89.12 ||
athainamavamanyante pare paribhavanti ca  |
tathā yuktaṃ caredbhaikṣyaṃ satāṃ dharmamadūṣayan  || 1,89.13 ||
bhaikṣyaṃ caredvanastheṣu yāyāvaragṛheṣu ca  |
śreṣṭhā tu prathamā hīyaṃ vṛttirasyopajāyate  || 1,89.14 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ gṛhastheṣu śīlīneṣu careddvijāḥ  |
śraddadhāneṣu dānteṣu śrotriyeṣu mahātmasu  || 1,89.15 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ punaścāpi aduṣṭāpatiteṣu ca  |
bhaikṣyacaryā hi varṇeṣu jaghanyā vṛttirucyate  || 1,89.16 ||
bhaikṣyaṃ yavāgūstakraṃ vā payo yāvakameva ca  |
phalamūlādi pakvaṃ vā kaṇapiṇyākasaktavaḥ  || 1,89.17 ||
ityeva te mayā proktā yogināṃ siddhivarddhanāḥ  |
āhārāsteṣu siddheṣu śreṣṭhaṃ bhaikṣyamiti smṛtam  || 1,89.18 ||
abbinduṃ yaḥ kuśāgreṇa māsi māsi samaśnute  |
nyāyato yaścaredbhaikṣyaṃ pūrvoktātsa viśiṣyate  || 1,89.19 ||
jarāmaraṇagarbhebhyo bhītasya narakādiṣu  |
evaṃ dāyayate tasmāttadbhaikṣyamiti saṃsmṛtam  || 1,89.20 ||
dadhibhakṣāḥ payobhakṣā ye cānye jīvakṣīṇakāḥ  |
sarve te bhaikṣyabhakṣasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm  || 1,89.21 ||
bhasmaśāyī bhavennityaṃ bhikṣācārī jitendriyaḥ  |
ya icchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caret || 1,89.22 ||
<behaviourof a yogin>
yogināṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ bhavet |
ekaṃ dve trīṇi catvāri śaktito vā samācaret || 1,89.23 ||
asteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca alobhastyāga eva ca  |
vratāni pañca bhikṣūṇāmahiṃsā paramā tviha  || 1,89.24 ||
akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucamāhāralāghavam  |
nityaṃ svādhyāya ityete niyamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ  || 1,89.25 ||
bījayoniguṇā vastu bandhaḥ karmabhireva ca  |
yathā dvipa ivāraṇye manuṣyāṇāṃ vidhīyate  || 1,89.26 ||
devaistulyāḥ sarvayajñakriyāstu yajñājjāpyaṃ jñānamāhuśca jāpyāt |
jñānāddhyānaṃ saṃgarāgādapetaṃ tasminprāpte śāśvatasyopalambhaḥ  || 1,89.27 ||
damaḥ śamaḥ satyamakalmaṣatvaṃ maunaṃ ca bhūteṣvakhileṣu cārjavam  |
atīndriyaṃ jñānamidaṃ tathā śivaṃ prāhustathā jñānaviśuddhabuddhayaḥ  || 1,89.28 ||
samāhito brahmaparo'pramādī śucistathaikāntaratirjitendriyaḥ  |*
samāpnuyādyogamimaṃ mahātmā maharṣayaścaivamaninditāmalāḥ  || 1,89.29 ||*
prāpyate'bhimatān deśānaṅkuśena nivāritaḥ  |
etanmārgeṇa śuddhena dagdhabījo hyakalmaṣaḥ  || 1,89.30 ||
sadācāraratāḥ śāntāḥ svadharmaparipālakāḥ  |
sarvāṃllokān vinirjitya brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te  || 1,89.31 ||
<salutationof superiors>
pitāmahenopadiṣṭo dharmaḥ sākṣātsanātanaḥ  |
sarvalokopakārārthaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ pravadāmi vaḥ  || 1,89.32 ||
gurūpadeśayuktānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ kramavarttinām  |
abhyutthānādikaṃ sarvaṃ praṇāmaṃ caiva kārayet || 1,89.33 ||
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena tridhā nyastena suvratāḥ  |
triḥpradakṣiṇayogena vandyo vai brahmaṇo guruḥ  || 1,89.34 ||
jyeṣṭhānye'pi ca te sarve vandanīyā vijānatā  |
ājñābhaṅgaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchetsiddhimuttamām  || 1,89.35 ||
dhātuśūnyabilakṣetra kṣudramantropajīvanam  |
viṣagrahaviḍambādīn varjayetsarvayatnataḥ  || 1,89.36 ||
kaitavaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ varjayetsadā  |
atihāsamavaṣṭambhaṃ līlāsvecchāpravartanam  || 1,89.37 ||
varjayetsarvayatnena gurūṇāmapi saṃnidhau  |
tadvākyapratikūlaṃ ca ayuktaṃ vai gurorvacaḥ  || 1,89.38 ||
na vadetsarvayatnena aniṣṭaṃ na smaretsadā  |
yatīnāmāsanaṃ vastraṃ daṇḍādyaṃ pāduke tathā  || 1,89.39 ||
mālyaṃ ca śayanasthānaṃ pātraṃ chāyāṃ ca yatnataḥ  |
yajñopakaraṇāṅgaṃ ca na spṛśedvai padena ca  || 1,89.40 ||
devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ na kuryātsarvayatnataḥ  |
kṛtvā pramādato viprāḥ praṇavasyāyutaṃ japet || 1,89.41 ||
devadrohagurudrohātkoṭimātreṇa śudhyati  |
mahāpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ tathaiva ca yathāvidhi  || 1,89.42 ||
pātakī ca tadardhena śudhyate vṛttavānyadi  |
upapātakinaḥ sarve tadardhenaiva suvratāḥ  || 1,89.43 ||
saṃdhyālope kṛte vipraḥ trirāvṛttyaiva śudhyati  |
āhnikacchedane jāte śatamekamudāhṛtam  || 1,89.44 ||
laṅghane samayānāṃ tu abhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇe  |
avācyavācane caiva sahasrācchuddhirucyate  || 1,89.45 ||
kākolūkakapotānāṃ pakṣiṇāmapi ghātane  |
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,89.46 ||
yaḥ punastattvavettā ca brahmavidbrāhmaṇottamaḥ  |
smaraṇācchuddhimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,89.47 ||
naivamātmavidāmasti prāyaścittāni codanā  |
viśvasyaiva hi te śuddhā brahmavidyāvido janāḥ  || 1,89.48 ||
yogadhyānaikaniṣṭhāśca nirlepāḥ kāñcanaṃ yathā  |
śuddhānāṃ śodhanaṃ nāsti viśuddhā brahmavidyayā  || 1,89.49 ||
<cleaningof water>
uddhṛtānuṣṇaphenābhiḥ pūtābhirvastracakṣuṣā  |
adbhiḥ samācaretsarvaṃ varjayetkaluṣodakam  || 1,89.50 ||
gandhavarṇarasairduṣṭamaśucisthānasaṃsthitam  |
paṅkāśmadūṣitaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ palvalodakam  || 1,89.51 ||
saśaivālaṃ tathānyairvā doṣairduṣṭaṃ vivarjayet |
<cleaningof clothes>
vastraśaucānvitaḥ kuryātsarvakāryāṇi vai dvijāḥ  || 1,89.52 ||
namaskārādikaṃ sarvaṃ guruśuśrūṣaṇādikam  |
vastraśaucavihīnātmā hyaśucirnātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,89.53 ||
devakāryopayuktānāṃ pratyahaṃ śaucamiṣyate  |
itareṣāṃ hi vastrāṇāṃ śaucaṃ kāryaṃ malāgame  || 1,89.54 ||
varjayetsarvayatnena vāso'nyairvidhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ  |
kauśeyāvikayo rūkṣaiḥ kṣaumāṇāṃ gaurasarṣapaiḥ  || 1,89.55 ||
śrīphalairaṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kutapānāmariṣṭakaiḥ  |
carmaṇāṃ vidalānāṃ ca vetrāṇāṃ vastravanmatam  || 1,89.56 ||
valkalānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ chatracāmarayorapi  |
cailavacchaucamākhyātaṃ brahmavidbhirmunīśvaraiḥ  || 1,89.57 ||
<cleaningof objects>
bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ kṣāreṇāyasamucyate  |
tāmramamlena vai viprāstrapusīsakayorapi  || 1,89.58 ||
haimamadbhiḥ śubhaṃ pātraṃ raupyapātraṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
maṇyaśmaśaṅkhamuktānāṃ śaucaṃ taijasavatsmṛtam  || 1,89.59 ||
agnerapāṃ ca saṃyogādatyantopahatasya ca  |
rasānāmiha sarveṣāṃ śuddhirutplavanaṃ smṛtam  || 1,89.60 ||
tṛṇakāṣṭhādivastūnāṃ śubhenābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam  |
uṣṇena vāriṇā śuddhistathā sruksruvayorapi  || 1,89.61 ||
tathaiva yajñapātrāṇāṃ muśalolūkhalasya ca  |
śṛṅgāsthidārudantānāṃ takṣaṇenaiva śodhanam  || 1,89.62 ||
saṃhatānāṃ mahābhāgā dravyāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ smṛtam  |
asaṃhatānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ śaucamucyate  || 1,89.63 ||
abhuktarāśidhānyānāmekadeśasya dūṣaṇe  |
tāvanmātraṃ samuddhṛtya prokṣayedvai kuśāṃbhasā  || 1,89.64 ||
śākamūlaphalādīnāṃ dhānyavacchuddhiriṣyate  |
mārjanonmārjanairveśma punaḥpākena mṛnmayam  || 1,89.65 ||
ullekhanenāñjanena tathā saṃmārjanena ca  |
gonivāsena vai śuddhā secanena dharā smṛtā  || 1,89.66 ||
bhūmisthamudakaṃ śuddhaṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ yatra gaurvrajet |
avyāptaṃ yadamedhyena gandhavarṇarasānvitam  || 1,89.67 ||
vatsaḥ śuciḥ prasravaṇe śakuniḥ phalapātane  |
svadārāsyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ ratau bhāryābhikāṅkṣayā  || 1,89.68 ||
hastābhyāṃ kṣālitaṃ vastraṃ kāruṇā ca yathāvidhi  |
kuśāṃbunā susaṃprokṣya gṛhṇīyāddharmavittamaḥ  || 1,89.69 ||
paṇyaṃ prasāritaṃ caiva varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ  |
śucirākarajaṃ teṣāṃ śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ  || 1,89.70 ||
chāyā ca vipluṣo viprā makṣikādyā dvijottamāḥ  |
rajo bhūrvāyuragniśca medhyāni sparśane sadā  || 1,89.71 ||
suptvā bhuktvā ca vai viprāḥ kṣuttvā pītvā ca vai tathā  |
ṣṭhīvitvādhyayanādau ca śucirapyācametpunaḥ  || 1,89.72 ||
pādau spṛśanti ye cāpi parācamanabindavaḥ  |
te pārthivaiḥ samā jñeyā na tairaprayato bhavet || 1,89.73 ||
kṛtvā ca maithunaṃ spṛṣṭvā patitaṃ kukkuṭādikam  |
sūkaraṃ caiva kākādi śvānamuṣṭraṃ kharaṃ tathā  || 1,89.74 ||
yūpaṃ cāṇḍālakādyāṃśca spṛṣṭvā snānena śudhyati  |
rajasvalāṃ sūtikāṃ ca na spṛśedantyajāmapi  || 1,89.75 ||
sūtikāśaucasaṃyuktaḥ śāvāśaucasamanvitaḥ  |
saṃspṛśenna rajastāsāṃ spṛṣṭvā snātvaiva śudhyati  || 1,89.76 ||
<undefilable people>
naivāśaucaṃ yatīnāṃ ca vanasthabrahmacāriṇām  |
naiṣṭhikānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalīnāṃ ca suvratāḥ  || 1,89.77 ||
tataḥ kāryavirodhāddhi nṛpāṇāṃ nānyathā bhavet |
vaikhānasānāṃ viprāṇāṃ patitānāmasaṃbhavāt || 1,89.78 ||
asaṃcayāddvijānāṃ ca snānamātreṇa nānyathā  |
tathā saṃnihitānāṃ ca yajñārthaṃ dīkṣitasya ca  || 1,89.79 ||
ekāhādyajñayājināṃ śuddhiruktā svayaṃbhuvā  |
tatastvadhītaśākhānāṃ caturbhiḥ sarvadehinām  || 1,89.80 ||
<durationof defilement>
sūtakaṃ pretakaṃ nāsti tryahādūrdhvamamutra vai  |
arvāgekādaśāhāntaṃ bāndhavānāṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 1,89.81 ||
snānamātreṇa vai śuddhirmaraṇe samupasthite  |
tata ṛtutrayādarvāgekāhaḥ parigīyate  || 1,89.82 ||
saptavarṣāttataścārvāktrirātraṃ hi tataḥ param  |
daśāhaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai prathame'hani vā pituḥ  || 1,89.83 ||
daśāhaṃ sūtikāśaucaṃ māturapyevamavyayāḥ  |
arvāktrivarṣātsnānena bāndhavānāṃ pituḥ sadā  || 1,89.84 ||
aṣṭābdādekarātreṇa śuddhiḥ syādbāndhavasya tu  |
dvādaśābdāttataścārvāktrirātraṃ strīṣu suvratāḥ  || 1,89.85 ||
sapiṇḍatā ca puruṣe saptame vinivartate  |
atikrānte daśāhe tu trirātramaśucirbhavet || 1,89.86 ||
tataḥ saṃnihito vipraścārvākpūrvaṃ tadeva vai  |
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu snānamātreṇa śudhyati  || 1,89.87 ||
<purificationaftertouchinga deadbody>
spṛṣṭvā pretaṃ trirātreṇa dharmārthaṃ snānamucyate  |
dāhakānāṃ ca netṝṇāṃ snānamātramabāndhave  || 1,89.88 ||
anugamya ca vai snātvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati  |
ācāryamaraṇe caiva trirātraṃ śrotriye mṛte  || 1,89.89 ||
pakṣiṇī mātulānāṃ ca sodarāṇāṃ ca vā dvijāḥ  |
bhūpānāṃ maṇḍalīnāṃ ca sadyo nīrāṣṭravāsinām  || 1,89.90 ||
kevalaṃ dvādaśāhena kṣattriyāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
nābhiṣiktasya cāśaucaṃ saṃpramādeṣu vai raṇe  || 1,89.91 ||
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudhyati  |
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktā dravyaśuddhiranuttamā  || 1,89.92 ||
aśaucaṃ cānupūrvyeṇa yatīnāṃ naiva vidyate  |
<menstruation>
tretāprabhṛti nārīṇāṃ māsi māsyārtavaṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,89.93 ||
kṛte sakṛdyugavaśājjāyante vai sahaiva tu  |
prayānti ca mahābhāgā bhāryābhiḥ kuravo yathā  || 1,89.94 ||
varṇāśramavyavasthā ca tretāprabhṛti suvratāḥ  |
bhārate dakṣiṇe varṣe vyavasthā netareṣvatha  || 1,89.95 ||
mahāvīte suvīte ca jaṃbūdvīpe tathāṣṭasu  |
śākadvīpādiṣu prokto dharmo vai bhārate yathā  || 1,89.96 ||
rasollāsā kṛte vṛttistretāyāṃ gṛhavṛkṣajā  |
saivārtavakṛtāddoṣādrāgadveṣādibhirnṛṇām  || 1,89.97 ||
maithunātkāmato viprāstathaiva paruṣādibhiḥ  |
yavādyāḥ samprajāyante grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa  || 1,89.98 ||
oṣadhyaśca rajodoṣāḥ strīṇāṃ rāgādibhirnṛṇām  |
akālakṛṣṭā vidhvastāḥ punarutpāditāstathā  || 1,89.99 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena na saṃbhāṣyā rajasvalā  |
prathame'hani cāṇḍālī yathā varjyā tathāṅganā  || 1,89.100 ||
dvitīye'hani viprā hi yathā vai brahmaghātinī  |
tṛtīye'hni tadardhena caturthe'hani suvratāḥ  || 1,89.101 ||
snātvārdhamāsātsaṃśuddhā tataḥ śuddhirbhaviṣyati  |
ā ṣoḍaśāttataḥ strīṇāṃ mūtravacchaucamiṣyate  || 1,89.102 ||
pañcarātraṃ tathāspṛśyā rajasā vartate yadi  |
sā viṃśaddivasādūrdhvaṃ rajasā pūrvavattathā  || 1,89.103 ||
snānaṃ śaucaṃ tathā gānaṃ rodanaṃ hasanaṃ tathā  |
yānamabhyañjanaṃ nārī dyūtaṃ caivānulepanam  || 1,89.104 ||
divāsvapnaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā vai dantadhāvanam  |
maithunaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi vācikaṃ devatārcanam  || 1,89.105 ||
varjayetsarvayatnena namaskāraṃ rajasvalā  |
rajasvalāṅganāsparśa saṃbhāṣe ca rajasvalā  || 1,89.106 ||
saṃtyāgaṃ caiva vastrāṇāṃ varjayetsarvayatnataḥ  |
snātvānyapuruṣaṃ nārī na spṛśettu rajasvalā  || 1,89.107 ||
īkṣayedbhāskaraṃ devaṃ brahmakūrcaṃ tataḥ pibet |
kevalaṃ pañcagavyaṃ vā kṣīraṃ vā cātmaśuddhaye  || 1,89.108 ||
caturthyāṃ strī na gamyā tu gato'lpāyuḥ prasūyate  |
vidyāhīnaṃ vratabhraṣṭaṃ patitaṃ pāradārikam  || 1,89.109 ||
dāridryārṇavamagnaṃ ca tanayaṃ sā prasūyate  |
kanyārthinaiva gantavyā pañcamyāṃ vidhivatpunaḥ  || 1,89.110 ||
raktādhikyādbhavennārī śukrādhikye bhavetpumān  |
same napuṃsakaṃ caiva pañcamyāṃ kanyakā bhavet || 1,89.111 ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ gamyā mahābhāgā satputrajananī bhavet |
putratvaṃ vyañjayettasya jātaputro mahādyutiḥ  || 1,89.112 ||
pumiti narakasyākhyā duḥkhaṃ ca narakaṃ viduḥ  |
puṃsastrāṇānvitaṃ putraṃ tathābhūtaṃ prasūyate  || 1,89.113 ||
saptamyāṃ caiva kanyārthī gacchetsaiva prasūyate  |
aṣṭamyāṃ sarvasampannaṃ tanayaṃ samprasūyate  || 1,89.114 ||
navamyāṃ dārikāyārthī daśamyāṃ paṇḍito bhavet |
ekādaśyāṃ tathā nārīṃ janayetsaiva pūrvavat || 1,89.115 ||
dvādaśyāṃ dharmatattvajñaṃ śrautasmārtapravartakam  |
trayodaśyāṃ jaḍāṃ nārīṃ sarvasaṃkarakāriṇīm  || 1,89.116 ||
janayatyaṅganā yasmānna gacchetsarvayatnataḥ  |
caturdaśyāṃ yadā gacchetsā putrajananī bhavet || 1,89.117 ||
pañcadaśyāṃ ca dharmiṣṭhāṃ ṣoḍaśyāṃ jñānapāragam  |
strīṇāṃ vai maithune kāle vāmapārśve prabhañjanaḥ  || 1,89.118 ||
caredyadi bhavennārī pumāṃsaṃ dakṣiṇe labhet |
strīṇāṃ maithunakāle tu pāpagrahavivarjite  || 1,89.119 ||
uktakāle śucirbhūtvā śuddhāṃ gacchecchucismitām  |
ityevaṃ saṃprasaṃgena yatīnāṃ dharmasaṃgrahe  || 1,89.120 ||
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ sadācāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ  |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sadācāraṃ śucirnaraḥ  || 1,89.121 ||
śrāvayedvā yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇān dagdhakilbiṣān  |
brahmalokamanuprāpya brahmaṇā saha modate  || 1,89.122 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge sadācārakathanaṃ nāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 90

sūta uvāca
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatīnāmiha niścitam  |
prāyaścittaṃ śivaproktaṃ yatīnāṃ pāpaśodhanam  || 1,90.1 ||
pāpaṃ hi trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavam  |
satataṃ hi divā rātrau yenedaṃ veṣṭyate jagat || 1,90.2 ||
tatkarmaṇā vināpyeṣa tiṣṭhatīti parā śrutiḥ  |
kṣaṇamevaṃ prayojyaṃ tu āyuṣyaṃ tu vidhāraṇam  || 1,90.3 ||
bhavedyogo'pramattasya yogo hi paramaṃ balam  |
na hi yogātparaṃ kiṃcinnarāṇāṃ dṛśyate śubham  || 1,90.4 ||
tasmādyogaṃ praśaṃsanti dharmayuktā manīṣiṇaḥ  |
avidyāṃ vidyayā jitvā prāpyaiśvaryamanuttamam  || 1,90.5 ||
dṛṣṭvā parāvaraṃ dhīrāḥ paraṃ gacchanti tatpadam  |
vratāni yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ tathaivopavratāni ca  || 1,90.6 ||
ekaikātikrame teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate  |
upetya tu striyaṃ kāmātprāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet || 1,90.7 ||
prāṇāyāmasamāyuktaṃ caretsāṃtapanaṃ vratam  |
tataścarati nirdeśātkṛcchraṃ cānte samāhitaḥ  || 1,90.8 ||
punarāśramamāgatya caredbhikṣuratandritaḥ  |
na dharmayuktamanṛtaṃ hinastīti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 1,90.9 ||
tathāpi na ca kartavyaṃ prasaṃgo hyeṣa dāruṇaḥ  |
ahorātropavāsaśca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā  || 1,90.10 ||
asadvādo na kartavyo yatinā dharmalipsunā  |
paramāpadgatenāpi na kāryaṃ steyamapyuta  || 1,90.11 ||
<importance of possession>
steyādabhyadhikaḥ kaścinnāstyadharma iti śrutiḥ  |
hiṃsā hyeṣā parā sṛṣṭā stainyaṃ vai kathitaṃ tathā  || 1,90.12 ||
yadetaddraviṇaṃ nāma prāṇā hyete bahiścarāḥ  |
sa tasya harate prāṇān yo yasya harate dhanam  || 1,90.13 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā suduṣṭātmā bhinnavṛtto vratāccyutaḥ  |
bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścareccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam  || 1,90.14 ||
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena saṃvatsaramiti śrutiḥ  |
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte bhūyaḥ prakṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ  |
punarnirvedamāpannaścaredbhikṣuratandritaḥ  || 1,90.15 ||
ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāṃ karmaṇā manasā girā  |
akāmādapi hiṃseta yadi bhikṣuḥ paśūn kṛmīn  || 1,90.16 ||
kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ kurvīta cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā  |
skandedindriyadaurbalyātstriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatiryadi  || 1,90.17 ||
tena dhārayitavyā vai prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa  |
divā skannasya viprasya prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate  || 1,90.18 ||
trirātramupavāsāśca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā  |
rātrau skannaḥ śuciḥ snātvā dvādaśaiva tu dhāraṇā  || 1,90.19 ||
prāṇāyāmena śuddhātmā virajā jāyate dvijāḥ  |
ekānnaṃ madhumāṃsaṃ vā aśṛtānnaṃ tathaiva ca  || 1,90.20 ||
abhojyāni yatīnāṃ tu pratyakṣalavaṇāni ca  |
ekaikātikramātteṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate  || 1,90.21 ||
prājāpatyena kṛcchreṇa tataḥ pāpātpramucyate  |
vyatikramāśca ye kecidvāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavāḥ  || 1,90.22 ||
sadbhiḥ saha viniścitya yadbrūyustatsamācaret || 1,90.23 ||
careddhi śuddhaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ samastabhūteṣu ca satsamāhitaḥ  |
sthānaṃ dhruvaṃ śāśvatamavyayaṃ tu paraṃ hi gatvā na punarhi jāyate  || 1,90.24 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge yatiprāyaścittaṃ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 91

sūta uvāca
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi ariṣṭāni nibodhata  |
yena jñānaviśeṣeṇa mṛtyuṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ  || 1,91.1 ||
arundhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva somachāyāṃ mahāpatham  |
yo na paśyenna jīvetsa naraḥ saṃvatsarātparam  || 1,91.2 ||
ariśmavantamādityaṃ raśmivantaṃ ca pāvakam  |
yaḥ paśyati na jīvedvai māsādekādaśātparam  || 1,91.3 ||
vamenmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā  |
pratyakṣamathavā svapne daśamāsānna jīvati  || 1,91.4 ||
rukmavarṇaṃ drumaṃ paśyedgandharvanagarāṇi ca  |
paśyetpretapiśācāṃśca navamāsān sa jīvati  || 1,91.5 ||
akasmācca bhavetsthūlo hyakasmācca kṛśo bhavet |
prakṛteśca nivarteta cāṣṭau māsāṃśca jīvati  || 1,91.6 ||
agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi khaṇḍaṃ yasya padaṃ bhavet |
pāṃsuke kardame vāpi saptamāsānsa jīvati  || 1,91.7 ||
kākaḥ kapoto gṛdhro vā nilīyedyasya mūrdhani  |
kravyādo vā khago yasya ṣaṇmāsānnātivartate  || 1,91.8 ||
gacchedvāyasapaṅktībhiḥ pāṃsuvarṣeṇa vā punaḥ  |
svacchāyāṃ vikṛtāṃ paśyeccatuḥpañca sa jīvati  || 1,91.9 ||
anabhre vidyutaṃ paśyeddakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitām  |
udake dhanuraindraṃ vā trīṇi dvau vā sa jīvati  || 1,91.10 ||
apsu vā yadi vādarśe yo hyātmānaṃ na paśyati  |
aśiraskaṃ tathā paśyenmāsādūrdhvaṃ na jīvati  || 1,91.11 ||
śavagandhi bhavedgātraṃ vasāgandhamathāpi vā  |
mṛtyurhyupāgatastasya ardhamāsānna jīvati  || 1,91.12 ||
yasya vai snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ pariśuṣyati  |
dhūmaṃ vā mastakātpaśyeddaśāhānna sa jīvati  || 1,91.13 ||
saṃbhinno māruto yasya marmasthānāni kṛntati  |
adbhiḥ spṛṣṭo na hṛṣyeta tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ  || 1,91.14 ||
ṛkṣavānarayuktena rathenāśāṃ ca dakṣiṇām  |
gāyannṛtyan vrajetsvapne vidyānmṛtyurupasthitaḥ  || 1,91.15 ||
kṛṣṇāṃbaradharā śyāmā gāyantī vāpyathāṅganā  |
yaṃ nayeddakṣiṇāmāśāṃ svapne so'pi na jīvati  || 1,91.16 ||
chidraṃ vā svasya kaṇṭhasya svapne yo vīkṣate naraḥ  |
nagnaṃ vā śramaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyānmṛtyumupasthitam  || 1,91.17 ||
ā mastakatalādyastu nimajjetpaṅkasāgare  |
dṛṣṭvā tu tādṛśaṃ svapnaṃ sadya eva na jīvati  || 1,91.18 ||
bhasmāṅgārāṃśca keśāṃśca nadīṃ śuṣkāṃ bhujaṅgamān  |
paśyedyo daśarātraṃ tu na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ  || 1,91.19 ||
kṛṣṇaiśca vikaṭaiścaiva puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ  |
pāṣāṇaistāḍyate svapne yaḥ sadyo na sa jīvati  || 1,91.20 ||
sūryodaye pratyuṣasi pratyakṣaṃ yasya vai śivāḥ  |
krośantyabhimukhaṃ pretya sa gatāyurbhavennaraḥ  || 1,91.21 ||
yasya vā snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate bhṛśam  |
jāyate dantaharṣaśca taṃ gatāyuṣamādiśet || 1,91.22 ||
bhūyobhūyastrasedyastu rātrau vā yadi vā divā  |
dīpagandhaṃ ca nāghrāti vidyānmṛtyumupasthitam  || 1,91.23 ||
rātrau cendradhanuḥ paśyeddivā nakṣatramaṇḍalam  |
paranetreṣu cātmānaṃ na paśyenna sa jīvati  || 1,91.24 ||
netramekaṃ sravedyasya karṇau sthānācca bhraśyataḥ  |
vakrā ca nāsā bhavati vijñeyo gatajīvitaḥ  || 1,91.25 ||
yasya kṛṣṇā kharā jihvā padmābhāsaṃ ca vai mukham  |
gaṇḍe vā piṇḍikārakte tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ  || 1,91.26 ||
muktakeśo hasaṃścaiva gāyannṛtyaṃśca yo naraḥ  |
yāmyāmabhimukhaṃ gacchettadantaṃ tasya jīvitam  || 1,91.27 ||
yasya śvetaghanābhāsā śvetasarṣapasaṃnibhā  |
śvetā ca mūrtirhyasakṛttasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ  || 1,91.28 ||
uṣṭrā vā rāsabhā vābhi yuktāḥ svapne rathe śubhāḥ  |
yasya so'pi na jīvettu dakṣiṇābhimukho gataḥ  || 1,91.29 ||
dve vātha parame'riṣṭe ekībhūtaḥ paraṃ bhavet |
ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇuyātkarṇe jyotirnetre na paśyati  || 1,91.30 ||
śvabhre yo nipatetsvapne dvāraṃ cāpi pidhīyate  |
na cottiṣṭhati yaḥ śvabhrāttadantaṃ tasya jīvitam  || 1,91.31 ||
ūrdhvā ca dṛṣṭirna ca sampratiṣṭhā raktā punaḥ samparivartamānā  |*
mukhasya śoṣaḥ suṣirā ca nābhiratyuṣṇamūtro viṣamastha eva  || 1,91.32 ||*
divā vā yadi vā rātrau pratyakṣaṃ yo nihanyate  |
hantāraṃ na ca paśyecca sa gatāyurna jīvati  || 1,91.33 ||
agnipraveśaṃ kurute svapnānte yastu mānavaḥ  |
smṛtiṃ nopalabheccāpi tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam  || 1,91.34 ||
yastu prāvaraṇaṃ śuklaṃ svakaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ  |
kṛṣṇaṃ raktamapi svapne tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ  || 1,91.35 ||
<preparation fordeath>
ariṣṭe sūcite dehe tasminkāla upasthite  |
tyaktvā khedaṃ viṣādaṃ ca upekṣedbuddhimānnaraḥ  || 1,91.36 ||
prācīṃ vā yadi vodīcīṃ diśaṃ niṣkramya vai śuciḥ  |
same'tisthāvare deśe vivikte jantuvarjite  || 1,91.37 ||
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā svasthaścācānta eva ca  |
svastikenopaviṣṭastu namaskṛtvā maheśvaram  || 1,91.38 ||
samakāyaśirogrīvo dhārayannāvalokayet |
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā  || 1,91.39 ||
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe tathā yuñjīta śāstravit |
kāmaṃ vitarkaṃ prītiṃ ca sukhaduḥkhe ubhe tathā  || 1,91.40 ||
nigṛhya manasā sarvaṃ śuklaṃ dhyānamanusmaret |
ghrāṇe ca rasane nityaṃ cakṣuṣī sparśane tathā  || 1,91.41 ||
śrotre manasi buddhau ca tatra vakṣasi dhārayet |
kālakarmāṇi vijñāya samūheṣveva nityaśaḥ  || 1,91.42 ||
dvādaśādhyātmamityevaṃ yogadhāraṇamucyate  |
śatamardhaśataṃ vāpi dhāraṇāṃ mūrdhni dhārayet || 1,91.43 ||
khinnasya dhāraṇāyogādvāyurūrdhvaṃ pravartate  |
tataścāpūrayeddehamoṅkāreṇa samanvitaḥ  || 1,91.44 ||
tathauṃkāramayo yogī akṣare tvakṣarī bhavet |
<oṃkāra>
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi oṅkāraprāptilakṣaṇam  || 1,91.45 ||
eṣa trimātro vijñeyo vyañjanaṃ cātra ceśvaraḥ  |
prathamā vidyutī mātrā dvitīyā tāmasī smṛtā  || 1,91.46 ||
tṛtīyāṃ nirguṇāṃ caiva mātrāmakṣaragāminīm  |
gāndhārī caiva vijñeyā gāndhārasvarasaṃbhavā  || 1,91.47 ||
pipīlikāgatisparśā prayuktā mūrdhni lakṣyate  |
yathā prayukta oṅkāraḥ pratiniryāti mūrdhani  || 1,91.48 ||
tathauṃkāramayo yogī tvakṣarī tvakṣarī bhavet |
praṇavo dhanuḥ śaro hyātmā brahmalakṣaṇamucyate  || 1,91.49 ||
apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravattanmayo bhavet |
omityekākṣaraṃ hyetadguhāyāṃ nihitaṃ padam  || 1,91.50 ||
omityetattrayo lokāstrayo vedāstrayo'gnayaḥ  |
viṣṇukramāstrayastvete ṛksāmāni yajūṃṣi ca  || 1,91.51 ||
mātrā cārdhaṃ ca tisrastu vijñeyāḥ paramārthataḥ  |
tatprayuktastu yo yogī tasya sālokyamāpnuyāt || 1,91.52 ||
akāro hyakṣaro jñeya ukāraḥ sahitaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
makārasahitauṃkārastrimātra iti saṃjñitaḥ  || 1,91.53 ||
akārastveṣa bhūrloka ukāro bhuva ucyate  |
savyañjano makārastu svarloka iti gīyate  || 1,91.54 ||
oṅkārastu trayo lokāḥ śirastasya triviṣṭapam  |
bhuvanāṅgaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṃ tatpadamucyate  || 1,91.55 ||
mātrāpādo rudraloko hyamātraṃ tu śivaṃ padam  |
evaṃ jñānaviśeṣeṇa tatpadaṃ samupāsyate  || 1,91.56 ||
tasmāddhyānaratirnityamamātraṃ hi tadakṣaram  |
upāsyaṃ hi prayatnena śāśvataṃ sukhamicchatā  || 1,91.57 ||
hrasvā tu prathamā mātrā tato dīrghā tvanantaram  |
tataḥ plutavatī caiva tṛtīyā copadiśyate  || 1,91.58 ||
etāstu mātrā vijñeyā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ  |
yāvadeva tu śakyante dhāryante tāvadeva hi  || 1,91.59 ||
indriyāṇi mano buddhiṃ dhyāyannātmani yaḥ sadā  |
ardhaṃ tanmātramapi cecchṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt || 1,91.60 ||
māse māse'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ  |
tena yatprāpyate puṇyaṃ mātrayā tadavāpnuyāt || 1,91.61 ||
na tathā tapasogreṇa na yajñairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ  |
yatphalaṃ prāpyate samyaṅmātrayā tadavāpnuyāt || 1,91.62 ||
tatra caiṣā tu yā mātrā plutā nāmopadiśyate  |
eṣā eva bhavetkāryā gṛhasthānāṃ tu yoginām  || 1,91.63 ||
eṣāṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa aiśvarye hyaṣṭalakṣaṇe  |
aṇimādye tu vijñeyā tasmādyuñjīta tāṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,91.64 ||
evaṃ hi yogasaṃyuktaḥ śucirdānto jitendriyaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ vidyate yastu sa sarvaṃ vindate dvijāḥ  || 1,91.65 ||
tasmātpāśupatairyogairātmānaṃ cintayedbudhaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ jānate ye tu śucayaste na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,91.66 ||
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni vedopaniṣadastathā  |
yogajñānādavāpnoti brāhmaṇo'dhyātmacintakaḥ  || 1,91.67 ||
sarvadevamayo bhūtvā abhūtaḥ sa tu jāyate  |
yonisaṃkramaṇaṃ tyaktvā yāti vai śāśvataṃ padam  || 1,91.68 ||
yathā vṛkṣātphalaṃ pakvaṃ pavanena samīritam  |
namaskāreṇa rudrasya tathā pāpaṃ praṇaśyati  || 1,91.69 ||
yatra rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvaḥ  |
anyadevanamaskārānna tatphalamavāpnuyāt || 1,91.70 ||
tasmāttriḥpravaṇaṃ yogī upāsīta maheśvaram  |
daśavistārakaṃ brahma tathā ca brahmavistaraiḥ  || 1,91.71 ||
evaṃ dhyānasamāyuktaḥ svadehaṃ yaḥ parityajet |
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ samuddhṛtya kulatrayam  || 1,91.72 ||
athavāriṣṭamālokya maraṇe samupasthite  |
avimukteśvaraṃ gatvā vārāṇasyāṃ tu śodhanam  || 1,91.73 ||
yena kenāpi vā dehaṃ saṃtyajenmucyate naraḥ  |
śrīparvate vā viprendrāḥ saṃtyajetsvatanuṃ naraḥ  || 1,91.74 ||
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  |
avimuktaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ jantūnāṃ muktidaṃ sadā  || 1,91.75 ||
seveta satataṃ dhīmān viśeṣānmaraṇāntike  || 1,91.76 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ariṣṭakathanaṃ nāma ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 92

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
evaṃ vārāṇasī puṇyā yadi sūta mahāmate  |
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ tatprabhāvaṃ hi sāṃpratam  || 1,92.1 ||
kṣetrasyāsya ca māhātmyamavimuktasya śobhanam  |
vistareṇa yathānyāyaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 1,92.2 ||

sūta uvāca
<descriptionof āvimukta>
vakṣye saṃkṣepataḥ samyakvārāṇasyāḥ suśobhanam  |
avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ yathāha bhagavān bhavaḥ  || 1,92.3 ||
vistareṇa mayā vaktuṃ brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā  |
śakyate naiva viprendrā varṣakoṭiśatairapi  || 1,92.4 ||
devaḥ purā kṛtodvāhaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ  |
himavacchikharāddevyā haimavatyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ  || 1,92.5 ||
vārāṇasīmanuprāpya darśayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ  |
avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ vāsaṃ tatra cakāra saḥ  || 1,92.6 ||
vārāṇasīkurukṣetra śrīparvatamahālaye  |
tuṅgeśvare ca kedāre tatsthāne yo yatirbhavet || 1,92.7 ||
yoge pāśupate samyakdinamekaṃ yatirbhavet |
tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya caretpāśupataṃ vratam  || 1,92.8 ||
devodyāne vasettatra śarvodyānamanuttamam  |
manasā nirmame rudro vimānaṃ ca suśobhanam  || 1,92.9 ||
darśayāmāsa ca tadā devodyānamanuttamam  |
haimavatyāḥ svayaṃ devaḥ sanandī parameśvaraḥ  || 1,92.10 ||
kṣetrasyāsya ca māhātmyamavimuktasya śaṅkaraḥ  |
uktavānparameśānaḥ pārvatyāḥ prītaye bhavaḥ  || 1,92.11 ||
praphullanānāvidhagulmaśobhitaṃ latāpratānādimanoharaṃ bahiḥ  |
virūḍhapuṣpaiḥ paritaḥ priyaṅgubhiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ kaṇṭakitaiśca ketakaiḥ  || 1,92.12 ||
tamālagulmairnicitaṃ sugandhibhirnikāmapuṣpairvakulaiśca sarvataḥ  |
aśokapunnāgaśataiḥ supuṣpitairdvirephamālākulapuṣpasaṃcayaiḥ  || 1,92.13 ||
kvacitpraphullāmbujareṇubhūṣitairvihaṅgamaiścānukalapraṇādibhiḥ  |
vināditaṃ sārasacakravākaiḥ pramattadātyūhavaraiśca sarvataḥ  || 1,92.14 ||
kvacicca kekārutanāditaṃ śubhaṃ kvacicca kāraṇḍavanādanāditam  |
kvacicca mattālikulākulīkṛtaṃ madākulābhirbhramarāṅganādibhiḥ  || 1,92.15 ||
niṣevitaṃ cārusugandhipuṣpakaiḥ kvacitsupuṣpaiḥ sahakāravṛkṣaiḥ  |
latopagūḍhaistilakaiśca gūḍhaṃ pragītavidyādharasiddhacāraṇam  || 1,92.16 ||
pravṛttanṛttānugatāpsarogaṇaṃ prahṛṣṭanānāvidhapakṣisevitam  |
pranṛttahārītakulopanāditaṃ mṛgendranādākulamattamānasaiḥ  || 1,92.17 ||
kvacitkvacidgandhakadambakairmṛgairvilūnadarbhāṅkurapuṣpasaṃcayam  |
praphullanānāvidhacārupaṅkajaiḥ sarastaḍāgairupaśobhitaṃ kvacit || 1,92.18 ||
viṭapanicayalīnaṃ nīlakaṇṭhābhirāmaṃ madamuditavihaṅgaṃ prāptanādābhirāmam  |
kusumitataruśākhālīnamattadvirephaṃ navakisalayaśobhāśobhitaṃ prāṃśuśākham  || 1,92.19 ||
kvacicca dantakṣatacāruvīrudhaṃ kvacillatāliṅgitacāruvṛkṣakam  |*
kvacidvilāsālasagāminībhirniṣevitaṃ kiṃpuruṣāṅganābhiḥ  || 1,92.20 ||*
pārāvatadhvanivikūjitacāruśṛṅgairabhraṅkaṣaiḥ sitamanoharacārurūpaiḥ  |
ākīrṇapuṣpanikarapravibhaktahaṃsairvibhrājitaṃ tridaśadivyakulairanekaiḥ  || 1,92.21 ||
phullotpalāṃbujavitānasahasrayuktaṃ toyāśayaiḥ samanuśobhitadevamārgam  |
mārgāntarākalitapuṣpavicitrapaṅkti sambaddhagulmaviṭapairvividhairupetam  || 1,92.22 ||
tuṅgāgrairnīlapuṣpastabakabharanataprāṃśuśākhairaśokairdolāprāntāntanīlaśrutisukhajanakairbhāsitāntaṃ manojñaiḥ  |
rātrau candrasya bhāsā kusumitatilakairekatāṃ samprayātaṃ chāyāsuptaprabuddhasthitahariṇakulāluptadūrvāṅkurāgram  || 1,92.23 ||
haṃsānāṃ pakṣavātapracalitakamalasvacchavistīrṇatoyaṃ toyānāṃ tīrajātapracakitakadalīcāṭunṛtyanmayūram  |
māyūraiḥ pakṣacandraiḥ kvacidavanigatai rañjitakṣmāpradeśaṃ deśe deśe vilīnapramuditavilasanmattahārītavṛndam  || 1,92.24 ||
sāraṅgaiḥ kvacidupaśobhitapradeśaṃ pracchannaṃ kusumacayaiḥ kvacidvicitraiḥ  |
hṛṣṭābhiḥ kvacidapi kinnarāṅganābhirvīṇābhiḥ sumadhuragītanṛttakaṇṭham  || 1,92.25 ||
saṃsṛṣṭaiḥ kvacidupaliptakīrṇapuṣpairāvāsaiḥ parivṛtapādapaṃ munīnām  |
ā mūlātphalanicitaiḥ kvacidviśālairuttuṅgaiḥ panasamahīruhairupetam  || 1,92.26 ||
phullātimuktakalatāgṛhanītasiddhasiddhāṅganākanakanūpurarāvaramyam  |*
ramyaṃ priyaṅgutarumañjarisaktabhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgāvalīkavalitāmrakadambapuṣpam  || 1,92.27 ||*
puṣpotkarānilavighūrṇitavāriramyaṃ ramyadvirephavinipātitamañjugulmam  |
gulmāntaraprasabhabhītamṛgīsamūhaṃ vāteritaṃ tanubhṛtāmapavargadātṛ  || 1,92.28 ||
candrāṃśujālaśabalaistilakairmanojñaiḥ sindūrakuṅkumakusumbhanibhairaśokaiḥ  |
cāmīkaradyutisamairatha karṇikāraiḥ puṣpotkarairupacitaṃ suviśālaśākhaiḥ  || 1,92.29 ||
kvacidañjanacūrṇābhaiḥ kvacidvidrumasannibhaiḥ  |
kvacitkāñcanasaṃkāśaiḥ puṣpairācitabhūtalam  || 1,92.30 ||
punnāgeṣu dvijaśatavirutaṃ raktāśokastabakabharanatam  |
ramyopāntaklamahārabhavanaṃ phullābjeṣu bhramaravilasitam  || 1,92.31 ||
sakalabhuvanabhartā lokanāthastadānīṃ tuhinaśikharaputryā sārdhamiṣṭairgaṇeśaiḥ  |
vividhataruviśālaṃ mattahṛṣṭānnapuṣṭairupavanamatiramyaṃ darśayāmāsa devyāḥ  || 1,92.32 ||
puṣpairvanyaiḥ śubhaśubhatamaiḥ kalpitairdivyabhūṣairdevīṃ divyāmupavanagatāṃ bhūṣayāmāsa śarvaḥ  |
sā cāpyenaṃ tuhinagirisutā śaṅkaraṃ devadevaṃ puṣpairdivyaiḥ śubhataratamairbhūṣayāmāsa bhaktyā  || 1,92.33 ||
sampūjya pūjyaṃ tridaśeśvarāṇāṃ samprekṣya codyānamatīva ramyam  |
gaṇeśvarairnandimukhaiśca sārdhamuvāca devaṃ praṇipatya devī  || 1,92.34 ||

śrīdevyuvāca
udyānaṃ darśitaṃ deva prabhayā parayā yutam  |
kṣetrasya ca guṇānsarvān punarme vaktumarhasi  || 1,92.35 ||
asya kṣetrasya māhātmyamavimuktasya sarvathā  |
vaktumarhasi deveśa devadeva vṛṣadhvaja  || 1,92.36 ||

sūta uvāca
devyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo varaprabhuḥ  |
āghrāya vadanāmbhojaṃ tadāha girijāṃ hasan  || 1,92.37 ||
<holinessof āvimukta>

śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ sadā vārāṇasī mama  |
sarveṣāmeva jantūnāṃ heturmokṣasya sarvadā  || 1,92.38 ||
asminsiddhāḥ sadā devi madīyaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ  |
nānāliṅgadharā nityaṃ mama lokābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ  || 1,92.39 ||
abhyasyanti paraṃ yogaṃ yuktātmāno jitendriyāḥ  |
nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇe nānāvihagaśobhite  || 1,92.40 ||
kamalotpalapuṣpāḍhyaiḥ sarobhiḥ samalaṃkṛte  |
apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ sadā saṃsevite śubhe  || 1,92.41 ||
rocate me sadā vāso yena kāryeṇa tacchṛṇu  |
manmanā mama bhaktaśca mayi nityārpitakriyaḥ  || 1,92.42 ||
yathā mokṣamavāpnoti anyatra na tathā kvacit |
kāmaṃ hyatra mṛto devi janturmokṣāya kalpate  || 1,92.43 ||
etanmama puraṃ divyaṃ guhyādguhyatamaṃ mahat |
brahmādayo vijānanti ye ca siddhā mumukṣavaḥ  || 1,92.44 ||
ataḥ paramidaṃ kṣetraṃ parā ceyaṃ gatirmama  |
vimuktaṃ na mayā yasmānmokṣyate vā kadācana  || 1,92.45 ||
mama kṣetramidaṃ tasmādavimuktamiti smṛtam  |
naimiṣe ca kurukṣetre gaṅgādvāre ca puṣkare  || 1,92.46 ||
snānātsaṃsevanādvāpi na mokṣaḥ prāpyate yataḥ  |
iha samprāpyate yena tata etadviśiṣyate  || 1,92.47 ||
prayāge vā bhavenmokṣa iha vā matparigrahāt |
prayāgādapi tīrthāgryādavimuktamidaṃ śubham  || 1,92.48 ||
dharmasyopaniṣatsatyaṃ mokṣasyopaniṣacchamaḥ  |
kṣetratīrthopaniṣadaṃ na vidurbudhasattamāḥ  || 1,92.49 ||
kāmaṃ bhuñjan svapan krīḍan kurvan hi vividhāḥ kriyāḥ  |
avimukte tyajetprāṇān janturmokṣāya kalpate  || 1,92.50 ||
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi piśācatvaṃ varaṃ nṛṇām  |
na tu śakrasahasratvaṃ svarge kāśīpurīṃ vinā  || 1,92.51 ||
tasmātsaṃsevanīyaṃ hi avimuktaṃ hi muktaye  |
jaigīṣavyaḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ gato yatra mahātapāḥ  || 1,92.52 ||
asya kṣetrasya māhātmyādbhaktyā ca mama bhāvitaḥ  |
jaigīṣavyaguhā śreṣṭhā yogināṃ sthānamiṣyate  || 1,92.53 ||
dhyāyantastatra māṃ nityaṃ yogāgnirdīpyate bhṛśam  |
kaivalyaṃ paramaṃ yāti devānāmapi durlabham  || 1,92.54 ||
avyaktaliṅgairmunibhiḥ sarvasiddhāntavedibhiḥ  |
iha samprāpyate mokṣo durlabho'nyatra karhicit || 1,92.55 ||
tebhyaścāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaiśvaryamanuttamam  |
ātmanaścaiva sāyujyamīpsitaṃ sthānameva ca  || 1,92.56 ||
kubero'tra mama kṣetre mayi sarvārpitakriyaḥ  |
kṣetrasaṃsevanādeva gaṇeśatvamavāpa ha  || 1,92.57 ||
saṃvarto bhavitā yaśca so'pi bhakto mamaiva tu  |
ihaivārādhya māṃ devi siddhiṃ yāsyatyanuttamām  || 1,92.58 ||
parāśarasutau yogī ṛṣirvyāso mahātapāḥ  |
mama bhakto bhaviṣyaśca vedasaṃsthāpravartakaḥ  || 1,92.59 ||
raṃsyate so'pi padmākṣi kṣetre'sminmunipuṅgavaḥ  |
brahmā devarṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ viṣṇurvāpi divākaraḥ  || 1,92.60 ||
devarājastathā śakro ye'pi cānye divaukasaḥ  |
upāsate mahātmānaḥ sarve māmiha suvrate  || 1,92.61 ||
anye'pi yogino divyāśchannarūpā mahātmanaḥ  |
ananyamanaso bhūtvā māmihopāsate sadā  || 1,92.62 ||
viṣayāsaktacitto'pi tyaktadharmaratirnaraḥ  |
iha kṣetre mṛtaḥ so'pi saṃsāre na punarbhavet || 1,92.63 ||
ye punarnirmamā dhīrāḥ sattvasthā vijitendriyāḥ  |
vratinaśca nirārambhāḥ sarve te mayi bhāvitāḥ  || 1,92.64 ||
devadevaṃ samāsādya dhīmantaḥ saṃgavarjitāḥ  |
gatā iha paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādānmama suvrate  || 1,92.65 ||
janmāntarasahasreṣu yaṃ na yogī samāpnuyāt |
tamihaiva paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādānmama suvrate  || 1,92.66 ||
goprekṣakamidaṃ kṣetraṃ brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ purā  |
kailāsabhavanaṃ cātra paśya divyaṃ varānane  || 1,92.67 ||
goprekṣakamathāgamya dṛṣṭvā māmatra mānavaḥ  |
na durgatimavāpnoti kalmaṣaiśca vimucyate  || 1,92.68 ||
kapilāhradamityevaṃ tathā vai brahmaṇā kṛtam  |
gavāṃ stanyajatoyena tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ mahat || 1,92.69 ||
atrāpi svayamevāhaṃ vṛṣadhvaja iti smṛtaḥ  |
sānnidhyaṃ kṛtavān devi sadāhaṃ dṛśyate tvayā  || 1,92.70 ||
bhadratoyaṃ ca paśyeha brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ hradam  |
sarvairdevairahaṃ devi asmindeśe prasāditaḥ  || 1,92.71 ||
gacchopaśamamīśeti upaśāntaḥ śivastathā  |
atrāhaṃ brahmaṇānīya sthāpitaḥ parameṣṭhinā  || 1,92.72 ||
brahmaṇā cāpi saṃgṛhya viṣṇunā sthāpitaḥ punaḥ  |
brahmaṇāpi tato viṣṇuḥ proktaḥ saṃvignacetasā  || 1,92.73 ||
mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmātsthāpitavānasi  |
tamuvāca punarviṣṇurbrahmāṇaṃ kupitānanam  || 1,92.74 ||
rudre deve mamātyantaṃ parā bhaktirmahattarā  |
mayaiva sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati  || 1,92.75 ||
hiraṇyagarbha ityevaṃ tato'trāhaṃ samāsthitaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvainamapi deveśaṃ mama lokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  || 1,92.76 ||
tataḥ punarapi brahmā mama liṅgamidaṃ śubham  |
sthāpayāmāsa vidhivadbhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ  || 1,92.77 ||
svarlīneśvara ityevamatrāhaṃ svayamāgataḥ  |
prāṇāniha narastyaktvā na punarjāyate kvacit || 1,92.78 ||
ananyā sā gatistasya yogināṃ caiva yā smṛtā  |
<Vyāghreśvara>
asminnapi mayā deśe daityo daivatakaṇṭakaḥ  || 1,92.79 ||
vyāghrarūpaṃ samāsthāya nihato darpito balī  |
vyāghreśvara iti khyāto nityamatrāhamāsthitaḥ  || 1,92.80 ||
na punardurgatiṃ yāti dṛṣṭvainaṃ vyāghramīśvaram  |
utpalo vidalaścaiva yau daityau brahmaṇā purā  || 1,92.81 ||
strīvadhyau darpitau dṛṣṭvā tvayaiva nihatau raṇe  |
sāvajñaṃ kandukenātra tasyedaṃ dehamāsthitam  || 1,92.82 ||
ādāvatrāhamāgamya prasthito gaṇapaiḥ saha  |
jyeṣṭhasthānamidaṃ tasmādetanme puṇyadarśanam  || 1,92.83 ||
devaiḥ samantādetāni liṅgāni sthāpitānyataḥ  |
dṛṣṭvāpi niyato martyo dehabhede gaṇo bhavet || 1,92.84 ||
pitrā te śailarājena purā himavatā svayam  |
mama priyahitaṃ sthānaṃ jñātvā liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  || 1,92.85 ||
śaileśvaramiti khyātaṃ dṛśyatāmiha cādarāt |
dṛṣṭvaitanmanujo devi na durgatimato vrajet || 1,92.86 ||
nadyeṣā varuṇā devi puṇyā pāpapramocanī  |
kṣetrametadalaṃkṛtya jāhnavyā saha saṃgatā  || 1,92.87 ||
sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā cāpi saṃgame liṅgamuttamam  |
saṃgameśvaramityevaṃ khyātaṃ jagati dṛśyatām  || 1,92.88 ||
saṃgame devanadyā hi yaḥ snātvā manujaḥ śuciḥ  |
arcayetsaṃgameśvaraṃ tasya janmabhayaṃ kutaḥ  || 1,92.89 ||
idaṃ manye mahākṣetraṃ nivāso yogināṃ param  |
kṣetramadhye ca yatrāhaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvāgramāsthitaḥ  || 1,92.90 ||
madhyameśvaramityevaṃ khyātaḥ sarvasurāsuraiḥ  |
siddhānāṃ sthānametaddhi madīyavratadhāriṇām  || 1,92.91 ||
yogināṃ mokṣalipsūnāṃ jñānayogaratātmanām  |
dṛṣṭvainaṃ madhyameśānaṃ janma prati na śocati  || 1,92.92 ||
sthāpitaṃ liṅgametattu śukreṇa bhṛgusūnunā  |
nāmnā śukreśvaraṃ nāma sarvasiddhāmarārcitam  || 1,92.93 ||
dṛṣṭvainaṃ niyataḥ sadyo mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ  |
mṛtaśca na punarjantuḥ saṃsārī tu bhavennaraḥ  || 1,92.94 ||
purā jambūkarūpeṇa asuro devakaṇṭakaḥ  |
brahmaṇo hi varaṃ labdhvā gomāyurbandhaśaṅkitaḥ  || 1,92.95 ||
nihato himavatputri jambūkeśastato hyaham  |
adyāpi jagati khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam  || 1,92.96 ||
dṛṣṭvainamapi deveśaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt |
grahaiḥ śukrapurogaiśca etāni sthāpitāni ha  || 1,92.97 ||
paśya puṇyāni liṅgāni sarvakāmapradāni tu  |
evametāni puṇyāni mannivāsāni pārvati  || 1,92.98 ||
kathitāni mama kṣetre guhyaṃ cānyadidaṃ śṛṇu  |
catuḥkrośaṃ caturdikṣu kṣetrametatprakīrtitam  || 1,92.99 ||
yojanaṃ viddhi cārvaṅgi mṛtyukāle'mṛtapradam  |
mahālayagiristhaṃ māṃ kedāre ca vyavasthitam  || 1,92.100 ||
gaṇatvaṃ labhate dṛṣṭvā hyasminmokṣo hyavāpyate  |
gāṇapatyaṃ labhedyasmādyataḥ sā muktiruttamā  || 1,92.101 ||
tato mahālayāttasmātkedārānmadhyamādapi  |
smṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ kṣetramavimuktaṃ varānane  || 1,92.102 ||
kedāraṃ madhyamaṃ kṣetraṃ sthānaṃ caiva mahālayam  |
mama puṇyāni bhūrloke tebhyaḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ tvidam  || 1,92.103 ||
yataḥ sṛṣṭāstvime lokāstataḥ kṣetramidaṃ śubham  |
kadācinna mayā muktamavimuktaṃ tato'bhavat || 1,92.104 ||
avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ mama dṛṣṭveha mānavaḥ  |
sadyaḥ pāpavinirmuktaḥ paśupāśairvimucyate  || 1,92.105 ||
śaileśaṃ saṃgameśaṃ ca svarlīnaṃ madhyameśvaram  |
hiraṇyagarbhamīśānaṃ goprekṣaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam  || 1,92.106 ||
upaśāntaṃ śivaṃ caiva jyeṣṭhasthānanivāsinam  |
śukreśvaraṃ ca vikhyātaṃ vyāghreśaṃ jambukeśvaram  || 1,92.107 ||
dṛṣṭvā na jāyate martyaḥ saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare  |

sūta uvāca
evamuktvā mahādevo diśaḥ sarvā vyalokayat || 1,92.108 ||
vilokya saṃsthite paścāddevadeve maheśvare  |
akasmādabhavatsarvaḥ sa deśojjvalito yathā  || 1,92.109 ||
tataḥ pāśupatāḥ siddhā bhasmābhyaṅgasitaprabhāḥ  |
māheśvarā mahātmānastathā vai niyatavratāḥ  || 1,92.110 ||
bahavaḥ śataśo'bhyetya namaścakrurmaheśvaram  |
punarnirīkṣya yogeśaṃ dhyānayogaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 1,92.111 ||
tasthurātmānamāsthāya līyamānā iveśvare  |
sthitānāṃ sa tadā teṣāṃ devadeva umāpatiḥ  || 1,92.112 ||
sa bibhratparamāṃ mūrtiṃ babhūva puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ  |
kṛtsnaṃ jagadihaikasthaṃ kartumanta iva sthitaḥ  || 1,92.113 ||
tasya tāṃ paramāṃ mūrtimāsthitasya jagatprabhoḥ  |
na śaśāka punardraṣṭuṃ hṛṣṭaromā girīndrajā  || 1,92.114 ||
tatastvadṛṣṭamākāraṃ buddhvā sā prakṛtisthitam  |
prakṛtermūrtimāsthāya yogena parameśvarī  || 1,92.115 ||
taṃ śaśāka punardraṣṭuṃ harasya ca mahātmanaḥ  |
tataste layamādhāya yoginaḥ puruṣasya tu  || 1,92.116 ||
viviśurhṛdayaṃ sarve dagdhasaṃsārabījinaḥ  |
pañcākṣarasya vai bījaṃ saṃsmarantaḥ suśobhanam  || 1,92.117 ||
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ purā caiva prakāśitam  |
nīlalohitamūrtisthaṃ punaścakre vapuḥ śubham  || 1,92.118 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śailajā prāha hṛṣṭasarvatanūruhā  |
stuvatī caraṇau natvā ka ime bhagavanniti  || 1,92.119 ||
tāmuvāca suraśreṣṭhastadā devīṃ girīndrajām  |

śrībhagavānuvāca
madīyaṃ vratamāśritya bhaktimadbhirdvijottamaiḥ  || 1,92.120 ||
yairyairyogā ihābhyastāsteṣāmekena janmanā  |
kṣetrasyāsya prabhāvena bhaktyā ca mama bhāmini  || 1,92.121 ||
anugraho mayā hyevaṃ kriyate mūrtitaḥ svayam  |
tasmādetanmahatkṣetraṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevitaṃ tathā  || 1,92.122 ||
śrutimadbhiśca viprendraiḥ saṃsiddhaiśca tapasvibhiḥ  |
pratimāsaṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pratimāsaṃ caturdaśīm  || 1,92.123 ||
ubhayoḥ pakṣayordevi vārāṇasyāmupāsyate  |
śaśibhānūparāge ca kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  || 1,92.124 ||
sarvaparvasu puṇyeṣu viṣuveṣvayaneṣu ca  |
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni vārāṇasyāṃ tu jāhnavīm  || 1,92.125 ||
uttarapravahāṃ puṇyāṃ mama mauliviniḥsṛtām  |
pituste girirājasya śubhāṃ himavataḥ sutām  || 1,92.126 ||
puṇyasthānasthitāṃ puṇyāṃ puṇyadikpravahāṃ sadā  |
bhajante sarvato'bhyetya ye tāñchṛṇu varānane  || 1,92.127 ||
saṃnihatya kurukṣetraṃ sārdhaṃ tīrthaśataistathā  |
puṣkaraṃ nimiṣaṃ caiva prayāgaṃ ca pṛthūdakam  || 1,92.128 ||
drumakṣetraṃ kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthasaṃyutam  |
kṣetrāṇi sarvato devi devatā ṛṣayastathā  || 1,92.129 ||
saṃdhyā ca ṛtavaścaiva sarvā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca  |
samudrāḥ sapta caivātra devatīrthāni kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 1,92.130 ||
bhāgīrathīṃ sameṣyanti sarvaparvasu suvrate  |
avimukteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā caiva triviṣṭapam  || 1,92.131 ||
kālabhairavamāsādya dhūtapāpāni sarvaśaḥ  |
bhavanti hi sureśāni sarvaparvasu parvasu  || 1,92.132 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni puṇyāni mahāntyāyatanāni ca  |
praviśanti sadābhyetya puṇyaṃ parvasu parvasu  |
avimuktaṃ kṣetravaraṃ mahāpāpanibarhaṇam  || 1,92.133 ||
kedāre caiva yalliṅgaṃ yacca liṅgaṃ mahālaye  || 1,92.134 ||
madhyameśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca tathā pāśupateśvaram  |
śaṅkukarṇeśvaraṃ caiva gokarṇau ca tathā hyubhau  || 1,92.135 ||
drumacaṇḍeśvaraṃ nāma bhadreśvaramanuttamam  |
sthāneśvaraṃ tathaikāgraṃ kāleśvaramajeśvaram  || 1,92.136 ||
bhairaveśvaramīśānaṃ tathauṃkārakasaṃjñitam  |
amareśaṃ mahākālaṃ jyotiṣaṃ bhasmagātrakam  || 1,92.137 ||
yāni cānyāni puṇyāni sthānāni mama bhūtale  |
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisamākhyāni rūḍhānyanyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 1,92.138 ||
tāni sarvāṇyaśeṣāṇi vārāṇasyāṃ viśanti mām  |
sarvaparvasu puṇyeṣu guhyaṃ caitadudāhṛtam  || 1,92.139 ||
teneha labhate janturmṛto divyāmṛtaṃ padam  |
snātasya caiva gaṅgāyāṃ dṛṣṭena ca mayā śubhe  || 1,92.140 ||
sarvayajñaphalaistulyamiṣṭaiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ  |
sadya eva samāpnoti kiṃ tataḥ paramādbhutam  || 1,92.141 ||
sarvāyatanamukhyāni divi bhūmau giriṣvapi  |
parātparataraṃ devī budhyasveti mayoditam  || 1,92.142 ||
aviśabdena pāpastu vedoktaḥ kathyate dvijaiḥ  |
tena muktaṃ mayā juṣṭamavimuktamata ucyate  || 1,92.143 ||
ityuktvā bhagavān rudraḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ  |
sudṛṣṭaṃ kuru deveśi avimuktaṃ gṛhaṃ mama  || 1,92.144 ||
<śrīśaila>
ityuktvā bhagavān devastayā sārdhamumāpatiḥ  |
darśayāmāsa bhagavān śrīparvatamanuttamam  || 1,92.145 ||
avimukteśvare nityamavasacca sadā tayā  |
sarvagatvācca sarvatvātsarvātmā sadasanmayaḥ  || 1,92.146 ||
śrīparvatamanuprāpya devyā deveśvaro haraḥ  |
kṣetrāṇi darśayāmāsa sarvabhūtapatirbhavaḥ  || 1,92.147 ||
kuṇḍīprabhaṃ ca paramaṃ divyaṃ vaiśravaṇeśvaram  |
āśāliṅgaṃ ca deveśaṃ divyaṃ yacca bileśvaram  || 1,92.148 ||
rāmeśvaraṃ ca paramaṃ viṣṇunā yatpratiṣṭhitam  |
dakṣiṇadvārapārśve tu kuṇḍaleśvaramīśvaram  || 1,92.149 ||
pūrvadvārasamīpasthaṃ tripurāntakamuttamam  |
vivṛddhaṃ giriṇā sārdhaṃ devadevanamaskṛtam  || 1,92.150 ||
madhyameśvaramityuktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam  |
amareśvaraṃ ca varadaṃ devaiḥ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  || 1,92.151 ||
gocarmeśvaramīśānaṃ tathendreśvaramadbhutam  |
karmeśvaraṃ ca vipulaṃ kāryārthaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam  || 1,92.152 ||
śrīmatsiddhavaṭaṃ caiva sadāvāso mamāvyaye  |
ajena nirmitaṃ divyaṃ sākṣādajabilaṃ śubham  || 1,92.153 ||
tatraiva pāduke divye madīye ca bileśvare  |
tatra śṛṅgāṭakākāraṃ śṛṅgāṭācalamadhyame  || 1,92.154 ||
śṛṅgāṭakeśvaraṃ nāma śrīdevyā tu pratiṣṭhitam  |
mallikārjunakaṃ caiva mama vāsamidaṃ śubham  || 1,92.155 ||
rajeśvaraṃ ca paryāye rajasā supratiṣṭhitam  |
gajeśvaraṃ ca vaiśākhaṃ kapoteśvaramavyayam  || 1,92.156 ||
koṭīśvaraṃ mahātīrthaṃ rudrakoṭigaṇaiḥ purā  |
sevitaṃ devi paśyādya sarvasmādadhikaṃ śubham  || 1,92.157 ||
dvidevakulasaṃjñaṃ ca brahmaṇā dakṣiṇe śubham  |
uttare sthāpitaṃ caiva viṣṇunā caiva śailajam  || 1,92.158 ||
mahāpramāṇaliṅgaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  |
paścime parvate paśya brahmeśvaramaleśvaram  || 1,92.159 ||
alaṃkṛtaṃ tvayā brahman purastānmunibhiḥ saha  |
ityuktvā tadgṛhe tiṣṭhadalaṃgṛhamiti smṛtam  || 1,92.160 ||
tatrāpi tīrthaṃ tīrthajñe vyomaliṅgaṃ ca paśya me  |
kadambeśvarametaddhi skandenaiva pratiṣṭhitam  || 1,92.161 ||
gomaṇḍaleśvaraṃ caiva nandādyaiḥ supratiṣṭhitam  |
devaiḥ sarvaistu śakrādyaiḥ sthāpitāni varānane  || 1,92.162 ||
śrīmaddevahradaprānte sthānānīmāni paśya me  |
tathā hārapure devi tava hāre nipātite  || 1,92.163 ||
tvayā hitāya jagatāṃ hārakuṇḍamidaṃ kṛtam  |
śivarudrapure caiva tatkāyopari suvrate  || 1,92.164 ||
tatra pitrā suśailena sthāpitaṃ tvacaleśvaram  |
alaṃkṛtaṃ mayā brahma purastānmunibhiḥ saha  || 1,92.165 ||
caṇḍikeśvarakaṃ devi caṇḍikeśā tavātmajā  |
caṇḍikānirmitaṃ sthānamaṃbikātīrthamuttamam  || 1,92.166 ||
rucikeśvarakaṃ caiva dhāraiṣā kapilā śubhā  |
eteṣu devi sthāneṣu tīrtheṣu vividheṣu ca  || 1,92.167 ||
pūjayenmāṃ sadā bhaktyā mayā sārdhaṃ hi modate  |
śrīśaile saṃtyajeddehaṃ brāhmaṇo dagdhakilbiṣaḥ  || 1,92.168 ||
mucyate nātra saṃdeho hyavimukte yathā śubham  |
mahāsnānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādghṛtena vidhinaiva tu  || 1,92.169 ||
sa yāti mama sāyujyaṃ sthāneṣveteṣu suvrate  |
snānaṃ palaśataṃ jñeyamabhyaṅgaṃ pañcaviṃśati  || 1,92.170 ||
palānāṃ dve sahasre tu mahāsnānaṃ prakīrtitam  |
snāpya liṅgaṃ madīyaṃ tu gavyenaiva ghṛtena ca  || 1,92.171 ||
viśodhya sarvadravyaistu vāribhirabhiṣiñcati  |
saṃmārjya śatayajñānāṃ snānena prayutaṃ tathā  || 1,92.172 ||
pūjayā śatasāhasramanantaṃ gītavādinām  |
mahāsnāne prasaktaṃ tu snānamaṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam  || 1,92.173 ||
jalena kevalenaiva gandhatoyena bhaktitaḥ  |
anulepanaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ pañcaviṃśatpalena vai  || 1,92.174 ||
śamīpuṣpaṃ ca vidhinā bilvapatraṃ ca paṅkajam  |
anyānyapi ca puṣpāṇi bilvapatraṃ na saṃtyajet || 1,92.175 ||
caturdroṇairmahādevamaṣṭadroṇairathāpi vā  |
daśadroṇaistu naivedyamaṣṭadroṇairathāpi vā  || 1,92.176 ||
śatadroṇasamaṃ puṇyamāḍhake'pi vidhīyate  |
vittahīnasya viprasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 1,92.177 ||
bherīmṛdaṅgamuraja timirāpaṭahādibhiḥ  |
vāditrairvividhaiścānyairninādairvividhairapi  || 1,92.178 ||
jāgaraṃ kārayedyastu prārthayecca yathākramam  |
sa bhṛtyaputradāraiśca tathā saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ  || 1,92.179 ||
sārdhaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prārthayelliṅgamuttamam  |
dravyahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ sureśvara  || 1,92.180 ||
kṛtaṃ vā na kṛtaṃ vāpi kṣantumarhasi śaṅkara  |
ityuktvā vai japedrudraṃ tvaritaṃ śāntimeva ca  || 1,92.181 ||
japitvaivaṃ mahābījaṃ tathā pañcākṣarasya vai  |
sa evaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam  || 1,92.182 ||
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vārāṇasyāṃ yathā mṛtaḥ  |
tathaiva mama sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 1,92.183 ||
matpriyārthamidaṃ kāryaṃ madbhaktairvidhipūrvakam  |
ye na kurvanti te bhaktā na bhavanti na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,92.184 ||

sūta uvāca
niśamya vacanaṃ devī gatvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm  |
avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ payasā ca ghṛtena ca  || 1,92.185 ||
arcayāmāsa deveśaṃ rudraṃ bhuvananāyakam  |
avimukte ca tapasā mandarasya mahātmanaḥ  || 1,92.186 ||
kalpayāmāsa vai kṣetraṃ mandare cārukandare  |
tatrāndhakaṃ mahādaityaṃ hiraṇyākṣasutaṃ prabhuḥ  || 1,92.187 ||
anugṛhya gaṇatvaṃ ca prāpayāmāsa līlayā  |
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kathāsarvasvamādarāt || 1,92.188 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam  |
sarvakṣetreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ sahasā labhet || 1,92.189 ||
śrāvayedvā dvijānsarvān kṛtaśaucān jitendriyān  |
sa eva sarvayajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 1,92.190 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vārāṇasīśrīśailamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 93

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
andhako nāma daityendro mandare cārukandare  |
damitastu kathaṃ lebhe gāṇapatyaṃ maheśvarāt || 1,93.1 ||
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam  |

sūta uvāca
andhakānugrahaṃ caiva mandare śoṣaṇaṃ tathā  || 1,93.2 ||
varalābhamaśeṣaṃ ca pravadāmi samāsataḥ  |
hiraṇyākṣasya tanayo hiraṇyanayanopamaḥ  || 1,93.3 ||
purāndhaka iti khyātastapasā labdhavikramaḥ  |
prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ sākṣādavadhyatvamavāpya ca  || 1,93.4 ||
trailokyamakhilaṃ bhuktvā jitvā cendrapuraṃ purā  |
līlayā cāprayatnena trāsayāmāsa vāsavam  || 1,93.5 ||
bādhitāstāḍitā baddhāḥ pātitāstena te surāḥ  |
viviśurmandaraṃ bhītā nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ  || 1,93.6 ||
evaṃ saṃpīḍya vai devānandhako'pi mahāsuraḥ  |
yadṛcchayā giriṃ prāpto mandaraṃ cārukandaram  || 1,93.7 ||
tataste samastāḥ surendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sureśaṃ maheśaṃ puretyāhurevam  |
drutaṃ cālpavīryaprabhinnāṅgabhinnā vayaṃ daityarājasya śastrairnikṛttāḥ  || 1,93.8 ||
itīdamakhilaṃ śrutvā daityāgamamanaupamam  |
gaṇeśvaraiśca bhagavānandhakābhimukhaṃ yayau  || 1,93.9 ||
tatrendrapadmodbhavaviṣṇumukhyāḥ sureśvarā vipravarāśca sarve  |*
jayeti vācā bhagavantamūcuḥ kirīṭabaddhāñjalayaḥ samantāt || 1,93.10 ||*
athāśeṣāsurāṃstasya koṭikoṭiśataistataḥ  |
bhasmīkṛtya mahādevo nirbibhedāndhakaṃ tadā  || 1,93.11 ||
śūlena śūlinā protaṃ dagdhakalmaṣakañcukam  |
dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ nanādeśaṃ praṇamya sa pitāmahaḥ  || 1,93.12 ||
tannādaśravaṇānnedurdevā devaṃ praṇamya tam  |
nanṛturmunayaḥ sarve mumudurgaṇapuṅgavāḥ  || 1,93.13 ||
sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi devāḥ śaṃbhostadopari  |
trailokyamakhilaṃ harṣānnananda ca nanāda ca  || 1,93.14 ||
dagdho'gninā ca śūlena protaḥ preta ivāndhakaḥ  |
sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāsthāya cintayāmāsa cetasā  || 1,93.15 ||
janmāntare'pi devena dagdho yasmācchivena vai  |
ārādhito mayā śaṃbhuḥ purā sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ  || 1,93.16 ||
tasmādetanmayā labdhamanyathā nopapadyate  |
yaḥ smarenmanasā rudraṃ prāṇānte sakṛdeva vā  || 1,93.17 ||
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ kiṃ punarbahuśaḥ smaran  |
brahmā ca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ  || 1,93.18 ||
śaraṇaṃ prāpya tiṣṭhanti tameva śaraṇaṃ vrajet |
evaṃ saṃcintya tuṣṭātmā so'ndhakaścāndhakārdanam  || 1,93.19 ||
sagaṇaṃ śivamīśānamastuvatpuṇyagauravāt |
prārthitastena bhagavān paramārtiharo haraḥ  || 1,93.20 ||
hiraṇyanetratanayaṃ śūlāgrasthaṃ sureśvaraḥ  |
provāca dānavaṃ prekṣya ghṛṇayā nīlalohitaḥ  || 1,93.21 ||
tuṣṭo'smi vatsa bhadraṃ te kāmaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te  |
varānvaraya daityendra varado'haṃ tavāndhaka  || 1,93.22 ||
śrutvā vākyaṃ tadā śaṃbhorhiraṇyanayanātmajaḥ  |
harṣagadgadayā vācā provācedaṃ maheśvaram  || 1,93.23 ||
bhagavandevadeveśa bhaktārtihara śaṅkara  |
