tvayi bhaktiḥ prasīdeśa yadi deyo varaśca me  || 1,93.24 ||
śrutvā bhavo'pi vacanamandhakasya mahātmanaḥ  |
pradadau durlabhāṃ śraddhāṃ daityendrāya mahādyutiḥ  || 1,93.25 ||
gāṇapatyaṃ ca daityāya pradadau cāvaropya tam  |
praṇemustaṃ surendrādyā gāṇapatye pratiṣṭhitam  || 1,93.26 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge andhakagāṇapatyātmako nāma trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 94

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathamasya pitā daityo hiraṇyākṣaḥ sudāruṇaḥ  |
viṣṇunā sūdito viṣṇurvārāhatvaṃ kathaṃ gataḥ  || 1,94.1 ||
tasya śṛṅgaṃ maheśasya bhūṣaṇatvaṃ kathaṃ gatam  |
etatsarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa sūta vaktumihārhasi  || 1,94.2 ||

sūta uvāca
hiraṇyakaśiporbhrātā hiraṇyākṣa iti smṛtaḥ  |
purāndhakāsureśasya pitā kālāntakopamaḥ  || 1,94.3 ||
devāñjitvātha daityendro baddhvā ca dharaṇīmimām  |
nītvā rasātalaṃ cakre vandīmindīvaraprabhām  || 1,94.4 ||
tataḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ  |
bādhitāstāḍitā baddhvā hiraṇyākṣeṇa tena vai  || 1,94.5 ||
balinā daityamukhyena krūreṇa sudurātmanā  |
praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ daityakoṭivimardanam  || 1,94.6 ||
sarve vijñāpayāmāsurdharaṇībandhanaṃ hareḥ  |
śrutvaitadbhagavān viṣṇurdharaṇībandhanaṃ hariḥ  || 1,94.7 ||
bhūtvā yajñavarāho'sau yathā liṅgodbhave tathā  |
daityaiśca sārdhaṃ daityendraṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam  || 1,94.8 ||
daṃṣṭrāgrakoṭyā hatvainaṃ reje daityāntakṛtprabhuḥ  |
kalpādiṣu yathāpūrvaṃ praviśya ca rasātalam  || 1,94.9 ||
ānīya vasudhāṃ devīmaṅkasthāmakarodbahiḥ  |
tatastuṣṭāva deveśaṃ devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 1,94.10 ||
śakrādyaiḥ sahito bhūtvā harṣagadgadayā girā  |
śāśvatāya varāhāya daṃṣṭriṇe daṇḍine namaḥ  || 1,94.11 ||
nārāyaṇāya sarvāya brahmaṇe paramātmane  |
kartre dhartre dharāyāstu hartre devāriṇāṃ svayam  |
kartre netre surendrāṇāṃ śāstre ca sakalasya ca  || 1,94.12 ||
tvamaṣṭamūrtistvamanantamūrtistvamādidevastvamanantaveditaḥ  |
tvayā kṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ prasīda sureśa lokeśa varāha viṣṇo  || 1,94.13 ||
tathaikadaṃṣṭrāgramukhāgrakoṭi bhāgaikabhāgārdhatamena viṣṇo  |
hatāḥ kṣaṇātkāmada daityamukhyāḥ svadaṃṣṭrakoṭyā saha putrabhṛtyaiḥ  || 1,94.14 ||
tvayoddhṛtā deva dharā dhareśa dharādharākāra dhṛtāgradaṃṣṭre  |
dharādharaiḥ sarvajanaiḥ samudraiḥ surāsuraiḥ sevitacandravaktra  || 1,94.15 ||
tvayaiva deveśa vibho kṛtaśca jayaḥ surāṇāmasureśvarāṇām  |
aho pradattastu varaḥ prasīda vāgdevatā vārijasaṃbhavāya  || 1,94.16 ||
tava romṇi sakalāmareśvarānayanadvaye śaśiravī padadvaye  |*
nihitā rasātalagatā vasuṃdharā tava pṛṣṭhataḥ sakalatārakādayaḥ  || 1,94.17 ||*
jagatāṃ hitāya bhavatā vasuṃdharā bhagavan rasātalapuṭaṃ gatā tadā  |
abaloddhṛtā ca bhagavaṃstavaiva sakalaṃ tvayaiva hi dhṛtaṃ jagadguro  || 1,94.18 ||
iti vākpatirbahuvidhaistavārcanaiḥ praṇipatya viṣṇumamaraiḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
vividhānvarān harimukhāttu labdhavān harinābhivārijadehabhṛtsvayam  || 1,94.19 ||
atha tāmuddhṛtāṃ tena dharāṃ devā munīśvarāḥ  |
mūrdhnyāropya namaścakruścakriṇaḥ saṃnidhau tadā  || 1,94.20 ||
anenaiva varāheṇa coddhṛtāsi varaprade  |
kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakāryeṇa śatahastena viṣṇunā  || 1,94.21 ||
dharaṇi tvaṃ mahābhoge bhūmistvaṃ dhenuravyaye  |
lokānāṃ dhāriṇī tvaṃ hi mṛttike hara pātakam  || 1,94.22 ||
manasā karmaṇā vācā varade vārijekṣaṇe  |
tvayā hatena pāpena jīvāmastvatprasādataḥ  || 1,94.23 ||
ityuktā sā tadā devī dharā devairathābravīt |
varāhadaṃṣṭrābhinnāyāṃ dharāyāṃ mṛttikāṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,94.24 ||
mantreṇānena yo bibhratmūrdhni pāpātpramucyate  |
āyuṣmān balavān dhanyaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ  || 1,94.25 ||
kramādbhuvi divaṃ prāpya karmānte modate suraiḥ  |
atha deve gate tyaktvā varāhe kṣīrasāgaram  || 1,94.26 ||
vārāharūpamanaghaṃ cacāla ca dharā punaḥ  |
tasya daṃṣṭrābharākrāntā devadevasya dhīmataḥ  || 1,94.27 ||
yadṛcchayā bhavaḥ paśyan jagāma jagadīśvaraḥ  |
daṃṣṭrāṃ jagrāha dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhūṣaṇārthamathātmanaḥ  || 1,94.28 ||
dadhāra ca mahādevaḥ kūrcānte vai mahorasi  |
devāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ sendrā devadevasya vaibhavam  || 1,94.29 ||
dharā pratiṣṭhitā hyevaṃ devadevena līlayā  |
bhūtānāṃ saṃplave cāpi viṣṇoścaiva kalevaram  || 1,94.30 ||
brahmaṇaśca tathānyeṣāṃ devānāmapi līlayā  |
vibhuraṅgavibhāgena bhūṣito na yadi prabhuḥ  || 1,94.31 ||
kathaṃ vimuktirviprāṇāṃ tasmāddaṃṣṭrī maheśvaraḥ  || 1,94.32 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge varāhaprādurbhāvo nāma caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 95

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
nṛsiṃhena hataḥ pūrvaṃ hiraṇyākṣāgrajaḥ śrutam  |
kathaṃ niṣūditastena hiraṇyakaśipurvada  || 1,95.1 ||

sūta uvāca
<Viṣṇu transformsinto ṇṛsiṃha andkillsḥiraṇyakaśipu>
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahrāda iti viśrutaḥ  |
dharmajñaḥ satyasampannastapasvī cābhavatsudhīḥ  || 1,95.2 ||
janmaprabhṛti deveśaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāvyayam  |
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadevabhavodbhavam  || 1,95.3 ||
tamādipuruṣaṃ bhaktyā parabrahmasvarūpiṇam  |
brahmaṇo'dhipatiṃ sṛṣṭi sthitisaṃhārakāraṇam  || 1,95.4 ||
so'pi viṣṇostathābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ samāhitam  |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti govindeti muhurmuhuḥ  || 1,95.5 ||
stuvantaṃ prāha devāriḥ pradahanniva pāpadhīḥ  |
na māṃ jānāsi durbuddhe sarvadaityāmareśvaram  || 1,95.6 ||
prahrāda vīra duṣputra dvijadevārtikāraṇam  |
ko viṣṇuḥ padmajo vāpi śakraśca varuṇo'thavā  || 1,95.7 ||
vāyuḥ somastatheśānaḥ pāvako mama yaḥ samaḥ  |
māmevārcaya bhaktyā ca svalpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sadā  || 1,95.8 ||
prahrāda jīvite vāñchā tavaiṣā śṛṇu cāsti cet |
śrutvāpi tasya vacanaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sudhīḥ  || 1,95.9 ||
prahrādaḥ pūjayāmāsa namo nārāyaṇeti ca  |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti sarvadaityakumārakān  || 1,95.10 ||
adhyāpayāmāsa ca tāṃ brahmavidyāṃ suśobhanām  |
durlaṅghyāṃ cātmano dṛṣṭvā śakrādibhirapi svayam  || 1,95.11 ||
putreṇa laṅghitāmājñāṃ hiraṇyaḥ prāha dānavān  |
etaṃ nānāvidhairvadhyaṃ duṣputraṃ hantumarhatha  || 1,95.12 ||
evamuktāstadā tena daityena sudurātmanā  |
nijaghnurdevadevasya bhṛtyaṃ prahrādamavyayam  || 1,95.13 ||
tatra tatpratikṛtaṃ tadā surairdaityarājatanayaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
kṣīravārinidhiśāyinaḥ prabhorniṣphalaṃ tvatha babhūva tejasā  || 1,95.14 ||
tadātha garvabhinnasya hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prabhuḥ  |
tatraivāvirabhūddhantuṃ nṛsiṃhākṛtimāsthitaḥ  || 1,95.15 ||
jaghāna ca sutaṃ prekṣya pitaraṃ dānavādhamam  |
bibheda tatkṣaṇādeva karajairniśitaiḥ śataiḥ  || 1,95.16 ||
tato nihatya taṃ daityaṃ sabāndhavamaghāpahaḥ  |
pīḍayāmāsa daityendraṃ yugāntāgnirivāparaḥ  || 1,95.17 ||
nādaistasya nṛsiṃhasya ghorairvitrāsitaṃ jagat |
ā brahmabhuvanādviprāḥ pracacāla ca suvratāḥ  || 1,95.18 ||
dṛṣṭvā surāsuramahoragasiddhasādhyāstasmin kṣaṇe hariviriñcimukhā nṛsiṃham  |
dhairyaṃ balaṃ ca samavāpya yayurvisṛjya ā diṅmukhāntamasurakṣaṇatatparāśca  || 1,95.19 ||
tatastairgataiḥ saiṣa devo nṛsiṃhaḥ sahasrākṛtiḥ sarvapātsarvabāhuḥ  |
sahasrekṣaṇaḥ somasūryāgninetrastadā saṃsthitaḥ sarvamāvṛtya māyī  || 1,95.20 ||
taṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ suraśreṣṭhā lokā lokācale sthitāḥ  |
sabrahmakāḥ sasādhyāśca sayamāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ  || 1,95.21 ||
parātparataraṃ brahma tattvāttattvatamaṃ bhavān  |
jyotiṣāṃ tu paraṃ jyotiḥ paramātmā jaganmayaḥ  || 1,95.22 ||
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ susūkṣmaṃ ca śabdabrahmamayaḥ śubhaḥ  |
vāgatīto nirālaṃbo nirdvandvo nirupaplavaḥ  || 1,95.23 ||
yajñabhugyajñamūrtistvaṃ yajñināṃ phaladaḥ prabhuḥ  |
bhavānmatsyākṛtiḥ kaurmamāsthāya jagati sthitaḥ  || 1,95.24 ||
vārāhīṃ caiva tāṃ saiṃhīmāsthāyehavyavasthitaḥ  |
devānāṃ devarakṣārthaṃ nihatya ditijeśvaram  || 1,95.25 ||
dvijaśāpacchalenaivamavatīrṇo'si līlayā  |
na dṛṣṭaṃ yattvadanyaṃ hi bhavān sarvaṃ carācaram  || 1,95.26 ||
bhavānviṣṇurbhavān rudro bhavāneva pitāmahaḥ  |
bhavānādirbhavānanto bhavāneva vayaṃ vibho  || 1,95.27 ||
bhavāneva jagatsarvaṃ pralāpena kimīśvara  |
māyayā bahudhā saṃsthamadvitīyamayaṃ prabho  || 1,95.28 ||
stoṣyāmastvāṃ kathaṃ bhāsi devadeva mṛgādhipa  |
stuto'pi vividhaiḥ stutyairbhāvairnānāvidhaiḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,95.29 ||
na jagāma dvijāḥ śāntiṃ mānayanyonimātmanaḥ  |
yo nṛsiṃhastavaṃ bhaktyā paṭhedvārthaṃ vicārayet || 1,95.30 ||
śrāvayedvā dvijānsarvān viṣṇuloke mahīyate  |
<devastake refuge to śiva>
tadantare śivaṃ devāḥ sendrāḥ sabrahmakāḥ prabhum  || 1,95.31 ||
samprāpya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvaṃ vijñāpya mṛgarūpiṇaḥ  |
tato brahmādayastūrṇaṃ saṃstūya parameśvaram  || 1,95.32 ||
ātmatrāṇāya śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ paramakāraṇam  |
mandarasthaṃ mahādevaṃ krīḍamānaṃ sahomayā  || 1,95.33 ||
sevitaṃ gaṇagandharvaiḥ siddhairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ  |
devatābhiḥ saha brahmā bhītabhītaḥ sagadgadam  |
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau tuṣṭāva parameśvaram  || 1,95.34 ||

brahmovāca
namaste kālakālāya namaste rudra manyave  |
namaḥ śivāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te  || 1,95.35 ||
ugro'si sarvabhūtānāṃ niyantāsi śivo'si naḥ  |
namaḥ śivāya śarvāya śaṅkarāyārttihāriṇe  || 1,95.36 ||
mayaskarāya viśvāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe namaḥ  |
antakāya namastubhyamumāyāḥ pataye namaḥ  || 1,95.37 ||
hiraṇyabāhave sākṣāddhiraṇyapataye namaḥ  |
śarvāya sarvarūpāya puruṣāya namonamaḥ  || 1,95.38 ||
sadasadvyaktihīnāya mahataḥ kāraṇāya te  |
nityāya viśvarūpāya jāyamānāya te namaḥ  || 1,95.39 ||
jātāya bahudhā loke prabhūtāya namonamaḥ  |
rudrāya nīlarudrāya kadrudrāya pracetase  || 1,95.40 ||
kālāya kālarūpāya namaḥ kālāṅgahāriṇe  |
mīḍhuṣṭamāya devāya śitikaṇṭhāya te namaḥ  || 1,95.41 ||
mahīyase namastubhyaṃ hantre devāriṇāṃ sadā  |
tārāya ca sutārāya tāraṇāya namonamaḥ  || 1,95.42 ||
harikeśāya devāya śaṃbhave paramātmane  |
devānāṃ śaṃbhave tubhyaṃ bhūtānāṃ śaṃbhave namaḥ  || 1,95.43 ||
śambhave haimavatyāśca manyave rudrarūpiṇe  |
kapardine namastubhyaṃ kālakaṇṭhāya te namaḥ  || 1,95.44 ||
hiraṇyāya maheśāya śrīkaṇṭhāya namonamaḥ  |
bhasmadigdhaśarīrāya daṇḍamuṇḍīśvarāya ca  || 1,95.45 ||
namo hrasvāya dīrghāya vāmanāya namonamaḥ  |
nama ugratriśūlāya ugrāya ca namo namaḥ  || 1,95.46 ||
bhīmāya bhīmarūpāya bhīmakarmaratāya te  |
agrevadhāya vai bhūtvā namo dūrevadhāya ca  || 1,95.47 ||
dhanvine śūline tubhyaṃ gadine haline namaḥ  |
cakriṇe varmiṇe nityaṃ daityānāṃ karmabhedine  || 1,95.48 ||
sadyāya sadyarūpāya sadyojātāya te namaḥ  |
vāmāya vāmarūpāya vāmanetrāya te namaḥ  || 1,95.49 ||
aghorarūpāya vikaṭāya vikaṭaśarīrāya te namaḥ  |*
puruṣarūpāya puruṣaikatatpuruṣāya vai namaḥ  || 1,95.50 ||*
puruṣārthapradānāya pataye parameṣṭhine  |
īśānāya namastubhyamīśvarāya namonamaḥ  || 1,95.51 ||
brahmaṇe brahmarūpāya namaḥ sākṣācchivāya te  |
sarvaviṣṇurnṛsiṃhasya rūpamāsthāya viśvakṛt || 1,95.52 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā karajairniśitaiḥ svayam  |
daityendrairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ hitārthaṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ  || 1,95.53 ||
saiṃhīṃ samānayanyoniṃ bādhate nikhilaṃ jagat |
yatkṛtyamatra deveśa tatkuruṣva bhavāniha  || 1,95.54 ||
ugro'si sarvaduṣṭānāṃ niyantāsi śivo'si naḥ  |
kālakūṭādivapuṣā trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān  || 1,95.55 ||
śukraṃ tu vṛttaṃ viśveśa krīḍā vai kevalaṃ vayam  |
tavonmeṣanimeṣābhyāmasmākaṃ pralayodayau  || 1,95.56 ||
unmīlayettvayi brahman vināśo'sti na te śiva  |
saṃtaptāsmo vayaṃ deva hariṇāmitatejasā  || 1,95.57 ||
sarvalokahitāyainaṃ tattvaṃ saṃhartumicchasi  |

sūta uvāca
vijñāpitastathā devaḥ prahasanprāha tān surān  || 1,95.58 ||
abhayaṃ ca dadau teṣāṃ haniṣyāmīti taṃ prabhuḥ  |
so'pi śakraḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇipatya yathāgatam  || 1,95.59 ||
jagāma bhagavān brahmā tathānye ca surottamāḥ  |
athotthāya mahādevaḥ śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ  || 1,95.60 ||
yayau prānte nṛsiṃhasya garvitasya mṛgāśinaḥ  |
apahṛtya tadā prāṇān śarabhaḥ surapūjitaḥ  || 1,95.61 ||
siṃhāttato naro bhūtvā jagāma ca yathākramam  |
evaṃ stutastadā devairjagāma sa yathākramam  || 1,95.62 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi saṃstavaṃ śārvamuttamam  |
rudralokamanuprāpya rudreṇa saha modate  || 1,95.63 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge nārasiṃhe pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 96

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ devo mahādevo viśvasaṃhārakārakaḥ  |
śarabhākhyaṃ mahāghoraṃ vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ  || 1,96.1 ||
kiṃ kiṃ dhairyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ  |

sūta uvāca
evamabhyarthito devairmatiṃ cakre kṛpālayaḥ  || 1,96.2 ||
yattejastu nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ saṃhartuṃ parameśvaraḥ  |
tadarthaṃ smṛtavān rudro vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam  || 1,96.3 ||
<Bhairava (description)>
ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ mahāpralayakārakam  |
ājagāma purā sadyo gaṇānāmagrato hasan  || 1,96.4 ||
sāṭṭahāsairgaṇavarairutpatadbhiritastataḥ  |
nṛsiṃharūpairatyugraiḥ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ  || 1,96.5 ||
tāvadbhirabhito vīrairnṛtyadbhiśca mudānvitaiḥ  |
krīḍadbhiśca mahādhīrairbrahmādyaiḥ kandukairiva  || 1,96.6 ||
adṛṣṭapūrvairanyaiśca veṣṭito vīravanditaḥ  |
kalpāntajvalanajvālo vilasallocanatrayaḥ  || 1,96.7 ||
āttaśastro jaṭājūṭe jvaladbālendumaṇḍitaḥ  |
bālendudvitayākāra tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāṅkuradvayaḥ  || 1,96.8 ||
ākhaṇḍaladhanuḥkhaṇḍa saṃnibhabhrūlatāyutaḥ  |
mahāpracaṇḍahuṅkāra badhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ  || 1,96.9 ||
nīlameghāñjanākāra bhīṣaṇaśmaśruradbhutaḥ  |
vādakhaṇḍamakhaṇḍābhyāṃ bhrāmayaṃstriśikhaṃ muhuḥ  || 1,96.10 ||
vīrabhadro'pi bhagavān vīraśaktivijṛmbhitaḥ  |
svayaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa kimatra smṛtikāraṇam  || 1,96.11 ||
ājñāpaya jagatsvāmin prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi  |
<śiva ordersthe destructionof ṇṛsiṃha>

śrībhagavānuvāca
akāle bhayamutpannaṃ devānāmapi bhairava  || 1,96.12 ||
jvalitaḥ sa nṛsiṃhāgniḥ śamayainaṃ durāsadam  |
sāntvayan bodhayādau taṃ tena kiṃ nopaśāmyati  || 1,96.13 ||
tato matparamaṃ bhāvaṃ bhairavaṃ saṃpradarśaya  |
sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmeṇa saṃhṛtya sthūlaṃ sthūlena tejasā  || 1,96.14 ||
vaktramānaya kṛttiṃ ca vīrabhadra mamājñayā  |
ityādiṣṭo gaṇādhyakṣaḥ praśāntavapurāsthitaḥ  || 1,96.15 ||
jagāma raṃhasā tatra yatrāste narakesarī  |
tatastaṃ bodhayāmāsa vīrabhadro haro harim  || 1,96.16 ||
uvāca vākyamīśānaḥ pitā putramivaurasam  |
<discussionof ṇṛsiṃha andVīrabhadra>

śrīvīrabhadra uvāca
jagatsukhāya bhagavannavatīrṇo'si mādhava  || 1,96.17 ||
sthityarthena ca yukto'si pareṇa parameṣṭhinā  |
jantucakraṃ bhagavatā rakṣitaṃ matsyarūpiṇā  || 1,96.18 ||
pucchenaiva samābadhya bhramannekārṇave purā  |
bibharṣi kūrmarūpeṇa vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī  || 1,96.19 ||
anena harirūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ  |
vāmanena balirbaddhastvayā vikramatā punaḥ  || 1,96.20 ||
tvameva sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhāvaḥ prabhuravyayaḥ  |
yadā yadā hi lokasya duḥkhaṃ kiṃcitprajāyate  || 1,96.21 ||
tadā tadāvatīrṇastvaṃ kariṣyasi nirāmayam  |
nādhikastvatsamo'pyasti hare śivaparāyaṇa  || 1,96.22 ||
tvayā dharmāśca vedāśca śubhe mārge pratiṣṭhitāḥ  |
yadarthamavatāro'yaṃ nihataḥ so'pi keśava  || 1,96.23 ||
atyantaghoraṃ bhagavannarasiṃha vapustava  |
upasaṃhara viśvātmaṃstvameva mama saṃnidhau  || 1,96.24 ||

sūta uvāca
ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ śāntayā girā  |
tato'dhikaṃ mahāghoraṃ kopaṃ prajvālayaddhariḥ  || 1,96.25 ||

śrīnṛsiṃha uvāca
āgato'si yatastatra gaccha tvaṃ mā hitaṃ vada  |
idānīṃ saṃhariṣyāmi jagadetaccarācaram  || 1,96.26 ||
saṃharturna hi saṃhāraḥ svato vā parato'pi vā  |
śāsitaṃ mama sarvatra śāstā ko'pi na vidyate  || 1,96.27 ||
matprasādena sakalaṃ samaryādaṃ pravartate  |
ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ  || 1,96.28 ||
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā  |
tattadviddhi gaṇādhyakṣa mama tejovijṛmbhitam  || 1,96.29 ||
devatāparamārthajñā mamaiva paramaṃ viduḥ  |
madaṃśāḥ śaktisampannā brahmaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ  || 1,96.30 ||
mannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ purā brahmā caturmukhaḥ  |
tallalāṭasamutpanno bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  || 1,96.31 ||
rajasādhiṣṭhitaḥ sraṣṭā rudrastāmasa ucyate  |
ahaṃ niyantā sarvasya matparaṃ nāsti daivatam  || 1,96.32 ||
viśvādhikaḥ svatantraśca kartā hartākhileśvaraḥ  |
idaṃ tu matparaṃ tejaḥ kaḥ punaḥ śrotumicchati  || 1,96.33 ||
ato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ  |
avehi paramaṃ bhāvamidaṃ bhūtamaheśvaraḥ  || 1,96.34 ||
kālo'smyahaṃ kālavināśaheturlokān samāhartumahaṃ pravṛttaḥ  |
mṛtyormṛtyuṃ viddhi māṃ vīrabhadra jīvantyete matprasādena devāḥ  || 1,96.35 ||

sūta uvāca
sāhaṅkāramidaṃ śrutvā hareramitavikramaḥ  |
vihasyovāca sāvajñaṃ tato visphuritādharaḥ  || 1,96.36 ||

śrīvīrabhadra uvāca
kiṃ na jānāsi viśveśaṃ saṃhartāraṃ pinākinam  |
asadvādo vivādaśca vināśastvayi kevalaḥ  || 1,96.37 ||
tavānyonyāvatārāṇi kāni śeṣāṇi sāṃpratam  |
kṛtāni yena kenāpi kathāśeṣo bhaviṣyati  || 1,96.38 ||
doṣaṃ tvaṃ paśya etattvamavasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ  |
tena saṃhāradakṣeṇa kṣaṇātsaṃkṣayameṣyasi  || 1,96.39 ||
prakṛtistvaṃ pumān rudrastvayi vīryaṃ samāhitam  |
tvannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 1,96.40 ||
sṛṣṭyarthena jagatpūrvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam  |
lalāṭe cintayāmāsa tapasyugre vyavasthitaḥ  || 1,96.41 ||
tallalāṭādabhūcchaṃbhoḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ tanna dūṣaṇam  |
aṃśo'haṃ devadevasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ  || 1,96.42 ||
tvatsaṃhāre niyukto'smi vinayena balena ca  |
evaṃ rakṣo vidāryaiva tvaṃ śaktikalayā yutaḥ  || 1,96.43 ||
ahaṅkārāvalepena garjasi tvamatandritaḥ  |
upakāro hyasādhūnāmapakārāya kevalam  || 1,96.44 ||
yadi siṃha maheśānaṃ svapunarbhūta manyase  |
na tvaṃ sraṣṭā na saṃhartā na svatantro hi kutracit || 1,96.45 ||
kulālacakravacchaktyā prerito'si pinākinā  |
adyāpi tava nikṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ kūrmarūpiṇaḥ  || 1,96.46 ||
harahāralatāmadhye mugdha kasmānna budhyase  |
vismṛtaṃ kiṃ tadaṃśena daṃṣṭrotpātanapīḍitaḥ  || 1,96.47 ||
vārāhavigrahaste'dya sākrośaṃ tārakāriṇā  |
dagdho'si yasya śūlāgre viṣvaksenacchalādbhavān  || 1,96.48 ||
dakṣayajñe śiraśchinnaṃ mayā te yajñarūpiṇaḥ  |
adyāpi tava putrasya brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ  || 1,96.49 ||
chinnaṃ tamenābhisaṃdhaṃ tadaṃśaṃ tasya tadbalam  |
nirjitastvaṃ dadhīcena saṃgrāme samarudgaṇaḥ  || 1,96.50 ||
kaṇḍūyamāne śirasi kathaṃ tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā  |
cakraṃ vikramato yasya cakrapāṇe tava priyam  || 1,96.51 ||
kutaḥ prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ kena tvayā tadapi vismṛtam  |
te mayā sakalā lokā gṛhītāstvaṃ payonidhau  || 1,96.52 ||
nidrāparavaśaḥ śeṣe sa kathaṃ sāttviko bhavān  |
tvadādistambaparyantaṃ rudraśaktivijṛmbhitam  || 1,96.53 ||
śaktimānabhitastvaṃ ca hyanalastvaṃ ca mohitaḥ  |
tattejaso'pi māhātmyaṃ yuvāṃ draṣṭuṃ na hi kṣamau  || 1,96.54 ||
sthūlā ye hi prapaśyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam  |
dyāvāpṛthivyā indrāgni yamasya varuṇasya ca  || 1,96.55 ||
dhvāntodare śaśāṅkasya janitvā parameśvaraḥ  |
kālo'si tvaṃ mahākālaḥ kālakālo maheśvaraḥ  || 1,96.56 ||
atastvamugrakalayā mṛtyormṛtyurbhaviṣyasi  |
sthiradhanvā kṣayo vīro vīro viśvādhikaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,96.57 ||
upahastā jvaraṃ bhīmo mṛgapakṣihiraṇmayaḥ  |
śāstāśeṣasya jagato na tvaṃ naivacaturmukhaḥ  || 1,96.58 ||
itthaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya saṃharātmānamātmanā  |
no cedidānīṃ krodhasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ  || 1,96.59 ||
vajrāśaniriva sthāṇostvevaṃ mṛtyuḥ patiṣyati  |

sūta uvāca
ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ  || 1,96.60 ||
nanāda tanuvegena taṃ gṛhītuṃ pracakrame  |
atrāntare mahāghoraṃ vipakṣabhayakāraṇam  || 1,96.61 ||
gaganavyāpi durdharṣa śaivatejaḥsamudbhavam  |
vīrabhadrasya tadrūpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva dṛśyate  || 1,96.62 ||
na taddhiraṇmayaṃ saumyaṃ na sauraṃ nāgnisaṃbhavam  |
na taḍiccandrasadṛśamanaupamyaṃ maheśvaram  || 1,96.63 ||
tadā tejāṃsi sarvāṇi tasmin līnāni śāṅkare  |
tato vyakto mahātejā vyakte saṃbhavatastataḥ  || 1,96.64 ||
rudrasādhāraṇaṃ caiva cihnitaṃ vikṛtākṛti  |
tataḥ saṃhārarūpeṇa suvyaktaḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 1,96.65 ||
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ  |
sahasrabāhurjaṭilaścandrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ  || 1,96.66 ||
sa mṛgārdhaśarīreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ cañcunā dvijāḥ  |
atitīkṣṇamahādaṃṣṭro vajratulyanakhāyudhaḥ  || 1,96.67 ||
kaṇṭhe kālo mahābāhuścatuṣpādvahnisaṃbhavaḥ  |
yugāntodyatajīmūta bhīmagaṃbhīraniḥsvanaḥ  || 1,96.68 ||
samaṃ kupitavṛttāgni vyāvṛttanayanatrayaḥ  |
spaṣṭadaṃṣṭro'dharoṣṭhaśca huṅkāreṇa yuto haraḥ  || 1,96.69 ||
<śiva overcomesViṣṇu>
haristaddarśanādeva vinaṣṭabalavikramaḥ  |
bibhradaurmyaṃ sahasrāṃśoradhaḥ khadyotavibhramam  || 1,96.70 ||
atha vibhramya pakṣābhyāṃ nābhipāde'bhyudārayan  |
pādāvābadhya pucchena bāhubhyāṃ bāhumaṇḍalam  || 1,96.71 ||
bhindannurasi bāhubhyāṃ nijagrāha haro harim  |
tato jagāma gaganaṃ devaiḥ saha maharṣibhiḥ  || 1,96.72 ||
sahasaiva bhayādviṣṇuṃ vihagaśca yathoragam  |
utkṣipyotkṣipya saṃgṛhya nipātya ca nipātya ca  || 1,96.73 ||
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya bhagavān pakṣāghātavimohitam  |
hariṃ harantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ viśveśānaṃ tamīśvaram  || 1,96.74 ||
anuyānti surāḥ sarve namovākyena tuṣṭuvuḥ  |
nīyamānaḥ paravaśo dīnavaktraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 1,96.75 ||
tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ haristaṃ lalitākṣaraiḥ  |
<Viṣṇu praisesśiva>

śrīnṛsiṃha uvāca
namo rudrāya śarvāya mahāgrāsāya viṣṇave  || 1,96.76 ||
nama ugrāya bhīmāya namaḥ krodhāya manyave  |
namo bhavāya śarvāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te  || 1,96.77 ||
kālakālāya kālāya mahākālāya mṛtyave  |
vīrāya vīrabhadrāya kṣayadvīrāya śūline  || 1,96.78 ||
mahādevāya mahate paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ  |
ekāya nīlakaṇṭhāya śrīkaṇṭhāya pinākine  || 1,96.79 ||
namo'nantāya sūkṣmāya namaste mṛtyumanyave  |
parāya parameśāya parātparatarāya te  || 1,96.80 ||
parātparāya viśvāya namaste viśvamūrttaye  |
namo viṣṇukalatrāya viṣṇukṣetrāya bhānave  || 1,96.81 ||
kaivartāya kirātāya mahāvyādhāya śāśvate  |
bhairavāya śaraṇyāya mahābhairavarūpiṇe  || 1,96.82 ||
namo nṛsiṃhasaṃhartre kāmakālapurāraye  |
mahāpāśaughasaṃhartre viṣṇumāyāntakāriṇe  || 1,96.83 ||
tryaṃbakāya tryakṣarāya śipiviṣṭāya mīḍhuṣe  |
mṛtyuñjayāya śarvāya sarvajñāya makhāraye  || 1,96.84 ||
makheśāya vareṇyāya namaste vahnirūpiṇe  |
mahāghrāṇāya jihvāya prāṇāpānapravartine  || 1,96.85 ||
triguṇāya triśūlāya guṇātītāya yogine  |
saṃsārāya pravāhāya mahāyantrapravartine  || 1,96.86 ||
namaścandrāgnisūryāya muktivaicitryahetave  |
varadāyāvatārāya sarvakāraṇahetave  || 1,96.87 ||
kapāline karālāya pataye puṇyakīrttaye  |
amoghāyāgninetrāya lakulīśāya śaṃbhave  || 1,96.88 ||
bhiṣaktamāya muṇḍāya daṇḍine yogarūpiṇe  |
meghavāhāya devāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ  || 1,96.89 ||
avyaktāya viśokāya sthirāya sthiradhanvine  |
sthāṇave kṛttivāsāya namaḥ pañcārthahetave  || 1,96.90 ||
varadāyaikapādāya namaścandrārdhamauline  |
namaste'dhvararājāya vayasāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 1,96.91 ||
yogīśvarāya nityāya satyāya parameṣṭhine  |
sarvātmane namastubhyaṃ namaḥ sarveśvarāya te  || 1,96.92 ||
ekadvitricatuḥpañca kṛtvaste'stu namonamaḥ  |
daśakṛtvastu sāhasra kṛtvaste ca namonamaḥ  || 1,96.93 ||
namo'parimitaṃ kṛtvānantakṛtvo namonamaḥ  |
namonamo namo bhūyaḥ punarbhūyo namonamaḥ  || 1,96.94 ||

sūta uvāca
nāmnāmaṣṭaśatenaivaṃ stutvāmṛtamayena tu  |
punastu prārthayāmāsa nṛsiṃhaḥ śarabheśvaram  || 1,96.95 ||
yadā yadā mamājñānamatyahaṅkāradūṣitam  |
tadā tadāpanetavyaṃ tvayaiva parameśvara  || 1,96.96 ||
evaṃ vijñāpayanprītaḥ śaṅkaraṃ narakesarī  |
nanvaśakto bhavān viṣṇo jīvitāntaṃ parājitaḥ  || 1,96.97 ||
tadvaktraśeṣamātrāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvasya vigraham  |
śuktiśityaṃ tadā maṅgaṃ vīrabhadraḥ kṣaṇāttataḥ  || 1,96.98 ||

devā ūcuḥ
atha brahmādayaḥ sarve vīrabhadra tvayā dṛśā  |
jīvitāḥ smo vayaṃ devāḥ parjanyeneva pādapāḥ  || 1,96.99 ||
yasya bhīṣā dahatyagnirudeti ca raviḥ svayam  |
vāto vāti ca so'si tvaṃ mṛtyurdhāvati pañcamaḥ  || 1,96.100 ||
yadavyaktaṃ paraṃ vyoma kalātītaṃ sadāśivam  |
bhagavaṃstvāmeva bhavaṃ vadanti brahmavādinaḥ  || 1,96.101 ||
ke vayameva dhātukye vedane parameśvaraḥ  |
na viddhi paramaṃ dhāma rūpalāvaṇyavarṇane  || 1,96.102 ||
upasargeṣu sarveṣu trāyasvāsmān gaṇādhipa  |
ekādaśātman bhagavān vartate rūpavān haraḥ  || 1,96.103 ||
īdṛśān te'vatārāṇi dṛṣṭvā śiva bahūṃstamaḥ  |
kadācitsaṃdihennāsmāṃstvaccintāstamayā tathā  || 1,96.104 ||
guñjāgirivarataṭāmitarūpāṇi sarvaśaḥ  |
abhyasaṃhara gamyaṃ te na nītavyaṃ parāparā  || 1,96.105 ||
dve tanū tava rudrasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ  |
ghorāpyanyā śivāpyanyā te pratyekamanekadhā  || 1,96.106 ||
ihāsmānpāhi bhagavannityāhatamahābalaḥ  |
bhavatā hi jagatsarvaṃ vyāptaṃ svenaiva tejasā  || 1,96.107 ||
brahmaviṣṇvindracandrādi vayaṃ ca pramukhāḥ surāḥ  |
surāsurāḥ samprasūtāstvattaḥ sarve maheśvara  || 1,96.108 ||
brahmā ca indro viṣṇuśca yamādyā na surāsurān  |
tato nigṛhya ca hariṃ siṃha ityupacetasam  || 1,96.109 ||
yato bibharṣi sakalaṃ vibhajya tanumaṣṭadhā  |
ato'smān pāhi bhagavan surān dānairabhīpsitaiḥ  || 1,96.110 ||
uvāca tān surāndevo maharṣīṃśca purātanān  |
yathā jale jalaṃ kṣiptaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīre ghṛtaṃ ghṛte  || 1,96.111 ||
eka eva tadā viṣṇuḥ śivalīno na cānyathā  |
eṣa eva nṛsiṃhātmā sadarpaśca mahābalaḥ  || 1,96.112 ||
jagatsaṃhārakāreṇa pravṛtto narakesarī  |
yājanīyo namastasmai madbhaktisiddhikāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 1,96.113 ||
etāvaduktvā bhagavān vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ  |
apaśyan sarvabhūtānāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata  || 1,96.114 ||
nṛsiṃhakṛttivasanastadāprabhṛti śaṅkaraḥ  |
vaktraṃ tanmuṇḍamālāyāṃ nāyakatvena kalpitam  || 1,96.115 ||
tato devā nirātaṅkāḥ kīrtayantaḥ kathāmimām  |
vismayotphullanayanā jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam  || 1,96.116 ||
ya idaṃ paramākhyānaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiḥ samanvitam  |
paṭhitvā śṛṇute caiva sarvaduḥkhavināśanam  || 1,96.117 ||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamārogyaṃ puṣṭivardhanam  |
sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam  || 1,96.118 ||
apamṛtyupraśamanaṃ mahāśāntikaraṃ śubham  |
aricakrapraśamanaṃ sarvādhipravināśanam  || 1,96.119 ||
tato duḥsvapnaśamanaṃ sarvabhūtanivāraṇam  |
viṣagrahakṣayakaraṃ putrapautrādivardhanam  || 1,96.120 ||
yogasiddhipradaṃ samyakśivajñānaprakāśakam  |
śeṣalokasya sopānaṃ vāñchitārthaikasādhanam  || 1,96.121 ||
viṣṇumāyānirasanaṃ devatāparamārthadam  |
vāñchāsiddhipradaṃ caiva ṛddhiprajñādisādhanam  || 1,96.122 ||
idaṃ tu śarabhākāraṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ pinākinaḥ  |
prakāśitavyaṃ bhakteṣu cireṣūdyamiteṣu ca  || 1,96.123 ||
taireva paṭhitavyaṃ ca śrotavyaṃ ca śivātmabhiḥ  |
śivotsaveṣu sarveṣu caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca  || 1,96.124 ||
paṭhetpratiṣṭhākāleṣu śivasannidhikāraṇam  |
coravyāghrāhisiṃhānta kṛto rājabhayeṣu ca  || 1,96.125 ||
atrānyotpātabhūkampa davāgnipāṃsuvṛṣṭiṣu  |
ulkāpāte mahāvāte vinā vṛṣṭyātivṛṣṭiṣu  || 1,96.126 ||
atastatra paṭhedvidvāñchivabhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ  |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi stavaṃ sarvamanuttamam  || 1,96.127 ||
sa rudratvaṃ samāsādya rudrasyānucaro bhavet || 1,96.128 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śarabhaprādurbhāvo nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 97

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
jalandharaṃ jaṭāmauliḥ purā jambhārivikramam  |
kathaṃ jaghāna bhagavān bhaganetraharo haraḥ  || 1,97.1 ||
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa suvrata  |

sūta uvāca
jalandhara iti khyāto jalamaṇḍalasaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,97.2 ||
āsīdantakasaṃkāśastapasā labdhavikramaḥ  |
tena devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ  || 1,97.3 ||
nirjitāḥ samare sarve brahmā ca bhagavānajaḥ  |
jitvaiva devasaṃghātaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vai jalandharaḥ  || 1,97.4 ||
jagāma devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaharaṃ gurum  |
tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ divārātramaviśramam  || 1,97.5 ||
jalandhareśayostena nirjito madhusūdanaḥ  |
jalandharo'pi taṃ jitvā devadevaṃ janārdanam  || 1,97.6 ||
provācedaṃ diteḥ putrānnyāyadhīrjetumīśvaram  |
sarve jitā mayā yuddhe śaṅkaro hyajito raṇe  || 1,97.7 ||
taṃ jitvā sarvamīśānaṃ gaṇapairnandinā kṣaṇāt |
ahameva bhavatvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā  || 1,97.8 ||
vāsavatvaṃ ca yuṣmākaṃ dāsye dānavapuṅgavāḥ  |
jalandharavacaḥ śrutvā sarve te dānavādhamāḥ  || 1,97.9 ||
jagarjuruccaiḥ pāpiṣṭhā mṛtyudarśanatatparāḥ  |
daityairetaistathānyaiśca rathanāgaturaṅgamaiḥ  || 1,97.10 ||
saṃnaddhaiḥ saha saṃnahya śarvaṃ prati yayau balī  |
bhavo'pi dṛṣṭvā daityendraṃ merukūṭamiva sthitam  || 1,97.11 ||
avadhyatvamapi śrutvā tathānyairbhaganetrahā  |
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ rakṣan rakṣako jagatāṃ prabhuḥ  || 1,97.12 ||
sāṃbaḥ sanandī sagaṇaḥ provāca prahasanniva  |
kiṃ kṛtyamasureśāna yuddhenānena sāṃpratam  || 1,97.13 ||
madbāṇairbhinnasarvāṅgo martumabhyudyate mudā  |
jalandharo'pi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śrotravidāraṇam  || 1,97.14 ||
sureśvaramuvācedaṃ suretarabaleśvaraḥ  |
vākyenālaṃ mahābāho devadeva vṛṣadhvaja  || 1,97.15 ||
candrāṃśusannibhaiḥ śastrairhara yoddhumihāgataḥ  |
niśamyāsya vacaḥ śūlī pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā  |
mahāṃbhasi cakārāśu rathāṅgaṃ raudramāyudham  || 1,97.16 ||
kṛtvārṇavāṃbhasi sitaṃ bhagavān rathāṅgaṃ smṛtvā jagattrayamanena hatāḥ surāśca  |
dakṣāndhakāntakapuratrayayajñahartā lokatrayāntakakaraḥ prahasaṃtadāha  || 1,97.17 ||
pādena nirmitaṃ daitya jalandhara mahārṇave  |
balavān yadi coddhartuṃ tiṣṭha yoddhuṃ na cānyathā  || 1,97.18 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā krodhenādīptalocanaḥ  |
pradahanniva netrābhyāṃ prāhālokya jagattrayam  || 1,97.19 ||

jalandhara uvāca
gadāmuddhṛtya hatvā ca nandinaṃ tvāṃ ca śaṅkara  |
hatvā lokānsuraiḥ sārdhaṃ ḍuṇḍubhān garuḍo yathā  || 1,97.20 ||
hantuṃ carācaraṃ sarvaṃ samartho'haṃ savāsavam  |
ko maheśvara madbāṇairacchedyo bhuvanatraye  || 1,97.21 ||
bālabhāve ca bhagavān tapasaiva vinirjitaḥ  |
brahmā balī yauvane vai munayaḥ surapuṅgavaiḥ  || 1,97.22 ||
dagdhaṃ kṣaṇena sakalaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram  |
tapasā kiṃ tvayā rudra nirjito bhagavānapi  || 1,97.23 ||
indrāgniyamavitteśa vāyuvārīśvarādayaḥ  |
na sehire yathā nāgā gandhaṃ pakṣipateriva  || 1,97.24 ||
na labdhvā divi bhūmau ca bāhavo mama śaṅkara  |
samastānparvatānprāpya gharṣitāśca gaṇeśvara  || 1,97.25 ||
girīndro mandaraḥ śrīmānnīlo meruḥ suśobhanaḥ  |
gharṣito bāhudaṇḍena kaṇḍūnodārthamāpatat || 1,97.26 ||
gaṅgā niruddhā bāhubhyāṃ līlārthaṃ himavadgirau  |
nārīṇāṃ mama bhṛtyaiśca vajro baddho divaukasām  || 1,97.27 ||
vaḍavāyā mukhaṃ bhagnaṃ gṛhītvā vai kareṇa tu  |
tatkṣaṇādeva sakalaṃ caikārṇavamabhūdidam  || 1,97.28 ||
airāvatādayo nāgāḥ kṣiptāḥ sindhujalopari  |
saratho bhagavānindraḥ kṣiptaśca śatayojanam  || 1,97.29 ||
garuḍo'pi mayā baddho nāgapāśena viṣṇunā  |
urvaśyādyā mayā nītā nāryaḥ kārāgṛhāntaram  || 1,97.30 ||
kathaṃcillabdhavān śakraḥ śacīmekāṃ praṇamya mām  |
māṃ na jānāsi daityendraṃ jalandharamumāpate  || 1,97.31 ||
sūta uvāca
evamukto mahādevaḥ prādahadvai rathaṃ tadā  |
tasya netrāgnibhāgaika kalārdhārdhena cākulam  || 1,97.32 ||
daityānāmatulabalairhayaiśca nāgairdaityendrāstripuraripornirīkṣaṇena  |
nāgādvaiśasamanusaṃvṛtaśca nāgairdeveśaṃ vacanamuvāca cālpabuddhiḥ  || 1,97.33 ||
kiṃ kāryaṃ mama yudhi devadaityasaṃghairhantuṃ yatsakalamidaṃ kṣaṇātsamarthaḥ  |
yattasmādbhayamihanāsti yoddhumīśa vāñchaiṣā vipulatarā na saṃśayo'tra  || 1,97.34 ||
tasmāttvaṃ mama madanāridakṣaśatro yajñāre tripuraripo mamaiva vīraiḥ  |
bhūtendrairharivadanena devasaṃghairyoddhuṃ te balamiha cāsti ceddhi tiṣṭha  || 1,97.35 ||
ityuktvātha mahādevaṃ mahādevārinandanaḥ  |
na cacāla na sasmāra nihatānbāndhavānyudhi  || 1,97.36 ||
durmadenāvinītātmā dorbhyāmāsphoṭya dorbalāt |
sudarśanākhyaṃ yaccakraṃ tena hantuṃ samudyataḥ  || 1,97.37 ||
durdhareṇa rathāṅgena kṛcchreṇāpi dvijottamāḥ  |
sthāpayāmāsa vai skandhe dvidhābhūtaśca tena vai  || 1,97.38 ||
kuliśena yathā chinno dvidhā girivaro dvijāḥ  |
papāta daityo balavānañjanādririvāparaḥ  || 1,97.39 ||
tasya raktena raudreṇa sampūrṇamabhavatkṣaṇāt |
tadraktamakhilaṃ rudra niyogānmāṃsameva ca  || 1,97.40 ||
mahārauravamāsādya raktakuṇḍamabhūdaho  |
jalandharaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā devagandharvapārṣadāḥ  || 1,97.41 ||
siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā sādhu deveti cābruvan  |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi jalandharavimardanam  || 1,97.42 ||
śrāvayedvā yathānyāyaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || 1,97.43 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge jalandharavadho nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 98

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ devena vai sūta devadevānmaheśvarāt |
sudarśanākhyaṃ vai labdhaṃ vaktumarhasi viṣṇunā  || 1,98.1 ||

sūta uvāca
devānāmasurendrāṇāmabhavacca sudāruṇaḥ  |
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ vināśakaraṇo mahān  || 1,98.2 ||
te devāḥ śaktimuśalaiḥ sāyakairnataparvabhiḥ  |
prabhidyamānāḥ kuntaiśca dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ  || 1,98.3 ||
parājitāstadā devā devadeveśvaraṃ harim  |
praṇemustaṃ sureśānaṃ śokasaṃvignamānasāḥ  || 1,98.4 ||
tān samīkṣyātha bhagavān devadeveśvaro hariḥ  |
praṇipatya sthitāndevānidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 1,98.5 ||
vatsāḥ kimiti vai devāścyutālaṅkāravikramāḥ  |
samāgatāḥ sasaṃtāpā vaktumarhatha suvratāḥ  || 1,98.6 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tathābhūtāḥ surottamāḥ  |
praṇamyāhuryathāvṛttaṃ devadevāya viṣṇave  || 1,98.7 ||
bhagavandevadeveśa viṣṇo jiṣṇo janārdana  |
dānavaiḥ pīḍitāḥ sarve vayaṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ  || 1,98.8 ||
tvameva devadeveśa gatirnaḥ puruṣottama  |
tvameva paramātmā hi tvaṃ pitā jagatāmapi  || 1,98.9 ||
tvameva bhartā hartā ca bhoktā dātā janārdana  |
hantumarhasi tasmāttvaṃ dānavāndānavārdana  || 1,98.10 ||
daityāśca vaiṣṇavairbrāhmai raudrairyāmyaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ  |
kauberaiścaiva saumyaiśca nairṛtyairvāruṇairdṛḍhaiḥ  || 1,98.11 ||
vāyavyaiśca tathāgneyairaiśānairvārṣikaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
saurai raudraistathā bhīmaiḥ kampanairjṛmbhaṇairdṛḍhaiḥ  || 1,98.12 ||
avadhyā varalābhātte sarve vārijalocana  |
sūryamaṇḍalasambhūtaṃ tvadīyaṃ cakramudyatam  || 1,98.13 ||
kuṇṭhitaṃ hi dadhīcena cyāvanena jagadguro  |
daṇḍaṃ śārṅgaṃ tavāstraṃ ca labdhaṃ daityaiḥ prasādataḥ  || 1,98.14 ||
purā jalandharaṃ hantuṃ nirmitaṃ tripurāriṇā  |
rathāṅgaṃ suśitaṃ ghoraṃ tena tān hantumarhasi  || 1,98.15 ||
tasmāttena nihantavyā nānyaiḥ śastraśatairapi  |
tato niśamya teṣāṃ vai vacanaṃ vārijekṣaṇaḥ  || 1,98.16 ||
vācaspatimukhānāha sa hariścakrabhṛtsvayam  |

śrīviṣṇuruvāca
bhobho devā mahādevaṃ sarvairdevaiḥ sanātanaiḥ  || 1,98.17 ||
samprāpya sāṃprataṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi divaukasām  |
devā jalandharaṃ hantuṃ nirmitaṃ hi purāriṇā  || 1,98.18 ||
labdhvā rathāṅgaṃ tenaiva nihatya ca mahāsurān  |
sarvāndhundhumukhāndaityānaṣṭaṣaṣṭiśatān surān  || 1,98.19 ||
sabāndhavānkṣaṇādeva yuṣmān saṃtārayāmyaham  |

sūta uvāca
evamuktvā suraśreṣṭhān suraśreṣṭhamanusmaran  || 1,98.20 ||
suraśreṣṭhastadā śreṣṭhaṃ pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram  |
liṅgaṃ sthāpya yathānyāyaṃ himavacchikhare śubhe  || 1,98.21 ||
meruparvatasaṃkāśaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā  |
tvaritākhyena rudreṇa raudreṇa ca janārdanaḥ  || 1,98.22 ||
snāpya sampūjya gandhādyairjvālākāraṃ manoramam  |
tuṣṭāva ca tadā rudraṃ sampūjyāgnau praṇamya ca  || 1,98.23 ||
devaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa bhavādyena yathākramam  |
pūjayāmāsa ca śivaṃ praṇavādyaṃ namo'ntakam  || 1,98.24 ||
devaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa bhavādyena maheśvaram  |
pratināma sa padmena pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram  || 1,98.25 ||
agnau ca nāmabhirdevaṃ bhavādyaiḥ samidādibhiḥ  |
svāhāntairvidhivaddhutvā pratyekamayutaṃ prabhum  || 1,98.26 ||
tuṣṭāva ca punaḥ śaṃbhuṃ bhavādyairbhavamīśvaram  |

śrīviṣṇuruvāca
bhavaḥ śivo haro rudraḥ puruṣaḥ padmalocanaḥ  || 1,98.27 ||
arthitavyaḥ sadācāraḥ sarvaśaṃbhurmaheśvaraḥ  |
īśvaraḥ sthāṇurīśānaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || 1,98.28 ||
varīyān varado vandyaḥ śaṅkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ  |
gaṅgādharaḥ śūladharaḥ parārthaikaprayojanaḥ  || 1,98.29 ||
sarvajñaḥ sarvadevādi giridhanvā jaṭādharaḥ  |
candrāpīḍaścandramaulirvidvānviśvāmareśvaraḥ  || 1,98.30 ||
vedāntasārasaṃdohaḥ kapālī nīlalohitaḥ  |
dhyānādhāroparicchedyo gaurībhartā gaṇeśvaraḥ  || 1,98.31 ||
aṣṭamūrtirviśvamūrtistrivargaḥ svargasādhanaḥ  |
jñānagamyo dṛḍhaprajño devadevastrilocanaḥ  || 1,98.32 ||
vāmadevo mahādevaḥ pāṇḍuḥ paridṛḍho dṛḍhaḥ  |
viśvarūpo virūpākṣo vāgīśaḥ śucirantaraḥ  || 1,98.33 ||
sarvapraṇayasaṃvādī vṛṣāṅko vṛṣavāhanaḥ  |
īśaḥ pinākī khaṭvāṅgī citraveṣaścirantanaḥ  || 1,98.34 ||
tamoharo mahāyogī goptā brahmāṅgahṛjjaṭī  |
kālakālaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ subhagaḥ praṇavātmakaḥ  || 1,98.35 ||
unmattaveṣaścakṣuṣyo durvāsāḥ smaraśāsanaḥ  |
dṛḍhāyudhaḥ skandaguruḥ parameṣṭhī parāyaṇaḥ  || 1,98.36 ||
anādimadhyanidhano giriśo giribāndhavaḥ  |
kuberabandhuḥ śrīkaṇṭho lokavarṇottamottamaḥ  || 1,98.37 ||
sāmānyadevaḥ kodaṇḍī nīlakaṇṭhaḥ paraśvadhī  |
viśālākṣo mṛgavyādhaḥ sureśaḥ sūryatāpanaḥ  || 1,98.38 ||
dharmakarmākṣamaḥ kṣetraṃ bhagavān bhaganetrabhit |
ugraḥ paśupatistārkṣyaḥ priyabhaktaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ  || 1,98.39 ||
dātā dayākaro dakṣaḥ kapardī kāmaśāsanaḥ  |
śmaśānanilayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śmaśānastho maheśvaraḥ  || 1,98.40 ||
lokakartā bhūtapatirmahākartā mahauṣadhī  |
uttaro gopatirgoptā jñānagamyaḥ purātanaḥ  || 1,98.41 ||
nītiḥ sunītiḥ śuddhātmā somaḥ somarataḥ sukhī  |
somapo'mṛtapaḥ somo mahānītirmahāmatiḥ  || 1,98.42 ||
ajātaśatrurālokaḥ saṃbhāvyo havyavāhanaḥ  |
lokakāro vedakāraḥ sūtrakāraḥ sanātanaḥ  || 1,98.43 ||
maharṣiḥ kapilācāryo viśvadīptistrilocanaḥ  |
pinākapāṇirbhūdevaḥ svastidaḥ svastikṛtsadā  || 1,98.44 ||
tridhāmā saubhagaḥ śarvaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvagocaraḥ  |
brahmadhṛgviśvasṛksvargaḥ karṇikāraḥ priyaḥ kaviḥ  || 1,98.45 ||
śākho viśākho gośākhaḥ śivo naikaḥ kratuḥ samaḥ  |
gaṅgāplavodako bhāvaḥ sakalaḥ sthapatiḥ sthiraḥ  || 1,98.46 ||
vijitātmā vidheyātmā bhūtavāhanasārathiḥ  |
sagaṇo gaṇakāryaśca sukīrtiśchinnasaṃśayaḥ  || 1,98.47 ||
kāmadevaḥ kāmapālo bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ  |
bhasmapriyo bhasmaśāyī kāmī kāntaḥ kṛtāgamaḥ  || 1,98.48 ||
samāyukto nivṛttātmā dharmayuktaḥ sadāśivaḥ  |
caturmukhaścaturbāhurdurāvāso durāsadaḥ  || 1,98.49 ||
durgamo durlabho durgaḥ sarvāyudhaviśāradaḥ  |
adhyātmayoganilayaḥ sutantustantuvardhanaḥ  || 1,98.50 ||
śubhāṅgo lokasāraṅgo jagadīśo'mṛtāśanaḥ  |
bhasmaśuddhikaro merurojasvī śuddhavigrahaḥ  || 1,98.51 ||
hiraṇyaretāstaraṇirmarīcirmahimālayaḥ  |
mahāhrado mahāgarbhaḥ siddhavṛndāravanditaḥ  || 1,98.52 ||
vyāghracarmadharo vyālī mahābhūto mahānidhiḥ  |
amṛtāṅgo'mṛtavapuḥ pañcayajñaḥ prabhañjanaḥ  || 1,98.53 ||
pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ pārijātaḥ parāvaraḥ  |
sulabhaḥ suvrataḥ śūro vāṅmayaikanidhirnidhiḥ  || 1,98.54 ||
varṇāśramagururvarṇī śatrujicchatrutāpanaḥ  |
āśramaḥ kṣapaṇaḥ kṣāmo jñānavānacalācalaḥ  || 1,98.55 ||
pramāṇabhūto durjñeyaḥ suparṇo vāyuvāhanaḥ  |
dhanurdharo dhanurvedo guṇarāśirguṇākaraḥ  || 1,98.56 ||
anantadṛṣṭirānando daṇḍo damayitā damaḥ  |
abhivādyo mahācāryo viśvakarmā viśāradaḥ  || 1,98.57 ||
vītarāgo vinītātmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
unmattaveṣaḥ pracchanno jitakāmo jitapriyaḥ  || 1,98.58 ||
kalyāṇaprakṛtiḥ kalpaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ  |
tapasvī tārako dhīmān pradhānaprabhuravyayaḥ  || 1,98.59 ||
lokapālo'ntarhitātmā kalpādiḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ  |
vedaśāstrārthatattvajño niyamo niyamāśrayaḥ  || 1,98.60 ||
candraḥ sūryaḥ śaniḥ keturvirāmo vidrumacchaviḥ  |
bhaktigamyaḥ paraṃ brahma mṛgabāṇārpaṇo'naghaḥ  || 1,98.61 ||
adrirājālayaḥ kāntaḥ paramātmā jagadguruḥ  |
sarvakarmācalastvaṣṭā maṅgalyo maṅgalāvṛtaḥ  || 1,98.62 ||
mahātapā dīrghatapāḥ sthaviṣṭhaḥ sthaviro dhruvaḥ  |
ahaḥ saṃvatsaro vyāptiḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ  || 1,98.63 ||
saṃvatsarakaro mantraḥ pratyayaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ  |
ajaḥ sarveśvaraḥ snigdho mahāretā mahābalaḥ  || 1,98.64 ||
yogī yogyo mahāretāḥ siddhaḥ sarvādiragnidaḥ  |
vasurvasumanāḥ satyaḥ sarvapāpaharo haraḥ  || 1,98.65 ||
amṛtaḥ śāśvataḥ śānto bāṇahastaḥ pratāpavān  |
kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī vedāṅgo vedavinmuniḥ  || 1,98.66 ||
bhrājiṣṇurbhojanaṃ bhoktā lokanetā durādharaḥ  |
atīndriyo mahāmāyaḥ sarvāvāsaścatuṣpathaḥ  || 1,98.67 ||
kālayogī mahānādo mahotsāho mahābalaḥ  |
mahābuddhirmahāvīryo bhūtacārī purandaraḥ  || 1,98.68 ||
niśācaraḥ pretacārī mahāśaktirmahādyutiḥ  |
anirdeśyavapuḥ śrīmān sarvahāryamito gatiḥ  || 1,98.69 ||
bahuśruto bahumayo niyatātmā bhavodbhavaḥ  |
ojastejo dyutikaro nartakaḥ sarvakāmakaḥ  || 1,98.70 ||
nṛtyapriyo nṛtyanṛtyaḥ prakāśātmā pratāpanaḥ  |
buddhaspaṣṭākṣaro mantraḥ sanmānaḥ sārasaṃplavaḥ  || 1,98.71 ||
yugādikṛdyugāvarto gaṃbhīro vṛṣavāhanaḥ  |
iṣṭo viśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭeṣṭaḥ śarabhaḥ śarabho dhanuḥ  || 1,98.72 ||
apāṃ nidhiradhiṣṭhānaṃ vijayo jayakālavit |
pratiṣṭhitaḥ pramāṇajño hiraṇyakavaco hariḥ  || 1,98.73 ||
virocanaḥ suragaṇo vidyeśo vibudhāśrayaḥ  |
bālarūpo balonmāthī vivarto gahano guruḥ  || 1,98.74 ||
karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ kartā sarvabandhavimocanaḥ  |
vidvattamo vītabhayo viśvabhartā niśākaraḥ  || 1,98.75 ||
vyavasāyo vyavasthānaḥ sthānado jagadādijaḥ  |
dundubho lalito viśvo bhavātmātmani saṃsthitaḥ  || 1,98.76 ||
vīreśvaro vīrabhadro vīrahā vīrabhṛdvirāṭ |
vīracūḍāmaṇirvettā tīvranādo nadīdharaḥ  || 1,98.77 ||
ājñādharastriśūlī ca śipiviṣṭaḥ śivālayaḥ  |
vālakhilyo mahācāpastigmāṃśurnidhiravyayaḥ  || 1,98.78 ||
abhirāmaḥ suśaraṇaḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ sudhāpatiḥ  |
maghavānkauśiko gomān viśrāmaḥ sarvaśāsanaḥ  || 1,98.79 ||
lalāṭākṣo viśvadehaḥ sāraḥ saṃsāracakrabhṛt |
amoghadaṇḍī madhyastho hiraṇyo brahmavarcasī  || 1,98.80 ||
paramārthaḥ paramayaḥ śambaro vyāghrako'nalaḥ  |
rucirvararucirvandyo vācaspatiraharpatiḥ  || 1,98.81 ||
ravirvirocanaḥ skandhaḥ śāstā vaivasvato janaḥ  |
yuktirunnatakīrtiśca śāntarāgaḥ parājayaḥ  || 1,98.82 ||
kailāsapatikāmāriḥ savitā ravilocanaḥ  |
vidvattamo vītabhayo viśvahartā nivāritaḥ  || 1,98.83 ||
nityo niyatakalyāṇaḥ puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanaḥ  |
dūraśravā viśvasaho dhyeyo duḥsvapnanāśanaḥ  || 1,98.84 ||
uttārako duṣkṛtihā durdharṣo duḥsaho'bhayaḥ  |
anādirbhūrbhuvolakṣmīḥ kirīṭī tridaśādhipaḥ  || 1,98.85 ||
viśvagoptā viśvabhartā sudhīro rucirāṅgadaḥ  |
janano janajanmādiḥ prītimānnītimānnayaḥ  || 1,98.86 ||
viśiṣṭaḥ kāśyapo bhānurbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ  |
praṇavaḥ saptadhācāro mahākāyo mahādhanuḥ  || 1,98.87 ||
janmādhipo mahādevaḥ sakalāgamapāragaḥ  |
tattvātattvavivekātmā vibhūṣṇurbhūtibhūṣaṇaḥ  || 1,98.88 ||
ṛṣirbrāhmaṇavijjiṣṇurjanmamṛtyujarātigaḥ  |
yajño yajñapatiryajvā yajñānto'moghavikramaḥ  || 1,98.89 ||
mahendro durbharaḥ senī yajñāṅgo yajñavāhanaḥ  |
pañcabrahmasamutpattirviśveśo vimalodayaḥ  || 1,98.90 ||
ātmayoniranādyantaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatsaptalokadhṛk |
gāyatrīvallabhaḥ prāṃśurviśvāvāsaḥ prabhākaraḥ  || 1,98.91 ||
śiśurgirirataḥ samrāṭsuṣeṇaḥ suraśatruhā  |
amogho'riṣṭamathano mukundo vigatajvaraḥ  || 1,98.92 ||
svayaṃjyotiranujyotirātmajyotiracañcalaḥ  |
piṅgalaḥ kapilaśmaśruḥ śāstranetrastrayītanuḥ  || 1,98.93 ||
jñānaskandho mahājñānī nirutpattirupaplavaḥ  |
bhago vivasvānādityo yogācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ  || 1,98.94 ||
udārakīrtirudyogī sadyogī sadasanmayaḥ  |
nakṣatramālī rākeśaḥ sādhiṣṭhānaḥ ṣaḍāśrayaḥ  || 1,98.95 ||
pavitrapāṇiḥ pāpārirmaṇipūro manogatiḥ  |
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamāsīnaḥ śuklaḥ śānto vṛṣākapiḥ  || 1,98.96 ||
viṣṇurgrahapatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samartho'narthanāśanaḥ  |
adharmaśatrurakṣayyaḥ puruhūtaḥ puruṣṭutaḥ  || 1,98.97 ||
brahmagarbho bṛhadgarbho dharmadhenurdhanāgamaḥ  |
jagaddhitaiṣī sugataḥ kumāraḥ kuśalāgamaḥ  || 1,98.98 ||
hiraṇyavarṇo jyotiṣmānnānābhūtadharo dhvaniḥ  |
arogo niyamādhyakṣo viśvāmitro dvijottamaḥ  || 1,98.99 ||
bṛhajjyotiḥ sudhāmā ca mahājyotiranuttamaḥ  |
mātāmaho mātariśvā nabhasvānnāgahāradhṛk || 1,98.100 ||
pulastyaḥ pulaho'gastyo jātūkarṇyaḥ parāśaraḥ  |
nirāvaraṇadharmajño viriñco viṣṭaraśravāḥ  || 1,98.101 ||
ātmabhūraniruddho'tri jñānamūrtirmahāyaśāḥ  |
lokacūḍāmaṇirvīraḥ caṇḍasatyaparākramaḥ  || 1,98.102 ||
vyālakalpo mahākalpo mahāvṛkṣaḥ kalādharaḥ  |
alaṃkariṣṇustvacalo rociṣṇurvikramottamaḥ  || 1,98.103 ||
āśuśabdapatirvegī plavanaḥ śikhisārathiḥ  |
asaṃsṛṣṭo'tithiḥ śakraḥ pramāthī pāpanāśanaḥ  || 1,98.104 ||
vasuśravāḥ kavyavāhaḥ pratapto viśvabhojanaḥ  |
jaryo jarādhiśamano lohitaśca tanūnapāt || 1,98.105 ||
pṛṣadaśvo nabhoyoniḥ supratīkastamisrahā  |
nidāghastapano meghaḥ pakṣaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ  || 1,98.106 ||
mukhānilaḥ suniṣpannaḥ surabhiḥ śiśirātmakaḥ  |
vasaṃto mādhavo grīṣmo nabhasyo bījavāhanaḥ  || 1,98.107 ||
aṅgirā munirātreyo vimalo viśvavāhanaḥ  |
pāvanaḥ purujicchakrastrividyo naravāhanaḥ  || 1,98.108 ||
mano buddhirahaṅkāraḥ kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrapālakaḥ  |
tejonidhirjñānanidhirvipāko vighnakārakaḥ  || 1,98.109 ||
adharo'nuttaro jñeyo jyeṣṭho niḥśreyasālayaḥ  |
śailo nagastanurdeho dānavārirarindamaḥ  || 1,98.110 ||
cārudhīrjanakaścāru viśalyo lokaśalyakṛt |
caturvedaścaturbhāvaścaturaścaturapriyaḥ  || 1,98.111 ||
āmnāyo'tha samāmnāyastīrthadevaśivālayaḥ  |
bahurūpo mahārūpaḥ sarvarūpaścarācaraḥ  || 1,98.112 ||
nyāyanirvāhako nyāyo nyāyagamyo nirañjanaḥ  |
sahasramūrdhā devendraḥ sarvaśastraprabhañjanaḥ  || 1,98.113 ||
muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍī dānto guṇottamaḥ  |
piṅgalākṣo'tha haryakṣo nīlagrīvo nirāmayaḥ  || 1,98.114 ||
sahasrabāhuḥ sarveśaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokabhṛt |
padmāsanaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ parāvaraṃ paraṃ phalam  || 1,98.115 ||
padmagarbho mahāgarbho viśvagarbho vicakṣaṇaḥ  |
parāvarajño bījeśaḥ sumukhaḥ sumahāsvanaḥ  || 1,98.116 ||
devāsuragururdevo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ  |
devāsuramahāmātro devāsuramahāśrayaḥ  || 1,98.117 ||
devādidevo devarṣi devāsuravarapradaḥ  |
devāsureśvaro divyo devāsuramaheśvaraḥ  || 1,98.118 ||
sarvadevamayo'cintyo devatātmātmasaṃbhavaḥ  |
īḍyo'nīśaḥ suravyāghro devasiṃho divākaraḥ  || 1,98.119 ||
vibudhāgravaraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvadevottamottamaḥ  |
śivajñānarataḥ śrīmān śikhiśrīparvatapriyaḥ  || 1,98.120 ||
jayastaṃbho viśiṣṭambho narasiṃhanipātanaḥ  |
brahmacārī lokacārī dharmacārī dhanādhipaḥ  || 1,98.121 ||
nandī nandīśvaro nagno nagnavratadharaḥ śuciḥ  |
liṅgādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo yugādhyakṣo yugāvahaḥ  || 1,98.122 ||
svavaśaḥ savaśaḥ svargaḥ svaraḥ svaramayasvanaḥ  |
bījādhyakṣo bījakartā dhanakṛddharmavardhanaḥ  || 1,98.123 ||
daṃbho'dambho mahādaṃbhaḥ sarvabhūtamaheśvaraḥ  |
śmaśānanilayastiṣyaḥ seturapratimākṛtiḥ  || 1,98.124 ||
lokottarasphuṭālokastryaṃbako nāgabhūṣaṇaḥ  |
andhakārirmakhadveṣī viṣṇukandharapātanaḥ  || 1,98.125 ||
vītadoṣo'kṣayaguṇo dakṣāriḥ pūṣadantahṛt |
dhūrjaṭiḥ khaṇḍaparaśuḥ sakalo niṣkalo'naghaḥ  || 1,98.126 ||
ādhāraḥ sakalādhāraḥ pāṇḍurābho mṛḍo naṭaḥ  |
pūrṇaḥ pūrayitā puṇyaḥ sukumāraḥ sulocanaḥ  || 1,98.127 ||
sāmageyaḥ priyakaraḥ puṇyakīrtiranāmayaḥ  |
manojavastīrthakaro jaṭilo jīviteśvaraḥ  || 1,98.128 ||
jīvitāntakaro nityo vasuretā vasupriyaḥ  |
sadgatiḥ satkṛtiḥ saktaḥ kālakaṇṭhaḥ kalādharaḥ  || 1,98.129 ||
mānī mānyo mahākālaḥ sadbhūtiḥ satparāyaṇaḥ  |
candrasaṃjīvanaḥ śāstā lokagūḍho'marādhipaḥ  || 1,98.130 ||
lokabandhurlokanāthaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kṛtibhūṣaṇaḥ  |
anapāyyakṣaraḥ kāntaḥ sarvaśāstrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ  || 1,98.131 ||
tejomayo dyutidharo lokamāyo'graṇīraṇuḥ  |
śucismitaḥ prasannātmā durjayo duratikramaḥ  || 1,98.132 ||
jyotirmayo nirākāro jagannātho jaleśvaraḥ  |
tumbavīṇī mahākāyo viśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ  || 1,98.133 ||
trilokātmā trilokeśaḥ śuddhaḥ śuddhī rathākṣajaḥ  |
avyaktalakṣaṇo vyakto vyaktāvyakto viśāṃpatiḥ  || 1,98.134 ||
varaśīlo varatulo māno mānadhano mayaḥ  |
brahmā viṣṇuḥ prajāpālo haṃso haṃsagatiryamaḥ  || 1,98.135 ||
vedhā dhātā vidhātā ca attā hartā caturmukhaḥ  |
kailāsaśikharāvāsī sarvāvāsī satāṃ gatiḥ  || 1,98.136 ||
hiraṇyagarbho hariṇaḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvajaḥ pitā  |
bhūtālayo bhūtapatirbhūtido bhuvaneśvaraḥ  || 1,98.137 ||
saṃyogī yogavidbrahma brahmaṇyo brāhmaṇapriyaḥ  |
devapriyo devanātho devajño devacintakaḥ  || 1,98.138 ||
viṣamākṣaḥ kalādhyakṣo vṛṣāṅko vṛṣavardhanaḥ  |
nirmado nirahaṅkāro nirmoho nirupadravaḥ  || 1,98.139 ||
darpahā darpito dṛptaḥ sarvartuparivartakaḥ  |
saptajihvaḥ sahasrārciḥ snigdhaḥ prakṛtidakṣiṇaḥ  || 1,98.140 ||
bhūtabhavyabhavannāthaḥ prabhavo bhrāntināśanaḥ  |
artho'nartho mahākośaḥ parakāryaikapaṇḍitaḥ  || 1,98.141 ||
niṣkaṇṭakaḥ kṛtānando nirvyājo vyājamardanaḥ  |
sattvavān sāttvikaḥ satya kīrtistambhakṛtāgamaḥ  || 1,98.142 ||
akaṃpito guṇagrāhī naikātmā naikakarmakṛt |
suprītaḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sukaro dakṣiṇo'nalaḥ  || 1,98.143 ||
skandhaḥ skandhadharo dhuryaḥ prakaṭaḥ prītivardhanaḥ  |
aparājitaḥ sarvasaho vidagdhaḥ sarvavāhanaḥ  || 1,98.144 ||
adhṛtaḥ svadhṛtaḥ sādhyaḥ pūrvamūrtiryaśodharaḥ  |
varāhaśṛṅgadhṛgvāyurbalavānekanāyakaḥ  || 1,98.145 ||
śrutiprakāśaḥ śrutimānekabandhuranekadhṛk |
śrīvallabhaśivārambhaḥ śāntabhadraḥ samañjasaḥ  || 1,98.146 ||
bhūśayo bhūtikṛdbhūtirbhūṣaṇo bhūtavāhanaḥ  |
akāyo bhaktakāyasthaḥ kālajñānī kalāvapuḥ  || 1,98.147 ||
satyavratamahātyāgī niṣṭhāśāntiparāyaṇaḥ  |
parārthavṛttirvarado viviktaḥ śrutisāgaraḥ  || 1,98.148 ||
anirviṇṇo guṇagrāhī kalaṅkāṅkaḥ kalaṅkahā  |
svabhāvarudro madhyasthaḥ śatrughno madhyanāśakaḥ  || 1,98.149 ||
śikhaṇḍī kavacī śūlī caṇḍī muṇḍī ca kuṇḍalī  |
mekhalī kavacī khaḍgī māyī saṃsārasārathiḥ  || 1,98.150 ||
amṛtyuḥ sarvadṛksiṃhastejorāśirmahāmaṇiḥ  |
asaṃkhyeyo'prameyātmā vīryavān kāryakovidaḥ  || 1,98.151 ||
vedyo vedārthavidgoptā sarvācāro munīśvaraḥ  |
anuttamo durādharṣo madhuraḥ priyadarśanaḥ  || 1,98.152 ||
sureśaḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvaḥ śabdabrahma satāṃ gatiḥ  |
kālabhakṣaḥ kalaṅkāriḥ kaṅkaṇīkṛtavāsukiḥ  || 1,98.153 ||
maheṣvāso mahībhartā niṣkalaṅko viśṛṅkhalaḥ  |
dyumaṇistaraṇirdhanyaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhisādhanaḥ  || 1,98.154 ||
nivṛttaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ śilpo vyūḍhorasko mahābhujaḥ  |
ekajyotirnirātaṅko naro nārāyaṇapriyaḥ  || 1,98.155 ||
nirlepo niṣprapañcātmā nirvyagro vyagranāśanaḥ  |
stavyastavapriyaḥ stotā vyāsamūrtiranākulaḥ  || 1,98.156 ||
niravadyapadopāyo vidyārāśiravikramaḥ  |
praśāntabuddhirakṣudraḥ kṣudrahā nityasundaraḥ  || 1,98.157 ||
dhairyāgryadhuryo dhātrīśaḥ śākalyaḥ śarvarīpatiḥ  |
paramārthagururdṛṣṭirgururāśritavatsalaḥ  || 1,98.158 ||
raso rasajñaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvasattvāvalaṃbanaḥ  |

sūta uvāca
evaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tuṣṭāva vṛṣabhadhvajam  || 1,98.159 ||
snāpayāmāsa ca vibhuḥ pūjayāmāsa paṅkajaiḥ  |
parīkṣārthaṃ hareḥ pūjā kamaleṣu maheśvaraḥ  || 1,98.160 ||
gopayāmāsa kamalaṃ tadaikaṃ bhuvaneśvaraḥ  |
hṛtapuṣpo haristatra kimidaṃ tvabhyacintayat || 1,98.161 ||
jñātvā svanetramuddhṛtya sarvasattvāvalambanam  |
pūjayāmāsa bhāvena nāmnā tena jagadgurum  || 1,98.162 ||
tatastatra vibhurdṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ haro harim  |
tasmādavatatārāśu maṇḍalātpāvakasya ca  || 1,98.163 ||
koṭibhāskarasaṃkāśaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam  |
jvālāmālāvṛtaṃ divyaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ bhayaṅkaram  || 1,98.164 ||
śūlaṭaṅkagadācakra kuntapāśadharaṃ haram  |
varādabhayahastaṃ ca dvīpicarmottarīyakam  || 1,98.165 ||
itthaṃbhūtaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhavaṃ bhasmavibhūṣitam  |
hṛṣṭo namaścakārāśu devadevaṃ janārdanaḥ  || 1,98.166 ||
dudruvustaṃ parikramya sendrā devāstrilocanam  |
cacāla brahmabhuvanaṃ cakampe ca vasuṃdharā  || 1,98.167 ||
dadāha tejastacchaṃbhoḥ prāntaṃ vai śatayojanam  |
adhastāccordhvataścaiva hāhetyakṛta bhūtale  || 1,98.168 ||
tadā prāha mahādevaḥ prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ  |
samprekṣya praṇayādviṣṇuṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam  || 1,98.169 ||
jñātaṃ mayedamadhunā devakāryaṃ janārdana  |
sudarśanākhyaṃ cakraṃ ca dadāmi tava śobhanam  || 1,98.170 ||
yadrūpaṃ bhavatā dṛṣṭaṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram  |
hitāya tava yatnena tava bhāvāya suvrata  || 1,98.171 ||
śāntaṃ raṇājire viṣṇo devānāṃ duḥkhasādhanam  |
śāntasya cāstraṃ śāntaḥ syācchāntenāstreṇa kiṃ phalam  || 1,98.172 ||
śāntasya samare cāstraṃ śāntireva tapasvinām  |
yoddhuḥ śāntyā balacchedaḥ parasya balavṛddhidaḥ  || 1,98.173 ||
devairaśāntairyadrūpaṃ madīyaṃ bhāvayāvyayam  |
kimāyudhena kāryaṃ vai yoddhuṃ devārisūdana  || 1,98.174 ||
kṣamā yudhi na kāryaṃ vai yoddhuṃ devārisūdana  |
anāgate vyatīte ca daurbalye svajanotkare  || 1,98.175 ||
akālike tvadharme ca anarthe vārisūdana  |
evamuktvā dadau cakraṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham  || 1,98.176 ||
netraṃ ca netā jagatāṃ prabhurvai padmasannibham  |
tadāprabhṛti taṃ prāhuḥ padmākṣamiti suvratam  || 1,98.177 ||
dattvainaṃ nayanaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇave nīlalohitaḥ  |
pasparśa ca karābhyāṃ vai suśubhābhyāmuvāca ha  || 1,98.178 ||
varado'haṃ varaśreṣṭha varānvaraya cepsitān  |
bhaktyā vaśīkṛto nūnaṃ tvayāhaṃ puruṣottama  || 1,98.179 ||
ityukto devadevena devadevaṃ praṇamya tam  |
tvayi bhaktirmahādeva prasīda varamuttamam  || 1,98.180 ||
nānyamicchāmi bhaktānāmārtayo nāsti yatprabho  |
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya dayāvān sutarāṃ bhavaḥ  || 1,98.181 ||
pasparśa ca dadau tasmai śraddhāṃ śītāṃśubhūṣaṇaḥ  |
prāha caivaṃ mahādevaḥ paramātmānamacyutam  || 1,98.182 ||
mayi bhaktaśca vandyaśca pūjyaścaiva surāsuraiḥ  |
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādātsurottama  || 1,98.183 ||
yadā satī dakṣaputrī vinindyaiva sulocanā  |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ bhaviṣyati sureśvarī  || 1,98.184 ||
divyā haimavatī viṣṇo tadā tvamapi suvrata  |
bhaginīṃ tava kalyāṇīṃ devīṃ haimavatīmumām  || 1,98.185 ||
niyogādbrahmaṇaḥ sādhvīṃ pradāsyasi mamaiva tām  |
matsaṃbandhī ca lokānāṃ madhye pūjyo bhaviṣyasi  || 1,98.186 ||
māṃ divyena ca bhāvena tadāprabhṛti śaṅkaram  |
drakṣyase ca prasannena mitrabhūtamivātmanā  || 1,98.187 ||
ityuktvāntardadhe rudro bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ  |
janārdano'pi bhagavān devānāmapi saṃnidhau  || 1,98.188 ||
ayācata mahādevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ munibhiḥ samam  |
mayā proktaṃ stavaṃ divyaṃ padmayone suśobhanam  || 1,98.189 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā dvijottamān  |
pratināmni hiraṇyasya tattasya phalamāpnuyāt || 1,98.190 ||
aśvamedhasahasreṇa phalaṃ bhavati tasya vai  |
ghṛtādyaiḥ snāpayedrudraṃ sthālyā vai kalaśaiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 1,98.191 ||
nāmnāṃ sahasreṇānena śraddhayā śivamīśvaram  |
so'pi yajñasahasrasya phalaṃ labdhvāsureśvaraiḥ  || 1,98.192 ||
pūjyo bhavati rudrasya prītirbhavati tasya vai  |
tathāstviti tathā prāha padmayonerjanārdanam  || 1,98.193 ||
jagmatuḥ praṇipatyainaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum  |
tasmānnāmnāṃ sahasreṇa pūjayedanagho dvijāḥ  || 1,98.194 ||
japennāmnāṃ sahasraṃ ca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 1,98.195 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge sahasranāmabhiḥ pūjanādviṣṇucakralābho nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 99

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
saṃbhavaḥ sūcito devyāstvayā sūta mahāmate  |
savistaraṃ vadasvādya satītve ca yathātatham  || 1,99.1 ||
menājatvaṃ mahādevyā dakṣayajñavimardanam  |
viṣṇunā ca kathaṃ dattā devadevāya śaṃbhave  || 1,99.2 ||
kalyāṇaṃ vā kathaṃ tasya vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam  |
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ  || 1,99.3 ||
saṃbhavaṃ ca mahādevyāḥ prāha teṣāṃ mahātmanām  |

sūta uvāca
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ daṇḍine tatsuvistaram  || 1,99.4 ||
yuṣmābhirvai kumārāya tena vyāsāya dhīmate  |
tasmādahamupaśrutya pravadāmi suvistaram  || 1,99.5 ||
vacanādvo mahābhāgāḥ praṇamyomāṃ tathā bhavam  |
sā bhagākhyā jagaddhātrī liṅgamūrtestrivedikā  || 1,99.6 ||
liṅgastu bhagavāndvābhyāṃ jagatsṛṣṭirdvijottamāḥ  |
liṅgamūrtiḥ śivo jyotistamasaścopari sthitaḥ  || 1,99.7 ||
liṅgavedisamāyogādardhanārīśvarobhavat |
brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe devamagre putraṃ caturmukham  || 1,99.8 ||
prāhiṇoti sma tasyaiva jñānaṃ jñānamayo haraḥ  |
viśvādhiko'sau bhagavānardhanārīśvaro vibhuḥ  || 1,99.9 ||
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ devo jāyamānamapaśyata  |
so'pi rudraṃ mahādevaṃ brahmāpaśyata śaṅkaram  || 1,99.10 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsthitaṃ devamardhanārīśvaraṃ prabhum  |
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirvaradaṃ vārijodbhavaḥ  || 1,99.11 ||
vibhajasveti viśveśaṃ viśvātmānamajo vibhuḥ  |
sasarja devīṃ vāmāṅgātpatnīṃ caivātmanaḥ samām  || 1,99.12 ||
śraddhā hyasya śubhā patnī tataḥ puṃsaḥ purātanī  |
saivājñayā vibhordevī dakṣaputrī babhūva ha  || 1,99.13 ||
satīsaṃjñā tadā sā vai rudramevāśritā patim  |
dakṣaṃ vinindya kālena devī mainā hyabhūtpunaḥ  || 1,99.14 ||
nāradasyaiva dakṣo'pi śāpādevaṃ vinindya ca  |
avajñādurmado dakṣo devadevamumāpatim  || 1,99.15 ||
anādṛtya kṛtiṃ jñātvā satī dakṣeṇa tatkṣaṇāt |
bhasmīkṛtvātmano dehaṃ yogamārgeṇa sā punaḥ  || 1,99.16 ||
babhūva pārvatī devī tapasā ca gireḥ prabhoḥ  |
jñātvaitadbhagavān bhargo dadāha ruṣitaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,99.17 ||
dakṣasya vipulaṃ yajñaṃ cyāvanervacanādapi  |
cyavanasya suto dhīmān dadhīca iti viśrutaḥ  || 1,99.18 ||
vijitya viṣṇuṃ samare prasādāttryaṃbakasya ca  |
viṣṇunā lokapālāṃśca śaśāpa ca munīśvaraḥ  || 1,99.19 ||
rudrasya krodhajenaiva vahninā haviṣā surāḥ  |
vināśo vai kṣaṇādeva māyayā śaṅkarasya vai  || 1,99.20 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge devīsaṃbhavo nāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 100
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vijitya viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ bhagavānparameśvaraḥ  |
sarvāndadhīcavacanātkathaṃ bheje maheśvaraḥ  || 1,100.1 ||

sūta uvāca
dakṣayajñe suvipule devān viṣṇupurogamān  |
dadāha bhagavān rudraḥ sarvānmunigaṇānapi  || 1,100.2 ||
bhadro nāma gaṇastena preṣitaḥ parameṣṭhinā  |
viprayogena devyā vai duḥsahenaiva suvratāḥ  || 1,100.3 ||
so'sṛjadvīrabhadraśca gaṇeśānromajāñchubhān  |
gaṇeśvaraiḥ samāruhya rathaṃ bhadraḥ pratāpavān  || 1,100.4 ||
gantuṃ cakre matiṃ yasya sārathirbhagavānajaḥ  |
gaṇeśvarāśca te sarve vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ  || 1,100.5 ||
vimānairviśvato bhadraistamanvayuratho surāḥ  |
himavacchikhare ramye hemaśṛṅge suśobhane  || 1,100.6 ||
yajñavāṭastathā tasya gaṅgādvārasamīpataḥ  |
taddeśe caiva vikhyātaṃ śubhaṃ kanakhalaṃ dvijāḥ  || 1,100.7 ||
dagdhuṃ vai preṣitaścāsau bhagavān parameṣṭhinā  |
tadotpāto babhūvātha lokānāṃ bhayaśaṃsanaḥ  || 1,100.8 ||
parvatāśca vyaśīryanta pracakampe vasuṃdharā  |
marutaścāpyaghūrṇanta cukṣubhe makarālayaḥ  || 1,100.9 ||
agnayo naiva dīpyanti na ca dīpyati bhāskaraḥ  |
grahāśca na prakāśyante na devā na ca dānavāḥ  || 1,100.10 ||
tataḥ kṣaṇātpraviśyaiva yajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ  |
romajaiḥ sahito bhadraḥ kālāgnirivacāparaḥ  || 1,100.11 ||
uvāca bhadro bhagavān dakṣaṃ cāmitatejasam  |
saṃparkādeva dakṣādya munīndevān pinākinā  || 1,100.12 ||
dagdhuṃ saṃpreṣitaścāhaṃ bhavantaṃ samunīśvaraiḥ  |
ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ dadāha gaṇapuṅgavaḥ  || 1,100.13 ||
gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ  |
prastotrā saha hotrā ca dagdhaṃ caiva gaṇeśvaraiḥ  || 1,100.14 ||
gṛhītvā gaṇapāḥ sarvān gaṅgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ  |
vīrabhadro mahātejāḥ śakrasyodyacchataḥ karam  || 1,100.15 ||
vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām  |
bhagasya netre cotpāṭya karajāgreṇa līlayā  || 1,100.16 ||
nihatya muṣṭinā dantān pūṣṇaścaivaṃ nyapātayat |
tathā candramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā  || 1,100.17 ||
gharṣayāmāsa bhagavān vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān  |
cicheda ca śirastasya śakrasya bhagavānprabhoḥ  || 1,100.18 ||
vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā  |
jaghāna mūrdhni pādena vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ  || 1,100.19 ||
yamasya daṇḍaṃ bhagavān pracicheda svayaṃ prabhuḥ  |
jaghāna devamīśānaṃ triśūlena mahābalam  || 1,100.20 ||
trayastriṃśatsurānevaṃ vinihatyāprayatnataḥ  |
trayaśca triśataṃ teṣāṃ trisāhasraṃ ca līlayā  || 1,100.21 ||
trayaṃ caiva surendrāṇāṃ jaghāna ca munīśvarān  |
anyāṃśca devān devo'sau sarvānyuddhāya saṃsthitān  || 1,100.22 ||
jaghāna bhagavān rudraḥ khaḍgamuṣṭyādisāyakaiḥ  |
atha viṣṇurmahātejāścakramudyamya mūrchitaḥ  || 1,100.23 ||
yuyodha bhagavāṃstena rudreṇa saha mādhavaḥ  |
tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam  || 1,100.24 ||
viṣṇoryogabalāttasya divyadehāḥ sudāruṇāḥ  || 1,100.25 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāhastā asaṃkhyātāśca jajñire  |
tānsarvānapi devo'sau nārāyaṇasamaprabhān  || 1,100.26 ||
nihatya gadayā viṣṇuṃ tāḍayāmāsa mūrdhani  |
tataścorasi taṃ devaṃ līlayaiva raṇājire  || 1,100.27 ||
papāta ca tadā bhūmau visaṃjñaḥ puruṣottamaḥ  |
punarutthāya taṃ hantuṃ cakramudyamya sa prabhuḥ  || 1,100.28 ||
krodharaktekṣaṇaḥ śrīmānatiṣṭhatpuruṣarṣabhaḥ  |
tasya cakraṃ ca yadraudraṃ kālādityasamaprabham  || 1,100.29 ||
vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā karasthaṃ na cacāla saḥ  |
atiṣṭhatstambhitastena śṛṅgavāniva niścalaḥ  || 1,100.30 ||
tribhiśca dharṣitaṃ śārṅgaṃ tridhābhūtaṃ prabhostadā  |
śārṅgakoṭiprasaṅgādvai cicheda ca śiraḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,100.31 ||
chinnaṃ ca nipapātāsu śirastasya rasātale  |
vāyunā preritaṃ caiva prāṇajena pinākinā  || 1,100.32 ||
praviveśa tadā caiva tadīyāhavanīyakam  |
tatpratidhvastakalaśaṃ bhagnayūpaṃ satoraṇam  || 1,100.33 ||
pradīpitamahāśālaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajño'pi dudruve  |
taṃ tadā mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṃ gaganaṃ prati  || 1,100.34 ||
vīrabhadraḥ samādhāya viśiraskamathākarot |
tataḥ prajāpatiṃ dharmaṃ kaśyapaṃ ca jagadgurum  || 1,100.35 ||
ariṣṭaneminaṃ vīro bahuputraṃ munīśvaram  |
munimaṅgirasaṃ caiva kṛṣṇāśvaṃ ca mahābalaḥ  || 1,100.36 ||
jaghāna mūrdhni pādena dakṣaṃ caiva yaśasvinam  |
cicheda ca śirastasya dadāhāgnau dvijottamāḥ  || 1,100.37 ||
sarasvatyāśca nāsāgraṃ devamātustathaiva ca  |
nikṛtya karajāgreṇa vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān  || 1,100.38 ||
tasthau śriyā vṛto madhye pretasthāne yathā bhavaḥ  |
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,100.39 ||
bhadramāha mahātejāḥ prārthayanpraṇataḥ prabhuḥ  |
alaṃ krodhena vai bhadra naṣṭāścaiva divaukasaḥ  || 1,100.40 ||
prasīda kṣamyatāṃ sarvaṃ romajaiḥ saha suvrata  |
so'pi bhadraḥ prabhāveṇa brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,100.41 ||
śamaṃ jagāma śanakaiḥ śāntastasthau tadājñayā  |
devo'pi tatra bhagavānantarikṣe vṛṣadhvajaḥ  || 1,100.42 ||
sagaṇaḥ sarvadaḥ śarvaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ  |
prārthitaścaiva devena brahmaṇā bhagavān bhavaḥ  || 1,100.43 ||
hatānāṃ ca tadā teṣāṃ pradadau pūrvavattanum  |
indrasya ca śirastasya viṣṇoścaiva mahātmanaḥ  || 1,100.44 ||
dakṣasya ca munīndrasya tathānyeṣāṃ maheśvaraḥ  |
vāgīśyāścaiva nāsāgraṃ devamātustathaiva ca  || 1,100.45 ||
naṣṭānāṃ jīvitaṃ caiva varāṇi vividhāni ca  |
dakṣasya dhvastavaktrasya śirasā bhagavānprabhuḥ  || 1,100.46 ||
kalpayāmāsa vai vaktraṃ līlayā ca mahān bhavaḥ  |
dakṣo'pi labdhasaṃjñaśca samutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 1,100.47 ||
tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam  |
stutastena mahātejāḥ pradāya vividhānvarān  || 1,100.48 ||
gāṇapatyaṃ dadau tasmai dakṣāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe  |
devāśca sarve deveśaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram  || 1,100.49 ||
nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
brahmā ca munayaḥ sarve pṛthakpṛthagajodbhavam  || 1,100.50 ||
tuṣṭuvurdevadeveśaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ vṛṣadhvajam  |
tān devānanugṛhyaiva bhavo'pyantaradhīyata  || 1,100.51 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivakṛddakṣayajñavidhvaṃsano nāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________

liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 101

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ himavataḥ putrī babhūvāṃbā satī śubhā  |
kathaṃ vā devadeveśamavāpa patimīśvaram  || 1,101.1 ||

sūta uvāca
sā menātanumāśritya svecchayaiva varāṅganā  |
tadā haimavatī jajñe tapasā ca dvijottamāḥ  || 1,101.2 ||
jātakarmādikāḥ sarvāścakāra ca girīśvaraḥ  |
dvādaśe ca tadā varṣe pūrṇe haimavatī śubhā  || 1,101.3 ||
tapastepe tayā sārdhamanujā ca śubhānanā  |
anyā ca devī hyanujā sarvaloke namaskṛtā  || 1,101.4 ||
ṛṣayaśca tadā sarve sarvalokamaheśvarīm  |
tuṣṭuvustapasā devīṃ samāvṛtya samantataḥ  || 1,101.5 ||
jyeṣṭhā hyaparṇā hyanujā caikaparṇā śubhānanā  |
tṛtīyā ca varārohā tathā caivaikapāṭalā  || 1,101.6 ||
tapasā ca mahādevyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvaraḥ  |
vaśīkṛto mahādevaḥ sarvabhūtapatirbhavaḥ  || 1,101.7 ||
etasminneva kāle tu tārako nāma dānavaḥ  |
tārātmajo mahātejā babhūva ditinandanaḥ  || 1,101.8 ||
tasya putrāstrayaścāpi tārakākṣo mahāsuraḥ  |
vidyunmālī ca bhagavān kamalākṣaśca vīryavān  || 1,101.9 ||
pitāmahastathā caiṣāṃ tāro nāma mahābalaḥ  |
tapasā labdhavīryaśca prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ  || 1,101.10 ||
so'pi tāro mahātejāstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram  |
vijitya samare pūrvaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca jitavānasau  || 1,101.11 ||
tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam  |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu divārātramaviśramam  || 1,101.12 ||
sarathaṃ viṣṇumādāya cikṣepa śatayojanam  |
tāreṇa vijitaḥ saṃkhye dudrāva garuḍadhvajaḥ  || 1,101.13 ||
tāro varāñchataguṇaṃ labdhvā śataguṇaṃ balam  |
pitāmahājjagatsarvamavāpa ditinandanaḥ  || 1,101.14 ||
devendrapramukhāñjitvā devāndeveśvareśvaraḥ  |
vārayāmāsa tairdevān sarvalokeṣu māyayā  || 1,101.15 ||
devatāśca sahendreṇa tārakādbhayapīḍitāḥ  |
na śāntiṃ lebhire śūrāḥ śaraṇaṃ vā bhayārditāḥ  || 1,101.16 ||
tadāmarapatiḥ śrīmān saṃnipatyāmaraprabhuḥ  |
uvācāṅgirasaṃ devo devānāmapi saṃnidhau  || 1,101.17 ||
bhagavaṃstārako nāma tārajo dānavottamaḥ  |
tena saṃnihatā yuddhe vatsā gopatinā yathā  || 1,101.18 ||
bhayāttasmānmahābhāga bṛhadyuddhe bṛhaspate  |
aniketā bhramantyete śakuntā iva pañjare  || 1,101.19 ||
asmākaṃ yānyamoghāni āyudhānyaṅgiro vara  |
tāni moghāni jāyante prabhāvādamaradviṣaḥ  || 1,101.20 ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi dviguṇāni bṛhaspate  |
viṣṇunā yodhito yuddhe tenāpi na ca sūditaḥ  || 1,101.21 ||
yastenānirjito yuddhe viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā  |
kathamasmadvidhastasya sthāsyate samare'grataḥ  || 1,101.22 ||
evamuktastu śakreṇa jīvaḥ sārdhaṃ surādhipaiḥ  |
sahasrākṣeṇa ca vibhuṃ samprāpyāha kuśadhvajam  || 1,101.23 ||
so'pi tasya mukhācchrutvā praṇayātpraṇatārtihā  |
devairaśeṣaiḥ sendraistu jīvamāha pitāmahaḥ  || 1,101.24 ||
jāne vo'rtiṃ surendrāṇāṃ tathāpi śṛṇu sāṃpratam  |
vinindya dakṣaṃ yā devī satī rudrāṅgasaṃbhavā  || 1,101.25 ||
umā haimavatī jajñe sarvalokanamaskṛtā  |
tasyāścaiveha rūpeṇa yūyaṃ devāḥ surottamāḥ  || 1,101.26 ||
vibhoryatadhvamākraṣṭuṃ rudrasyāsya mano mahat |
tayoryogena sambhūtaḥ skandaḥ śaktidharaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,101.27 ||
ṣaḍāsyo dvādaśabhujaḥ senānīḥ pāvakiḥ prabhuḥ  |
svāheyaḥ kārtikeyaśca gāṅgeyaḥ śaradhāmajaḥ  || 1,101.28 ||
devaḥ śākho viśākhaśca naigameśaśca vīryavān  |
senāpatiḥ kumārākhyaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ  || 1,101.29 ||
līlayaiva mahāsenaḥ prabalaṃ tārakāsuram  |
bālo'pi vinihatyaiko devān saṃtārayiṣyati  || 1,101.30 ||
evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā  |
bṛhaspatistathā sendrairdevairdevaṃ praṇamya tam  || 1,101.31 ||
<śiva burnsKāma>
meroḥ śikharamāsādya smaraṃ sasmāra suvrataḥ  |
smaraṇāddevadevasya smaro'pi saha bhāryayā  || 1,101.32 ||
ratyā samaṃ samāgamya namaskṛtya kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
saśakramāha taṃ jīvaṃ jagajjīvo dvijottamāḥ  || 1,101.33 ||
smṛto yadbhavatā jīva samprāpto'haṃ tavāntikam  |
brūhi yanme vidhātavyaṃ tamāha surapūjitaḥ  || 1,101.34 ||
tamāha bhagavāñchakraḥ saṃbhāvya makaradhvajam  |
śaṅkareṇāṃbikāmadya saṃyojaya yathāsukham  || 1,101.35 ||
tayā sa ramate yena bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  |
tena mārgeṇa mārgasva patnyā ratyānayā saha  || 1,101.36 ||
so'pi tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ pradāsyati śubhāṃ gatim  |
viprayuktastayā pūrvaṃ labdhvā tāṃ girijāmumām  || 1,101.37 ||
evamukto namaskṛtya devadevaṃ śacīpatim  |
devadevāśramaṃ gantuṃ matiṃ cakre tayā saha  || 1,101.38 ||
gatvā tadāśraye śaṃbhoḥ saha ratyā mahābalaḥ  |
vasaṃtena sahāyena devaṃ yoktumanā bhavat || 1,101.39 ||
tataḥ samprekṣya madanaṃ hasan devastriyaṃbakaḥ  |
nayanena tṛtīyena sāvajñaṃ tamavaikṣata  || 1,101.40 ||
tato'sya netrajo vahnirmadanaṃ pārśvataḥ sthitam  |
adahattatkṣaṇādeva lalāpa karuṇaṃ ratiḥ  || 1,101.41 ||
ratyāḥ pralāpamākarṇya devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ  |
kṛpayā parayā prāha kāmapatnīṃ nirīkṣya ca  || 1,101.42 ||
amūrto'pi dhruvaṃ bhadre kāryaṃ sarvaṃ patistava  |
ratikāle dhruve bhadre kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ  || 1,101.43 ||
yadā viṣṇuśca bhavitā vāsudevo mahāyaśāḥ  |
śāpādbhṛgormahātejāḥ sarvalokahitāya vai  || 1,101.44 ||
tadā tasya suto yaśca sa patiste bhaviṣyati  |
sā praṇamya tadā rudraṃ kāmapatnī śucismitā  || 1,101.45 ||
jagāma madanaṃ labdhvā vasaṃtena samanvitā  || 1,101.46 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge madanadāho nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 102

sūta uvāca
tapasā ca mahādevyāḥ pārvatyā vṛṣabhadhvaja  |
prītiśca bhagavāñcharvo vacanādbrahmaṇastadā  || 1,102.1 ||
hitāya cāśramāṇāṃ ca krīḍārthaṃ bhagavānbhavaḥ  |
tadā haimavatīṃ devīmupayeme yathāvidhi  || 1,102.2 ||
jagāma sa svayaṃ brahmā marīcyādyairmaharṣibhiḥ  |
tapovanaṃ mahādevyāḥ pārvatyāḥ padmasaṃbhavaḥ  || 1,102.3 ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca tāṃ devīṃ sa jagato'raṇīm  |
kimarthaṃ tapasā lokān saṃtāpayasi śailaje  || 1,102.4 ||
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ mātastvaṃ mā vināśaya  |
tvaṃ hi saṃdhārayellokānimān sarvān svatejasā  || 1,102.5 ||
sarvadeveśvaraḥ śrīmān sarvalokapatirbhavaḥ  |
yasya vai devadevasya vayaṃ kiṅkaravādinaḥ  || 1,102.6 ||
sa evaṃ parameśānaḥ svayaṃ ca varayiṣyati  |
varade yena sṛṣṭāsi na vinā yastvayāṃbike  || 1,102.7 ||
vartate nātra saṃdehastava bharttā bhaviṣyati  |
ityuktvā tāṃ namaskṛtya muhuḥ samprekṣya pārvatīm  || 1,102.8 ||
gate pitāmahe devo bhagavān parameśvaraḥ  |
jagāmānugrahaṃ kartuṃ dvijarūpeṇa cāśramam  || 1,102.9 ||
sā ca dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ dvijarūpeṇa saṃsthitam  |
pratibhādyaiḥ prabhuṃ jñātvā nanāma vṛṣabhadhvajam  || 1,102.10 ||
sampūjya varadaṃ devaṃ brāhmaṇacchadmanāgatam  |
tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ pārvatī parameśvaram  || 1,102.11 ||
anugṛhya tadā devīmuvāca prahasanniva  |
kuladharmāśrayaṃ rakṣan bhūdharasya mahātmanaḥ  || 1,102.12 ||
krīḍārthaṃ ca satāṃ madhye sarvadevapatirbhavaḥ  |
svayaṃvare mahādevī tava divyasuśobhane  || 1,102.13 ||
āsthāya rūpaṃ yatsaumyaṃ sameṣye'haṃ saha tvayā  |
ityuktvā tāṃ samālokya devo divyena cakṣuṣā  || 1,102.14 ||
jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā divyaṃ svapuraṃ prayayau ca sā  |
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭastadā devīṃ menayā tuhinācalaḥ  || 1,102.15 ||
āliṅgyāghrāya sampūjya putrīṃ sākṣāttapasvinīm  |
duhiturdevadevena na jānannabhimantritam  || 1,102.16 ||
svayaṃvaraṃ tadā devyāḥ sarvalokeṣvaghoṣayat |
atha brahmā ca bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sākṣājjanārdanaḥ  || 1,102.17 ||
śakraśca bhagavān vahnirbhāskaro bhaga eva ca  |
tvaṣṭāryamā vivasvāṃśca yamo varuṇa eva ca  || 1,102.18 ||
vāyuḥ somastatheśāno rudrāśca munayastathā  |
aśvinau dvādaśādityā gandharvā garuḍastathā  || 1,102.19 ||
yakṣāḥ siddhāstathā sādhyā daityāḥ kiṃpuruṣoragāḥ  |
samudrāśca nadā vedā mantrāḥ stotrādayaḥ kṣaṇāḥ  || 1,102.20 ||
nāgāśca parvatāḥ sarve yajñāḥ sūryādayo grahāḥ  |
trayastriṃśacca devānāṃ trayaśca triśataṃ tathā  || 1,102.21 ||
trayaśca trisahasraṃ ca tathānye bahavaḥ surā  |
jagmurgirīndraputryāstu svayaṃvaramanuttamam  || 1,102.22 ||
atha śailasutā devī haimamāruhya śobhanam  |
vimānaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam  || 1,102.23 ||
apsarobhiḥ pranṛttābhiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ  |
gandharvasiddhairvividhaiḥ kinnaraiśca suśobhanaiḥ  || 1,102.24 ||
bandibhiḥ stūyamānā ca sthitā śailasutā tadā  |
sitātapatraṃ ratnāṃśu miśritaṃ cāvahattathā  || 1,102.25 ||
mālinī giriputryāstu saṃdhyā pūrṇendumaṇḍalam  |
cāmarāsaktahastābhirdivyastrībhiśca saṃvṛtā  || 1,102.26 ||
mālāṃ gṛhya jayā tasthau suradrumasamudbhavām  |
vijayā vyajanaṃ gṛhya sthitā devyāḥ samīpagā  || 1,102.27 ||
mālāṃ pragṛhya devyāṃ tu sthitāyāṃ devasaṃsadi  |
śiśurbhūtvā mahādevaḥ krīḍārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  || 1,102.28 ||
utsaṅgatalasaṃsupto babhūva bhagavānbhavaḥ  |
atha dṛṣṭvā śiśuṃ devāstasyā utsaṃgavarttinam  || 1,102.29 ||
ko'yamatreti saṃmantrya cukṣubhuśca samāgatāḥ  |
vajramāhārayattasya bāhumudyamya vṛtrahā  || 1,102.30 ||
sa bāhurudyamastasya tathaiva samupasthitaḥ  |
stambhitaḥ śiśurūpeṇa devadevena līlayā  || 1,102.31 ||
vajraṃ kṣeptuṃ na śaśāka bāhuṃ cālayituṃ tathā  |
vahniḥ śaktiṃ tathā kṣeptuṃ na śaśāka tathā sthitaḥ  || 1,102.32 ||
yamo'pi daṇḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca nirṛtirmunipuṅgavāḥ  |
varuṇo nāgapāśaṃ ca dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samīraṇaḥ  || 1,102.33 ||
somo gadāṃ dhaneśaśca daṇḍaṃ daṇḍabhṛtāṃ varaḥ  |
īśānaśca tathā śūlaṃ tīvramudyamya saṃsthitaḥ  || 1,102.34 ||
rudrāśca śūlamādityā muśalaṃ vasavastathā  |
mudgaraṃ stambhitāḥ sarve devenāśu divaukasaḥ  || 1,102.35 ||
stambhitā devadevena tathānye ca divaukasaḥ  |
śiraḥ prakampayan viṣṇuścakramudyamya saṃsthitaḥ  || 1,102.36 ||
tasyāpi śiraso bālaḥ sthiratvaṃ pracakāra ha  |
cakraṃ kṣeptuṃ na śaśāka bāhūṃścālayituṃ na ca  || 1,102.37 ||
pūṣā dantān daśan dantairbālamaikṣata mohitaḥ  |
tasyāpi daśanāḥ peturdṛṣṭamātrasya śaṃbhunā  || 1,102.38 ||
balaṃ tejaśca yogaṃ ca tathaivāstambhayadvibhuḥ  |
atha teṣu sthiteṣveva manyumatsu sureṣvapi  || 1,102.39 ||
brahmā paramasaṃvigno dhyānamāsthāya śaṅkaram  |
bubudhe devamīśānamumotsaṃge tamāsthitam  || 1,102.40 ||
sa buddhvā devamīśānaṃ śīghramutthāya vismitaḥ  |
vavande caraṇau śaṃbhorastuvacca pitāmahaḥ  || 1,102.41 ||
buddhistvaṃ sarvalokānāmahaṅkārastvamīśvaraḥ  |
bhūtānāmindriyāṇāṃ ca tvameveśa pravarttakaḥ  || 1,102.42 ||
tavāhaṃ dakṣiṇāddhastātsṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ purātanaḥ  |
vāmahastānmahābāho devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,102.43 ||
iyaṃ ca prakṛtirdevī sadā te sṛṣṭikāraṇa  |
patnīrūpaṃ samāsthāya jagatkāraṇamāgatā  || 1,102.44 ||
namastubhyaṃ mahādeva mahādevyai namonamaḥ  |
prasādāttava deveśa niyogācca mayā prajāḥ  || 1,102.45 ||
devādyāstu imāḥ sṛṣṭā mūḍhāstvadyogamohitāḥ  |
kuru prasādameteṣāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ bhavantvime  || 1,102.46 ||

sūta uvāca
vijñāpyaivaṃ tadā brahmā devadevaṃ maheśvaram  |
saṃstambhitāṃstadā tena bhagavānāha padmajaḥ  || 1,102.47 ||
mūḍhāstha devatāḥ sarvā naiva budhyata śaṅkaram  |
devadevamihāyāntaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam  || 1,102.48 ||
gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ  |
sanārāyaṇakāḥ sarve munibhiḥ śaṅkaraṃ prabhum  || 1,102.49 ||
sārdhaṃ mayaiva deveśaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram  |
anayā haimavatyā ca prakṛtyā saha sattamam  || 1,102.50 ||
tatra te stambhitāstena tathaiva surasattamāḥ  |
praṇemurmanasā sarve sanārāyaṇakāḥ prabhum  || 1,102.51 ||
atha teṣāṃ prasanno bhūddevadevastriyaṃbakaḥ  |
yathāpūrvaṃ cakārāśu vacanādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,102.52 ||
tata evaṃ prasanne tu sarvadevanivāraṇam  |
vapuścakāra deveśo divyaṃ paramamadbhutam  || 1,102.53 ||
tejasā tasya devāste sendracandradivākarāḥ  |
sabrahmakāḥ sasādhyāśca sanārāyaṇakāstathā  || 1,102.54 ||
sayamāśca sarudrāśca cakṣuraprārthayan vibhum  |
tebhyaśca paramaṃ cakṣuḥ sarvadṛṣṭau ca śaktimat || 1,102.55 ||
dadāvaṃbāpatiḥ śarvo bhavānyāśca calasya ca  |
labdhvā cakṣustadā devā indraviṣṇupurogamāḥ  || 1,102.56 ||
sabrahmakaḥ saśakrāśca tamapaśyanmaheśvaram  |
brahmādyā nemire tūrṇaṃ bhavānī ca girīśvaraḥ  || 1,102.57 ||
munayaśca mahādevaṃ gaṇeśāḥ śivasaṃmatāḥ  |
sasarjuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ  || 1,102.58 ||
devadundubhayo nedustuṣṭuvurmunayaḥ prabhum  |
jagurgandharvamukhyāśca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ  || 1,102.59 ||
mumuhurgaṇapāḥ sarve mumodāṃbā ca pārvatī  |
tasya devī tadā hṛṣṭā samakṣaṃ tridivaukasām  || 1,102.60 ||
pādayoḥ sthāpayāmāsa mālāṃ divyāṃ sugandhinīm  |
sādhu sādhviti samprocya tayā tatraiva cārcitam  || 1,102.61 ||
saha devyā namaścakruḥ śirobhirbhūtalāśritaiḥ  |
sarve sabrahmakā devāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ  || 1,102.62 ||

iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge umāsvayaṃvaro nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ



_______________________________________________________________


liṅgapurāṇam‌ 1, 103

sūta uvāca
atha brahmā mahādevamabhivandya kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
udvāhaḥ kriyatāṃ deva ityuvāca maheśvaram  || 1,103.1 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
yatheṣṭamiti lokeśaṃ prāha bhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ  || 1,103.2 ||
udvāhārthaṃ maheśasya tatkṣaṇādeva suvratāḥ  |
brahmaṇā kalpitaṃ divyaṃ puraṃ ratnamayaṃ śubham  || 1,103.3 ||
athāditirditiḥ sākṣāddanuḥ kadruḥ sukālikā  |
pulomā surasā caiva siṃhikā vinatā tathā  || 1,103.4 ||
siddhirmāyā kriyā durgā devī sākṣātsudhā svadhā  |
sāvitrī vedamātā ca rajanī dakṣiṇā dyutiḥ  || 1,103.5 ||
svāhā svāhāmatirbuddhirṛddhirvṛddhiḥ sarasvatī  |
rākā kuhūḥ sinīvālī devī anumatī tathā  || 1,103.6 ||
dharaṇī dhāraṇī celā śacī nārāyaṇī tathā  |
etāścānyāśca devānāṃ mātaraḥ patnayastathā  || 1,103.7 ||
udvāhaḥ śaṅkarasyeti jagmuḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ  |
uragā garuḍā yakṣā gandharvāḥ kinnarā gaṇāḥ  || 1,103.8 ||
sāgarā girayo meghā māsāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā  |
vedā mantrāstathā yajñāḥ stomā dharmāśca sarvaśaḥ  || 1,103.9 ||
huṅkāraḥ praṇavaścaiva pratihārāḥ sahasraśaḥ  |
koṭirapsaraso divyāstāsāṃ ca paricārikāḥ  || 1,103.10 ||
yāśca sarveṣu dvīpeṣu devalokeṣu nimnagāḥ  |
tāśca strīvigrahāḥ sarvāḥ saṃjagmurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ  || 1,103.11 ||
gaṇapāśca mahābhāgāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ  |
udvāhaḥ śaṅkarasyeti tatrājagmurmudānvitāḥ  || 1,103.12 ||
abhyayuḥ śaṅkhavarṇāśca gaṇakoṭyo gaṇeśvarāḥ  |
daśabhiḥ kekarākṣaśca vidyuto'ṣṭābhireva ca  || 1,103.13 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭyā viśākhāśca navabhiḥ pārayātrikaḥ  |
ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvāntakaḥ śrīmān tathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ  || 1,103.14 ||
jvālākeśo dvādaśabhiḥ koṭibhirgaṇapuṅgavaḥ  |
saptabhiḥ samadaḥ śrīmān dundubho'ṣṭābhireva ca  || 1,103.15 ||
pañcabhiśca kapālīśaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃdārakaḥ śubhaḥ  |
koṭikoṭibhireveha gaṇḍakaḥ kuṃbhakastathā  || 1,103.16 ||
viṣṭambho'ṣṭābhireveha gaṇapaḥ sarvasattamaḥ  |
pippalaśca sahasreṇa saṃnādaśca tathā dvijāḥ  || 1,103.17 ||
āveṣṭanastathāṣṭābhiḥ saptabhiścandratāpanaḥ  |
mahākeśaḥ sahasreṇa koṭīnāṃ gaṇapo vṛtaḥ  || 1,103.18 ||
kuṇḍī dvādaśabhirvīrastathā parvatakaḥ śubhaḥ  |
kālaśca kālakaścaiva mahākālaḥ śatena vai  || 1,103.19 ||
āgnikaḥ śatakoṭyā vai koṭyāgnimukha eva ca  |
ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca tathā caiva dhanāvahaḥ  || 1,103.20 ||
saṃnāmaśca śatenaiva kumudaḥ koṭibhistathā  |
amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā sumantrakaḥ  || 1,103.21 ||
kākapāṭo'paraḥ ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā saṃtānakaḥ prabhuḥ  |
mahābalaśca navabhirmadhupiṅgaśca piṅgalaḥ  || 1,103.22 ||
nīlo navatyā deveśaḥ pūrṇabhadrastathaiva ca  |
koṭīnāṃ caiva saptatyā caturvaktro mahābalaḥ  || 1,103.23 ||
koṭikoṭisahasrāṇāṃ śatairviṃśatibhirvṛtāḥ  |
tatrājagmustathā devāste sarve śaṅkaraṃ bhavam  || 1,103.24 ||
bhūtakoṭisahasreṇa pramathaḥ koṭibhistribhiḥ  |
vīrabhadraścatuḥṣaṣṭyā romajāścaiva koṭibhiḥ  || 1,103.25 ||
karaṇaścaiva viṃśatyā navatyā kevalaḥ śubhaḥ  |
pañcākṣaḥ śatamanyuśca meghamanyustathaiva ca  || 1,103.26 ||
kāṣṭhakūṭaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sukeśo vṛṣabhastathā  |
virūpākṣaśca bhagavān catuḥṣaṣṭyā sanātanaḥ  || 1,103.27 ||
tāluketuḥ ṣaḍāsyaśca pañcāsyaśca sanātanaḥ  |
saṃvartakastathā caitro lakulīśaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ  || 1,103.28 ||
lokāntakaśca dīptāsyastathā daityāntakaḥ prabhuḥ  |
mṛtyuhṛtkālahā kālo mṛtyuñjayakarastathā  || 1,103.29 ||
viṣādo viṣadaścaiva vidyutaḥ kāntakaḥ prabhuḥ  |
devo bhṛṅgī riṭiḥ śrīmān devadevapriyastathā  || 1,103.30 ||
aśanirbhāsakaścaiva catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahasrapāt |
ete cānye ca gaṇapā asaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ  || 1,103.31 ||
sarve sahasrahastāśca jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ  |
candrarekhāvataṃsāśca nīlakaṇṭhāstrilocanāḥ  || 1,103.32 ||
hārakuṇḍalakeyūra mukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtāḥ  |
brahmendraviṣṇusaṃkāśā aṇimādiguṇairvṛtāḥ  || 1,103.33 ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśāstatrājagmurgaṇeśvarāḥ  |
pātālacāriṇaścaiva sarvalokanivāsinaḥ  || 1,103.34 ||
tuṃbarurnārado hāhā hūhūścaiva tu sāmagāḥ  |
ratnānyādāya vādyāṃśca tatrājagmustadā puram  || 1,103.35 ||
ṛṣayaḥ kṛtsnaśastatra devagītāstapodhanāḥ  |
puṇyān vaivāhikānmantrānajapurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ  || 1,103.36 ||
tata evaṃ pravṛtte tu sarvataśca samāgame  |
girijāṃ tāmalaṃkṛtya svayameva śucismitām  || 1,103.37 ||
puraṃ praveśayāmāsa svayamādāya keśavaḥ  |
sadasyāha ca deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamajo harim  || 1,103.38 ||
bhavānagre samutpanno bhavānyā saha daivataiḥ  |
vāmāṅgādasya rudrasya dakṣiṇāṅgādahaṃ prabho  || 1,103.39 ||
manmūrtistuhinādrīśo yajñārthaṃ sṛṣṭa eva hi  |
eṣā haimavatī jajñe māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 1,103.40 ||
śrautasmārtapravṛttyarthamudvāhārthamihāgataḥ  |
ato'sau jagatāṃ dhātrī dhātā tava mamāpi ca  || 1,103.41 ||
asya devasya rudrasya mūrtibhirvihitaṃ jagat |
kṣmābagnikhendusūryātma pavanātmā yato bhavaḥ  || 1,103.42 ||
tathāpi tasmai dātavyā vacanācca girermama  |
eṣā hyajā śuklakṛṣṇā lohitā prakṛtirbhavān  || 1,103.43 ||
śreyo'pi śailarājena saṃbandho'yaṃ tavāpi ca  |
tava pādme samudbhūtaḥ kalpe nābhyaṃbujādaham  || 1,103.44 ||
madaṃśasyāsya śailasya mamāpi ca gururbhavān  |

sūta uvāca
bāḍhamityajamāhāsau devadevo janārdanaḥ  || 1,103.45 ||
devāśca munayaḥ sarve devadevaśca śaṅkaraḥ  |
tataścotthāya vidvānsaḥ padmanābhaḥ praṇamya tām  || 1,103.46 ||
pādau prakṣālya devasya karābhyāṃ kamalekṣaṇaḥ  |
abhyukṣadātmano mūrdhni brahmaṇaśca girestathā  || 1,103.47 ||
tvadīyaiṣā vivāhārthaṃ menajā hyanujā mama  |
ityuktvā sodakaṃ dattvā devīṃ deveśvarāya tām  || 1,103.48 ||
svātmānamapi devāya sodakaṃ pradadau hariḥ  |
atha sarve muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvavedārthapāragāḥ  || 1,103.49 ||
ūcurdātā gṛhītā ca phalaṃ dravyaṃ vicārataḥ  |
eṣa devo haro nūnaṃ māyayā hi tato jagat || 1,103.50 ||
ityuktvā taṃ praṇemuśca prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ  |
sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ  || 1,103.51 ||
devadundubhayo nedurnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ  |
vedāśca mūrtimantaste praṇemustaṃ maheśvaram  || 1,103.52 ||
brahmaṇā munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ devadevamumāpatim  |
devo'pi devīmālokya salajjāṃ himaśailajām  || 1,103.53 ||
na tṛpyatyanavadyāṅgī sā ca devaṃ vṛṣadhvajam  |
varado'smīti taṃ prāha hariṃ so'pyāha śaṅkaram  || 1,103.54 ||
tvayi bhaktiḥ prasīdeti brahmākhyāṃ ca dadau tu saḥ  |
tatastu punarevāha brahmā vijñāpayanprabhum  || 1,103.55 ||
havirjuhomi vahnau tu upādhyāyapade sthitaḥ  |
dadāsi mama yadyājñāṃ kartavyo hyakṛto vidhiḥ  || 1,103.56 ||
tamāha śaṅkaro devaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ  |
yadyadiṣṭaṃ suraśreṣṭha tatkuruṣva yathepsitam  || 1,103.57 ||
kartāsmi vacanaṃ sarvaṃ devadeva pitāmaha  |
tataḥ praṇamya hṛṣṭātmā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ  || 1,103.58 ||
hastaṃ devasya devyāśca yuyoja paramaṃ prabhuḥ  |
jvalanaśca svayaṃ tatra kṛtāñjalirupasthitaḥ  || 1,103.59 ||
śrautairetairmahāmantrairmūrtimadbhirupasthitaiḥ  |
yathoktavidhinā hutvā lājānapi yathākramam  || 1,103.60 ||
ānītānviṣṇunā viprān sampūjya vividhairvaraiḥ  |
triśca taṃ jvalanaṃ devaṃ kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam  || 1,103.61 ||
muktvā hastasamāyogaṃ sahitaiḥ sarvadaivataiḥ  |
suraiśca mānavaiḥ sarvaiḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā  || 1,103.62 ||
nanāma bhagavānbrahmā devadevamumāpatim  |
tataḥ pādyaṃ tayordattvā śaṃbhorācamanaṃ tathā  || 1,103.63 ||
madhuparkaṃ tathā gāṃ ca praṇamya ca punaḥ śivam  |
atiṣṭhadbhagavānbrahmā devairindrapurogamaiḥ  || 1,103.64 ||
bhṛgvādyamunayaḥ sarve cākṣataistilataṇḍulaiḥ  |
sūryādayaḥ samabhyarcya tuṣṭuvurvṛṣabhadhvajam  || 1,103.65 ||
śivaḥ samāpya devoktaṃ vahnimāropya cātmani  |
tayā samāgato rudraḥ sarvalokahitāya vai  || 1,103.66 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi bhavodvāhaṃ śucismitaḥ  |
śrāvayedvā dvijāñchuddhān vedavedāṅgapāragān  || 1,103.67 ||
sa labdhvā gāṇapatyaṃ ca bhavena saha modate  |
yatrāyaṃ kīrtyate vipraistāvadāste tadā bhavaḥ  || 1,103.68 ||
tasmātsampūjya vidhivatkīrtayennānyathā dvijāḥ  |
udvāhe ca dvijendrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 1,103.69 ||
kīrtanīyamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhavodvāhamanuttamam  |
kṛtodvāhastadā devyā haimavatyā vṛṣadhvajaḥ  || 1,103.70 ||
sagaṇo nandinā sārdhaṃ sarvadevagaṇairvṛtaḥ  |
purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ divyāmājagāma mahādyutiḥ  || 1,103.71 ||
avimukte sukhāsīnaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam  |
apṛcchatkṣetramāhātmyaṃ bhavānī harṣitānanā  || 1,103.72 ||
athāhārdhendutilakaḥ kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam  |
avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ vistarācchakyate nahi  || 1,103.73 ||
vaktuṃ mayā sureśāni ṛṣisaṃghābhipūjitam  |
kiṃ mayā varṇyate devī hyavimuktaphalodayaḥ  || 1,103.74 ||
pāpināṃ yatra muktiḥ syānmṛtānāmekajanmanā  |
anyatra tu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ vyapohati  || 1,103.75 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ paiśācyanarakāvaham  |
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi piśācatvaṃ varaṃ nṛṇām  || 1,103.76 ||
na tu śakrasahasratvaṃ svarge kāśīpurīṃ vinā  |
yatra triviṣṭapo devo yatra viśveśvaro vibhuḥ  || 1,103.77 ||
oṃkāreśaḥ kṛttivāsā mṛtānāṃ na punarbhavaḥ  |
uktvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepācchaśiśekharaḥ  || 1,103.78 ||
darśayāmāsa codyānaṃ parityajya gaṇeśvarān  |
tatraiva bhagavān jāto gajavaktro vināyakaḥ  || 1,103.79 ||
daityānāṃ vighnarūpārthamavighnāya divaukasām  |
